tei:div.tei:p: ra 6 77777 /rgya 7 rgya0770 0 ba ṇaca gli ciX ba bab jaX d+ku—7 jib 'ji
༄mdo sde/༷dzi
(64)krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi bka' bstan dpe sdur khang gis dpe bsdur zhus/krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang /

mdo sde/ (mi (64)02go 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 3lots+tsha ba ban de rin chen 'tsho dang /chos nyid tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(275) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(313)0250 'phags pa sprin chen po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 314dang po/ lha thams cad 'dus pa zhes bya ba ste phung po'i le'u/ 314gnyis pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi le'u/ 384gsum pa/ gzungs kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 425bzhi pa/ ldem po ngag gi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 428lnga pa/ srid par skye ba'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 430drug pa/ 'khor ba nyon mongs pa'i zhing gi las kyi sa 'thob pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 431

bdun pa/ ye shes la rmongs pa gzud pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 432brgyad pa/ ye shes zab mo brtan pa 'thob pa la 'jug pa'i rnam pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 433dgu pa / rnam par thar pa'i bsod nams kyi mdzod kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 433bcu pa/ bsod nams kyi rnam pa yongs su brjod pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 434bcu gcig pa/ sprin chen po'i tshogs nam mkha' las 'byung ba'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 435bcu gnyis pa/ glog gi 'od cikyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 436bcu gsum pa/ sprin chen po'i glog 'gyu ba dang ldan zhing mun pa 'joms pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 437bcu bzhi pa/ sprin chen po'i glog gi sgyu 'phrul gyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 438bcwa lnga pa/ cho 'phrul chen po'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 439bcu drug pa/ chos kyi thog tog gi 'bel ba'i gtam gyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 440bcu bdun pa/ ye shes rdo rje'i rnam pa la 'jug pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 441bcwa brgyad pa/ longs spyod mi zad pa'i rnam pa la 'jug pa rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal po'i chos kyi sgo'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 442bcu dgu pa/ yang dag pa'i lam gyi rnam pa mngon par mtshon pa la 'jug pa'i chos kyi sgo'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 443nyi shu pa/ phra zhing zab pa'i gleng gzhi'i rnam pa la 'jug pa'i le'u/ 444nyi shu gcig pa/ seng ge rnam par rtse ba la dmigs pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 444nyi shu gnyis pa/ mtshams sbyar ba tshogs pa'i rnam pa 'jig rten dang 'thun par 'jug par bya ba la 'jug pa'i mdo'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 446nyi shu gsum pa/ mngon par rtse ba rin po che'i mdzod la 'jug pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 4472

nyi shu bzhi pa/ nam mkha' lding gi rtsal chen po'i stobs la 'jug pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 448nyi shu lnga pa/ sgra chen po'i dus rnam par bsgrags pa bkod pa'i rgyal po'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 4gnyi shu drug pa/ mi 'jigs pa chen po'i stobs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa la 'jug pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 450nyi shu bdun pa/ gnas kyi rnam pa dang bcas pa yangs pa'i chos kyi sgo'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 451nyi shu brgyad pa/ lhag pa'i bsam pa'i cho ga la 'jug pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 452nyi shu dgu pa/ dmag chen po dpa' ba'i rgyal po stobs bkod pa'i gling gzhi'i le'u/ 452sum cu pa/ bzang po'i rnam pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal po la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sgo'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 453sum cu gcig pa/ rtse ba dang bcas pa yang dag par sbas pa ston pa'i dpung bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 454sum cu gnyis pa/ ye shes rtsom pa'i cho ga la zhugs pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 456sum cu gsum pa/ ye shes kyi nor bsgrims te bsgrub pa'i mdzod kyi gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 456sum cu bzhi pa/ yang dag pa'i mchod sbyin la phan pa'i cho ga bkod pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 457sum cu lnga pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yang dag pa'i sa bon rab tu skyed pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 458sum cu drug pa/ de kho na'i snying po'i tshul gyis mngon par rtse ba la dga' ba'i rgyal po'i rnam par 'phrul pa la 'jug pa'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 4593

sum cu bdun pa/ dam pa'i chos kyi dkyil 'khor gyi phung po'i le'u/ 460rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo rnyi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(569) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(598)0251 'phags pa sprin chen po'i mdo las phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dga' ston chen po la rtse ba zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 599rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren dra bo snyi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba bad de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(675) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(682)0252 'phags pa sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 683rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /su ren+d+ra bo rnyi dang /zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(697 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(697)0253 'phags pa sprin chen po/ 698rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /shrī len dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab/

bsdur mchan/(730) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(736)0254 bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba sgrub pa'i don mngon par thob pa'i rgyu byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo le'u stong phrag bcu pa las le'u bcu pa/ 737bsdur mchan/(792) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(801)0255 gtsug tor chen po bam po dgu pa las bdud kyi le'u nyi tshe phyung ba/ 802bsdur mchan/(830) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(836)glo dkar ga gi zur ma na/ chos tshan (0254)pa'i mtshan byang rgyas drags pas thod yig tu bsdus te bkod yod/
tsho

༄ga /'phags pa dgon mchog sprin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo①/)lhun /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya rad na me gha nāsam ma hā yā na sru tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'ashethams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das yul ga yalgen ga yalgemago'i ri la dge slong bdun khri nyis stong gi/ dudage 'dun chen po dgashedang thabs cigashetu bzhugs te/ thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang dang ldan par gyur pa/sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba/ cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/bka' yang dag pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/ sems kyi dbang thams 64—3

cad kyi dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa/ chos kyi dbyings la mkhas pa/ chos kyi rgyal po'i sras/ sems rnyed pa dang / bkur ste7thams cad dang bral ba/legs par rab tu byung ba/ legs par bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ brnag pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i 5gelam la gnas pa sha stag ste/gang zag gcig ma gtogs pa ni 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' brgyad khri bzhi stong gi byang chub sems dpa'ikhutshogs chen po dang yang thabs cig ste/ thams cad kyang skye ba gcig gis thogasalgepa/thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mngon du phyogs pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la gzhol ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la 'bab pa⑤/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la babasdo0)pa/ chags patswamed pa'i gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin thob pa/dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la shin tu gnas pa/ mngon par shes pa chen pos rnam par rol pa/ lam gyi rgyun ma bcad pa/ sgrib pa dang / chod pa dang / kun nas ldang ba thams cad dang bral ba/ byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen pos phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par byed pa/sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas par 'gro ba la mkhas pa/ stong pa nyid spyod yul ba / mtshan ma med pa la gnas pa/ smon lam la gnas pa thams cad dang bral ba/ sems can thams cad la phan par brtson pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yul thams cad la mkhas pa ye shes mtha' yas pa/ sems nam mkha' dang mtshungs pal/ sems rgya mtsho ltar zab pa/ sems ri'i rgyal po ri rab ltar mi sgul ba/sems pad ma7ltar ma gos pa/ sems rin po che ltar shin tu yongs su dag pa/sems gser ltar shin tu yongs su byang ba rnams la 'di lta ste/ byang chub 64—4

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin po che'i7dpal dang / lag na rdo rje rin po che dang / lag na phyag rgya rin po che dang / rin po che'i cod pan dang /gtsug na rin po che dang / rin po che brtsegs pa dang / rin po che 'byung gnas dang / rin po che'i rtse mo dang / rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang / rdo rje'i snying po dang / gser gyi snying po dang / rin po che'i snying po dang /dpal gyi snying po dang / dge ba'i snying po dang / dge ba dri ma med pa'i snying po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang / ye shes kyi snying po dang / nyi ma'i snying po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi snying po dang / pad ma'i snying po dang /rnam par grol ba'i zla ba dang / kun tu zla ba dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang po dang / mthu chen thobasnyedang / kun tu bzang po dang / kun nas mig dang / pad ma'i mig dang / dri ma med pa'i mig dang / yangs pa'i mig dang / kun tu spyod lam dang / kun tu mdzesasnyedang / kun tu spyod pa'i blo gros dang / ye shes kyi blo gros dang / chos kyi blo gros dang / rgyal ba'i blo gros dang / bla ma'i blo gros dang / rdo rje'i blo gros dang / khyad par blo gros dang / seng ge rnam par rol pa dang / sgra chen po'ikhudabyangs kyi rgyal po dang /seng ge'i sgra sgrogs dang / sgra dbyangs brjod pa zab mo sgrogasashedang / gos ga⑧med dang / dri ma kun bral dang / zla ba'i 'od dang / nyi ma'i 'od dang /ye shes kyi 'od dang / ye shes kyi dpal dang / bzang po'i dpal dang / zla ba'i dpal dang / pad ma'i dpal dang / rin po che'i dpal dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang / bzang skyong la sogs pa skyes bu dam pa bcu drug dang / byams pa la sogs pa bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' 64—5

sems dpa' chen po thams cad dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs pa rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin la sogs pa sum cushertsa gsum gyisaris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang / lha'i bu shin tu gnod bral la las sogs pa gnod bral gyi lha'i bu rnams dang / lha'i bu kun tu dga' ldan la sogs pa dga' ldan gyisheris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang / lha'i bu shin tu 'phrul dga' la sogs pa 'phrul dga'i ris kyi lha'i bu rnams dang / lha'i bu dbang byed la sogs pa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu rnams dang / ded dpon la sogs pa dkar po'i phyogs kyi bdud kyi bu rnams dang / tshangs pa chen po la sogs pa tshangs pa'i ris kyi lha'i bu thams cad dang / lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu thams cad dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs〈ris dang / /stobs can dang / nor sbyin dang / de dag la sogs pa lha ma yin brgya stong7du ma dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang /gzi can dang / rgya mtsho dang / mtha' yas dang / nor rgyas kyi dushedang /de dag la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po brgya stong du ma dang / dpal gyi gzi brjid la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po'i khye'u brgya stong du ma dang / klu'i bu mo mang po rnams dang ske/ de ma yin pa gzhan lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang ske/ lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po brgya stong dgaphudang yang thabs cig go/ /yang de'i tshe ga yalgen ga yalgemago'i ri'i dpag tshad bzhi kho ra khorarwanyeyug tu skra'i rtse mo'i cha shas kyi rdul phra rab tsam yang gang lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha'7lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang /64—6

mi dang mi ma yin pa dag gis ma gang bar gyur pa'i sa'i phyogs sam/ bar snang gi phyogs de med do/ /'khor de lta bu 'dus shing 'khod pa'i dbus na bcom ldan 'das kyinyeseng ge'i khri 'phang du dpag tshad gcig /khokhur khor yug tu dpag tshad phyed pa la lha'i ras bcos bu ③du ma ni bting / rin po che'i dril bu g.yer kha'i rjodra bas ni bla re 0bres/ dar gyi lda ldi brgya stong du ma ni dpyangasaX / me tog sil mas ni gtor ba zhig bshams te/ seng ge'i khri de'i khokhur khor yug gi sa'i phyogs de dngosaphurdo rje la yid du 'ong zhing lag mthil ltar mnyam pa dang / chag chag legs par btab pa dang / phyag dar legs par byas pa dang / dri rab tu zhim zhing lha'i me tog brgya stong du masashegator bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis yongs su longs spyad pa'i phyir phyogs de na gser gyi pad ma shing rta'i 'khor lo tsam/ 'dab ma brgya stong du ma yod pa/chu ba ni be+e drur+ya(nye/ snying po ni yin dra 55)la/ ze ba ni amatshwanyegar bha ste/ dri rab tu zhim zhing yid du 'ong la reg na dga' bar 'gyur ba dag skyes par gyur to/ /seng ge'i khri de'i grwa7bzhir ha cang yang mi ring / ha cang yang mi nye ba nas rin po che'i shing srid du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis/ sboms su rgyang grags gnyis kyis 'khor ba bzhi skyes so/ /seng ge'i khri legs par bshams pa de la bcom ldan 'das blo ni rab tu rnam par dag /chos kyi 'khor lo ni rab tu bskor / bdud dang phyir rgol ba ni bcom/ 'jig rten gyi chos rnams kyis ni ma gos la mi bsnyengs shing mi 'dzem ste/ seng ge ltar bag tsha ba med pa/ mtsho dang 'dra bar dang ste rnyog pa med cing shin tu rnam par dang ba8/ rgya mtsho chen po (nyeltar zab cing gting dpag dka'apha 7la rin po che'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa/64—7

ri rab ltar mngon par 'phags pa/ nyi ma ltar rab tu lhan pa/ zla ba ltar rab tu sim pa/ klu chen po ltar chos kyi charatumangon par 'bebs pa tshangs pa chen po ltar 'jig rten kun las mngon par 'phags pa/ slob ma shin tu dul ba'i tshogs mtha' yas pa'i 'khor mnga' ba/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang ske/ 'jig rten skyong ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong rnams kyis zhal du bltas shing ma khengs ma dud par ②bzhugs te/ 'khor tshogs pa de na lham ②me/lhan ne/ lhang nge'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nge ba'i dbu'i gtsug gi gtsug tor gyi gseb nas 'od zer kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba 'od zer gyi 'khor brgya stong phrag du ma yod pa byung ste/ de byung nas0phyogs bcu thams cad du 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byam thams cad snang bar byas te/phyir 'ongs nas bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas zhugasalgenas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo phye ba'am btsums ⑨par yang mi mngon no/ /'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od nam mkha'i khams thams cad kyi gseb tu zhugs kyang nam mkha'i khams kyi gseb 37 phye ba'am btsums pararwanyemi mngon pa de bzhin du/ de'i tshe na 'od zer de dag zhugs kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo phye ba'am btsumasalgepar mi mngon no/ /'di lta ste dper na/ bye ma'i phung po la mar ram 'bru mar ram/chu zhugs na mi mngon pa de bzhin du/ de'i tshe na 'od zer de dag zhugs kyang phye ba'am btsumasalgepar mi mngon no/ /de nas shar phyogs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na/ pad ma can zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams de na8/ pad ma'i spyan zhes bya ba de 64—8

bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang rkang par ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi stiston pa/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la 'di lta ste/ theg pa gcig las7brtsams nas chos ston te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dag dang / nyan thos kyi theg pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'i ming yang med/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na rdzus te skye ba ma gtogs par bud med dang / mngal na gnas te 'byung zhing skye ba'i sgra yangasami grag go/ /'jig rten gyi khams de'i sems can de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sha stag go/ /'jig rten gyi khams de na bza' ba dang ske/ btung ba dang / zas kyi bya ba yang mi shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang bsam gtan gyi dga' ba'i zas can dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dga' ba'i zas can dang / chos kyi dga' ba'i zas can no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de nyid kyi 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams de khyab cing dri ma med par gyur pa ma gtogs par 'jig rten gyi khams de na zla ba dang / nyi ma dang /gza' dang / skar ma rnams kyi 'od kyang mi shes so/ /'jig rten gyi khams de lag mthil bzhin du mnyam par gyur pa las 'jig rten gyi khams de na rtswa dang /shing dang / bong ba dang / rtsig pa dang / ri la sogs pa yang mi snang ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams de 'dra ba de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba de'i ming thos pa tsam gyis sems 64—9

can gyi sgrib pa thams cad zad par 'gyur ba zhig gnas te/ de 'od des reg ste bskul nas/ rang gi gnas nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i spyan detug la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshalasate/ pad ma'i snying po la phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag kyang 'od des reg ste bskul ba dang / rang rang gi gnas nas byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i spyan desheg la ba der dong ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das de'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ pad ma'i snying po la so so ci rigs par 'khod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga pad ma'i snying po la btsugs nas/ bco ma ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i spyan ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta bu'i 'od bzang po dri ma mkhumachis pa rnam par dag pa/ yid du mchi ba lus dang sems shin tu dga' bar bgyid par ⑥byung ba 'di bu'i mthu lags zhes50de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i spyan des byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la 'di skad ces bka' stsal toni/ /rigs kyi bu nub7phyogs na sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na mi mjed ces bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na shākya thub pa zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig 64—10

pa dang / rkang par ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/skyes bu 'dul ba'i7kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyilaston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasasnyede'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis sems can rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba zhig bzhugs te/ des 'od bzang po dri ma med pa/ rnam par dag pa yid du 'ong ba/ lus dang sems shin tu rnam par dga' bar0byed pa 'di phyung ngo / /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i spyan de la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa de'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis sems can rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i spyan des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to / /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa des sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na/ 'di ltar sems can su gang dag gis bdag mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i ming thos pa de dag thams cad bla na med ⑥pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par shog shig ces smon lam btab bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ 'jig rten gyi khams de'i sems can de dag thams cad phyir mi ldog pa lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das des bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi 64—11

bu ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sems can de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa de'i mtshan ma thosanyesam/ bcom ldan 'das des bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu thos so/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du phyir mi ldog pa ma lags/ bcom ldan 'das des bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de dag thams cad ni phyir mi ldog pa yang yin la phyir ldog pa yang yin no/ /gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das ji ltar/ gang de lta bur de dag thams cad phyir mi ldog pa yang lags la/ phyir ldog pa yang lags/ bcom ldan 'das des bka' stsal pa / rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa de'i⑧mtshan thos pas/ sems can de dag gis phyir mi ldog pa'i sa bon skyes pa mthong nas sems can de dag phyir mi ldog par lung ston to/ /mtshan thos pasre'o nas de ma thag tu phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba yang ma yin te/ de bas na rigs kyi bu don de nyid rab tu grub par bya ba'i phyir khyod la dpe bshad do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na shing la la'i sa bon gyi rnam pa zhig yod de/ sa bon de la sa bon gyi nyes pa thams cad med la/ myu gu skye ba nas rdzogs pa'i bar du rkyen rnams yod na/ rigs kyi bu sa bon de la ji skad ces bya/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das nyes pa thams cad dang bral bas na/ de ni yongs su rdzogs pa zhes bgyi'o/ /bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa de'i dumatshan thos pa dang ldan pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i zhus bon yod pa'i sems can rnams ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa yin no/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i spyan de la byang chub 61—12

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams de blta7ba dang / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la'ang ②phyag 'tshal ba dang /bsnyen bkur bgyi ba dang / btsun par bgyi ba dang / ri mor bgyi ba dang /bkur steltebagyi ba dang / mchod pa bgyi ba'i slad du mchi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i〈spyan des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu de'i dus la dbab par shes na khyod song shig⑦ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i spyan⑧de la byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag kyang mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams de blta ba dang / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de la yang phyag 'tshal ba dang / bsnyen bkur bgyi ba dang / btsun par bgyi ba dang / ri mor bgyi ba dang / bkur ste7bgyi ba dang / mchod pa bgyi ba'i slad du mchi'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa pad ma'i7spyan des byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu dag de'i dus la dbabalgepar shes na khyod deng7shig /'jig rten gyi khams der bag yod par gnas pas gnas par gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khams de'i sems can (stede dag ni rab tu 'dod chags mang ba/64—13

zhe snang mang ba/ gti mug mang ba/ dge sbyong du mi 'dzin pa/ bram zer mi 'dzin pa/ phar mi shes pa/ mar mi shes pa/ chos ma yin pa 'dod pa mang banyu)la/ brlang ba/ gtum pa/ zhe gcod pa/ mu cor7smra ba/ pho theg can/ g.yengs bzhu/ brkam pa/ le lo can/ ngan pa'i ngang tshul can/ sdig pa'i chos can/ phrag dog dang ser snas yongs su dkris pa/ nyon mongs pa du mas nye bar nyon mongs par gyur pa rnams te/ sems can de 'dra ba de dag gi nang na de bzhin gshegs pa de chos ston to/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang 'di 'dra ba'i sems can rnams kyi nang na chos ston pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa de dka' ba mdzad pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das des bka' stsal pa/ de de bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin te / gang 'di 'dra ba'i sems can rnams kyi nang na chos ston pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa gzhi de dka' meb mdzad pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu dag gang de lta bur kun nas nyon mongs par gyur pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na dge ba'i sems gcig tsam bskyed pa'i sems can de dag kyang dka' ba byed pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ gang yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sems can yongs su dag pa yod pa lta ci nimatshar kyi/ gang dag de ltar kun nas nyon mongs par gyur pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de na ⑨ se gol gtogs pa7 srid du〈nyeyang dad pa rnyed pa dang / se gol gtogs pa srid du yang sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / chos la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / se hurtegol gtogs pa srid du yang tshul khrims yang dag par bzung ste/spyod pa 'di ni ches ngo mtshar to/ /de bas kyang gang dag se gol gtogs pa 61—14

srid du yang 'dod chags dang bral ba la gnas pa'i sems yang dag par bzung ste gnas pa 'di ni ches ngo mtshar to/ /de bas kyang gang dag se gol gtogs pa srid du yang snying rje ba'i sems nye bar gzhagasher+sā/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa 'disani chesakyingo mtshar to/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar to/ /bde bar gshegs pa ngo mtshar to/ /de nas sgrib pa tshams cad rnam par sel ba la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das de las 'di lta bu 'thun pa'i rjes su bstan pa de⑥mnyan nas bcom ldan 'das de'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ rang rang gi gnas nas dong ngoshe/ /dong nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la mchod pa'i phyir la las ni rin po che'i shing me tog dang bcas pa/'bras bu dang bcas pa/ chu dang zheng du ldan pa rnams mngon par sprul/ la las ni bai drur+ya'i⑧shing rnams/ la las ni shel gyi shing rnams/ la las ni dpag bsam gyi shing rnams/ la las ni gser gyi shing rnams/ la las ni me tog gi shing rnams/ la las ni 'bras bu'i shing rnams/ la las ni gos kyi sprin rnams/ la las ni rgyan7gyi sprin rnams/ la las ni spos kyi sprin rnams/la las ni phreng ba'i sprin rnams/ la las ni phye ma'i sprin rnams/ la las ni gdugs kyi sprin rnams/ la las ni rgyal mtshan gyi sprin rnams/ la las ni sil snyan gyi sprin rnams mngon par sprul te⑩/ mngon par sprul nas gcig tu 'dus te / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang lhan cig tu mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi5)khams ga la ba der dong ngo //64—15

de nas byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas byang chub sems dpa' de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye ma'otugrogs po dag mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams sdug bsngal lo/ /de bas na gang gis sems can de dag thams cad bde ba mchog gis bstabs par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par bya ba legs par mngon par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' de kun gyis legs so zhes smras nas byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i ltar mnyan to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas ji lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par bya ba mngon par byas pas byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i lus las 'od dang ba/ dri ma med pa/ rnam par dag pa/ yid du 'ong ba/ lus dang sems shin tu dga' bar byed pa byung ste/ 'od des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di zhukhyab cing snang bar gyur pa dang / gang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i sems can dmyal ba pa'i lus su gnas pa dang / byol song gi skye gnas pa'i lus su gnas pa dang /gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'i lus su gnas pa de dag 'od des reg nas sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba dang bral te/ bde zhing khro ba dang gnod sems dang yangasabral te phan tshun du pha mar 'du shes par gyur pa dang / gang yang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig nirten gyi khams 'di na 'jig rten gyi bar mun pa mun nag gang du nyi ma dang / zla ba 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba 'di ltar mthu che ba/ 'di ltar dbang che bar grags pa 'di dag gis kyang lam me/ lhan ne lhang nger ma gyur pa de dag kyang 'od des khyab nas snang bar gyur te/ gang der skyes pa'i 64—16 4

sems can denyedag kyang gcig gis gcig mthong ba dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i gang khor yug gi ri rnams dang / khor yug gi ri chen po rnams dang / ri btang bzungakhudang / ri btang bzungashechen po rnams dang / de ma yin pa'i ri nag po gzhan de dag kyang 'od des khyab ste snang bar gyur pa dang / blar ni tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad/ 'og tu ni mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal btsochen po yan chad de'i bar du gang 'od des snang bar ma byas pa'i sa phyogs de gang yang med pa de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par bya ba mngon par byas so/ /de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gzhan dag gis kyang ji lta bu'i0rdzu 'phrul mngon par bya ba mngon par byas pasashezas 'dod pa'i sems can rnams ni zas thob/ btung ba 'dod pa rnams ni btung ba/ gos 'dod pa rnams ni gos/ bzhon pa 'dod pa rnams ni bzhonasnyipa / nor 'dod pa rnams ni nor thob/ long ba rnams ni mig thob/ 'on pa rnams ni sgra thos/ sgren mo rnams ni gos can du gyur/ smyosalgepa rnams ni dran pa thob/ sdug bsngal ba rnams ni bde bar gyur/ sbrum pa rnams ni bde bar btsas pa de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par bya ba mngon par byas so/ /de nas sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad yul ga ya dang ga ya mgo'i ri ga la ba der nye ba dang / skyes bu dam pa de dag nye bar gyur ma thag tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rin po che'i dra bas khebs par kun tu snang ngo / /steng gi bar snang las kyang lha'i pad ma'i char mngon par rab tu phabarwanyebo/ /lha'i me tog gi sprin rnams dang ske/ lha'i shing tog gi sprin rnams dang / lha'i phreng7ba'i sprin rnams dang /64—17

lha'i spos kyi sprin rnams dang / lha'i gos kyi sprin rnams dang / lha'i phye ma'i sprin rnams dang / lha'i chos gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang /ba dan gyi sprin gyi char mngon par rab tu bab 3)bo/ /de dag mngon par rab tu bab ri pas sems can gang la reg pa de dag thams cad rab tu bde bar gyur/yul ga ya dang ga ya mgo'i ri la shing tha mal pa dang / sa phyogs tha mal pa gang yod pa de dag thams cad kyang med par 1snang ngo / /sa phyogs de dag na rin po che'i shing rnams dang / dpag bsam gyi shing rnams dang / me tog gi shing rnams dang / 'bras bu'i shing rnams dang / tsan dan gyi shing rnams dang /a ga ru'i shing rnams kun tu snang ste/ de dag kun tu bzang por 'dug par gyur to/ /bar snang las lha'i sil snyan dag sgra ⑥'byin cing / sil snyan de dag las 'di lta bu'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang byung ngo / /lum bi'i tshal rab mchog tu gang skyes pa/ /mnyam med gzhar7yang nyon mongs dbang mi 'gyur / /nam mkha' mtshungs mnyam de la phyag 'tshal du/ /ri bo mchog rab 'di la bdag cag lhags/ /byang chub mchog sus0byang chub shing dbang drung kyi/ /bdud kyi sde stobs bcom nas sangs rgyas pa/ /dri med gzi ldan de la phyag 'tshal du/ /ri bo mchog rab 'di la bdag cag lhags/ /chos tshul 'di dag sgyu ma smig rgyu dang / /chu zla 'dra bar gang gis rtogs gyur pa/ /bsod nams zhing rab de la phyag 'tshal du/ /ri bo mchog rab 'di la bdag cag lhags/ /chos rnams sna tshogs 'ja' dang 'dra ba dang / /gar mkhan tshon 'drar gang gis rab rtogs pa/ /mi g.yo bsod nams gter la phyag 'tshal du / /ri bo mchog rab 'di la bdag cag lhags/ /gang gis bskal pa brgya 64—18

phrag mang por ni/ /thugs rje'i thugs kyis7tshogs kun rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dri med zla zhal de la phyag 'tshal du/ /ri bo mchog rab 'di la bdag cag lhags/byang chub sems dpa' bye ba brgya mang dang / /lha yi tshogs kyis de bzhin gang mchod pa/ /gti mug mun bral de la phyag 'tshal du/ /ri bo mchog rab 'di la bdag cag lhags/ /gang gis mchog gi chos kyi gter brnyes shing / /thugs rje nyid kyis 'jig rten dag la btang / /mnyam med phan mdzad de la phyag 'tshal du/ /ri bo mchog rab 'di la bdag cag lhags/ /gang zhig thugs zhi rtag par byams pa'i yid/ /pad ma chus ltar nyon mongs ma gos pa/ /yon tan mchog rab mnga' la phyag 'tshal du/ /ri bo mchog rab 'di la bdag cag lhags / /mtshan gyi me tog rgyas pa yongs su dag pa'i sku/ /dpe byad bzang po'i 'bru chags 'gro ba'i 'tsho ba gang / /yal ga mtha' yas rin chen shing la phyag 'tshal du/ /bdag cag thams cad lhan cig mchod pa thogs te lhags/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag byung ma thag tu de nas tshe dang ldan pa med gal gyi bu chen po stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig la gzar phyinas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba dekhulogs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sngon ma thos sngon ma mthong ba'i snga ltas gda' ba 'di dag bu'i lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa med gal gyi bu chen po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /mod gal gyi bu shar phyogs nakyisangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i7klung gi bye ma snyed 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams pad ma can zhes bya ba zhig yod de/64—19

de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas pad ma'i spyan zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs so/ /'tsho'o/ /gzhes so/ /chos kyang0)ston to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa'5misems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba zhes bya ba 'jig rten gyi khams mi mjed 'dir 'ongs pa dang / de ma yin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gzhan bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gang skyes bu dam pa de nyid dang lhan cig tu mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir 'ongs pa de dag gi snga ltas 'di yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal ma thag tu/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas bskor cing mdun du bdar gte/rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen pos bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der 'ongs te phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 'khod nas/ bcom ldan 'das la tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do/ /grags chen shes rab chen po pa/ /thub chen dpa' bo chen po pa/ /srid pa'i mya ngan rgal ba po/ /nyon mongs rgal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad du yang tha le ste/ /kun nas rab tu lhan ner bzhugs/ /kun nas rnam par grol ba po/ /phyag 'tshal mi mtshungs mtshungs med rnya/ /rab tu mi sgul ri bo bzhin/ /gting tshod yangs pa rgya mtsho 'dra/ /mu stegs kun nasam⑤mi bskyod pa/ /chos rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /gzodashenas zhi zhing ma skyes pa/ /64—20

rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /chos rnams mgon po khyod kyis bstan/ /la la latuni lam yang bstan/ /la la yang dag nyid la bkod/ /la la yang dag mya ngan bzlas②/ /la la byang chub lung yang bstan/ /bag la nyal dang bsamasapa mkhyen/ /khyedakyikyis mi mkhyen ci yang med/ /de phyir 'dul ba'i bya ba rnams/ /gzigs pas khyod kyi bka' 'grub bo/ /byang chub snying por bzhugs pa na/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug dang / /dri ma sna tshogs gzhan rnams kyang / /khyod kyi ye shes me yis bsregs/ /rgal nas sems can rnams sgrol zhing / /grol nas skye dgu grol mdzad de/ /srid pa'i mya ngan 'khyams pa yi 'jig rten tshol ba khyod lags so/ /srid pa'i btson rar sems can dag /yunashering mi shes gnyid log rnams/ /sad par mdzad pa mgon po khyod/ /gnyen gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi sras mchog 'di dag kyang / /thams cad byang chub slad du zhugs/ /dam pa'i chos ni nyan 'tshal na/ /'dren pas de dag bstan du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas tshul dang 'dra ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ste pad ma'i snying po la phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang nas pad ma'i snying po la so so ci rigs par 'khod do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba stanasnyelas langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig la gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga pad ma'i snying po la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud denyu/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te 64—21

zhus nas zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na/ bdag0)bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu'o/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rtag tu skabs phyesal/ de bzhin gshegs pa la khyod ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang / dris pa lung bstan pa de dang dekhunyid kyis ngas khyod kyi 3)sems rangs par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs phye ba dang ske/ bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas 'di skad ces yigasol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams lags/ji ltar na tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na bsam gtan phun sum tshogs pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na shes rab phun sum tshogs pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na thabs mkhas pa phun sum tshogs pas rnams lags/ ji ltar na smon lam phun sum tshogs pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na stobs phun sum tshogs pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sa dang mtshungs pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na chu dang mtshungs pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na me dang mtshungs pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na rlung mar dang mtshungs pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa 61—22

rnams lags/ ji ltar na zla ba lta bu rnams lags/ ji ltar na nyi ma lta bu rnams lags/ ji ltar na seng ge lta bu rnams lags/ ji ltar na dul ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na cang shes pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na pad ma lta bu rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems rgyanyeche ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na sems rnam par dag pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na sems nem nur ma mchis pa rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' blo rgya mtsho lta bu rnams lags/ ji ltar na blo zhibalgepa rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rigasalgepa'i spobs pa can rnams lags/ ji ltar na grol ba'i spobs pa can rnams lags/ji ltar na rnam par dag pa'i spobs pa can rnams lags/ ji ltar na sems can thams cad mgu bar byed pa'i spobs pa can rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' tshigatugazung ba rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos brjod pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na chos kyi dbyings la mkhas pa rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' stong pa nyid spyod yul ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na mtshan ma med pa la gnas pa rnamasakyilags/ ji ltar na smon lam la gnas pa thams cad dang bral ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na byams pa'i bdag nyid can rnams lags/ ji ltar na snying rje'i bdag nyid can rnams lags/ ji ltar na dga' ba la gnas pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na btang snyoms la gnas pa rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mngon par shes pas rnam par rol pa rnams 64—23

lags / ji ltar na mi khom pa brgyad rnam par spangs pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na byang chub kyi sems shi)ma stor ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na skye ba dran pa rnams lags / ji ltar na dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang ma bral ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na sdig pa'i grogs po yongs su spangs pa rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i chos nyid 'thob ②par 'gyur(9/ ji ltar na lus rdo rje ltar sra ba rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dedakyidapon chen po rnams lags/ ji ltar na lam la mkhas pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na lam ma log par stonasapa rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par sems mnyam par bzhag pa rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' phyagasredar khrod pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na chos gos gsum pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na phying pa can rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bsod snyoms pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na stan gcig pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na zas phyis mi len pa rnams lags / bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dgon pa pa rnams lags / ji ltar na shing drung pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na bla gab med pa pakhurnams lags/ ji ltar na dur khrod pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na cog pu pasnyirnams lags/ ji ltar na gzhi ji bzhin pa rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnal 'byor spyod pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na mdo sde 'dzin pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na 'dul ba 'dzin pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na ma mo 'dzin pa rnams lags/⑨ ji ltar na cho ga dang / spyod yul 64—24

dang / spyod pa dang / spyodakyilam phun sum tshogs pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na ser sna dang / phrag dog dang bral ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na sems can thams cad la sems snyomasalgepa rnams lags/ ji ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang rim grokhebagyid0mkhas pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na nga rgyal bcom pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na dad pa mang ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na kun rdzob la mkhas pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na don dam pa la mkhas pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la mkhas pa rnams lags / ji ltar na bdag shes pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na 'jig rten shes pa rnams lags/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par dze+e/ ji ltar na mngal gyi dri mas ma gos par m+mu/ji ltar na khyim gyi gnas nas mngon par byung ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na 'tsho ba yongs su dag pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na yid yongs su mi skyo ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bka' bzhin bgyid pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na bzhinashe'adzum zhing khro gnyer ma mchis pa rnams lags/ji ltar na mang du thos pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na chos kyi rgyal po'i sras rnams lags/ ji ltar na brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang 'jig rten skyong bas bsulob rnams lagasal/ ji ltar na bsam pa dang / bag la nyal 'tshal ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na sems can yongs su smin par bgyi ba'i cho ga 'tshal ba rnams lags/ji ltar na des pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na 'grogs na bde ba rnams lags/ji ltar na bsdu ba'i dngos po la mkhas pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na tshul du shis 64—25

pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na gnas bca' ba rnams lags/ ji ltar na rtsi'i rgyal po'i shing chen po lta bu rnams lags/ ji ltar na bsod nams bgyi ba la brtson 1)pa rnams lags/ ji ltar na sprul pa la mkhas pa rnams lags/bcom ldan 'das ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dag gyomyur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen posasgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /yang rigs kyi bu khyod skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse0ba dang ske/ skye bo phal po che dang / lha dang mi rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir zhugs shing / de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa la khyodakyi'adi lta bu'i don 'dri bar sems pa legs so/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir legs par shin tu nyon la yid la zung shig dudang ngas khyod la bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas bcom ldan 'das kyi khyaltar mnyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/chos kyi sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ zang zing gi sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/lan du phan 'dogs pa la mi re ba'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/snying rje ba'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ mi brnyas pa'i sbyin pa phun 64—26

sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ bstetustang gi sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/mchod pa dang rim gro'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ mi gnas pa'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ yongs su dag pa'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pakhuyin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' zang zing med pa'i sems kyis chos rnams 'dzin cing kun chub par byed de/ rnyed pasnyedang bkur sti'i phyir ma yin/ shes kyi khe 'dod pa'i phyir ma yin / grags pa 'dod pa'i phyir ma yin te/ gzhan du na de 'di0ltar sems can 'di dag gi sdug bsngal thams cad ji ltar zad par bya snyam ste/ chos de dag kyang zang zing med pa'i sems kyis gnyis su med par gzhan dag la yang yangasnyedag par ston to0/ /ji ltar rgyal po'am blon po chen po la yang dag par ston pa de ltar gdol pa'am/ gdol bu la yang yangashedag par ston na/ de ma yin pa grong pasnyedang / yul gyi mi gzhan dag la lta7ci smos/ chos kyi sbyin pa des khengs par yang mi 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi 'jigs7 pa'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' bdag gis dbyig pa bor ba dang / mtshon cha bor ba yin te/ gzhan dag kyang bslab pa de nyid la gzhog go/ /derwatesems can thams cad la phar 'du shes pa yin/ mar 'du shes pa yin/ bur 'du shes pa yin/ gnyen bshes su 'du shes pa yin/ nye du'am snag gi gnyen mtshams dag kyang rung bar 'du shes pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de 'di 64—27

snyam du sems te/ de bzhin gshegs pas kyang skye ba 'pho ba de dang de dag tu sems can gyi ris su gang khyod kyi pha'am/ ma'am bu'am/ gnyen bshes sam/nye du'am/ snag gi gnyen mtshams dag gang yang rung ba'i gnas su ma gyur pa'ishesems can de lta bu med do zhes gsungs so snyam nas/ de srog chags su gyur pa phra mo'i phyir yang bdag gi sha dag gis kyang phan 'dogs na/ srog chags chen po che ba migazhan dag chal lta ci smos〈gete/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi 'jigs patshan sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' zang zing gi sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems can gang dag⑧mi dge ba'i las rab tu byed pashemathong na/ de dag zang zing gis sdud cing / zang zing gis bsdus nas mi dge ba'i gnas de nas bslang ste/ dge ba'i gnas su 'god do/ /de yang 'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang sbyin pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i byang chub bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa sbyin⑧pa na mi dge ba'i chos phrag dog dang / ser sna dang / ngan sems gsum spangs pa yin no zhes gsungs te/ de bas na bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su bslab cing sbyin pa sbyin spupar bya'o snyam ste(2 / de sbyin pa yang sbyin7zhing sbyin pa des khengs par yang mi 'gyur te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' zang zing gi sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' lan du phan 'dogs pa la mi re ba'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa'atshwa sbyin pa sbyin tunyepa yang 'dod pa'i phyir sbyin pa mi sbyin/ phan 'dogs su re ba'i tsophyir ma yin/ don gyi phyir ma yin/ g.yog gi phyir ma yin/ 'jig 61—28

rten gyi tshul gyi phyir ma yin gyinyu/ gzhan du na 'di snyam du sems te/ gang byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa'i ngang tshul can du 'gyur ba 'di ni chos nyid yin no snyam ste/ de rgyu de dang rkyen de dngashegazhis phan btags pa'i lan du phan 'dogs pa thams cad la mi re bar sbyin pa sbyin par byed de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' lan du phan 'dogs pa la mi re ba'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' snying rje ba'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems can sdug bsngal ba dang /bkres pa dang / skom pa dang / gcer bu dang / gos ngan pa dang / bgo ba ngan pa dang / mgon med pa dang / dpung gnyen med pa dang / skyabs med pa dang / gnas med pa dang / rten med pa rnye busabasod nams med pa dag mthong na/ de dag la snying rje ba'i sems rab tu skyed0cing / de 'di snyam du sems te0sems can gang dag gi phyir bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i sems can deshedag ni sdug bsngal ba / mgon med pa/ dpung gnyen med pa/ skyabs med pa/ gnas med pa/rten med pa 'di dag yin te/ kun tu 'khyamasnyen nam zhig bdag sems can de dag gi mgon dang / dpung gnyen dang / skyabs dang / gnas dang /rten du 'gyur7snyam nas/ de snying rjes rab tu mi bzadarwaskrede/ bdog cing7yod pa'i〈nyedangos pos sems can de dag la phan 'dogs so/ /phan btags pa'i mod la skyesalgepa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des kyang khengs par mi 'gyur te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' snying rje ba'i sbyin7pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi brnyas pa'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin 64—29

zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa sbyin ①pa na/ bor ba'i sbyin pa mi sbyin/brnyas shing sbyin pa mi sbyin/ gshe zhing sbyin pa mi sbyin/ nyon mongs shing sbyin pa mi sbyin/ phyug tsho pas rgyags shing dregs te sbyin pa mi sbyin/ grags pa 'dod cing sbyin pa mi sbyin/ mang du thos pas rgyags shing dregs pas sbyin pa mi sbyin gyi/ci sbyin pa de yang bsti stang du byas shing sbyin pa sbyin ④par byed do/ /btsun par byas shing sbyin pa sbyin rinapar byed do/ /ri mor byas te mchod cing rang gi lag nas 46 sbyin pa sbyin ri7 par byed do/ /de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi brnyas 8pa'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na7byang chub sems dpa' bste 1 stang gi sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ byang chub sems dpas slob dpon dang / mkhan po dang / bla ma lta bu dang / tshangasalgepa mtshungs par spyod pa dag mthong na/ lus kyis gus pa dang bcas pa yin/sems kyis ri mo dang bcas pa yin te/ des gus pa bskyed/ ri mo bskyed nas gus par smra ba dang / phyag 'tshal ba dang / bsnatshonyeb dang / thal mo sbyar ba dang / 'dud pa'i las dag byed do/ /de dag gi dge ba dang ldan pa'i bya ba de dang de dag la yang grogs su 'gyur te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bste nyu stang gi sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mchod pa dang / rim gro'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas dang / chos dang dge 'dun la bya ba dag byed de/ ji ltar na sangs rgyas la bya ba dag byed ce na/ 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten dag dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la spos samatsha/ me tog gam/ bdug pa'am/ byug pa'am/ skyong〈nyenul lam/64—30

de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten zhig pa bcos pa dag gis te/ de ltar na sangs rgyas la bya ba dag byed do/ /ji ltar na chos la bya ba dag byed ce na/ de chos nyan to/ /klog go/ /'chang ngo / /yi ger 'dri'o①/ /kha ton byed do/ /kun chub par byed do/ /sems so/ /ma log par sgom pa'i sbyor bas goms par byed de/ de ltar na chos la bya ba dag byed do/ /ji ltar na dge 'dun la bya ba dag byed ce na/ de gos dang / bsod snyoms dang / mal cha dang /na ba'i rkyen sman dang / yo byad rnams dang / chung ngu na chu grang7mo khyor gang tsam yang dge 'dun la 'bul te/ de ltar na dge 'dun la bya ba dag byed de/de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mchod pa dang rim gro'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi gnas pa'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa byin⑧pa na/ sbyin pa 'dis bdag lha'am lhaphul la zhig tu shog shigashece'am/ rgyal po'am rgyal po la la zhig tu shog shig0ces de ltar sems mi skyed de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa'akhumi gnas pa'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa'akhuyongs su dag pa'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa 'di dag ji skad du bshad pa la so sor rtog pa'i rang bzhin can yin te de ①sbyin pa ci dang ci sbyin yang7 / sbyin pa de dang de la so sor rtog pa'i rang bzhin can yin no/ /de de ltar so sor rtog pa larwategang 'di sbyin pa'i nyes pa dang / sbyin pa'i7dri ma dang / sbyin pa'i bar du gcod pa de dag mi 'byung ste/ de ltar na rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' yongs su dag pa'i sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /64—31

rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pas bsdams pa rnams yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i sdom pas bsdams pa rnams yin/ nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi yongs su gdung )tshob dang bral ba rnams yin/ tshul bzhin ma yin pa riXyid la byed pa dang bral ba rnams yin/ las kyi7'jigs pa rnams yin/kha na ma tho bas 'jigs pa rnams yin/ 'jigs par lta ba rnams yin/ yang dag par blangs pa la brtan rigepa rnams yin/ mi gnas pa'i tshul khrims pa rnams yin/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i tshul khrims pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' so sor thar pa'i sdom pas bsdams pa rnams 75yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pas mdo sde'am/ 'dul ba'am/ gnas gang yang rung ba la la dag tu bslab pa'i gnas 'di dag gang bcas pa de dag ston pas bstan pa'o snyam du sems te/ gnas de dang de dag la shin tu legs par slob kyi/rigs la 'dod chags pas ma yin/ lta ba la 'dod chags pas ma yin/'khor50la 'dod chags pas ma yin/ gang zag gi skyon gyi phyir bslab pa'i gnas de dang de dag la ri mo byed pa ma yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' so sor thar pa'i sdom pas bsdams pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i sdom pas bsdams pa yin zhe na/'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du so sor thar pa'i sdom pa tsam gyis ni/61—32

bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chubatumangon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi nus kyisal/ de bzhin gshegs pas mdo sde de dang de dag las byang chub sems dpa'i yang dag par spyad pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gnas 'di dag gang bcas bsnyede dag la bdag gis bslab par bya'o zhes rnam par dpyod do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yang dag par spyad pa de dag ni gang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gnas de rnams kyang gang zhe na / 'di la byang chub sems dpa' gang gi phyir de la sems can rnamasasredad par 'gyur ba'i gnas ma yin par mi spyod/ dus ma yin par mi spyod/meyul ma yin par mi spyod/ dus ma yin par mi smra ba yin/ dus mi shes pa ma yin / yul mi shes pa ma yin/ tshod mi shes pa ma yin te/ de sems can7rjes su bsrung ba dang / bdag gi byang chub kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyirarnyuspyod lam phun sum tshogs shing 'jam par smra ba dang / dal bus smra ba dang / 'du 'dzi mi mang ba dang / rab tu dben pa la mngon par phyogs pa dang ske/ bzhin gyi mdangs rab tu dang ba yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' cho ga phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i sdom ⑧pas bsdams pa yin zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pas ⑨mdo sde de dang ⑩de dag la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bslab pa'i gnas 'di dag gang bcas pa'i bslab pa'i0teganas de dag la gus par byed pa yin/ brtson par byed pa yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i sdom5)pas bsdams pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa thams cad kyis〈nyeyongs su gdung ba 64—33

dang bral ba yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'dod chags kyis7yongs su gdung ba'am/ zhe sdang gis yongs su gdung ba'am/ gti mug gisasheyongs su gdung ba'am/ nyon mongs pas geyongs su gdung ba gang yang rung ba la la'am/ yo byad kyis phongs pa'i yongs su gdung ba gang yang rung ba la las yongs su gdung bar mi 'gyur te/ de 'dod chags kyi gnyen po la rtenabacing 'dod chags skye ba'i rkyen rnams yongs su spong khya)ngo / /'dod chags kyi gnyen po de ni gang 'dod chags skye ba'i rkyen de dag ni gang zhe na/ mi sdug pa sgom pa ni 'dod chags kyi gnyen po'o/ / yul gyi57bzang mo ni 'dod chags skye ba'i rkyen to8)/ /mi sdug pa bsgom 9pa de gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ lus 'di la skra dang ske/ spu dang / sen mo dang / so dang / rngul dang / dri ma dang /pags 7pa dang / sha dang / rus pa dang / rgyus pa dang / rtsa〈nyedang /mkhal ma dang / snying dang / mchin pa dang / glo ba dang / rgyu ma dang /gnye ma dang / pho ba dang / sul mangs 1 dang / long ka dang / lgang pa dang ske/ mtsher sna pa dang / phyi sa dang / mchilacham dang / rdul dang /snabs dang / ngar snabs dang / zhag dang / chu ser dang / rkang dang /tshil dang / mkhris tshapa dang / bad kun dang / rnag dang / khrag dang /klad nyu pa dang / klad /shergyas dang / gcin dag kyang5)yod de/ dngos po de dag la byang chub sems dpa' yongs su rtog pa'i rang bzhin can yin te/yongs su rtog pa'i rang bzhin can de 'di snyam du byis pa blun po mi gsal ba mi mkhas pa de yang dngos po 'di dag shes nas/ 'dod chags kyi sems mi skyed na / shes rab dang ldan pa'i rang bzhin can lta smos kyang57ci dgos snyam ste/64wa 34

de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi sdug pa sgom pa mang ba yin no/ / yul gyitubazang mo de gang zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpas chags par 'gyur ba'i bud medaphugazugs bzang ba/ yid du 'ong ba/ mdzes pa/ mig tu sdug pa/sems 'phrog pa mthong yang des de ltakhubu dag mthong na 'di ltar yongs su rtog ste / bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang yul ni rmi lam dang 'dra ba dag ste/ byung nas med par 'gyur ba yin na mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can su zhig mi lam lta bu'i yul dag la 'dod chags skyed par byed ces gsungs so snyam ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'dod chags kyi gnyen po la sten cing 'dod chags skye ba'i rkyen rnams yongs su spong ngo / /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa'i zhe snang gi gnyen po la sten gcing zhe sdang skye ba'i rkyen rnams yongs lasu spong zhe na/'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems can rnams la byams pa mang ba yin te/de gzhi gang dang rgyu gang dang rkyen gang gis khro zhing gnod sems su 'gyur ba dang ske/ khonashedu 'dzin par7 'gyur ba'i rgyu de dag dang / rkyen de dag yongs su spangs te⑩/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' zhe sdang gi gnyen po la rten cing zhe snang skye ba'i rkyen rnams yongs su spong ba yin no/ / ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gti mug gi gnyen po la sten cing / gti mug skye ba'i rkyen rnams yongs su spong zhe na(nye de de ltar yongs su rtog pas gti mug dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /gti mug dang bral bas 'dod pa ma 'byor tam/ yo byad ma 'byor kyang yongs su yi 'chad7pa med de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa thams cad kyis7yongs su gdung ba dang bral ba yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid la byed pa dang bral ba 64—35

yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' gcig pu lkog tu song ste/ rab tu dben pa na7)gnas shing 'di ltar bdag ni ma 'dres par gnas pa ste/ bdag ni rab tu dben pa na 'dug pa'o/ /bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos 'dul ba la zhugs pa'o/ /dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze gzhan dag ni kun kyang 'dres par gnas pa/ 'du 'dzi mang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos 'dul ba las nyams pa'o snyam du sems mimi skyed de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' tshul bzhin ma yin pa 5)yid la byed pa dang bral ba yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' las kyis bya'ajigs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang dge slong rnams bsod nams dag gus par bya'o/ /tshul khrims gus par bsrungasnyingo / /shes rab gus par bsgom yimo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bsod nams gus par byas pa rnams kyi rnam par smin pa ni 'dod pa dang / 'thad pa dang / dga' ba dang / yid du 'ong bar nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so snyam du dpyod dol/ /de de ltar mngon par yid ches pas mi dge ba'i chos thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa'aphulas kyis 'jigs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' kha na ma tho bas 'jigs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' kha na ma tho ba phra mo tsam dag la yang 'jigs par lta zhing sdig pa chung ngu yang khyad du〈mi gsod pa yin te/ de 'di snyam du bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang dge slong dag dug chung ngus kyang skyes bu 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /dge slong dgatshwanyedug chen pos kyang skyes bu 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du sdig pa chung ngus hunyekyang ngan song rnams su phyin par byed do/ /sdig pa chen posalge64wa 36

kyang ngan song rnams su phyin par byed do zhes gsungs so snyam du sems te/ de de ltar yongs su rtoganyepas kha na ma tho bas 'jigs pa yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' kha na ma tho bas 'jigs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs par lta ba yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / grong rdal gyi mi⑧dang / yul gyi mi rnams kyis yid brtan du rung ba yin te/ bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / grong rdal gyi mi⑧dang / yul gyi mi rnams byang chub sems dpa' de gcig pu gnyis su med pa la 'gron bu dang / gser dang nor bu dang / mu tig dang be+e drur+ya0dang ske/ dung dang / man shel dang byi ru la sogs pa nor dang / yo byad kyi rnam pa dag 'debs kyang / de la byang chub sems dpa' brnab sems kyang mi skyed do/ /gal te byang chub sems dpa' mchod rten gyi'am/ dge 'dun gyi dngos po'i phyir las su bskos na yang ⑦dngos po des kyang nye bar mi 'tsho ste/de 'di snyam du sems shing bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang byang chub sems dpas7ni bdag gi lus las sha zos kyang bla'i gzhan gyi7zas sam/ skom 'amakho/ yo byad kyi rnam pa gang ci yang rung ba dag ma byin la/ ma gnang bar spyad7pa ni mi rung ngo zhes gsungs so snyam ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs par lta ba yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par blangs pa la brtan 8pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' bdud dam 'badud kyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis gtses sam/ nor dang / 'khrig pa'i yan lag gis brjod kyang mi g.yo mi 'gyur zhing nyams par mi 'gyur te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par blangs pa la brtan7pa yin no/ /ji ltar na7byang 64—37

chub sems dpa' mi gnas pa'i tshul khrims pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims srung na/ tshul khrims 'dis bdag lhar shog shigatuce'am / lha la lar shog shigadzagece'am/ rgyal por shog shigashece'am/ rgyal po la lar shog shigs0ces sems mi skyedapo de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi gnas pa'i tshul khrims pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i tshul khrims 6)pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' lus kyis yongs su dag pa yin/tho ngag dang yid kyis yongs su dag pa yin te/ ji ltar na lus kyisarkuyongs su dag pa yin zhe na/ de gang lus kyis 9cingan du spyod pa 'di dag thams cad du thams cad yongs su spong ste/lus kyis nyi ༷ngan du spyod pa de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste srog gcod pa dang ske/ ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pa la log par g.yem pa ste/ de ltar na lus kyis yongs su dag pa yin no/ /ji ltar na ngag gis yongs su dag pa yin zhe na/ de gang 'di dag ngag gis hu1ngan du spyod pa de dag thams cad du thams cad yongs su spong ste/ ngag gis hurtengan du spyod pa de dag kyang gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ brdzun du smra ba dang / phra ma dang / tshig rtsub po dang / tshig kyal pa ste/ de ltar na nyigengag gis yongs su dag pa yin no/ /ji ltar na yid kyis yongs su dag pa yin zhe na/ de gang 'di dag yid kyis ngan du spyod pa de dag thams cad du thams cad yongs su spong ste/ yid kyisatsongan du spyod pa de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ brnab sems dang / gnod sems dang /log par lta ba'o8/ /de ltar na yid kyis yongs su dag pa yin te/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i tshul khrims 64wa 38

can yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no / /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste nang gi bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin / phyi'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams7yin/ chos kyi bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba'i⑧bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ nyisatshe ba ma yin pa'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ tha dad pa med pa'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/dgos pa la mi lta ba'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ rnam par mi 'khrugs pa'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ snying rje'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ dam bcas pa las sgrol bar byed pa'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin nodu/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nang gi bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' gang 'di nang gshemya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang /sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug⑧pa de dag bzod cing dang du len la yongs su yi7mi 'chadakyi de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nang gi bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' phyi'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' ma las smos pa'am/ pha las smos pa'am/ nye du las smos pa'am/ mkhan po las smos pa'am/ slob dpon las smos pa'i tshig gi lam〈skrengan du brjod pa dang ske/ ngan du smras pa pha rol las thos sam/ sangs rgyas sam/ chos sam/61—39

dge 'dun la mi snyan patrehu)brjod pa thos na/ mi khro zhing gnod par mi sems la khonatshabadu mi 'dzin te/ de bzod cing dang du len la gnod sems mi mang ba yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' phyi'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' gang 'di dag mdo sde zab moshedag las de bzhin gshegs pas chos bstan pa rgyud chad pa/ mtshams sbyor ba las rnam par grol ba bsdur tshogemed pa 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad thog ma nas zhi ba'o / /chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ༅mya ngan las 'das pa'o zhes bstan pa de dag thos kyang mi 'jigs mi dngang skrag par mi 'gyur te/ de 'di ltaraphuchos 'di dag ma shes sam ma thos ⑨par ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par ⑩'tshang rgya bar mi nus so/ /snyam du sems te/ de'i phyir gang chos derwamedag 'dzin pa dang / sems pa7dang /sgom pa dang / yongs su rtog 8pa dang / mos pa 'di ni chos kyi bzod pa zhes bya ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' khro ba'i bsam pa skyes sam/ gnod sems kyi bsam pa skyes na/ 'di ltar khro ba 'di gang nas byung / gang du 'gag /gang lasatso'abyung / ji ltar 'byung / ji'i don du 'byung zhes yongs su rtog ste/ des de ltar yongs su brtags na/ khro ba'i skye ba'ang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / 'gag pa'ang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / gang las the skye ba de yang yang57dag par rjes su mi mthong /64wa 40

ji ltar skye ba de yang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong / rkyen gang gis skye btuyang yang dag par rjes su mi mthong ste/ de de'i phyir bzod cing dang du len la kun nas ldang ba mi mngakhub yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyi ①tshe ba ma yin pa'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' ni nyin par bzod la mtshan mo mi bzod pa 'am/ mtshan mo bzod la nyin par mi bzod pa'am/ bdag gi yul na bzod la gzhan gyi yul na mi bzod pa'am/ gzhan gyi yul na bzod la bdag gi yul na mi rjobazod pa'am/ bshes pa la bzod la mi bshes pa la mi bzod pa'am/ mi bshes pa la bzod la bshes pa la mi bzod pa ma yin0gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' ni dus thams cad du'ang bzod/ yul thams cad du'ang bzod/thams cad la'ang bzod pa yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa'akhunyi tshe ba ma yin pa'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' tha dad pa med pa'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' pha dang / ma dang bla ma dang bu dang bu mo dang chung ma dang nye du 'amarnyusnag gi gnyen mtshams la bzod la/ gzhan la mi bzod pa ma yin gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' ni tha na gdol pa gzhon nu yan chad la yang bzod de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' tha dad pa med pa'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dgos pa la mi lta ba'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' don gyi phyir bzod pa ma yin/ 'jigs pa'i phyir ma yin/ phan thogs su re ba'i phyir 64wa 41

ma yin/ 'jig rten gyi tshul gyis ma yin①/ ngo tsha bas bzod pa ma yin gyi/byang chub sems dpa' ni rtag par yang bzod pa mang ba yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dgos pa la mi lta ba'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnam par mi 'khrugs ②pa'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' nam deshel khro ba skye ba'i9)rkyen gang gis zil gyis non na/ khu tshur gyis 'tshog par 'gyur ba'am/thal mos 'tshog par 'gyur ba'am/ dbyig pas rdeg dupar 'gyur ba'am/mtshon gyis 'debs par 'gyur ba'am/ mi gtsigs pa'i tshig gis donashedu brjod pa de lta bu'i rkyen 6)ma byung gi bar du bzod pa ma yin gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' ni gal te la la zhig gis brdegs sam/ bsdigasashesam/ spyos sam / brgyadacan/ de la byang chub sems dpa'7'di snyam du bdag nyid kyis las 'di dag byas te/ bdag nyid la rnam par smin par 'gyur ro/ /mas ma byas / phas ma byas/ nye du dang / snag gi gnyen mtshams gang yang rung ba dag gis ma byas te/ las 'di dag bdag nyid kyis byas pas/ de'i phyir bdag nyid la rnam par smin par 'gyur gyi/ phyi rol gyi sa'i khamasasnyil rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ de bzhin du chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang /rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur ro⑩/ /de bzhin du nang gi sa'i khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur/ de bzhin du chu'i khams dang / me'i khams dang / rlung gi khams la rnam par smin par mi 'gyur ro snyam du sems gzhag par bya'o/ /de de (steltar ma log par rtogs (nyepas de'i rgyu de'i rkyen/de'i gzhis rnam par dkrugs kyang bzod/ rnam par ma dkrugs kyang bzod de/61—42

de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnam par mi 'khrugs ①pa'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' snying rje'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po'am/ blon po chen po phyug cing nor mang ba/ longs spyod che ba/ sems can sdug bsngal ba rnams kyi bdag por gyurasnyel/ de la sems can⑧de dag gis mi snyan par brjod kyang rung / kyal kyang rung / gtses7kyang rung ste/ mi khro zhing gnod sems su mi byed la/ bdag por gyur pa lta bur mi ston gyi/ gzhan du na de 'di snyam du sems can 'di dag ni bdag nyid kyis bzung ba ste/ sems can 'di dag ni bdag nyid kyis yongs su bskyang 0par bya ba yin la/ de ltar yongs su bsrung ba na/ brlag par bya ba ni bdag gi mi cha'o zhes/ de de'i phyir snying rje'i sems nye bar gzhag ste/ bzod cing dang du len la gnod sems mi mang ba yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' snying rje'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dam bcas pa ⑦las sgrol ba'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gi spyan sngar bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i 'dam du bying ba'i sems can rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o zhes seng ge'i sgra bsgrags kyisal/ de ltar7sems can thams cad bsgral ba dang /sems can thams cad dgrol ba dang / sems can thams cad dul ba dang /zhi ba la rab tu dgod (bye par brtson tunyel/ bdag nyid khro ba mang ba dang /64—43

gnod sems mang ba dang / mi bzod pa mang ba dang / phog snya med7pa ni bdag gi mi cha'o snyam du sems so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na sman pa thur ma can zhig yod la/ sems can rnams kyang rab rib kyis sdongasalgepar gyur na(mi/ sman pa des 'di snyam du bdag gis sems can 'di dag gi rab rib kyi skyon bsal bar bya'o/ /zhes bsamasakyil/ de nas sman pa de bdag nyid kyang ldongasachudapar gyur na/ rigs kyi bu de ji snyam du sems/ ji ga sman pa des sems can de dag gi rab rib kyi skyon thams cad bsal bar nus sam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni rtsim lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang jisaltar 'jig rten mi shes pa'i rab rib kyis ldongasalgepa'i gti mug gi dri ma shes rab kyi mig gis bsal bar 'dod la/ bdag nyid kyang mi shes pa'i rab rib kyis ldongs tson bdag gi mi cha'o snyam du sems te/ de de'i phyir bzod cing dang du len la gnod sems mi mang ba yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dam bcas pa las sgrol bar byed pa'i bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' bzod pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no// //'phags pa dkon mchog sprin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdonye/ bam po gnyis pa/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rdo rje lta bu'i brtson 'grus can rnams yin/ mi 'phrogasalgepa'i brtson 'grus can rnams yin/ mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i brtson 'grus can rnams yin/64—44

rlabs po che'i brtson 'grus can rnams yin/ 'bar ba'i brtson 'grus can rnams yin/ rgyun du chud pa'i brtson 'grus can rnams yin/ rnam par dag pa'i brtson 'grus can rnams yin/ thun mongatum yin pa'i brtson 'grus can rnams yin/ mi brnyas pa'i brtson 'grus can rnams yin/ snyems pa med pa'i brtson 'grus can rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na rdo rje lta bu'i brtson 'grus can rnams yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems can gyi ②khams yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba dang / ma rgal ba bsgralasheb dang / ma grol ba dgrol ba dang /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung ba dang / mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma rgyas pa mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin te/ de de ltar brtson 'grus brtsams shing gnas pa'i drung du bdud sdig to ducan 'ongs nas byang chub sems dpa' de la rigs kyi bu 'di lta bu'i brtson 'grus thong shig⑦ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu ngas kyang sems can gyi khams yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa yongs su mya ngan lasnyibazla ba dang / ma rgal ba bsgral ba dang / ma grol ba dgrol ba dang / dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung ba dang / mngon par rdzogs par sangs ma ④rgyas pa mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus 'di lta bu brtsams te/ de ni brdzunaspedang 'drid7pa'i chos can byis pa'i skye bo slu ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu ngas ni sems can brtson 'grus brtsams pa gcig 'gas7kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chubalgemangon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par ma shes so / /rigs kyi bu ngas ni sems can bye ba du ma nyan thos kyi theg pa dang /64wa 45

rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pas yongs su mya ngan las 'das par ①shes kyisal/rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de'i phyir brtson 'grus zlog shig① /don med par nyon mongs pa la stenam0pa por gyur ta re zhes dad pa dang bral bar byed cing kyal ka byed kyang / de la byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma 'di ni bdud sdig can bdag la kyal ka byed par 'dod do snyam ste/ des de ltar shes nas bdud sdig can de la 'di skad du/ sdig can khyod bya ba nyung ngu gyis shig /'jig rten gyi sko phyinasham gyis khyod la ci zhig bya/ sdig can bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang las bdag gir 57bya ba ni 'jig rten pa7yin te/ las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa'o/ /las kyi skye gnas pa'o/ /las la rton⑧pa'o zhes gsungs te/sdig can khyod kyang las bdag gir bya ba yin te/ las kyi bgo skal la spyod pa/las kyi skye gnas pa/ las la rton〈nyepa yin gyis7/ sdig can khyod gang nas/'ongs pa'i lam nas song shiganyurke /nga la kyal ka byas pas khyod yun ring por don med pa dang / gnod pa dang / sdug bsngal bar gyur ta re zhes bsgo'o/ /bdud sdig can de yang bdag gi sems ni sems kyisatshwanyetshor bar rig nas yibs yibs te de nyid du mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar5)byang chub sems dpa' bdud thams cad dam/ bdud kyi ris kyi lha thams cad kyis kyal ka byas te dad pa dang dbral bar byas kyang mi 'gyur/ mi 'jumakha/ zhum par mi 'gyur te / de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje lta bu'i brtson 'grus can yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi 'phrogs〈nyepa'i brtson 'grus can yin zhe na/'di la byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus brtsams pa'i rnam pa ji lta bus yun ring po nas theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gzhan 64wa 46

dag kyang byang chub sems dpa' de la grangs su yang nye bar mi 'gro/ cha dang /bgrang ba dang / dpe nasaturgyu'i bar du yang nye bar mi 'gro na/ nyan thos dang ske/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad lta ci smos te/ de'i sems 'byung ba re re la brtson 'grus kyi stobs bskyedakhupas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su 'dzin7cing / sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos thams cad rab tu spong ba de lta bu'i brtson 'grus rtsom gho/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi 'phrogasalgepa'i brtson 'grus can yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i brtson 'grus can yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' ha cang brtun ngas pa'am/ ha cang zhan pa'i brtson 'grus mi⑧com ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ha cang brtun ngas pa'i brtson 'grus ni yab yab por 'gyurame/ ha cang zhan pa ni le lor 'gyur te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i brtson 'grus can yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rlabs po che'i brtson 'grus can yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar brtson 'grus rtsomasnyiste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ci 'dra bar bdag gi lus kyang de dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyi gtsug bltar mi snang ba dang / 'od 'dom gang ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po phun sum tshogs pa dang / ye shes thogs pa med cing mtha' yas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi che ba nyid dang / sangs rgyas kyi7khya mchog nyid de yang bdag la7yod par 'gyur ro/ /zhes brtson 'grus rtsom ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rlabs po che'i brtson 'grus can yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'bar ba'i brtson 'grus can yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 64wa 47

'di lta ste/ dper na gser ram/ nor bu rin po che chen po dri ma dang skyon thams cad dang bral ba ni lham me hu)lhan ne lhang nge ste/ de ni a la la 'bar ba'i gser ro/ /a la la 'bar ba'i nor bu rin po che zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyang brtson 'grus kyi dri ma dang skyon thams cad dang bral ba yin no/ /brtson 'grus kyi dri ma dang skyon de dag gang zhe na / letshagelo ni brtson 'grus kyi dri ma dang skyon no/ /snyom las ni brtson 'grus kyi dri ma dang skyon no/ /zas la tshod mi shes pa ni brtson 'grus kyi dri ma dang skyon no / /bdag mi ri shes pa ni brtson 'grus kyi dri ma dang skyon no/ / tshul ma yin pa ni brtson 'grus kyi dri ma dang skyon no/ /0tshul bzhin ma yin pa ni brtson 'grus kyi dri ma dang skyon no/ /'du 'dzi ni brtson 'grus kyi dri ma dang skyon te/de dag ni brtson 'grus kyi dri ma dang / brtson 'grus kyi skyon zhes bya'o/ /de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' la med pa yin te/ de'i phyir de'i brtson 'grus de 'bar zhing dri ma med pa dang / 'od gsal zhing yongs su dag pa dang /yongs su byang ba yin no/ /de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'bar ba'i brtson 'grus can yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rgyun du chud 0pa'i brtson 'grus can yin rtso)zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' spyod lam thams cad du brtson 'grus rtsom ste/ ci nas kyang lus skyo bar mi 'gyur ba dang /sems skyo bar mi 'gyur ba de ltar brtson⑧pa de ni byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus rgyun du chud pa zhes bya ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rgyun du chud pa'i brtson 'grus can yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dag pa'i brtson 'grus can yin zhe na/ de ltar rgyun du chud pa'i brtson 'grus 64—48

can de'i gang sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi lam gyi bar du gcod pa gnod ①pa dang ldan pa de dag spangs pa yin/ gang yang 'di dag dge ba'i chos mya ngan las 'das pa dang 'thun⑧pa/ byang chub kyi lam gyi tshogs dang 'thun⑧pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs byang chub tu 'brang ba de dag 'phel ba dang /rgyas pa dang / yangs par 'gyur te/ de la mi dge ba'i sems skye ba phra zhing chung ba 'ga' yang mi skye na che ba lta ci smos te/ de ni rnam par dag pa'i brtson 'grus zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dag pa'i brtson 'grus can yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' thun mong ma yin pa'i brtson 'grus can yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ gal te phyogs bcu kun tu 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed cig mnar med pa'i me'i phung po chen pos byur bur gang bar gyur la/'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'das pa na sems can gcig cig sdug bsngal zhing /skyabs med/ mgon med de/ gnas dngasnyi/ rten med pa zhig yod na'ang sems can gcig po de'ishedon gyi phyir me'i phung po de la rkang gis0'bogs te⑨/'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'das nas sems can gcig po de yi thar bar bya bar bdag spro na sdug bsngal phal (kyelta ci zhig smos snyam ste/ de ni byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / mu stegs7can thams cad dang thun mong ma yin pa zhes bya ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' thun mong ma yin pa'i brtson 'grus can〈nyeyin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi brnyas pa'i brtson 'grus can yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du mir gyur pas nirnyubyang chub thob par dka' 64—49
