ste / bdag gi brtson 'grus 'di ni chung shing zhan la bdag kyang le lo can te/byang chub ni mgo'i thod la me nyu)'bar ba bzhin du bskal pa mang po bskal pa brgya phrag mang po/ bskal pa stong phrag mang po/ bskal pa brgya stong phrag mang por bsgrub ri dgos pas bdag ni de lta bu'i khur bskurakhubar mi spro'o snyam du sems mi skyed de/ byang chub sems dpas geni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de dag dang / gang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba de dag dang /gang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba de dag kyang tshul 'di dang du'adra ba dang / lam 'di dngam/sku'adra ba dang / brtson 'grus 'di dngashe'adra bas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya/mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs par gyur pa ༄8)sha stag las mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa ma yin gyi/ bdag tso ci nas kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur bar sems can thams cad dang thun mong gi brtson 'grus dang / sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i brtson 'grus kyis bdag gis kyang de lta de ltar btsal〈nye lo 'bad rdo)/ /bdag sems can thams cad la phan par brtson pa la ni sems can dmyal ba na gnas kyang bla'i nyurtebadag la phan par brtson na mya ngan las 'das pa ni ma yin no snyam du sems bskyed par bya ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi brnyas pa'i brtson 'grus can yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' snyems pa med pa'i brtson 'grus can yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' brtson 64—50

'grus rtsom na brtson 'grus de'i ro myongatubar mi byed de/ brtson 'grus des gzhan la mi smod/ bdag la mi stodakyide/ de 'di snyam du shes rab dang ldan pa'i rang bzhin can su zhig bdag gi las la brtson pas gzhan la smod snyam du sems te/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' snyems pa med pa'i brtson 'grus can yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bsam gtan phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bsod nams kyis brtan⑧pa rnams yin/ skyo ba mang ba0rnams yin/ brtson 'grus brtsams pa rnams yinadu / mang du thos pa rnams yin/ ma log par gdams ngag bsgomakhupa la brtson pa rnams yin/ chos kyi rjes su 'thunashepa'i chos la zhugs pa rnams yin/dbang po rno ba rnams yin/ sems lasnyemakhas pa rnams yin/ zhi gnas dang /lhag mthong la mkhas pa rnams yin/ de la ma zhen pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams kyis brtan pa yin zhe na / 'di la byang chub sems dpa' theg pa chen po la dge ba'i rtsa ba shin tu bsags shing tshe rabs tha dad pa de dang de dag tu spyad pa legs par spyad pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba yin te/ de bram ze'i rigs shing sā7la chen po lta bu'am/ rgyal rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'am/khyim bdag gi rigs shing sā〈spel chen po lta bu gang dang gang du skyes kyang khyim de'i mi dad pa yin te/ de skyes nas kyang rgyu de dag dang rkyen de dag de bas kyang 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang yangs par 'gyur〈nyete/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams 64—51

dang mi 'bral ba yin tespyi/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen de dag kyang gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dag gam/ byang chub sems dpa' dag go(2/ /de skyes na57sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba la goms pas 'di ltar dpyodakyide/kye ma skye dgusa'adi ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /kye ma skye dgu 'di ni nyam thag pa'o/ /kye ma skye dgungapa'adi ni na ba'o/ /kye ma skye dgusa'adi ni7mi gnas pa'o/ /kye ma skye dgula'adi ni yun ring po nas nad par gyur pa'o/ /kye ma skye dgu57'di ni gti mug gis ldongs sna pa'o/ /de'ang 'dod pa'i rgyu dang 'dod pa'i phyir te/ /de bas na 'jig rten gnas pa de lta bu la bdag gis 'dod pa rnams la bsten pa ni bdag gi mi cha'inyunye/ 'dod pa zhes bya ba 'di ni yang dag pasnyim yin pasheyongs su brtags pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rnam grangs du mar 'dod pa rnams kyi nyes pa 'di lta ste/ 'dod pa rnams ni gsal shing lta bu'o/ /'dod pa rnams ni mtshon shag ti lta bu'o/ /'dod pa rnams ni ral gri'i so lta bu'ol/ /'dod pa rnams ni spu gri'i so lta bu'o/ /'dod pa rnams ni sbrul gyi mgo lta bu'o/ /'dod pa rnams ni dbu ba rdos pa lta bu'o/ /'dod pa rnams ni rul pa'o/ /'dod pa rnams ni dri nga ba'o zhes gsungs so snyam ste/ de de ltar skyo nas skra dang kha spu bregs te/ gos ngur smrig dag bgos nas/ dad pas khyim nas khyim med par yang dag par rab tu 'byung ngo / /de rab tu byung nas ma thob pa 'thob5nyepar bya ba dang / khong du ma chud pa khong du chud par bya ba dang ske/ mngon du ma byas pa mngon du bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin no / /de de'i rgyu de de'i rkyen de'i gzhis kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i tshul du bshad pa dang ske/ don dam pa'i bden pa'i tshul du bshad pa'i7thos pa 'dzin to/ /de 64—52

gnyis ka la yang mkhas pas gdams ngag yang dag par bsgomanyemo/ /gdams ngag ma log par bsgom ②pa la brtson pas chos kyi rjes su 'thun ①pa'i chos la 'jug ste/ chos kyi rjes su 'thun0pa'i chos de'ang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtog pa dang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin to0/ /des lam khong du chud pas dbang po rno ba dang / dbang po gsal ba dang / de shes pa'i dbang po can yin no⑦/ /de dbang po rno zhing dbang po gsal la de shes pa'i dbang po can yin pas dben pa mang ba yin te/de 'du ba thams cad du thams cad yongs su spong ngo / 'du 'dzi thams cad du thams cad yongs su spong ngo / /smra ba la dga' ba dang / 'dod pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang / gnod sems kyi rnam par rtog pa dang / 'tshesnyiba'i rnam par rtog pa dang / lha la rnam par rtog pa thams cad du thams cad yongs su spong ngo / /shes kyi khe 'dod pa dang / grags pa 'dod pa dang / rnyed pa 'dod pa thams cad du thams cad yongs su spong ste/ de lus dang sems rab tu dben pas sems la mkhas pa yin te/ de sems la 'di snyam du bdag gis sems 'di ci dge ba la spyod dam/ de ste mi dge ba'am/ 'on tam lung du ma bstan pa'am/ chos gang la spyod ces rnam par dpyod del/ gal te dge ba la spyod na de la sems dga' ba dang / rangs pa dang / mos pa skyed do/ /dge ba'i chos de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun no/ /'on te mi dge ba la spyod na de la skyo ba mang ba dang / rtog pa 64—53

mang ba yin te/ mi dge ba'i chos de dag spangatub la brtson pa yin no/ /mi dge ba'i chos de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug go/ /de la 'dod chags7rnam pa gsum du rig par bya ste / chen po dang / 'bring po dang / chung ngu'o/ /de la 'dod chags chen po gang zhe na/ gang lus thams cad du khyab ste/ sems kun nas bzung zhing gnas pa dang / gang gis de la gzhol zhing 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems mi 'thob pa ste/ de la gzhol ba de snol ngo tsha ba dang / 'dzem pa thams cad du thams cad med par 'gyur te/ ji ltar na ngo tsha ba dang / 'dzem pa thams cad du thams cad med pa yin zhe na/ de gcig pu lkog tu song ste/ de nyid rjes su rnam par sems/ de nyid rjes su rnam par rtog cing / de nyid lakyilegs par shin tu smon pa dang / de nyid la yang yon tan du lta ba yin te/de ltar na de la ngo tsha ba med pa yin no/ /ji ltar na 'dzem pa med pa yin zhe na/de 56༄de'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis pha ma'am/ bla ma lta bu gzhan dag dang /rtsod tshecing phyir bzlogs ④pa dang / rgol bar byed cing des ngo mi tsha la deshel yon tan du lta ba yin te/ de ltar na de la ngo tsha ba med pa yin te/ de de'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis ngan song rnams su skye bar 'gyur te/ de ni 'dod chags chen po zhes bya'o/ /de la 'dod chags 'bring po gang zhe na/ gang gis 'dod pa77rnams la sten par gyur na bya ba grub kyi bar du sten gyi/ bya ba grub nas 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sems 'thob pa dang / 'gyod pa 'thob pa dang /sems la mi cha ba 'thob pa ste/ de ni 'dod chags 'bring po zhes bya'o/ /de la 'dod chags chung ngu gang zhe na/ gang gis 'dod pa rnams la sten7par gyur 61—54

kyang mnams pa dang / byugs pa dang / lus kyis reg pa tsam 'amatsho tshig tu smra ba tsam 'amanya/ mthong ba tsam gyis tshim par 'gyur ba de ni 'dod chags chung ngu zhes bya'o/ /mdor na 'tsho ba'i yo byad thams cad la chags pa'i sems su gyur pa ste de ni 'dod chags zhes bya'o/ /de la zhe snang gang zhe na/ zhe sdang yang rnam pa gsum du rig par bya ste/ chen po dang 'bring po dang chung ngu'o/ /de la zhe snang chen po gang zhe na/ zhe snang gi rnam pa gang gis zhe sdang zhing rngam 'khrugasalgegatum par gyur nas mtshams med pa lnga las gang yang rung ba la la dhibyed pa'am/ dam pa'i chos spong ba gang byas pa la/ mtshams med pa lnga bsdoms pas kyang grangs su yang nye bar mi 'gro/ cha dang / bgrang ba dang /dpe dang rgyur yang nye bar mi 'gro ba de lta bu byed de/ de de'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis lus zhig nas sems can dmyal ba chen po dag tu skye zhing / gal te brgya lam na mir skye na yang gnagatucing mig dmar la gtum zhing gnod sems mang bar 'gyur te/ de de'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis yang sems can dmyal ba dag du skye bar 'gyur ba de ni zhe snang chen po zhes bya'o/ /de la zhe snang 'bring po gang zhe na/ gang gis zhe sdang bar gyurabate/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i las byas na myur ba myur ba/ skyen pa skyenatshwanye pa/ la gor la gor du 'gyod〈nyecing de'i gnyen po la yang sten pa ste/ de ni zhe sdang 'bring po zhes bya'o/ /de la zhe snang chung ngu gang zhe na/ gang gis zhe snang bar gyur nas tshig tsam dang / mi snyan pa tsam dang / ngan du brjod pa tsam gyis mi dge ba la stsogs 8pa ste/ de yang de la brgyal bar 'ga' 'byung ste/ byung na yang de'i skad cig de'i 7yud tsam de'i thangasacig la gnyen po la sten pa ste/ de ni zhe sdang chung ngu zhes bya'o8/ /de la 864—55

gti mug gang zhe na/ gti mug kyang rnam pa gsum du rig par bya ste/ chen po dang ske/ 'bring po dang / chung ngu'o/ /gang de la gti mug chen po gang zhe na/gang ji skad du smos pa'i gnas de dag la nyes kyang dga'anyezhing mya ngan du mi byed/smre sngags mi 'don/ 'gyod pa med pa yin te/ de ni gti mug chen po zhes bya'o / /de la gti mug 'bring po gang zhe na/ gang gis mi dge ba'i las la la byas kyang / la gor la gor du 'gyod cing / tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyi drung du 'chags shing mi 'chab la/ de lasnyeyon tan du yang mi lta ba yin te/ 'di ni gti mug 'bring po zhes bya'o/ /de la gti mug chung ngu gang zhe na / gang gis rang bzhin gyis kha na ma tho ba ma yin pa/ bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba bslab pa kun spyad〈pepa'i lam gnyis gsum las 'da' ba ste/ de ni gti mug chung ngu zhes bya'o/ /de la yang byang chub sems dpa' sems phyir bzlog0pa la mkhas pa yin te/ de de ltar sems la mkhas pa la/ gang 'dod pa rnams la dga' ba medang 'dod pa rnams la mos pa dang / 'dod pa rnams la lhag par〈chags pa de lta bu med pa7yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ltar sems la mkhas pa'i phyir ro/ /'on te lung du ma bstan pa la spyod na/ de la dran pa dang ldan zhing nan tan du byed la/ de brtag pa la brtson pa yin te/de la ji ltar na lung du ma bstan pa la spyod pa yin zhe na/ gang gi tshe sems phyi rol tu'ang mi rgyu/ nang du'ang mi rgyu/ dge ba la'ang mi spyod/ mi dge ba la'ang mi spyod/ lhag mthong la yang mi spyod/ zhi gnas kyang mi 'dzin cing zhum la gnyid kyis non par gnas pa ste/ 'di lta ste/ dper na skyes bu nyal nyal ba las sad pa mig gnyid hu1kyis bsgribs pa'i sems mi gsal ba de bzhin du 64—56

de'i tshe sems de7mi gsal bar 'gyur bsheste/ de la byang chub sems dpa' sems yang dag parashegazengs0bstod pa dang / yang dag paraphurab tu dga' bar bya ba dang / yang dag par gzhag pa la mkhas pa yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems la mkhas pa yin no/ /de de ltar sems la mkhas pas0chos 'di dag ni sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /chos 'di dag ni rmi lam lta bu'o/ /chos 'di dag ni dge ba'o/ /chos 'di dag ni mi dge ba'o/ /chos 'di dag ni 'byung ba'o/ /chos 'di dag ni mi 'byung ba'o zhes chos rnams la yongs su rtog ste / de 'di snyam du chos 'di dag thams cad ni sems la gnas pa/ sems las byung ba/ sems sngon du 'gro ba ste/ sems shin tu bcil/ shin tu btul/ shin tu khong du chud par byas na/ chos de dag thams cad kyang shin tu bcil ba dang / shin tu btul ba dang / shin tu khong du chud par 'gyur te/des chos rnams de ltar mthong bas/ deshede'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis sems zhi bar bya ba'i phyir nan tan du7byed de①/ /de sems nyid la sems 'dogs so/ /sems nyid kyis sems zhi bar byed do/ /sems nyid la sems rab tu gzhog go/ /de de ltar zhi ba la brtson pas sems rtse gcig tu 'gyur te/ rtse gcig tu red nas mnyam par gzhog go/ /sems mnyam par bzhag pa la dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba mngon du 'gyur te/ de yid dga' bar gyur nas 'dod pa dganyelas dben pa8/ sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams las dben pa/ rtog pa dang bcas pa/ dpyod pa dang bcas pa/ dben pa las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan dang po rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de rtog pa dang dpyod pa mi snang bar bya ba'i phyir nan tan byed cing dga' ba dang /61—57

bde ba'i ro de 'ang7)myang bar mi byed de mi rtogashego snyam nas bsam gtan dang po las sems skyedarabado/ /de rtog pa dang dpyod pa dang bral zhing chags pa med pa'i yid du gyur pas nang yongs su dang ste/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu gyur pas rtog pa med pa/ dpyod pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' ba dang bde ba can bsam gtan gnyis pa rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de dga' ba dang sdug bsngal ba ⑤yin par 0khong du chud par byed deX/ sdug bsngal lo snyam nas btang snyoms la gnas pa yin/ btang snyoms la gnas pas dran pa dang ldan zhing shes bzhin can yin te/ bde ba lus kyis myong la/'phags pa rnams kyis gang de dran pa dang ldan pa bde ba la gnas pa btang snyoms pa'o zhes brjod pa ste/ dga' ba med pa'i bsam gtan gsum pa rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de bsam gtan gsum pa gtong ngo snyam nas bsam gtan bzhi pa la sems gtong ste/ des7bsam gtan bzhi pa thob pas bdag tu 'dzin pa phyir ldog go/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa phyir ldog pas bde ba yang spong /sdug bsngal ba yang spong ste/ de bde ba yang spangs/ sngarwanyenas sdug bsngal yang spangs shing yid bde ba dang yid mi bde ba yang nub pas bde ba yang ma yin/sdug bsngal ba yang ma yin pa btang snyoms dang dran pa yongs su dag pa bsam gtan bzhi pa rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de bdag gi lus dang nam mkha'i lus su gcig tu mos par byed de/ de de ltar mos pas gzugs kyi 'du shes las thams cad du thams cad yang dag par 'das pa yin/ thogs pa'i 'du shes kyang nub pa yin 18/ de rnam pa thams cad du gzugs kyi 'du shes rnams las yang dag par 'das te/ thogs pa'i 'du shes rnams nub par gyur 64—58

cing sna tshogs kyi 'du shes rnams yid la mi byed pas nam mkha' mtha' yas so snyam nas/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das nas rnam par shes pa mtha' yas so snyam nas/ rnam shes7mtha' yas skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las yang dag par 'das nas/ci yang med do snyam nas ci yang med pa'i skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de ci yang med pa'i skye mched las yang dag par 'das nas 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de'i gong nakhugang sems kyi mtshan ma med pa/ rgyu ba thams cad 'gags pa sgrib pa thams cad dngasabral ba 'di ni 'gog pa⑥zhes bya ste/ de ni shes par bya'o snyam nas byang chub sems dpa' snyoms par 'jug gi /de la mngon par dga' ba'i rten gyi gnas mi skyedakyido/ /de byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems khon7med pa/ 'gran zla med pa/ gnod pa med pa/ yangs pasachen por gyur pa tshad med pa/ mi gnyis pa shin tu bsgoms pas phyogs gcig tu mos te khyab par byas nas rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /gcig tu ji lta ba de bzhin du gnyis pa dang / de bzhin du gsum pa dang / de bzhin du bzhi pa dang / bla dang / 'og dang /grwa'i7'jig rten 'disgo/) thams cad kyi rnam pa thams cad du byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems khon 3)med pa/ 'gran zla med pa/ gnod pa med pahu)/ yangs patsochen por gyur pa/ tshad med pa/ mi gnyis pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas mos te khyab par byas nas rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de bzhin du snying rje dang ldan pa dang / dga' ba dang btangachasnyoms dang ldan pa'i sems khon 8med pa/64—59

'gran zla med pa/ gnod pa med pa/ yangs pa chen por gyur pa/ tshad med pa / mi gnyis pa/ shin tu bsgoms pas phyogs gcig tu mos te khyab par byas nas rdzogs par byas tetuganas so/ /gcig tu ji lta ba de bzhin du gnyis pa dang ske/ des/ bzhin du gsum pa dang / de bzhin du bzhi pa dang / bla dang /'og dang / grwa'i gu'ajig rten 'di thams cad kyi rnam pa thams cad du btang snyoms dang ldan pa'i sems khonasremed pa/ 'gran zla med pa/ gnod pa med pa / yangs pa chen por gyur pa/ tshad med pa/ mi gnyis pa shin tu bsgoms pas mos (6)te khyab par byas nas rdzogs par byas te gnas so/ /de mngon par shes pa lnga skyed do/ /de la yang ma zhen pa yin te/ gong du yang byang chub kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i chos rnams yongs su tshol lo/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bsam gtan phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' shes rab phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ bdag med pa la mkhas pa rnams yin/ las kyi rnam par smin pa la mkhas pa rnams yin/ 'dus byas la mkhas pa rnams yin/ 'khor ba'i rgyun la mkhas pa rnams yin/ 'khor ba'i ldog pa lasnyemakhas pa rnams yin/nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la mkhas pa rnams yin/ theg pa chen po la mkhas pa rnams yin/ bdud kyi las yongs su spangs pa la mkhas pasnyernams yin/ ma log pa'i shes rab can rnams yin mnyam pa med pa'i shes rab can rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bdag med pa la mkhas pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la ⑩byang chub sems dpa' 64—60

yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis gzugs la rtog /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes patul rtog ste/ de gzugs〈gul rtog pa na gzugs kyi skye ba mi dmigs/ kun 'byung ba mi dmigs/ 'gog⑧pa mi dmigs so/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes0dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa'i skye ba mi dmigs/ kun 'byung ba mi dmigs/'gog pa mi dmigs so/ /de yang don dam par yin gyi tha snyad kyi rang bzhin dusnyim yin te/ des don dam pa'i rang bzhin gang yin pa dang / tha snyad kyi rang bzhin gang yin pa'i rang bzhin de gnyis ka yang brjodakyipa'i rang bzhin du7mi dmigs te/ de'i phyir brtson 'grus kyang nyamasalgepar mi byed de/ mgo'i thod la me 'bar ba bzhin du sems can rnams kyi don du rtsol zhing 'bad la brtson 'grus rtsom ste/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bdag med pa la mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' las kyi rnam par smin pa lashemakhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar dpyod de/'jig rten gnas pa 'di ni gar mkhan gyi tshon dang 'dra ba/ dri za'i grong khyer lta bu rang bzhin gyis stong la/ sems can 'di dag kyang sems can ma yin na 'on kyang bdag tu 'dzin pa la mngon par zhen pas de dag de'i phyir lam khong du chud pa mi 'thob bo/ /de dag ni 'di snyam du gal te bdag gam/sems can nam/ srog gam/ skye ba57po'am/ gso ba'amanya/ skyes7bu'am/gang zag gam/ shed las skyes sam/ shed bu med na dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam par smin pa yang med par 'gyur ro snyam du sems mod kyi/ sems can med du zin kyang las kyi rnam par smin pa yangachamangon no snyam ste/ de la 64—61

byang chub sems dpa' de jiganyu)ltar sems can de yang med la/ ji ltar dge ba dang ske/ mi dge ba'i las rnams50kyi rnam par smin pa yang mngon pa desnyeyang dag pa'i shes rab kyis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' las kyi rnam par smin pa la mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'dus byas la mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'dus byas kyi chos rnams lam④yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis rtog par byed cing de 'di snyam du sems te/ 'dus byas kyi chos 'di dag ni〈mi gnas pa / g.yo ba/ zil pa'i thigs pa lta bu/ ri bo'i 'bab chu lta bu yin na⑥/de la mkhas pa su zhig 'di lta bu'i chos rnams la zhen pa dang / chags par byed pa'am / de dag med par gyur pas mya ngan du byed snyam nas/ de ④de'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis skyo geb dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / 'gog pa la sems gtong ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'dus byas la mkhas pa yin rnam/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba'i rgyun la mkhas pa yin zhe na/'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar dpyod de/ kye ma'o 'jig rten gnas pa 'di ni ma rig pas ldongs 1)pa/ 'khor ba la phyogs pa/ srid pa'i zhags pas bcings pa ste11/ len pa nye bar len to3ge/ /de len pa'i rgyus dge ba dang ske/ mi dge ba'i las mngon par 'du byed de/ de dge ba dang mi dge ba'i las mngon par 'du byed pa dang ldan pas srid par hunyeyang mtshams sbyor bar 'gyur te/ de'i rgyu las skye bar 'gyur ro/ /skye ba yod pas rga bar 'gyur ro/ /rga ba'i chos can ni 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /'chi ba las mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rgyun 64wa 62

chags pa nyid du 'gyur te/ de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhigashepo de zokhuchun rgyudashemo'i 'khor lo ltar/ 'khor ba'i⑧'khor lo'i rgyun⑧du 'gyur ro snyam ste/ de yang byang chub sems dpas yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te②/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba'i rgyun la mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba ldog pa la mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar dpyod de/ ma rig pa med par gyur pas 'du byed la zhen par mi 'gyur/'du byed la zhen pa7med par gyur pas rnam par shes par mi 'gyur/ rnam par shes pa med par gyur pas ming dang gzugs dang / skye mched drug dang /reg pa dang / tshor ba dang / sred pa med par 'gyur ro/ /sred pa med par gyur pas7 len pa mi 'byung ste/ len pa med pas srid pa 31yang mtshams sbyor bar mi 'gyurang/ srid parwarteyang mtshams sbyor ba med par gyur pas/ skye bar mi 'gyur/ skye ba med par gyur pas rga shi dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa rnams rgyun chad par 'gyur te/ de yang byang chub sems dpa'as7yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'khor ba ldog pa la mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la mkhas pa yin zhe na/'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar dpyod de/ chos 'dis ni rgyun tu zhugs par 'gyur ro/ /'dis ni lan cig phyir 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'dis ni7phyir mi 'ong bar 'gyur7/ 'dis ni dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa/ srid pa'i kun 61—63

tu7sbyor ba chad pa/ yang mtshams sbyor ba7med pa/ mya ngan las 'das pa lasnyeyang dag par gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /chos 'dis ni rang sangs rgyas bse ru lta bur gegacig pu spyod par 'gyur ro snyam ste/ de thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpasams)yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis rab tu rtogs par byed de/ chos 'di dag mngon du yangs④mi byed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de 'di snyam du sems te/sems can gyi khams bdag gis bzung / bdag gis seng ge'i sgra bsgrags te⑦/sems can 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa na gnas pa thams cad sgrol7lo zhes dam bcas la/ gcigashes 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa nas 'byung ba ni bdag gi mi cha'o snyam ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' theg pa chen po la mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' bslab pa thams cad la yang slob la/ slob pa yang mi dmigs/ bslabalgepa'i lam yang mi dmigs12/ gang slob pa de yang mi dmigs so/ /de7de'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis chad par ltasabar yang7mi lhung ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' theg pa chen po la mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bdud kyi las spong ba la mkhas pa yinasnyizhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' mi dge ba'i grogs po thams cad du thams cad〈nyeyongs su spong ste/ mi cha ba'i yul la gnas pa dang / 'jig rten rgyang pan〈nyepa'i gsang tshig la sten cing sgom pa dang ske/ rnyed pa dang / bkur ste dang / mchod pa dang / rim gro la ched cher 'dzin pa thams cad du thams cad yongs su spong ngo / /nye ba'i nyon mongs pa gzhan gang byang chub kyi lam gyi bar chad dum )'gyur ba de dag kyang thams cad 64wa 64

du thams cad yongs su sponganyezhing / de dag gi gnyen po la yang sten tezhu/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bdud kyi las yongs su spang ba la mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ma log pa'i shes rab can yin zhe na/'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten pa'i gtsug lag dang / gsang tshig dang ske/ las dang /① bzo'i gnas thams cad la shes rab gtong ste/ de yang sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir te/ shes kyi khe 'dod pa dang / grags pa 'dod pa dang / rnyed pa dang / bkur ste 'dod pa'i phyir ma yin gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i che ba nyid brjod pa'i phyir te/ de la yon tan du ltakhuba'i phyir ni ma yin no/ /gzhan du na de 'di snyam du sems te/ gsung rab 'di ni dam pa ste/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos 'dul ba'o snyam nas/ de de la yon tan du lta bas〈khyamu stegs can gzhan gyi lta ba can du mi 'gyur te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ma log pa'i shes rab can yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mnyam pa med pa'i shes rab can yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten bdud dang bcas pa tshangs pa dang bcas pa/ skye dgu'ishedage sbyong dang / bram zer bcas pal/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i nang na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ma gtogs par gang de dang shes rab mnyam pa de lta bu'i sems7can sems can gyi ris na7 med de/ de ni 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa/ bdud dang bcas pa/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa/ skye dgu'i〈spedage sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin du bcas pa'i nang na/64—65

shes rab kyi bye brag gis zil gyis mnan7pa yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mnyam pa med pa'i shes rab can yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' shes rab phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas tsho pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ yongs su bsngo ba'i thabs mkhas pa rnams yin/ mu stegs can rnam par zlog⑧pa'i thabs mkhas pa rnams yin/ yul las rnam par zlogasnyipa'i thabs mkhas pa rnams yin/'gyod pa yid la gcags pa sel ba'i thabs mkhas pa rnams yin/ sems can la dpung gnyen byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa rnams yin/ sems can 'tsho ba'i thabs 55nye bar sbyor ba la mkhas pa rnams yin/ len pa'i thabs mkhas pa rnams yin/ gnas nas gnas su slong ba'i thabs mkhas pa rnams yin/ yang dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa dang / gzengs stod pa dang / shin tu dga' bar byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa rnams yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba'i thabs mkhas pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yongs su bsngo ba'i thabs mkhas pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la 575byang chub sems dpa' gang 'di dag me tog gi rnam pa 'am/'bras bu'i rnam pa nga yir 58)bya ba med pa/ yongs su bzung ba med pa de rnams nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'bul lo/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ciyongs su bsngo'o/ /de gang 'di dag bdug pa'i shing ngam/spos kyi shing ngam/ rin po che'i shing ngam/ dpag bsam gyi shing ngam/ me 61—66

tog gi shing ngam/ 'bras bu'i shing nga yir0bya ba med pa yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kyang nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'bul lo/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o/ /de mdo sde rnams la ②mchod pa dang / rim gro bya ba gang 'di dag rgya chen po rgya che ba dag nyan cing de dag snying thagashepa nas lhag pa'i bsam pa mchog gisasresangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yongs su bsngo'o/ /gang phyogs bcu na byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / de ma yin pa'i sems can dag dge ba'i las rnams byed cing byang chub kyi tshogs rnams yongs su rdzogs par byed pa de dag la snying thag pa nas rjes su yisarang ste/ dge ba'i rtsa ba de yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo'o/ /de de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten nam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la me tog gam/ bdug pa'am/spos gsol na sems can thams cad kyi ngang tshul ngan pa'i dri nga ba bsal ⑦ba dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims kyi dri thob par yongs su bsngo'o/ /de phyag dar dang zhal zhal byedalon sems can thams cad kyi spyod lam mi sdug pa med par 'gyur ba dang / spyod lam mdzes pa phun sum tshogs par yongs su bsngo'o/ /de me tog gi gdugasalgegasol na/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba med par bya ba'i7phyir yongs su bsngo'o/ /de gtsug lag khang gi nang du 'gro na 'di ltar sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer durwamegazud do snyam du sems bskyed do / /de phyir 'byung na 'di ltar sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i btsonatsor 64—67

nas 'don to snyam du sems skyed0)do/ /de gnas khang gi sgo 'byed na 'di ltar 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes kyis bde 'gro thams cad kyi sgo dbye'o/ /snyam du sems skyed57do/ /de sgo gcod na 'di ltar ngan 'gro thams cad kyi sgo rnams gcad rdudo snyam du sems skyed do④/ /de 'dug na 'di ltar sems can thams cad byang chub kyi snying po la dgodakyido snyam du sems skyed do/ /de glo〈g.yas pas nyal na 'di ltar sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mya ngan las 'da' bas rin yongs su mya ngan las bzla'o snyam du sems skyed7do/ /de de nas ldang na 'di ltar sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa'i kun nas ldang ba rnams las bslang mngo snyam du sems skyedasngormedo/ /de lus kyi ched la 'gro na/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad skyes bu chen po'i 'gros hurtesu 'gro bar gyur cig snyam du sems skyed nyusnyedo/ /de der 'dug na 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug gi zug rngu dbyung ngo snyam du sems skyedashedo / /de bkru bshal byed na 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i dri ma'i skyon rnams bkru'o snyam du sems skyed7do/ /de lag pa bsnyal na 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi5nyenyon mongs pa'i dri nga ba rnams bsal lo snyam du sems skyed〈nyedo/ /de rkang pa 'khru na 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i rdul rnam pa sna tshogs bsal lo snyam du sems skyed do/ /de so shing za na 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi dri ma rnam pa sna tshogs bsal lo snyam du sems skyed ⑥ do/ /de lus kyi g.yo ba thams cad sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde bar yongs su sngo'o༅/ /de de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la phyag 'tshal na 'di ltar sems can thams cad lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 64wa 68

gyis phyag bya bar shog shigatusnyam du sems skyedakhude/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yongs su sngoneba'i thabs mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mu stegs can rnam par zlog①pa'i thabs mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di lta ste/ mu stegs can spyod pa pasnyidang ske/ kun tu rgyu dang / gcer bu pa la sogs pa'i mu stegs can gyi gnasalgede dang de dag tu 'phrul ba dag mngon par sprul te/ de sems can⑩yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir thabs byed cing de 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma'o sems can 'di rnams nga rgyal gyi zil gyis non pas bdag gis sngar slob dpon gyi tshul gyis gdul bar nilomi nus kyisal/ slob mar khas blang ngo snyam ste/ de dag gi khrod du rab tu 'byung ngo / /de rab tu byung nas ji ltar spyod pa dang / spyod yul dang / mang du thos pa dang / spyod pa7dman tshegs5)kyis kyang mu stegs can gzhan de dag zil gyis gnon pa de lta de lta bur rtsol lo/ /'bad do/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /de dag gi nang5nyen slob dpon dang bla ma lta bur bkur bar 'gyur/ tshig bzungasnyizhing ngag mi gcog par 'gyur te/ ④kye sems can de dag nye bar gyur pa'o snyam du shes nas/ grogs po dag 'di ni skyo ba dang /'dod chags dang bral ba dang / 'gog par 'gyur ba'i lam ma yin no zhes mu stegs can de dag gi ma legs pa rjodagyepar 'gyur te/ des mu stegs can gzhan de dag gnas de rnams las bslang ⑩nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos 'dul ba la 'god do/ /de phyi rol gyi mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa dag gi gan du tshangs par spyad pa spyod do/ /de tshangs par spyad pa spyod cing chos de thob par bya ba'i phyir spyod cing rtsol lo/ /'bad do/ /dekertsol zhing 'bad pas 64—69

bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sgrub ste/ci nas kyang mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa gzhan de dag pas ches mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / ches 'bar bar 'gyur ba dang / slob dpon gyi mchog tu 'gyur ba dang / mkhas par bkur bar 'gyur ba de ltar sgrubatupo/ /des sems can de rnams yongs su smin pa'i dus dang / tshod shes nas grogs po dag lam 'di ni skyo ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / 'gogashepar 'gyur ba'i lam ma yin no zhes/ bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /snyoms par 'jug pa de dag gi ma legs pa ④brjod pa yin te/ des sems can de dag gnas de las bslang nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos 'dul ba la rab tu 'god de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mu stegs can rnam pa ra zlog pa pa'i thabs mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yul las rnam par zlog bapa'i thabs mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems can gang rab tu 'dod chags can rab tu 'dod chags mang ba'i sems can rnams mthong na/ des de dag gdul ba'i thabs gzhan med do snyam nas des de dag gi drung du bud med sprul pa bzang mo blta na sdug pa bud med thams cad kyi mchog dag sprul te/ sems can deshernams de dag la rab tu chags par rig nas sprul pa'i bud med de mal de nyid du 'chi ba'i dus byed du 'jug go/ /de yang skad cig de nyid dang / yud tsam de nyid dang / thang cig de nyid la rul cing dri nga ba dang 'jig spupar 'gyur te/ de dag gis kyang de tsomathong nas dngangasal)skrag skyo bar red de/ bdag cag 'di 'dra ba'i dri nga ba'i nang nas gang thar bar byed pa su zhig yod ces nyam thag par 'gyur ro/ /61—70

de'i tshe na byang chub sems dpa' sems can de dag gi mdun du 'dug ste/ de byang chub gsum las gang yang rung ba'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ba de ltar sems can de dag la chos ston te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yul las rnam par zloganyepa'i thabs mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'gyod pa yid la gcagasalgepa sel ba'i thabs mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems can su mtshams med pa'i las byed pa'am/ mi dge ba'i las byed pa mthong na/ de'i gan du song ste/ kye skyes bu khyod57ci'i phyir yid mi bde zhing mi dga' bar gnas zhes de skad zer ro/ /des kyang smras pal/ rigs kyi bu bdag gis mtshams med pa'i las byas pas de'i phyir bdag la yun ring por gnod pa dang / phan pa med pa dang / sdug bsngal bar7mi 'gyur grang zhes yid mi bde zhing mi dga' bar gnas so/ /de'i phyir dekyil byang chub sems dpa' sdom pa 'dzin du 'jug go/ /nyes pa yang 'chags su 'jug go/ /de la chos bstan pa zab mo zab mo yang byed dol/ /de ste 'gyod pa mi gtong na de'i phyir de la byang chub sems dpa' thog marakyi'adi lta ste/ rdzu 'phrul labage/ sems kun rjod7pas yang dag par yid ches pa skyed do/ /de nas sems can de yang dag par yid ches pa skyes nas byang chub sems dpa' de la dga' ba dang / mos pa dang / rangs pa rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /derwa byedaga' ba dang / mos pa dang / rangs pa rnyed pas de chos bstan tu rung bar 'gyur/byang chub sems dpa' de 37dang 'thun par hunye'adzin par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' des de'i mdun du 'di lta ste/ pha mar sprul pa mngon par sprul te 'di skad zer ro/ /kye skyes bu khyod ltos la 'gyod pa chod cig /nga 61—71

yang khyod kyi grogs te/ las 'di lta bus su'ang shin tu sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba'am/ don thams cad las nyams par 'gyur ba med do/ /las de ye shes kyis bsal du mi nus pa yang ma yin no/ /zhes de skad smras nas/ pha ma srog dang phral lo/ /srog dang phral nas kyang0)rdzu 'phrul de ston to/ /de nas sems can de 'di snyam du sems te/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pas kyang pha ma srog dang phral na/ bdag 'dra ba lta ci zhig smos snyam mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' de yang de'i tshe sems can de la ci nas kyang de'i las de sbrang ma'i 'dab ma 'dra bar 'gyur bsnyede lta bu'i〈chos ston par byed do/ /de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'gyod pa yid la gcags pa sel ba'i thabs mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can la dpung gnyen byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpasasresems can gang chos bstan par rung zhing nus pa dag mthong la/ de dag kyang shin tu mi dge ba'i las7byed par gyur na/ de dag gdul7ba'i thabs su byang chub sems dpas 'phrul ba dag mngon par sprul te/ de la sems can gang rnams rgyal pos 'dul bar 'gyur ba de dag la rgyal por sprul pa mngon par sprul par byed do/ /sems can gang rnams blon po chen pos 'dul bar 'gyur bsade dag la blon po chen por sprul pa mngon par sprul par byed do/ /sems can gang rnams bram ze dang /rgyal rigs dang / grong pa dang / yul mis 'dul bar 'gyur ba de dag la bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / grong pa dang / yul mir sprul pa dang /sems can gang rnams lhas 'dul ba de dag la lhar sprul pa dang / gang lag na rdo rjes 'dul ba de dag la lag na rdo rjer sprul pa mngon par sprul par byed do/ /64—72

sems can gang rnams 'jigs pas 'dul bar 'gyur ba de dag la 'jigs pa ston / sems can gang rnams bdegs pa dang / bsdigs pa dang / gsad patudang / bcing bas gdul7ba de dag la de 'dra bar ston/ sems can gang rnams des pasaphu'adul ba de dag la des pas 'dul/ sems can gang rnams mtshams med pa byed 'dod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dag la brgyad par 'dod pa de dag thabs sna tshogs kyis zlogasacing zil gyis gnon par byed/ phyogs gzhan du yang bskar bar byed do/ /mtshams med par 'gyur ba'i dngos po sbas te/ de 'dra bar de'i mdun du sprul pa ston to/ /yang na sems can dmyal ba ston to/ /mngon par shes pa ma skyes pa'i byang chub sems dpa' tshe'i mtshan ma shes pa ni byed 'dod pa dang / gsod 'dod pa'i sems can de dag mthong nas snying rje chen po'i sems skyes te/ de yang 'di snyam du/ kye ma sems can 'di rnams ni phung bar 'dod pa'o/ /kye ma sems can 'di rnams ni brlag par 'dod pa'o snyam du sems shing / de dag des lag mthil du skyu ru ra'i 'bru bzhag pa ltar mthong nas mi dga' ba'i sems chen po skyed de/ de yang 'di snyam du sems so/ /bdag sems can gcig gi phyire yang sems can de phung po'i lhag ma ma lus pa'i mya ngan las ⑨'das pa'i dbyings su rab tu ma 7bzhag pa'i bar du/ mnar med pa'i sdug bsngal bkur bar (trebazod na/ sems can 'di rnams kyang mi dge ba'i las byas te/mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por skye bar 'dod pa thabs gzhan gyis ni bzlog7par mi nus te/ sems can de rnams tshe yang thung dad pahūyang med pa dag cig la yul gzhan du bskarachaba'am/ zil gyis mnan par bya 61—73

ba de lta bu'i dbang ni bdag la med na sems can 'di rnams mi dge ba'i las 'dis0)lus zhig nas mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por skye bar mi 'gyur grang zhesashede'i phyir snying rje'i sems nye bar gzhag nas las7bdag girasrebya ba dang 'dra bar byas nas/ sems can de rnams la byams pas khyab par byas te/ thabs gzhan gyis mi nus nas chad pa rab kyis 'chos te/ de ltar na (9byang chub sems dpa' sems can la dpung gnyen byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can 'tsho ba'i thabs nye bar sbyor ba la mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems can gang rnams 'phags pa'i chos 'dul ba shes par mi lcogs mi nus te/ zas dang gos lhura'i/'dzin cing de kho nas chog⑧par rtsi ba mthong na/ de rnams la byang chub sems dpa' yi ge dang / gtsugashelag dang / rgya dang / grangs dang /shod thabs la sogs pa'i las dge ba dang ldan pa dag ston teyi/ mi dge ba dang ldan pa mi ston to/ /de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can 'tsho ba'i thabs nye bar sbyor ba la mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' len pa'i thabs mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i phung po ri rab tsam thob na yang len te/ dngos po ngan pa zhig thob na'ang len to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de 17'di ltar sems te/ sems can 'di dag ni ser sna can/ brkam pa/ 'dod pas 'khol5)ba/ 'jungs pa yin te/de'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis chu'i phung po chen pos non pa bzhin du 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'byung nub byed pa de dag la/ de ni yun ring por〈nyedon dang / phan pa dang / bde bar 'gyur ro snyam steci/ de blangs nas bdag gir7mi byed/61—74

chags pa'i sems mi skyed7de/ gzhan du na sems can thams cad dang thun mong du sangs rgyas dang chos dang / dge'u'adun dag la bya ba byed do/ /sems can sdug bsngal bsnyernams la yang phan par byed do/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po de yang gzengs stodasnyipa dang / shin tu dga' bar byed de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' len pa'i thabs mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gnas nas gnas su slong ba'i thabs mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems can gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar lcogs shing nus pa zhig la/ de yang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa thob par rtsol zhing 'bad de brtson 'grus rtsom pa mthong na/ de gnas de nas bslangasnyiste/ tha na 'khor dbye ba yang byas nas theg pa chen po la 'jog ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gnas nas gnas su slong ba'i thabs mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par 'dzin tu 'jug pa dang / gzengs stodakyipa dang ske/ shin tu dga' bar byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi sems ma bskyed pa'i sems can rnams byang chub kyi sems skyedakyidu 'jug /byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i sems can le lo can brtson 'grus chung ba/ tshul khrims tsam gyis chog7par 'dzin pa dag ni brtson 'grus la 'jog /sems can gang rnams bslab pa kun spyod pa phra mo las 'gal ba dag de'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis semasarwa )kun khebs shing 'khod de/ dga' mgu rangs pa yang mi rnyed pa de dag la/ de ci nas kyang gnas de nas ldang ba de lta de lta bur chos ston par byed de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yang 64—75

dag par 'dzin du 'jug pa dang / gzengs stod7pa dang / shin tu dga' bar byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang / rim gro bya ba'i thabs mkhas pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' rab tu 'byungakhebar 'gyur te/ rnyed pa chung ngusayang chos kyi rnyed pas chog par 'dzin pa yin/de gcig sa)pu lkog tu song ste/ rab tu dben par gnas nas/ de 'di ltar sems te/ ma la bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang / rim gro bya ba bsam mo snyam nas/ de de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang / rim gro bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs sems te/ de ltar sems pa de'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsgomashepa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar na⑧pa rol tu phyin pa drug bsgom ⑨pa yongs rkyu )su rdzogs par 'gyur zhe na/ de la gang mchod pa dang /rim gro bya ba mngon par byed pa 'di ni de'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /mchod pa dang / rim gro bya ba de la gang sems can thams cad la dmigs pa'i sems skye ba 'di ni de'i tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /mchod pa dang / rim gro bya ba de dag la gang sems mngon par mos shing shin tu dga' ba 'di ni de'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /mchod pa dang / rim gro bya ba de dag nyidarwanyel gang sems mi skyoneb 'di ni de'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /mchod pa dang / rim gro bya ba de dag7nyid la gang nye bar rtog pa 'di ni de'i bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /mchod pa dang / rim gro bya ba de dag nyid la gang sna tshogs pa 'di ni de'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang /64—76

rim gro bya ba'i thabs mkhas pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' smon lam phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi dman pa'i smon lam pa rnams yin/ ma zhum pa'i smon lam pa rnams yin/ sems can thams cad kyi don la brtson pa'i smon lam pa rnams yin/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yang dag par bsngags7pa'i smon lam pa rnams yin/ bdud thams cad shin tu tshar gcod pa'i smon lam pa rnams yin/ gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog⑧pa'i smon lam pa rnams yin/ mtha' yas pa'i smon lam pa rnams yin/ mi skrag pa'i smon lam pa rnams yin/ yongs su mi skyo ba'i smon lam pa rnams yin/ legs par yongs su rdzogs pa'i smon lam pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi dman pa'i smon lam pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la nibyang chub sems dpa' srid pa'i bde ba 'dod cing smon lam mi 'debs④te / de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi dman pa'i smon lam pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ma zhum pa'i smon lam pa yin zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni khams gsum las skyo ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba dang ske/ 'gog par smon lam mi 'debs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ma zhum pa'i smon lam pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad kyi don la brtson pa'i smon lam pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar sems can gyi khams ji snyed pa ma lus par de thams cad yongs su mya ngan las bzlas ⑤nas bdag phyis sangs rgyas kyi yongs su mya ngan las 64—77

'da' bas yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o zhes smon lam 'debs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad kyi don la brtson pa'i smon lam pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yang dag par bsngags pa'i smon lam pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar byang chub kyi sems ma bskyed pa'i sems can gyi khams ji snyed pa de dag thams cad byang chub tu sems bskyed du bcug ste/ mthar gyis byang chub kyi spyod pa spyod 7du btsud nas byang chub kyi snying por 'dug pa rnams la mchod pa dang /bkur sti bya'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar gsol ba gdab po②/ /yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba rnams kyang sems can thams cadashel phan pa'i phyir bzhugs su gsol lo ④zhes smon lam 'debs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yang dag par bsngags pa'i smon lam pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bdud thams cad shin tu tshar gcod pa'i smon lam pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' ni 'di ltar bdag mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i dusangs rgyas kyi zhing na ci nas kyang bdud kyi sgra'am/ bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams 'byung bar yang7mi 'gyur ba de ltar bdag gis bya'o zhes smon lam 'debs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bdud thams cad shin tu tshar gcod pa'i smon lam pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa'i smon lam pa yin zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' ni gzhan gyi dring la bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam mi 'debs kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' ni bdag nyid kyikhushes rab kyis dpyad na/de/ sems can gyi khams sdug bsngal ba la bltas nas bla 64—78

na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam 'debs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa'i smon lam pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas pa'i smon lam pa yin zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni 'di lta ste/ byang chub kyi tshogs rnams kyi phyogs 'ga' zhiganyebazung nas nyilo tse ba'ikhusmon lam mi 'debs kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' ni bla gos phrag pa gcig la ④gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/sems mi skyo bar byas nas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su bltas te/byang chub sems dpa' gang dag phyogs bcu na gnas pa dang / gang dag dka' ba spyod pa la gnas pa dang / gang dag byang chub kyi snying po la gnas pa dang /sangs rgyas gang dag mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dngaston/ gang dag chos kyi 'khor lo skoraporab de dag rnams la snying thag pa nas bsams te⑦/ de dag gis chos bstan pa ji snyed pa de dag la mos par byed do/ /mos par gyur nas rjes su yi rang ngo / /rjes su yi rang nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su sngo gho/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas pa'i smon lam pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi skrag pa'i smon lam pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa yin yang chos zab mo zab mo rnams thos pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi che ba zab mo thos pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par rol pa zab mo thos pa dang / thabs mkhas pa'i tshul zab mo thos kyang mi skrag rab tu mi skrag shin tus7skrag par mi byed do / /de 'di snyam du sangs rgyas kyi byang7)chub kyang mtha' yas/ sangs rgyas kyi yul yangarwartematha' yas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sems can 64—79

yongs su smin par mdzad pa yang mtha' yas te/ de ni bdag 'dra bas shes par mi nus kyi/ sangs rgyas dag7nyid kyis mkhyen gyi/ bdag gis mi shes so snyam du sems te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi skrag pa'i smon lam pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yongs su mi skyo ba'i smon lam pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' sems can dmukyirgod sems can⑧gdul dka' bar rig stege/ de rnams kyis yi chad nas/ 'di lta bu'i dmu rgod 'di lta bur gdul dka' ba'i sems can 'di dag gis chog go zhes te/de'i phyir yongs su 67zhing rgyab kyis phyogs par⑩gyur te/ gang na sems can 'di lta bu dag gi ming yang mi thos pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su dag par smon lam mi 'debs so/ /sems can gyi don la ma phyogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar yang mi 'gyur te/de la byang chub sems dpa' shes rab can ni 'di ltar sems can gyi khams thams cad na sems can gang rnams ngan pa brtson 'grus chung ba/ blun po glen pa / lug ltar lkugasalgepa'i rang bzhin can yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i chos can/ sems can gyi khams ma lus pa 'dishelas bsnyigs pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis spangs par gyur pa yod pa de dag bdag gis (rtesangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'dus par gyur la/bdag gis de dag byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug tu bcug ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o snyam du sems skyedamo/tede/ byang chub sems dpa' de ltar sems pa'i sems bskyed pa re re la yang bdud kyi gnas thams cad rab tu g.yo'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 64—80

kyang de'i bsngags pa gsung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yongs su mi skyo ba'i smon lam pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' legs par yongs su rdzogs pa'i smon lam pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' gang byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug ste/ bdud kyi dpung gzhom pa dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / yang de las 'das par7smon lam mi 'debs pa 'di ni legs par yongs/ su rdzogs pa'i smon lam pa zhes bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ dper na/ mar ram/ 'bru mar gyi snod kha tha7chad du gang ste/lhag par rdul phra rab tsam gyi thigs pa yang mi shong na/ de'i phyir e ma'o snod gang ba/ e ma'o snod shin tu gang ba zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa la smon lam legs par yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir smon lam ma rdzogs pa rdul phra rab tsam yang med do/ /de bas na legs par yongs su rdzogs pa'i smon lam zhes bya ste/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' smon lam phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' stobs phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ zil gyis mi non pa'i stobs phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ mi tshugs pa'i stobs phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ bsod nams kyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ shes rab kyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ 'khor gyi 64—81

stobs phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ dbang gi stobs phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ gzungs kyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ rnam par mi 'khrugs pa'i byin gyi rlabasatukyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ bka' mi gcog⑧pa'i stobs phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' zil gyis mi non pa'i stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' pha rol rgol ba kun gyis zil gyis mi non pa yin te / de ltar na zil gyis mi non ③pa'i stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi tshugs pa'i stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/'di la byang chub sems dpa' de'i stobs la gang stobs kyis thub pa'i sems can de lta bu sems can gyi ris na med de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi tshugs pa'i stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams kyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpas ④ma bsgrubs gyepa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs 'jig rten pa'am/'jig rten las 'das pa de gang yang med de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams kyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpas de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes ma gtogs par sangs rgyas kyisachos gang yang yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis ma mthong ba dang / mngon du ma byas pa dang / khong du ma chud pa de dag med de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems 64—82

dpa' 'khor gyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor tshul khrims nyams pa ma yin/ lta ba nyams pa ma yin/ cho ga nyams pa ma yin/ 'tsho ba nyams pa ma yin gyi/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor ni byang chub sems dpa' mtshungs par spyod pa7rnams nyid yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'khor gyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi yul thams cad dang /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi yul thams cad zil gyis gnon te/ de'ang rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs bskyed pa/ mchog gis zil gyis gnon to / /de 'dod na 'dzam bu'i⑧blang skra nyag ma gcig gi rtse mo la 'jog go/ /de bzhin du gling bzhi pa dang / stong gi 'jig rten gyi5)khams dang / stong gnyis dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyang de bzhin no / /de 'dod na gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rdul phra rab gcig la 'jog go/ /de bzhin du gang gā'i klung gnyis kyi bye ma snyed dang /gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu dudang / bzhi bcu dang / lnga bcu nas brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rdul phra rab gcig la 'jog kyang rdul phra rab de la gang ba dang / bri bar yang mi mngon te/'jig rten gyi khams de rnams kyang phan tshun du 'dosalgepar mi 'gyur/ sems can de rnams la gnod par yang mi 'gyur te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub 61—83

sems dpa' dbang gi stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'dod na stongashegasum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che sna bdun gyis gang bar byin gyis rlob bo/ /de 'dod na brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bar du rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang bar byin gyis rlob ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dbang gi stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gzungs kyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ji snyed cig don tha dad pa dang / tshig dang yi ge tha dad pa dang brjodasapa tha dad pa dang / tshul tha dad pa'i chos bshad pa de dag byang chub sems dpasasheskad cig yud tsam thang cig gcig la thams cad 'dzin par byed/ khong du chud par byed/ sgom par byed de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gzungs kyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnam ④par mi 'khrugs 0pa'i byin gyi rlabs bukyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ma gtogasalgepar byang chub sems dpas byin gyi rlabs kyis byin gyis ⑧brlabs pa gang rnam par 'khrugs ⑨par byed pa'i sems can de lta bu sems can gyi ris na med de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnam par mi 'khrugs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin rnal/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bka' mi gcog7pa'i stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ thabs mkhas pa ma gtogasalgepar gang 64wa 84

byang chub sems dpa'i bka' gcog pa'i sems can de lta bu sems can gyi ris natum mthong ste/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa'akhubaka' mi gcog pa'i stobs phun sum tshogs pa yin no②/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' stobs phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no//rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gang zag la bdag med pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ chos la bdag med pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ nyi tse ba ma yin pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gyi ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin / byin gyi rlabs7kyi ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ mi 'phrogs pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa la rnam par lta ba'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid kyi ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gang zag la bdag med pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin zhe na/rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpas0phung po rnams skye ba yang yangashedag par mthong / 'jig pa dang / 'gog pa yang yang dag par mthong ngo / /des phung po skye ba rnams snying po med pa dang / byed pa med pa dang / gsog tu yang dag par mthong / phung po 'gag pa rnams 'jig par yang dag par mthong ste/ de 'di snyam du phung po 'di dag ni bdag med pa/ sems can 64—85

med pa/ srog med pa/ gso ba med pa dnganye/ gang zag med pa yin mod kyi/'on kyang byis pa so so'i skye bo bdag tu 'dzin pa la mngon par zhen pa 'disnyedag ni 'di ltar bdag cag gi phung po rnams bdag go/ /bdag cag gi phung po rnams la bdag yod do/ /bdag cag gi bdag la phung po rnams yod do/ /bdag cag gi bdag ni phung po can5kyeno snyam ste/ de dag bdag tu 'dzin pa la mngon par zhen pas de kho na nyid khong du mi chud do/ /de kho na nyid khong du masrechud pas mgal me'i 'khor lo ltar 'khor bar 'khyam mo snyam du sems shing /de thams cad kyang byang chub sems dpas yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gang zag la bdag med pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos la bdag med pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa'aphuchos la sgro 'dogs pa dang / chos la skur pa yang yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te/ de 'di snyam du glo bur du byung ba'i chos la kun brtags pa'i ming gdags te/ chos de yang de'i ngo bo nyid ma7yin/ yi ge de dag kyang de'i ngo bo nyid ma yin mod kyi/ 'di ni ming tsam dang / tha snyad tsam du bya'i/'di la mngon par zhen par mi bya'o/ /glo bur du byung ba'i chos de yang thams cad du thams cad med pa mkhuyin te/ gzhan gyi rkyen dang / gzhan gyi rkyen la sdod pa dang / gzhan gyi rkyen rnams kyis 'byung zhing rkyen dang bral na 'gag pa'i chos 'di ni yod do zhes de thams cad byang chub sems dpas7yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos la bdag med pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems 61—86

dpa' nyi tsitub ma yin pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' nyilatse'uba'i ye shes skad cig gcig la 'jug cing skad cig gnyis pa la mi 'jug pa ma yin gyi/ byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes mthong ba ni skad cig thams cad la thogs pa med par 'jug ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyi tse ba ma yin pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gyi ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' menyan thos kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang rab tu shes/ rang sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang rab tu shes/byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang rab tu shes/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang rab tu shes so/ /des ting nge 'dzin gang dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gang la nyan thos spyod pa de yang rab tu shes / ting nge 'dzin gang dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gang la rang sangs rgyas spyod pa de yang rab tu shes/ ting nge 'dzin gang dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gang la byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa de yang rab tu shes/des ting nge 'dzin gang dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gang la de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod pa de yang rab tu shes te/ de bzhin gshegs pas skabs phye na de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni rab tu shes kyi/ rnam par smin pas grub pa'i rang gi ye shes kyis ni ma yin no/ /ting nge 'dzin gzhan rnams ni rnam par smin pas grub pa'i rang gi ye meshes kyis rab tu shes te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gyi ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin no / /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' byin gyi rlabasasnyikyi ye shes phun sum 64—87

tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa'atunyan thos kyi byin gyi rlabs7kyang ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabasalgekyang ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes/ byang chub sems dpa'i byin gyi rlabs kyang ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes na/ sems can de ma yin pa gzhan dag gisnyilta ci smos te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' byin gyi rlabs kyi ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi 'phrogasalgepa'i ye shes59phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes ni mu stegs can thams cad dang / bdud thams cad dang / nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mi 'phrogasalgepa yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi 'phrogs pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa la rnam par lta ba'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' ye shes yongs su dag pa dang zhing (1rnyog pa med pas sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta stenyurte/ des de na sems can la la byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dag dang /la la byang chub kyitsosems ma bskyed pa dag dang / la la byang chub kyi sems bsgrubs pa dag dang / la la byang chub kyi sems ma bsgrubs pa dag dang / la la sa 8dang po la gnas pa dag dang / la la sa bcu'i bar la gnas pa dag dang ske/ la la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dag dang / la la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu skor ba dag dang / la la bya ba kun byas te yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dag dang / la la nyan thos kyi theg pas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dag dang / la la rang sangs rgyas kyi 64—88

theg pas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba dag dang / la la bde 'gror skye ba dag dang / la la ngan 'gror7skye ba dag mthong ngo / /de ltarashesems can thams cad kyi spyod pa la rnam par lta ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa la rnam par lta ba'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa'am/ 'greng ba'am/ 'dug pa'am/ 'gro ba'am/ 'ong ba na lhun gyis grub cing ye shes 'byung ste/ 'di lta ste/ dper na mi gnyid kyis log pa'i dbugs 'byung ba dang ske/ rngub pa dag lhun gyis grubashecing 'byung ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes de yang de bzhin du blta'o/ /ye shes de yang thams cad du mi chags par 'jug ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' lhun gyis grub pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid kyi ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpas chos thams cad mtshan nyid mtshungs par yang rab tu shes/ mtshan nyid gcig par yang rab tu shes mtshan nyid du mar yang rab tu shes/ sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid du'ang rab tu shes/ yang dag pa ma yin par yongs su brtagasalgepa'i mtshan nyid du'ang rab tu shes te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid kyi ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' zag pa med pa'i ye shes 'jig rten thams cad las 'das pa dang ldan pa yin te/ rigs 61—89

kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes phun sum tshogs pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' ye shes phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin no// //'phags pa dkon mchog sprin zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdotu/ bam po gsum pa/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sa dang mtshungs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ yangs shing tshad med pa rnams yin/ sems can thams cad kyi 'tsho bar gyur pa rnams yin/gnod pa dang lan du phan 'dogs pa dang bral ba rnams yin/ chos kyi sprin chen po kun zed pa rnams yin/ sems can thams cad kyi gnas su gyur pa rnams yin/ dge ba'i chos kyisas bon gyi gzhir gyur pa rnams yin/ rin po che'i snod du gyur pa rnams yin/ rtsi ③chen po'i snod du gyur pa rnams yin/mi skul bsrenams yin/ mi dngangs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yangs shing tshad med pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na sa chen po ni thams cad du yangs shing tshad med do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang 'di lta ste/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyis kun tu yangs shing tshad med pa yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yangs shing tshad med pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad kyi 'tsho bar gyur pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na sa chen po ni 'di ltar yo byad rnam pa de dang de dag gis sems can thams cad kyi 'tsho bar gyur pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 64—90

'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab la sogs pa byang chub kyi tshogs rnams dang / phan par 'gyur ba'i yo byad7rnam pa du ma de dang de dag gis sems can thams cad kyi 'tsho bar gyur pa yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad kyi 'tsho bar gyur pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gnod pa dang lan du phan 'dogs pa dang bral ba yin zhe na/'di lta ste/ rigs kyi bu dper na sa chen po ni gnod pas kyang khong khro bar mi 'gyur / phan pas kyang chags par mi 'gyur te/ de la gnyis su 'du shes pa yang mi 'byung ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang gnod pa dag gis khong khro bar mi 'gyur/ phan pa dag gis kyang chags7par mi 'gyur te/ de ni sems can de dag la chags pa dang / khong khro ba yang7mi skyed de de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gnod pa dang lan du phan 'dogs pa dang bral ba yin no//ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi sprin chen po kun zed pa yin zhe na/rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na sa chen po ni sprin chen po las 'bab pa'i chu klung chen po kun zed de/ bzod cing kun 'dzin to7de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi sprin chen po las chos kyi char pa (snyechen po rab tu phab pa kun zed cing bzod la 'dzin te/ de ltar yin byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi sprin chen po kun zed pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad kyi gnas su gyur pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na sa chen po ni sems can thams cad 'gro ba dang /'ong ba'i gnas su gyur pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang sems can thams cad kyi bde 'gro dang mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba'i gnas 64—91

su gyur pa yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad kyi gnas su gyur pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i chos kyi sa bon gyi gzhir gyur pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na sa bon thams cad ni sa chen po'i gzhir gyur pa las skye'o/ /de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i chos kyinyes bonashethams cad kyang byang chub sems dpa'i gzhir gyur pa las skye ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i chos kyi sa bon gyi gzhir gyur pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i snod du gyur pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na sa chen po ni rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs kyi snod yin te/ sa chen po la rin po che sna tshogs kun snang ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang yon tan rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs kyi snod du gyur pa yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' la yon tan rin po che sna tshogs kun snang ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i snod du gyur pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rtsi chen po'i snod du gyur pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rtsi chen po gang dag nad rnam pa sna tshogs zhi bar 'gyur ba dag kyang sa chen po la gnas te 'jig rten na snang ngo ske/ /de bzhin du gang dag gis nyon mongs pa'i nad rnam pa sna tshogs pa rnams zhi bar 'gyur ba'i chos kyi rtsi chen po rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' la gnas shing 'jig rten du snang bar 'gyur te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rtsi chen po'i snod du gyur pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi sgul ba yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na sa chen po ni 'di ltar sha sbrang dang / sbrang bu dang / rlung dang / nyi ma dang / sbrul gyis reg pa'i sdug 64—92

bsngal thams cad kyis mi sgul ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang 'di lta ste/ sems can thams cad las byung ba'i phyi nang gi sdug bsngal thams cad kyis mi sgul ba yin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi skul ba yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi dngangs pa7yin zhe na / rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na sa chen po ni glang po'i⑧rgyal po dang /ri dgas7kyi rgyal po rnam pa sna tshogs kyi sgra thos kyang mi skrag rab tu mi skrag shin tu mi skrag skrag par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang bdud dang mu stegs can thams cad kyi sgra thos na mi skrag rab tu mi skrag shin du mi skrag skrag par mi 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi dngangs pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sa chen po dang mtshungs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' chu dang mtshungs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dge ba'i chos la gzhol ba rnams yin/ dkar po'i chos thams cad skyed pa rnams yin/ dga' ba dang dad pa dang rangs pa'i gsher ba can rnams yin/ nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud thams cad srul ba rnams yin/ dang zhing rnyog pa med de gsal ba rnams yin/ nyon mongs pa'i yongs su gdung ba rab tu zhi bar byed pa rnams yin/ 'dod pa la sred pa zlog pa rnams yin/ zab cing gting dpag dka' ba rnams yin/ mthon dman 'gengs papornams yin/ nyon mongs pa'i rdul thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i chos la gzhol ba yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na chu ni gzhol 64—93

bar 'gro ba dang / gzhol bar rgyu ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang dge ba'i chos la gzhol zhing dge ba'i chos kyi phyir nyu)rgyu ba yin te/de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i chos la gzhol ba yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dkar po'i chos thams cad skyed pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na chu ni rtswa nadang / shing gel pa dang / rtsi dang /nags tshal thams cad skyed de/ skyes pa rnams kyang phyir zhing rgyas par byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang ting nge 'dzin gyi chus cibyang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad rnam par byed 4do/ /skyes pa rnams kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi shing du gyur gyi bar du phyir zhing rgyas par byed do/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi shing du gyur pa dag gis sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'bras bu rnam pa sna tshogs dag gis sems can rnams 'tsho bar 'gyur te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dkar po'i chos thams cad skyed pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba dang / dad pa dang / rangs pa'i gsher ba can yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na chu ni ngo bo nyid kyis gsher ba can yin te/ gzhan yang gsher bar byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang ngo bo nyid kyis dga' ba dang / dad pa dang / rangs pa'i gsher ba can yin te/ sems can gzhan yang dga' ba dang / dad pa dang / rangs pa'i gsher ba can du byed do/ /de la dga' ba ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos tshol ba'o/ /dad pa ni sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la rtenamacho5) pa'o / /rangs pa ni gang sems dag pa ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba dang / dad pa dang / rangs pa'i gsher ba can yin no/ /ji ltar 64wa 94

na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyun7thams cad srul ba yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na chu ni shing gi rnam pa dang rtswa'i rnam pa'i rtsa bshedag gi rgyun7thams cad srul lo/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang sgom7pa la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi chus nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyunasathams cad srul te/ ji ltar na nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyun⑩'di dag gi ming yang mi shes pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i dri nga ba'i bag chags kyang med par 'gyur ba de lta bur srul te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyun thams cad srul ba yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa'aphudang zhing rnyog pa med de gsal ba yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na chu ni rang bzhin gyis dang zhing rnyog pa med de gsal lo/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang rang bzhin gyis dang zhing rnyog pa med de gsal ba yin rnal / /de la bag la nyal ba dang / kun nas ldang ba dang bral bas na dang ba'o / /'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug dang bral bas na rnyog pa med pa'o/ /dbang po rab tu dang bas na gsal ba ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dang zhing rnyog pa med de gsal ba yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa'i yongs su gdung ba rab tu zhi bar byed ce na/rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na chu ni sa chen po dpyid kyi tsha bas gdungs pa dang ske/ de las gzhan yang sems can rnams dpyid kyi tsha bas gdungs pa rnams rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang nyon mongs pas gdungs pa'i sems can gyi khams thams cad chos kyi chus rab tu zhi bar byed de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa'i yongs su gdung ba 37 64—95

rab tu zhi bar byed pa yin no②/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'dod pa la sred pa zlog pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na chu ni skom pas nyen pa'i sems can rnams kyi skom pa rnam par zlog go/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang yul la sred pas nyen pa'i sems can nyen par gyur pa dag la gang gi ④sems can de dag gi yul la sred pa ldog ①par 'gyur ba de lta bu'i ④chos kyi char mngon par 'bebs te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'dod pa la sred pa rinasazlog par byed do/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' zab cing gting dpag dka' ba yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na chu'i 'jings 6)ni zab cing gting dpag dka' ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ye shes yang dag par grub pa yang 'di lta ste/ bdud thams cad dang ske/ mu stegs can thams cad kyis gting dpag dka' zhing zab pa yin te/de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' zab cing gting dpag dka' ba yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mthon dmanashe'agengs pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na chu'i klung ni sa'i phyogs mthon dman⑧'gengs so/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang chos kyi chu ⑨klung gis sems can gyi khams mthon dman bo'agengs te/ ji ltar na chus 'gengs pa ltar sems can la gnod pa byed pa de lta bu byang chub sems dpa' ma yin gyi/ sems can de rnams la snying brtse ba'i phyir chos kyi chu klung 'bebs shing de dag la gnod par mi byed de(lha/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mthon dman 'gengs pa7yin no//ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa'i rdul thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na chus ni sa'i phyogs skam 64—96

zhing rdul 'thul ba thams cad snum par byed cing / rdul de dag zhi7ribar byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang sems can sems rtsub pa rnams 'di lta ste/ shes rab la gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi chus sems snum par byed cing sems can de dag gi nyon mongs pa'i rdul thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed de/de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa'i rdul thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' chu dang mtshungs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' me dang mtshungs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ nyon mongs pa'i phyag dar khung tsho thams cad kyang sreg par byed/sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyang yongs su smin par byed/ nyon mongs pa'i 'dam thams cad kyang skoms par byed/ me'i phung po dang 'dra ba rnams yin/ snang bar gyur pa rnams yinari/ skrag par byed pa rnams yin/ dbugs 'byin pa rnams yin/ sems can thams cad kyi thun mong du gyur pa rnams yin/mchod par bya ba rnams yin/ mi brnyas pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa'i phyag dar khung (5thams cad bsregal)ce na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na me ni phyag dar khungs7)dang /rtswa gedang / shing gel pa dang / rtsi dang / sdong po thams cad sreg go/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang shes rab kyis bag la nyal dang / kun nas ldang ba dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug gi nyon mongs pa'i phyag dar khungs3)thams cad bsreg stebo/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa'i phyag dar khungs11thams cad bsregs pa yin no/ /ji ltar 61—97

na byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams yongs su smin par byed ce na/rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na me ni lo thog dang / rtsi7dang / sdong bu'i⑧rnam pa thams cad yongs su smin par byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang shes rab kyis nang gi sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams7yongs su smin par byed pa'ang ji ltar 'jig par mi 'gyur ba de ltar yongs su smin par byed deX/de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' snisangs rgyas kyi chos rnams yongs su smin par byed pa'o/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa'i 'dam thams cad skam par byed ce na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na/ me ni chu bran gyi 'dam thams cad skam par byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang shes rab kyis zag pa'i 6)nyon mongs pa'i 'dam thams cad skam ⑦par byed de/de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs pa'i 'dam thams cad skamasapar byed do/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' me'i phung po dang 'dra ba yin zhe na/rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na sems can grang ba'i nad kyis nyen pa rnams kyi grang ba med par bya ba'i phyir me'i phung po byed do0/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang nyon mongs pa'i grang ba'i nad kyis btab pa'i sems can rnams kyi nyon mongs pa'i grang ba'i nad med par bya ba'i phyir shes rab kyis rab tu dro bar byed de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' me'i phung po dang 'dra ba yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' snang bar gyur pa yin zhe na/rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na gangs kyi rtse mo'am ri bin da'i〈nyertse mo la me'i phung po chen po 'bar na/ des dpag tshad gcig kho ra khor yug tu snang bar byed/ dpag tshad gnyis kho ra khor yug dang / dpag tshad gsum kho ra 64—98

khor yug tu yang snang bar byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang ye shes kyi snang bas dpag tshad brgyar yang khyab par byed/ dpag tshad stong du yang khyab par byed/ dpag tshad stong phrag brgyar yang khyab par byed pa nas/'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med/ grangs med pa'i bar du yangatukhyab par byas nas/ sems can thams cad la ye shes kyis snang bar byed de/ ye shes kyi snang ba des mi shes pa'i mun pa mun nag thams cad rnam par sel te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' snang bar gyur pa yin no/ /jisheltar na byang chub sems dpa' skrag par byed pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na ri dgas khro bo'am/ ri dgas kyi rgyal po khro bos me'i phung po chen po mthong na skrag rab tu skrag shin tu skrag par gyur cing / 'di lta ste/ me'i 'jigs pas skrag pas gnas te②/ de ring ba bas kyang shin tu ring bar spong ngo / /de bzhin du bdud rnams sam bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' mthong nas7skrag rab tu skrag shin tu skrag par gyur cing / 'di lta ste/gzi brjid chung ba'i phyir gang du byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mingasnyiyang mi7)thos na/ mthong ba lta smos kyang mi smos par ring ba bas kyang shin tu ring bar sa'i phyogs de yongs su spong ngo / /de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' skrag par byed pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dbugs 'byin pa yin zhe na/rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na mi la la zhig 'brog dgon par 'khyams0pa las me'i phung po chen po mthong ste/ de de logs su song ba dang / des de na grong ngam/ rdzi'u brang7mthong na de shugs phyin te'o)/ rab tu dbugs phyin nas 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems 61—99
