dpa' yang 'khor ba'itu'abrog dgon par 'khyams pa'i sems can rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' mthong na/ shugs phyin par 'gyur/ rab tu dbugs phyin par 'gyur/ nyon mongs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ②bar 'gyur te/ /de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' dbugs 'byin pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad kyi thun mong du gyur pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na me ni sems can thams cad kyi thun mong du gyur pa ste/ ji ltar na rgyal po la phan par nye bar gnas pa ltar gdolakhubu la yang de bzhin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang sems can thams cad kyi thun mong du gyur pa yin te/ ji ltar rgyal po la phan par nye bar gnas pa ltar gdol bu la yang de bzhin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad kyi thun mong du gyur pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mchod par bya ba yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na me la ni bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / grong ba dang / yul gyi mi rnams kyis mchod do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang 'di lta ste/ lha dang /mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis ston par 'du shes pas mchod de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mchod par bya ba yin no//ji ltar na mi brnyas thupa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na me stagasnyichung ngu yang 'tshigasrepa'i bdag nyid can yin pas na mi brnyas pa yin no/ /de bzhin du mos pas spyod pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' mthu stobs ma rnyed pa/ theg pa chen po la las dang po pa yang lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 4she'ajig rten gyis mi brnyas pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/64—100

lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' 'di ring po mi thogs par byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug ste/bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chubatumangon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar khong du chud de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi brnyas pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' me dang mtshungs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rlung mar lta bu rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gnas med par spyod pa dang / spyod yul kun tukhumu med pa dang / sems can nga rgyal gyis snyems pa'i rtse mo 'thor zhing 'jig la rab tu rnyil7bar byed pa dang /chos kyi char sprin chen po kun nas skyed pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba rab tu zhi bar byed pa dang / sems can thams cad la chos dkar po lus 'thun⑧par 'byungaphuba'i dbugs 'byung ba dang / rngub pa'i srog nye bar sbyor ba dang / chos kyi char sprin dpag tu med pa kun 'dzin pa dang ske/ chos rnam pa tha dad pa'i gzhal med khang chen po'i bkod pa rnam par dbye ba thams cad rnam par 'byed cing yongs su 'god pa dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dpag bsam gyi shing las shin tu byung ba'i chos kyi gtam yang dag par rnam parashegadon mi za ba'i me tog yid du 'ong ba'i char rtag tu mngon par 'bebs pa dang / bskal pa grangs med par dkar po'i dkyil 'khor yongs su bsagasalgepa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par thar pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rgya mtsho dang / ri rab dang / 'od dang / zla ba dang /⑧ nyi ma dang / chos kyi tshul dang / nags tshal dang / khang pa dang / dge ba'i khor yug gi ri la 64—101

sogs pas ①yongs su bskor ba'i sems can gyi 'khor gyi ②dkyil 'khor na gdul khub yongs su smin pa mang po yang dag par gnas pa bla na med cing lus med pa'i gnas 'pho bar 'jig pa'i ye shes kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor rab tu gtong ba'i phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gnas med par spyod pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rlung mar ni thams cad du thogs pa med cing gnas med rten med de/ gzugs med kyang nags tshal〈pedang / khang pa dang / gzhal med khang dang / ri rab dang /rgya mtsho la sogs pa thams cad la rang gi dgos pa byed par snang ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' (sherlung mar yang chos thams cad la kun tu mi gnas pa yin te/ phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched rnams dang /gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa dang / mig gi khams dang / gzugs kyi khams dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / rna ba'i khams dang / sgra'i khams dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / sna'i khams dang / dri'i khams dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / lce'i khams dang / ro'i khams dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / lus kyi khams dang / reg bya'i khams dang /lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / yid kyi khams dang / chos kyi khams dang ske/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams dang / mig gi skye mched dang /gzugs kyi skye mched dang / rna ba'i skye mched dang / sgra'i skye mched dang /sna'i skye mched dang / dri'i skye mched dang / lce'i skye mched dang / ro'i skye mched dang / lus kyi skye mched dang / reg bya'i skye mched dang / yid kyi skye 64—102

mched dang / chos kyi skye mched la mi gnas pa yin/ 'jig rten pa'i chos rnams dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams dang / lha dang mi'ituphun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang / 'khor los sgyurakhub dang / brgya byin dang ske/ tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dag tu 'gyur ba dang / dbang phyug chen po dag tu 'gyur ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dag tu 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa rnams dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dag la yang gnas par mi byed de/ de thams cad lakhumi gnas pas dngos po dang / dngos po med pa dang / gcig pa dang / tha dad pa dang /de bzhin nyid la sogs par durlom sems kyi rnam pa du mas ⑤ma gyur cing dmigs pa med la rnam par thar pa'i 0sgrib pa med pa'i spyod yul dang ldan pas/brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba la sogs pa'ang byed la/phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu sems can thams cad kyi don thams cad thob par bya ba'i phyir phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bskal par thams cad du'ang rgyu la/ chos kyi lus kyis mi snang ba yang yin zhing mi rtog⑧rnam par mi rtog ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gnas med par spyod pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' spyod yul kun tu mu med pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rlung mar ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa dag tu reg par byed de g.yob cing rgyu'o/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'0)rlung mar yang chos mu med pa dag kun rdzob dang / don dam par kun nas mthong zhing rgyas par byed/ reg spupar byed/ rnam par 'god cing ston te/ de bzhin 64wa 103

gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dag dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dag dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi gnas dag tu yid kyi mgyogs pa dang ldan zhing / phyogs0)thams cad kyi mthar thug pa'i spyod yul par gyur nas rgyu zhing 'gro ste/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' spyod yul kun tu mu med pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can nga rgyal gyis snyems pa'i rtse mo 'thor zhing 'jig la rab tu rnyil b.ralo byed pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rlung mar ni ri dang ske/ khyim dang / nags tshal gyi rtse mo dag55)'dud par byed/ rab tu rnyil se bar byed/ rnam par 'jig par byed/ 'thor bar byed/ mi sngaradzan bar byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'4)rlung mar yang sems can nga rgyal dang / rlom pas skadang / dregs pa dang / 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i rtse mos snyems pa rnams gzugs dang / dar la bab pa dang / longs spyod dang /dbang dang / stobs dang / tshe dang / nad med pa dang / 'tsho0)ba dang /bzo dang / thos pa dang / yid gzhungs pa dang / g.yog dang / smra mkhas pa dang / dpal che ba'i dregs pas myos pa dag dang / yang dag pa'i nan tan gyis bdag bstod 9)pa rnams la de dang khyad tsozhugs pa'i phun sum tshogs pa bstan pa dang / chos bstan pas nga rgyal chomasasngo1par byed cing dge ba dri ma hunyemed pa la sbyor bar byed de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can nga rgyal kyis snyems pa'i rtse mo 'thor zhing 'jig la rab tu rnyil bar byed pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos makyi char sprin chen po kun nas skyed pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rlung mar ni phyogs bzhi 64wa 104

nas sprin gyi dkyil 'khor kha dog sna tshogs can dang / zab cing gsal la mnyen zhing 'jam pa'i 'brug sgra rgya mtsho'i dbyangs can/ klung ro7sna tshogs kyi sgra 'byin cing yid du 'ong ba'i dbyangs rjes su grag②pa/ glog gi phreng ba'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan pa gang dag gis 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag brgya dag kun nas yongs su khebs par byas te/ 'gro ba thams cad dga' ba dang / lo tog dang / sdong po yongs su bskyed pa'i phyir char gyi rgyun chen po rtag tu rgyun mi chad par mngon par 'bebs pa'i sprin chen po kun nas slong ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'7rlung mar yang lus sna tshogs kyi sprin sems can thams cad dga' bar byed pa/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu0med pa snang bar byed pa/ 'od zer kha dog mtha' yas pa'i glog gi phreng ba'i rgyun 'byung ba/ yang dag pa de kho na nyid kyi chos kyi 'brug sgra yan lag stong phrag drug cu pa sgrogs pa/ snying rje chen po'i rlung mar gyis yang dag par mtho ba/ chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi nam mkha' khyab par byed pa dag gisala'ajig rten gyi khams thams cad kun nas khebs par byas shing ngan song dang mi khom pa la sogs pa nas sems can rnams rnam par bslang ste/ rnam pa thams cad du mtshan dang / dpe byad bzang po dang /'od kyi dkyil 'khor snang bar ⑨rnam par dag pa yang byin gyis brlabs te/bkod pa thams cad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag kyang byin gyis brlabs nas/ lha dang mi dga' ba dang mgu ba dang rangs pa mchog tu gyur pa/ dga' ba dang bde ba mchog thob pa dang ldan pa rnams kyi 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos dkar po'i lo tog dang / rtsi chen 64—105

po dang / sdong po thams cad rnam par bskyed7pa dang / thams cad du skyid par chos kyi dbang bskur ba'i phyir sems can thams cad kyi phun sum tshogs pa dang ske/ dga' bar byed pa dang / rgyad pa rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i chos kyi char chen po mngon par 'bebs te/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi char sprin chen po kun nas skyed pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' la'agro ba thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba rab tu zhi bar byed pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rlung mar dri zhim po'i char gyi rgyun gyi snying po can ldang na/ sems can rnams kyi gdung ba yongs su zhi bar byas shing / lus shin tu sim pa dang / bsil bar byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ①rlung mar yang sems can rnams kyi 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / ngan 'gro dang / ngan par ltasnyib dang / nyes byas dang / the tsomasnyedang / phongs pa mi bzad pa dang /yul la sred pa dang / sdug pa dang / mi sdug pa dang bral zhing phrad pa dang /nad rnams bcil nas dam pa ma yin pa'i chos la sred pa la sogs pa'i gdung ba dag dam pa'i chos kyi char dang 'dresalgepa'i bla na med pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang / smon lam dang / mthong ba dang / reg pa dang / 'grogs pa dang ske/ bstan pa don yod pa la sogs pas rab tu zhi bar byed de/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba rab tu zhi bar byed cing nyon mongs pa med pa'i sa la 'god pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad la chos dkar po las 'thun par byung ba'ishedabugs 'byung ba dang / rngub pa'i srog 61—106

nye bar sbyor ba yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na dbugs 'byungatub dang / rngub pa'i rlung gi mthus sems can thams cad 'tsho'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpas mngon par bsgrubasalgepa dang / byang chub sems dpasakhubastabs pa'i chos dkar po'i rlung mar nye bar spyad pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad skyed pas kyang sems can thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ dper na rlung mar ni 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'di lta ste/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang / khor yug ri dag dang / khor yug gi ri chen po rnams dang / gling chen po bzhi yongs su 'dzin pa'i gser gyi dkyil 'khor rnams dang / rgya mtsho rin po che'i 'byung gnas dang bcas pa rnams dang / ri rabasridang / ri rab chen po dang / de ma yin pa'i rin po che'i ri dang / gangs dang / ri spos kyi ngad ldang ba dang /grong rdal dang / nags tshal dang / gzhal med khang dag dang / 'dzam bu'i5shegling dag dang / gling chen po bzhi dag dang / stong dag dang / stong gnyis pa dag dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po dag7bkod pa rnam par phye ba sna tshogs mngon par sgrub bo/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'57rlung mar yang phyogs bcu kun tu sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi phung po phun sum tshogs pa nye bar sgrub bo/ /skyed do/ /yongs su gzhog7)go/ /de la ji ltar gangs kyi ri phun sum tshogs pa de ltar ni 'jig rten pa'i bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa rnams blta'o/ /ji ltar gling chen po bzhisnyidang ri rab phun sum tshogs pa de ltar ni nyan thos kyi phun sum tshogs pa 8rnams blta'o/ /ji ltar stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams phun sum tshogs pa de ltar ni rang sangs rgyas kyi phun 64—107

sum tshogs pa rnams blta'o/ /ji ltar7stong gnyis kyila'ajig rten gyi khams phun sum tshogs pa de ltar ni7byang chub sems dpa'i phun sum tshogs pa rnams blta'o / /ji ltar stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams phun sum tshogs pa de ltar ni 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gtugs pa/ shin tu rnam par dag par grags pa mchod pa la dmigs pa thams cad la yang dag par gnas pa rnams kyis thams cad mngon du byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan dang ldan pa rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa phun sum rigetshogs pa rnams blta'o/ /de la rgya mtsho ltar ni ting nge 'dzin gyi rgya mtsho rnams blta'o/ /gling dang / bar gyi gling dang / ri gzhan dang / gling chen po bzhi pa la sogs pa ltar ni sbyor ba dang / gzungs dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang / slob ma'i dge 'dun la sogs pa blta'o/ /grong rdal dang / nags tshal dang / gzhal med khang ltar ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa'i yon tan bkod pa rnams blta'o/ /dpag bsam gyikhushing gi nags tshal ltar ni sa dang pha rol btu phyin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang /gzungs dang / mngon par shes pa dang / rig pa dang / ye shes snang ba dang ske/ dbang dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / ma 'dres pa dang / snying rje chen po la sogs pa dbang sgyur ba dam pa phun sum tshogs pa'i chos rnams blta'o / /rigs kyi bu de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bsod nams brgya ba'i mtshan gang zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na yongs su 64—108

brtag pa bzungatuste/ phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i7klung grangs med pa'i bye ma snyed dag na sems can gang ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad stong gsum phrag bcu'i 'khor los sgyur ②ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par gyur la/ de lta bu'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i dngos po nyid dang ldan pa'i sems can de dag gi bsod nams kyi phung po ji tsam pa de bsdoms pa dang / 'khor los sgyur0ba chen po gcig cig ldan par gyur te/ rnam grangs des shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'das te/ de snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i sems can de snyed cig 'khor los sgyur ⑦ba'i dngos po de 'dra ba nyid dang so sor ldan par gyur la/ snga ma bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nam mkha'i (nyamathas gtugs pa dag na sems can yod do cog ji snyed pa de dag thams cad 'khor los sgyur ⑨ba'i dngos po de lta bu sha stag dang so sor ldan par gyur te/ de bzhin du bgrang ba de nyid ⑩kyis 'jig rten gyi khams de snyed du gtogs pa'i sems can rnams brgya byin gyi bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan pa'i brgya byin sha stag tu gyur la/phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung grangs med pa'i bye ma snyed du gtogs pa'i brgya byin rnams kyi bsod nams kyi phung po ji tsam pa de dang brgya byin gcig cig ldan par gyur te/ de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa thams cad na sems can gang ji snyed 'khod pa de dag5nyethams cad brgya byin de dang 'dra ba sha stag tu gyur la/ bgrang ba de nyid kyis phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung grangs med pa'i bye ma snyed du gtogs pa'i sems can de 64—109

dag thams cad tshangs pa chen por gyur la/ bsod nams de thams cad gcig tu bsdoms pa dang tshangs pa chen po gcig cig ①ldan par gyur la/ tshangs pa chen po ji ltar sems can thams cad kyang de bzhin du gyur te/ snga ma bzhin du bgrang ba de nyid kyis nyan thos dag dang / rang sangs rgyas dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' sa chen po thob pa/ 'od zer gyi sprin chen po'i dbang bskur bas dbang bskur ba/ dbang bcu thob pa sha stag tu gyur te/ de ltar rigs kyi bu de lta bu'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang / nam mkha'i dbyings su gtogs pa'i dus gsum pa thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi phung po ji tsam pa de dus gsum gyi nam mkha'i dbyings su gtogs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab brgyar bsgyur bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig mngon par 'grub bo/ /ba spu'i khung bu thams cad du gtogs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po brgya stong grangs med pa bcur bsgyur bas/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu57las dpe byad bzang po re re mngon par 'grub bo/ /dpe byad bzang por gtogs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po desathams cad brjod du med pa bcur bsgyur bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan nyi shu rtsa dgu las mtshan re re mngon par 'grub bo/ /de yang brjod du med pa bcur bsgyur bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu zla ba nya ste dri ma med pa'i dkyil 'khor stong bas kyang lhag par mdzes pa'i 'od dang ldan pa mngon par 'grub bo/ /de yang brjod du med pa bye ba 42stong phrag bcur bsgyur bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyi gtsug 'gro ba thams cad las mngon par 'phags shing bltar mi snang 64wa 110

ba gtsug tor7gyis yongs su brgyan pa mngon par 'grub bo/ /de yang brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pashebye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcurashebasgyur bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gsung yan lag stong phrag drug cusapa dmigs pa thams cad las gsung gi sgra mtha' yas par 'byung ba lhun gyis grub pas sems can thams cad bsam pa yongs su sim par gyur la/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du go bar byed pa mngon par 'grub ste/ rigs kyi bu 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan ces bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar na 0de bzhin gshegs pa ⑥bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs mi zad pa dang ldan zhing kun tu rgyas par byed pa bkod pa dang ldan pas sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba yin te/ rigs kyi bu yongs su brtag pa bzung na/ gal te phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gtugs pa thams cad du gtogs pa'i sems can rnams sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin la gnas pa/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi rgyan 'chang ba/ dbang bcu la dbang sgyur ba sha stag tu gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig tu gtogs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po la 'dzam bu'i chu bo'isnyigaser las byas pa'i snod rin po che sna tshogs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis spras pa nam mkha'i tshad tsam gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed so so nas thogs te/ phyi ma'i mthar thug pa'i bskal par yongs su bkang zhing skad cig skad cig tu blangs shing khyer yang ba spu'i khung bu gcig tu gtogs pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po de gang ba'am 'bri bar mi mngon te/ rigs kyi bu de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsod nams brgya'i 64—111

mtshan ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /de las bcu gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/byang chub kyi sems ma bskyed7pa'i sa dang / rab tu dga' ba dang / dri ma med pa dang / 'od byed pa dang / 'od 'phro ba can dang / shin tu dka' rgyal dang / mngon du gyur pa dang / ring du song ba dang / mi g.yo ba dang /legs pa'i blo gos dang / chos kyi sprin dang / sangs rgyas kyi sa kun tu 'od de/sa〈snyebacu gnyis po de ni de dag go/ /de la byang chub kyi sems ma bskyed pa'i sa gang zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' byis pa'i spyod pa dang / log pa'i nan tan thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa/ 'jig rten gsum po thams cad kyi brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang khyad zhugs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa/ rnam pa thams cad du dpal dang ldan pa'i lus dang ske/ ngag dang / yid kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mu med pa snang bar byed pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa/ sgrib pa med pa'i stobs kyi shugs 'chang ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med par skad cig re re la 'gro zhing 'ong na dri zhim po dang / 'od zer gyi dra ba'i tshogs chen po gling chen po bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu 'byung ba'i pad mas rkangasnyepa yongs su brtanasnyipa/ stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mtha' dang mnyam pa'i stan gyi rgyanasredang ldan pa/ chos thams cad shin tu rnam par non pa'i lhag mthong rnam par bsgoms59pas thogs pa med cing yid du 'ong ba'i dmigs pa'i mtshan ma chen po bcu la sogs pa grangs med pa'i ltas bzang po mthong ba/phyir mi ldog pa/ phyogs kyi nags tshal thobs po mtha' yas pa thams cad du 64—112

'od kyi dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa rab tu 'gyed pas zhing dpag tu med pa'i rgyan byed pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa'i 'jig rten gyi mnga' bdag ①dpag tu med pa snyed kyi bdag gi gzugs brnyan gyis dbang bskur ba/yang dag par mnod7pa'i dbang dang byin gyi rlabasashel mkhas pa/ 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rin po che'i char gyi snang ba'i sgo dpag tu med pa thams cad gtan pa med par kun tu rgyas par 'gengs pa'i mchod sbyin chen po'i sprin gtong ba lhur byed pa/ blta na bzang zhing yid du 'ong la mdzes shing dge la 'gro ba thams cad dngasami 'thun pa med cing don yod par bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa rab tu g.yo bar byed cing 'gro ba ngan 'gro la sogs pa las sems can mtha' yas pa yongs su skyob pa/ mtha' yas pa'i sangs rgyas mchod pa dang chos kyi sgo 'dzin nus pa/ ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / rnam par thar pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / rig pa grangs med pas rnam par rol pa/ chos mtha' yas pa la dga' zhing mos pas zanganyezing med par phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa'i mthar7thug par rnam par mi rtog cing lhun gyis grub pa'i dga' ba'i shugs kyi snang ba 'thob pa/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong ther 'bum dpag tu med par theg pa chen po la zhugs pa'i bsgomatshwanyepa sna tshogs yongs su rdzogs la/ gzhan gyi don gyi nan tan tshar phyin pa'i bsod nams dang ske/ ye shes kyi tshogs mngon par bsgrubalgepar grub pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba brgya stong7phun sum tshogs pa'i mos pa chen po'i yang chen pos spyod7pa'i chos nyid kyis sa dang po de ma thag tu 'thob par gang gnas pa de ni byang chub sems 64—113

dpa'i byang chub kyi sems ma bskyed pa'i stisa'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/dper na 'khor los sgyuralaba'i rgyal po ni mi'i kha dog las 'das la/ lha'ishes dog ni ma thob pa yin te/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang 'jig rten pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa thams cad las ni 'das pa yin / don dam pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sa ni ma thob pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi sa kun tu 'od ni mtha' dang dbung ④med pa ma lus pa dri ma med pa'i chos thams cad la dbang sgyur ba ste/ kun tu shin tu lta bge/ sems can thams cad kyi don thams cad thob par byed pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /de la ting nge 'dzin rnams gang zhe na/ bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin rnams te/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rin chen kun tu 'phags pa neradang / shin tu gnas pa dang / mi sgul ba dang / phyir mi ldog pa dang / rin chen 'byung gnas dang / nyi ma'i 'od kyi gzi brjid dang /don thams cad grub pa dang / ye shes sgron ma dang / dkyiltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon du bzhugs pa dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin te/ de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin ni mtha' yas so/ /gzungs ni bcu gnyis te/ bcu gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dbang bskuramatsho ldan dang / ye shes ldan dang / sgra dbyangs rnam par dag pa dang /mi zad pa'i za ma tog dang / 'khyil pa mtha' yas dang / ④rgya mtsho'i phyag rgya dang ske/ pad ma bkod pa dang / chags pa med pa'i sgor 'jug pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnam par gdon mi za ba la 'jug pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rgyan gyi byin gyis brlabs /7pa dang / kha dog mtha' yas pa dang / sangs 61—114

rgyas kyi sku'i kha dog rdzogs pa mngon par bsgrub ①pa'i gzungs te/ de dag la sogs pa snga ma bzhin no/ /mngon par shes pa ni drug ste/ drug gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ lha'i mig dang / lha'i rna ba dang / pha rol gyi sems shes pa dang /sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'ikhushes pa dang / rdzu 'phrul mngon par shes pa'i shes pa dang / gang zag pa zad par7shes pa'i mngon par shes pa ste drug po de dag go/ /dbang ni bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ tshe'ikhutshad bskal pa grangs medakyidapag tu med par byin gyis rlob pas tshe la dbang ba dang /ting nge 'dzin brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa la nges par rtog cing 'jug pa'i tshul gyis sems la dbang ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bkod pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan par byin gyis rlob pa ston ⑥pa'i tshul gyis yo byadakyil dbang ba dang / dus ji bzhin du las kyi rnam par smin pa byin gyis rlob pa ston pas las la dbang ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du skye ba ston pas skye ba la dbang ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad sangs rgyas kyis7yongs su gang ba ston pas mos pa la dbang ba dang / dus dang zhing gang du 'dod par7mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ston pas smon lam la dbang ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' yas pa ston pas rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba dang / chos kyi sgo snang ba mtha' dang dbung yimed pa yongs su ston pas chos la dbang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / ma 'dres pa dang / mtshan dang / dpe byad bzang po dang ske/ mngon par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dmatshwanyepa dang / dus thams cad du 64—115

gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba'i grangs la sogs pa skad cig gcig la yongs su shes pa rnam pa7thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa stonashepas ye shes la dbang ba duste/ bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang rnams so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa'i stobs bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ bsam pa'i stobs dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa'i stobs dang /sbyor ba'i stobs dang / shes rab kyi stobs dang / smon lam gyi stobs dang /spyod pa'i stobs dang / theg pa'i stobs dang / rnam par 'phrul ba'i stobs dang ske/ byang chub kyi stobs dang / chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu skor0ba'i stobs te / bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i stobs rnams so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa'i mi 'jigs pa bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ gzungs kyis thos pa 'dzin cing don bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa dang / bdag med pa0khong du chud pas gzhan gyis gtse ba'i mtshan ma mi 'byung zhing rang bzhin gyis spyod lam 7mad du med pa'i las gsum yongs su dag pa'i bsrung ⑧ba chen po phun sum tshogs pa'i mi 'jigs pa dang / chos bzung ba yun du mi brjed pa dang /thabs dang shes rab mthar phyin pas sems can sgrol zhing dad pa ston pa dang /dge ba'i bar chad du mi 'gyur ba'i mi 'jigs pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems ma 7nyams shing theg pa gzhan gyis mi 'byung bar dbang yongs su rdzogs pa dang / sems can gyi don rnam pa thams cad du yang dag par thob par bya ba la mi 'jigs pa ste/ bzhi po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i mi 'jigs pa rnams so/ /de la byang chub sems dpa'i chos ma 'dres pa bcwa 64—116

brgyad gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni ma bstan7pa'i sbyin pa can rnams yin/ ma bstan pa'i tshul khrims can rnams dang / ma bstan pa'i ②bzod pa can rnams dang / ma bstan pa'i brtson 'grus can rnams dang / ma bstan pa'i bsam gtan can rnams dang / ma bstan pa'i shes rab can rnams dang / bsdu ba'i dngos pos sems can thams cad sdudasnyepa rnams dang / yongs su bsngo ba'i cho ga shes pa rnams dang / thabs la mkhas pas sems can thams cad kyi spyod pa'i dbang gi theg pa'i mchog gis 'byung ba ston pa rnams dang / theg pa chen po las ma nyams pa rnams dang /mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgo ston pa rnams dang / zung dang snrel zhi'i0rgyud la mkhas pa rnams dang / ye shes sngon du 'gro ba'i mngon par 'du mi byed cing kha na ma tho ba med par tshe rabs thams cad du mngon par 'phags pa rnams dang / lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' dge ba bcu dang ldan pa rnams dang / sdug bsngal gyi phung po thams cad bzod pa'i lus len pas sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su mi gtong ba rnams dang / 'gro ba thams cad mngon par dga' bar ston pa rnams dang / byis pa dang / nyan thos mi bzad7pa ji snyed cig gi nang na yang dge ba mang po'i rin po che'i shing dpag bsam ltar brtan7pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems yongs su ma nyams pa rnams dang / chos thams cad kyi thabs sbyin pas dbang bskur ba thob par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi chos btsal ba (7bstan pa las mi ldog pa rnams te/bcwa 8brgyad po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams so/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/64—117

gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar gyi las kyi rgyu'i rnam par smin pa len pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / khams sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba dang /rnam par ldang ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa mkhyen pa'i stobs dang / 'chi 'pho dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs dang /zag pa zad par tshimakhyen pa'i stobs te/ bcu po de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams so/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mi 'jigs pa bzhi gang zhe na / 'di lta ste/② chos thams cad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa la mi 'jigs pa dang / zag pa thams cad zad par shes pa la mi 'jigs pa dang /bar du gcod pa'i chos rnams gzhan du mi 'gyur bar nges pa'i lung bstan pa la mi 'jigs pa dang / phun sum tshogs pa thams cad thob par 'gyur ba'i 'byung ba'i lam de bzhin du 'gyur ba la mi 'jigs pa ste/ bzhi po de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i mi 'jigs pa rnams so/ /de la sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bcwa gebargyad gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la 'khrul ba med pa dang ske/ ca co med pa dang / bsnyel ba med pa dang / sems mnyam par ma bzhag pa med pa dang / tha dad pa'i 'du shes med pa dang / so sor ma brtags pa'i btang snyoms med pa dang / mos pa nyams pa med pa dang /64wa 118

brtson 'grus nyams pa med pa dang / dran pa nyams pa med pa dang / ting nge 'dzin nyams pa med pa dang / shes rab nyams pa med pa dang / rnam par grol ba nyams pa med pa dang / 'das pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa dang / da ltar gyi dus la ma chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa dang / lus kyi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / ngag gi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / yid kyi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'brang ba ste/ bcwa0brgyad po de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams so/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po gang zhe na/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po ni rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis dang ldan par phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa ②dag tu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin du 'byung ste/ sum cu rtsa gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad nisnyebadag med pa na sems can rnams ni bdag med par ma bumos pas de'i phyir sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni sems can med pa na sems can rnams ni sems can du smra'o zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni srog med pa na sems can rnams ni srog tu smra'o zhes de'i phyir sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni gang zag med pa na sems can rnams ni gang zag la gnas pa'o zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs 64—119

pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni med pa na sems can rnams ni yod par lta'o zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni gnas med pa na sems can rnams ni gnas la rten to zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni gzhi med pa na sems can rnams ni gzhi ①la cadaga'o zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni nga yirarnyubya ba med pa na sems can rnams ni nga yir7bya ba la rten to zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni bdag po med pa na sems can rnams ni yongs su bzung ba la brtson no zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni dngos po med pa na sems can rnams ni dngos po la rten to zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad7ma skyes pa na sems can rnams ni skye ba la rten to zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni ma 'phos ma byung ba na sems can rnams ni 'chi 'pho dang skye ba la rten nito zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni kun nas nyon ma7mongs pa na sems can rnams ni kun nas nyon mongs so zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni 'dod chags dang bral ba na sems can rnams ni 'dod chags par byed do5) zhes de'i phyir sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni zhe snang dang bral ba na sems can rnams7zhe 64—120

snang bar byed do zhes de'i phyir sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni gti mug dang bral ba na sems can rnams ni gti mug par gyur to zhes de'i phyir sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni 'ong ba med pa na sems can rnams ni 'ong ba la gnas pa'o zhes de'i phyir sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni 'gro ba med pa na sems can rnams ni 'gro ba la gnas so zhes de'i phyir sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni mngon par 'du byed pa med patun sems can rnams ni mngon par 'du byed pa la spyod do zhes de'i phyir sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni spros pa med pa nasasems can rnams ni spros pa la dga'o zhes de'i phyir sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni stong pa na sems can rnams ni lta ba la zhen to zhes de'i phyir sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni mtshan ma med pa na sems can rnams ni mtshan ma'i spyod yul can no zhes de'i phyir sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje'uchen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni smon pa med pa na sems can rnams ni smon lam la spyod do zhes de'i phyir sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /kyephum 'jig rten gnas pa 'di ni phan tshun rtsod pas yongs su zin cing gnod sems kyi tha ba'i skyon la zhugs par gzigs nas/ de dag la gnod sems kyi tha ba'i skyon spong duba'i phyir chos bstan par bya'o zhes sems can rnams la de 64—121

bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /kye ma 'jig rten gnas pa 'di ni phyin ci log dang ldan zhing lam nyam ngatubar zhugs pa lam gol ba la gnas pa yin gyis②/ de dag la7yang dag pa'i lam du gzud par bya'o zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /kye ma 'jig rten gnas pa 'di ni brkam zhing 'dod pa'i zil gyis non pa ste/ chog mi shes shing gzhan gyi nor la 'phrog pa yin gyis rjode dag 'phags pa'i nor dad pa ⑦dang / tshul khrims dang / thos pa dang / gtong ba dang / shes rab dang /ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa'i nor la dgodasnyedo zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /kye ma sems can 'di dag ni bu smad dang ske/ khyim dang / nor dang / 'bru la sred7pas 'khol7ba ste/ snying po med pa la snying por 'du shes pa yin gyis5)de dag la shin tu mi rtag par bstan par bya'o zhes de'i phyir sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen posaskye'o/ /kye ma sems can 'di dag ni mi rigs pas 'tsho ba7ste/ gcig la gcig 'drid par gnas pa yin gyis7de dag la 'tshosnyib yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir chos bstan to zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /kye ma sems can 'di dag ni chog mi shes pa ste/ rnyed pa dang /bkur ste dang / tshigs su bcad pa la spyod kyang bdag cag ni chog shes pa'o snyam du 'dzin gyis8/ de dag la gang 'di sdug bsngal shin tu zhi zhing bde ba'i mya ngan las 'das pas shin tu chog par bya'o zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /kye ma sems can 'di dag ni khyim gyi gnas sdug bsngal gyi snod shin tu nyon mongs pa la rtag tu dga' ba yin gyis ⑩de dag 64—122

las byung zhing khams gsum pa las yang dag par 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir chos bstan to zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /chos thams cad ni rgyusasho nye bar 'gro ba ste/ bsgrubs pas nye bar gnas pa'i mtshan nyid yin na④/ de la sems can rnams ni 'phags pa'i rnam par grol ba la le lo byed kyisasngogede dag la rnam par grol ba lhur blang ba'i phyir brtson 'grus brtsam par chos bstan to zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /sems can rnams ni chags pa med pa'i ye shes dam pa ri nikhyad par du 'phags pa'i yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa 'di btang zhing gang 'di nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dman pa tshol ba yin gyis 7nide dag la gang 'di sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la dmigs par bya ba'i phyir rgya chen po la sa/blo mos par bya'o zhes sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye ste/ rigs kyi bu rnam pa 9sum cu rtsa gnyis po de dag dang ldan na sems can rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po skye'o/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa thugs rje chen po la gnas pa zhes bya ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' gang la la zhig sems can dag la rnam pa sum cu rtsa gnyis po de dag dang ldan pa'i snying rje chen po skye na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ni bsod nams kyi zhing gzi brjid chen pos rgyas pa phyir mi ldog pa sems can gyi don la brtson par rig par bya'o/ /snying rje chen po'i chos kyi sgo'i le'u 'di bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa na srog chags stong phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skyes so/ /srog chags brgya stong ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/ /lha'i bu stong phrag 61—123

bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar de dag la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang sgyur gyi chos kyi rnam par 'god pa ni 3)dpag tu med grangs med de/ de dgasaphyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bskal par de bzhin gshegs pas bstan kyang mtha' med na sems can rnams kyi dga' ba dang / dad pa gedang / rangs pa bskyed pa'i phyir phyogs tsam zhig bstan te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad la chos dkar po las 'thun ④par 'byung ba'i dbugs 'byung ba dang / rngub pa'i srog nye bar sbyor ba la mkhas pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi char sprin dpag tu med pa kun 'dzin nus pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste / dper na rlung mar ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor mu med cing rgya che la brtanakyizhing sra bas 'jig rten gyi khams 'jig pa dang 'byung ba char sprin dang bcas pa/rgya mtsho dang / gling chen po bzhi bar bcas pa/ ri rab dang / ri btang bzungang nodang / ri btang bzungang chen po dang / gangs dang / khor7yug ri dang ske/ khor yug ⑨ri chen po dang / ri spos kyi ngad ldang ba dang / grong rdal dang / 'bab chu dang / nags tshal dang / gzhal med khang gi rnam par bcas pa dag yongs su 'dzin to/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yang gzungs kyi rlung mar gyi dkyil 'khor mu med pas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sprin gyis phab pa'i gtan pa med pa'i chos kyi char gyi rgyun chen po thams cad yongs su 'dzin to/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'byung ba'i tshe ji skad du brjod pa'i ri rab dang / rgya mtsho dang / gling 61—124

chen po bzhi pa dang / ri btang bzung medang / ri btang bzungasho chen po dang /gangs dang / khor yug ri dang / khor yug ri chen po dang / ri spos kyi ngad5kyeldang ba dang / grong rdal dang / 'bab chu dang / nags tshal dang / gzhal med khang gi rnam pa lta bu bsod nams brgya pa'i mtshan dang / sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs dang / mngon par shes pa5gedang ske/ dbang dang / stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / ma 'dres pa dang / snying rje chen po la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad yongs su 'dzin torka/ /'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi phung po brgya stong mu med pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang rtag tu rgyun mi chad par yongs su 'dzin te/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi char sprin dpag tu med pa kun 'dzin nus pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos rnam pa tha dad pa'i gzhal med khang chen po'i bkod pa rnam par dbye ba thams cad rnam par 'byed cing yongs su 'god pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/dper na rlung mar ni gzhal med khang dgod pa'i rnam par dbye ba sna tshogs thams cad kun nas gzhog par byed/ rnam par 'byed par byed de/ nags tshal dang / shing dang / yal ga dang / 'dabatsom dang / ldum bu dang /myu gu dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang / lo ma dang / sdong po la sogs pa dang / sems can thams cad7kyi yan lag dang / nying lag rnam par dbye ba sna tshogs rtag tu rgyun mi chad par yongs su gzhog cing rnam par 'byed de gsal bar byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' rlung mar yang so so 64—125

yang dag par rig pa dang / spobs 3pa'i ye shes ma thogs ma chags shing mtha' yas pas 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad sgo sna tshogs nas yongs su gzhog par byed/ /rnam par 'byed par byed/ snang bar byed/ yongs su ston par byed/ thob par byed cing rnam pa 'di dag 'di lta ste/ chos 'di dag ni ngan song sgrub pa'o/ /'di dag ni bde 'gro sgrub pa'o/ /'di dag ni bdag por 5sgrub pa'o/ /'di dag ni sems can dmyal ba sgrub pa'o/ /'di dag ni byol song gi skye gnas sgrub pa'o//'di dag ni gshin rje'i 'jig rten sgrub pa'o/ /'di dag ni miras sgrub pa'o/ /'di dag ni lhar 4sgrub pa'o/ /'di dag ni 'khor los sgyur bar gasgrub pa'o/ /de bzhin du mdor bsdus te/ 'di dag ni brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang /'jig rten skyong ba sgrub pa'o/ /'di dag ni gzugs dang / g.yog dang /yid gzhungs pa dang / dpal chen po sgrub pa'o/ /'di dag ni rig pa'o/ /'di dag ni sgyu 6rtsal to/ /'di dag ni bzo'i gnas so/ /'di dag ni gtsug lag sna tshogs la rnam pa thams cad du mkhas pa'o/ /'di dag ni nyan thos kyi theg pa ste/ nyan thos su 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ste / rang sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba'o/ /'di dag ni theg pa chen po ste/ rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa bdag dang / gzhan gyi don yang dag par 'thob 7par byed pa kun tu bzang po thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'gyur ba'o/ /de bzhin du mdor bsdus te/ 'di dag ni sa rnams dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnams dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / rig pa rnams dang / dbang rnams dang / gzungs rnams dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang / rnam 64—126

par thar pa rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / mi 'jigs pa rnams dang /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / ma 'dres pa rnams so zhes rigs kyi bu de ltar nashibyang chub sems dpa' ni de dag la sogs pa rnam pa tshad med pas gzungs pad ma bkod pa la sogs pa la mkhas pas / chos bkod pa rnam par bkod pa dag byed de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos rnam pa tha dad pa'i gzhal med khang chen po'i bkod pa rnam par dbye ri swāb thams cad rnam par 'byed cing yongs su dgodam4)pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dpag bsam gyi 95)shing las shin tu byung ba'i chos kyi gtam yang dag par gdon mi za ba'i me tog yid du 'ong ba'i char rtag tu mngon par 'bebs pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rlung mar ni dpag bsam gyi ri/shing gi nags tshal dag las gang gis lha dang / mi rnams shin tu dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas mya ngan med par rnam par rtse ba dang ske/ nyams bde zhing yongs su spyod de/ rtag tu rgyun mi chad par kha dog dang ske/ stobs dang / mthu dang / yid bde ba las dzoyongs su mi nyamasam2)pa de lta bu'i spos dang / me tog dang / rgyan dang / gos dang / rnga dang /sil snyan la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i char mngon par 'bebs yongs su skyod cing 'byin par byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' rlung mar yang yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor nas sems can dag la gang gis sems can de dag rtag tu rgyun mi chad par chos kyi dga' ba la mos shing 'dun pa dang / lus dang / ngag dang / yid kyi las kha na ma tho ba med pa dang /61—127

gzi dang ldan pa dang / yongs su skyo bar mi 'gyur ba dang / lha dang mi'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad nyams su myong bar byed pa dang / mi nyams pa'ishechos can du 'gyur ba dang / shes rab kyis snang bar gyur pas rtag tu khyad par gyi rnam parar 'dod par 'gyur ba'i mdo dang / dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa dang /lung bstan pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang /gleng gzhir dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / 'di lta bu 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmadamabadu byung ba dang / gtan la phab ge par bstan pa dag dang ldan pa'i dam pa'i chos rin po che'i me tog la sogs pa'i char mngon par 'bebs so/ /lugs dang 'thun ⑥pa dang /lugs dang mi 'thunamatso pa dang / snrel zhi gshedang / spyi'u tshugs kyi rgyud la sogs pa'i gtam rnam par gdon mi za ba nye bar sgrub podhi/ /tha snyad kyi dmigs pa thams cad la bdag med pa zhi zhing rnam par dag pa'i chos nyid rjod cing ston la rnam par byang bar /1byed do/ /chos thams cad sgo 8kun tu yang dag par gzhol ba yongs su ston to/ /sgyu ma'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug pa nye bar sbyor ro/ /ye shes sgyu ma rnam par rgyas par byed de/ chos thams cad la dga' bar rtse ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa rnams kyis sems can rnams yongs su rgyas par byed do/ /'drirwanyeb thams cad kyi lung bstan pas tshim par byed do/ /mtha' dang dbungasamed pa'i rdzu 'phrul la mkhas par byedasnyido/ /de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dpag bsam gyi shing las shin tu byung ba'i chos kyi gtam yang dag par nyu tshogadon mi za ba'i me tog yid du 'ong ba'i char rtag tu mngon par 'bebs pa yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 64—128

bskal pa grangs med par dkar po'i dkyil 'khor yongs su bsags pa7)ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par thar pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rgya mtsho dang / ri rab dang ske/ 'od dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / chos kyi tshul dang / nags tshal dang / khang pa dang / dge ba'i khor yug gisari la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i sems can gyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na gdul ba yongs su smin pa mang po yang dag par gnas pa/ bla na med cing lus med pa'i gnas 'pho bar 'jig pa'i ye shes kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor rab tu lagatong ba yin zhe na/rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rlung mar ni bskal pa'i mthar thug ste/'jig rten gyi khams 'jig par 'gyur ba'i dus na gang gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong ri rab dang / khor yug ri dang / rgya mtsho la sogs par bcas pa kun nas 'jig cing rnam par 'thor ba dang / thegasnyimed par byed cing nam mkha'i rang bzhin du byed pa de lta bu'i55)stobs kyi shugs thogs pa med par ldang ngo / /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ⑥drung mar yang bskal pa mang por tshogs ⑦bsags pa'i sems can bsod nams dang / ye shes sna tshogs rnam par bkod pa'i ri mthon po dang ldan pa rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i stobs kyi shugs dang / rdzu 'phrul dang ske/ rnam par 'phrul pa chen po yongs su bstan pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo thogs pa med par rab tu bskor ba'i sgra skad kyi dbyangs rab tu bsgrags pas chos kyi phung po'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gang gis 'dul ba chos snang ba'i lhag mthong dam pashedang ldan pa/ bzod par mi nus pa'i 'du byed kyi stobs thams cad mnyam par gzhog pa/ tshul bzhin yid la byas nas/ yang dag par 64—129

sems nang du gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin phun sum tshogs pa la brtenanyete/ srid pa dang / phung po dang / khams dang / skye mched kyi 'du byed kyi lus thams cad bshig cing rnam par gtor te lus med par byas nas yang dag pa ma yin pa meyongs su brtags pa rnam par bshig ste/ 'jig rten thams cad las yongs su 'das pa bsam gyis mi khyab cing gzugs med pa'i bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa dang / gzugs thams cad yongs su bstan pa rnam par bshigs pas gnas gyur pa rnam par dag pa phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug par gnas pa/ rnam pa thams cad du mtha' dang bral ba rnams thob par byed pa de lta bu kun nas rab tu gtong ste/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bskal pa grangs med par dkar po'i dkyil 'khor yongs su bsags pa/ ting nge 'dzin dang /rnam par thar pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rgya mtsho dang / ri rab dang / 'od dang ske/ zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / chos kyi tshul dang / nags tshal dang /khang pa dang / dge ba'i khor yug ri la sogs pas yongs su bskor ④ba'i sems can gyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na 5cigadul ba yongs su smin pa mang po yang dag par gnas pa/ bla na med cing lus med pa'i gnas 'pho ba dang /'jig pa'i ye shes kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor rab tu gtong ba yin te/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rlung mar lta bu rnams yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /a la la de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan zhing sems can rlabs zhupo che rnams yongs su tshim par 'gyur ba'i chos kyi tshul bcu po 'di bstan pa/ bcom 64—130

ldan 'das ngo mtshar to/ /bde bar gshegs pa ngo mtshar to/ /bcom ldan 'das lha dang mi gang la la chos 'di dag la mos shing nan tan bgyid na de dag thams cad ji skad du gsungs pa'i phun sum tshogs pa bde ba dang bcas pa yid bde ba dang bcas par thob par 'gyur te/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang /'jig rten skyong ba la sogs pa zhig bgyid na'ang gzhan gyi don la gzhol zhing tshe 'di dang / tshe rabs gzhan gyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang 'thob ༅par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin rnal/ /de de bzhin te/ sems can gang de lta bu'i chos rnams la nan tan dusabyed pa tshide dag ni 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa dang /kun tu rnam par bltas pa dang / mi dge ba'i chos thams cad rab tu spangs pa dang ske/ dge ba'i chos thams cad dang ldan pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ro/ /gang spong ba'i skyes bu glen pa de dag ni mun pa nas mun par gzhol ba ste/ sdug bsngal thams cad la rtenamacho tshopa'o/ /lha dang / mi dang /ge lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis mya ngan du bya ba'o// //'phags pa dkon mchog sprin zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdoyo/ bam po bzhi pa/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dri ma med pa rnams yin/ ma chags pa rnams yin/ zhi ba rnams yin/ shes rab mtha' yas pa rnams yin/ ye shes mtha' yas pa rnams yin/ chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su song ba rnams yin/ chos thams cad ni nam mkha'i dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid du mos pa rnams yin/ so sor mi rten pa rnams yin/61—131

mtshan ma'i spyod yul las 'das pa rnams yin/ rtog ge'i spyod yul las 'das pa rnams yin tenyu)/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ yid du 'ong ba dang / yid du mi 'ong ba'i gzugs rnams la chags par yang mi 'gyur/ khong khro bar yang mi 'gyur ba dang / yid du 'ong ba dang yid du mi 'ong ba'i sgra rnams dang /dri rnams dang / ro rnams dang / reg bya rnams dang / yid du 'ong ba dang yid du mi 'ong ba'i chos rnams la chags par yang mi 'gyur/ khong khro bar yang( nomi 'gyur ba dang / rnyed pa dang / ma rnyed pa dang / bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba dang / grags pa dang ma grags pa dang / bstodasapa dang smad pas chags par yang mi 'gyur/ khong khro bar yang gemi 'gyur ba ste/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag sanodang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' yinam mkha' dang mtshungs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' zla ba dang 'dra ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can thams cad kyi lus rab tu sim par byed pa dang / mthong na dga' ba rnams yin/chos dkar po rnams skye bar byed pa dang / chos nag po rnams bri bar byed pa dang ske/ rab tu bsngags ⑦pa rnams yin/ lus yongs su dag pa rnams yin/bzhon pa mchog la zhon pa rnams yin/ rtag tu brgyan pa rnams yin/ chos kyi dga' ba la mos shing 'dun pa rnams yin/ 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams 64—132

cad kyi lus rab tu sim par byed pa nas ji ltar na 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba'i bar du yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na zla ba shar na 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi lus bsil ba dang / yid du 'ong bas rab tu sim par byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' zla ba shar na yang 'di lta ste / nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba thams cad dang bral ba dang / dga' ba dang / dad pa 1dang / rangs pa dang / yid du 'ong bas sems can thams cad kyi lus rab tu sim par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na zla ba shar na 'di lta ste/ zhi ba dang / dang ba dang / sems shin tu dga' bar byed pas sems can thams cad mthong na dga' ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' zla ba shar na yang 'di lta ste/ dbang po rnam par gsal ba dang /sems kyi rgyud dang ba dang / spyod pa dang / spyod lam dang / yon tan phun sum tshogs pas sems can thams cad mthong na dga' zhing yid du 'ong ba yin no / /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na zla ba yar gyi ngo la zla ba nya ste/ rnam pa thams cad du rgyas par 'gyur gyi ribar du nyi ma re re zhing 'phel lo/ /yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' zla ba yang thog ma sems bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug gi bar du nyi ma re re zhing chos dkar po rnams 'phel zhing yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ nam byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug pa de na rnam pa thams cad du yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na zla ba mar gyi ngo la bab pa na/zla ba'i gedakyil 'khor kha dog dang / snang ba dang / chu zheng yang yongs su 'bri ste/ bcwa ri lnga la ji ltar rnam pa thams cad du thams cad mi mngon pa de 64—133

ltar 'bri'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' zla ba yang nam 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes thob par gyur pa de na3da/ de'i mi dge ba'i chos rnams thams cad du thams cad rab tu 'bri ste/ ji ltar byang chub kyi snying po la thams cad du thams cad med par 'gyur ba de ltar rab tu 'bri'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na zla ba shar na bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / grong pa dang /yul gyi mi skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang / bu mo rnams kyis rab tu bsngags par bya ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' zla ba shar na yang lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis rab tubasngags par bya ba yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na lha'i bu zla ba'i lus 'di ltar rang gi bsod nams kyi las rnam par smin pas grub pa ni yongs su dag ste/ rtog pa med cing dang ba dang / gsal geb yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' zla ba'i lus kyang 'di lta ste/ chos nyid kyis mngon par grub pa/ rdzus te /skyes pa/ pha ma'i btsog sa pa dang / mer mer po las byung ba ma yin te/ yongs su dag la rtog pa med cing dang ba dang gsal ba yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper 3rin lha'i bu zla ba ni bzhon pa mchog la zhon te/ gling bzhir snang bar byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' zla ba yang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa mchog la zhon te/ 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med par snang bar byed do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/dper na lha'i bu zla ba ni rtag tu brgyan cing rgyan ma rnyings pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' zla ba yang 'di ltar yon tan gyi rgyan rnams kyis rtag tu brgyan pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na lha'i bu zla ba ni 61—134

rtag tu rgyun mi chad par lha'i 'dod pa'i dga' ba la mos pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' zla ba yang rtag tu rgyun mi chad par chos kyi dga' ba la mos shing 'dun pa yin gyi 'dod pas dga' ba la dga' ba ma yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na lha'i bu zla ba ni 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' zla ba yang 'di lta ste/ bsod nams chen po dang / ye shes chen pos 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba yin te/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad kyi lus rab tu sim par byed pa nas 'phrul che zhing mthu che ba'i bar du yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' zla ba dang 'dra ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma dang 'dra ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba rnams yin / 'dul ba'i sems can rnam par 'byed par byed 1pa rnams yin/phyogs bcu thams cad du lhan ner dbyed pa rnams yin / dge ba'i chos mngon par shar ba 4rnams yin/ de dag gi zag pa nub par 'gyur ba rnams yin / snang bar byed pa rnams yin/ mu stegs can ngan pa'i lugs rnams zil gyis mnan te 'dug pa rnams yin/ mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa kun ston pa rnams 5yin/ chos dkar po'i las kyi mtha' thams cad 'byung bar byed pa rnams yin/ skye bo dge ba 56tshodaga' ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ma rig pa'i )mun pa sel ba nas/ ji ltar skye bo dge ba dga' ba'i bar 2du yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma shar na mun pa mun nag thams cad rnam par sel to/ /de bzhin du byang chub 61—135

sems dpa' 1)nyi ma shar na yang ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad rnam par sel to//rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma shar na pad ma rnam par 'bye'ubar byed do / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'57nyi ma shar na yang gdul ba'i sems can gyi pad ma rnam par 'bye bar byed do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma shar na phyogs bcu thams cad du lhan ner byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' (4)nyi ma shar na yang phyogs bcu thams cad du shes rab kyi gzi brjid dang / ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis rab tu lhan nor byed kyang sems can rnams la gnod par mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na 'dzam bu'i 3gling du nyi ma'i 'od zer dag57nam snang ba de'i tshe na shar ces bya'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'i ye shes kyi 'od zer rnams nam snang ba de'i tshe na dge ba'i chos rnams shar ces bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/dper na 'dzam bu'i 3gling du nyi ma'i snang ba nam med par gyur pa de'i tshe na nub ces bya'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams thams cad du thams cad nam med par gyur pa de'i tshe na zag pa zad ces bya'o / /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma shar na 'dzam bu'i 6gling gi sems can rnams la snang bar byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma shar na yang sems can thams cad la ye shes kyi snang ba 1 5byed cing / gti mug gi mun pa'i rab rib kyis khebs pa rnam par sel to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste / dper na nyi ma shar na 'od thams cad kyi 31'od med par byed kyang nyi ma ni ngas 'od thams cad kyi 'od mi snang bar bya'o snyam du mi sems mod kyi/ 'on kyang chos nyid thob pas 'od med par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems 64—136

dpa' nyi ma shar na yang mu stegs can ngan pa'i 'od dang / mu stegs can ngan pa'i lugs thams cad 'od med par7'gyur mod kyi/ byang chub sems dpa'i nyi ma ni ngas 'di dag 'od med par bya'o snyam du mi sems mod kyi/ 'on kyang chos nyid thob pas 'od med par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma shar na 'dzam bu'i 3gling gi mi rnams la mnyam pa dang mi mnyam (7pa legs par ston to/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma shar na yang sems can thams cad la ye shes kyi snang bas mnyam pa dang / mi mnyam pa legs par ston to/ /rigs kyi bu mnyam pa zhes bya ba 'di ni 'phags pa'i lam gyi tshig bla dgas so/ /rigs kyi bu mi mnyam pa zhes bya ba 'di ni lam ngan pa'i tshig bla dgas so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma shar na rmo brko—3ba'i las kyi mtha' thams cad 'byung ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma shar na yang ④dge ba'i chos las kyi mtha' thams cad 'byung ngo / /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma shar na skye bo dge ba ni dga' bar 'gyur la/ mi srun pa'i rang bzhin can medag mi dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ④nyi ma shar na yang / skye bo dge ba rnams dang /mkhas pa rnams dang / shes rab kyi rang bzhin can rnams ni dga' bar 'gyur la / lam ngan par zhugs pa rnams dang / mi srun pa'i rang bzhin can rnams dang ske/ byis pa'i rang bzhin can rnams dang / shes rab 'chal pa'i rang bzhin can rnams dang / 'khor ba la mngon par dga' ba rnams dang / mya ngan las 'das pa las phyir phyogs pa rnams ni mi dga' bar 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnams ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba nas skye 64—137

bo dge ba dga' ba'i bar du yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma dang 'dra ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' seng ge dang 'dra ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bag mi tsha ba rnams yin/ mi brtabs0)pa rnams yin/ mi zlogs gupa rnams yin/ seng ge'i sgra sgrogs dupa rnams yin/mi 'jigs pa rnams yin/ nags tshal dang / nags tshal gyi 'dabartsongarin rgyu ba rnams yin/ ri'i phug na gnas pa rnams yin/ len pa med pa rnams yin/bdag gi sgrubartson 'grus dang / stobs dang / mthu thobs6)pas bdud kyi sde rab tu 'joms 7pa rnams yin/ dge ba'i chos kyi lo thog srung52)ba rnams yin no / /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bag mi tsha ba nas dge ba'i chos kyi lo thog srung 49ba'i bar du yin zhe na/ rigs kyi mibu 'di lta ste/dper na seng ge ni gar 'gro yang bdag dang 'dra ba med par mthong bas bag mi tsha zhing mi skrag par 'gro'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' seng ge yang bdag dang 'dra ba med par mthong bas gar 'gro yang 31bag mi tsha zhing mi skrag par 'gro'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na seng ge ni wa thams cad kyi sgras mi brtabs 1 pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' seng ge yang pha rol gyi rgol ba thams cad kyis brtsad 1 pas brgal yang bomi brtabs shing rgod pa dang zhum par mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na seng ge ni bskugs na phyir mi ldog pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' seng ge yang pha rol rgol ba thams cad kyis bskugs na mi zlogs shing /demi zhum par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na seng ge ni sgra gang gis ri dgas 64—138

phra mo thams cad dang wa thams cad phyogs bcur 'byer bar 'gyur ba de lta bur sgrog go/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' seng ge yang bdag med pa'i seng ge'i sgra gang gis bdag tu 'dzin pa la mngon par chags pa'i gzhan mu stegs can gyi ri dgas rnams dang / gzhan mu stegs can gyi wa thams cad phyogs bcur 'byer bar 'gyur ba de lta bu sgrog ste/ byang chub sems dpa' seng ge ni bdag tu 'dzin pa las bzlog par bya ba dang / sems can gzhan dag gdul ba'i dbang du bya ba ma gtogs par de dag la gnod pa bya ba'i phyir bdag med pa'i seng ge'i sgra mi sgrog go/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na seng ge ni kun tu lta yang mi 'jigs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' seng ge yang spyod pa yongs su dag pa'i nan tan la lta yang mi 'jigs pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na seng ge ni rang bzhin gyis nags tshal dang /nags tshal gyi 'dab nya7na rgyu ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' seng ge yang rang bzhin gyis dben pa la mngon par phyogs shing nags tshal dang /nags tshal gyi 'dab spyon spyod pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na seng ge ni ri'i phug na gnas pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' seng ge yang ye shes kyi 3)brag ri'i phug na gnas pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na seng ge ni mi len par 'gro ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' seng ge yang nyon mongs pa'i khur thams cad bor zhing len pa med par 'gro ba yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na seng ge ni gcig pu gnyis su med pa bdag gi gebartson 'grus dang / stobs dang / mthu thob pas pha rol gyi sde 'joms so/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' seng ge yang 64wa 139

gcig pu gnyis su med par byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug nas bdag gi1brtson 'grus dang / stobs dang / mthu thob pas bdud kyi sde 'joms so / /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na grong gi 'dabashosagang na seng ge rgyu ba der ri dgas phra mo dag gis lo thog rnams chud mi gzon cato/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' seng ge yang yul dang yul gyi phyogs gang na 'dug pa der mu stegs can gyi ri dgas phra mo dag gis dge ba'i chos kyi lo thog chud mi gzon phyirate/rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bag mi tsha ba nas dge ba'i chos kyi lo thog srung ba'i bar du yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' seng ge dang 'dra ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' 'dul ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na / 'di lta ste/ byang chub kyi sems brtan pa rnams yin/ byang chub kyi sems byi dor shin tu byas pa rnams yin/ dbang po bsdams pa rnams yin/lam du zhugs pa rnams yin/ khur chen po khyer 46)phod pa rnams yin/ sems can gyi don rnams la yongs su mi skyo ba rnams yin/ yang dag pas 'tsho ba rnams yin/ tshul 'chos pa gedang / kha gsag gi rnyed pa thams cad dang bral ba rnams yin/ g.yo sgyu na dang bral ba rnams yin/ drang ba'i rang bzhin can bas drang ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' 'dul ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' cang shes pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste / stong pa nyid la sgom pa mang bas rnal 'byor spyod pa rnams yin/ sgrib pa med cing kun nas ldang ba thams cad dang bral bas lam gyi rgyun ma bcad pa 64wa 140

rnams yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' mi gcog pas bka' bzhin byed pa rnams yin/ chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rtogs pas chos thams cad kyi tshul mnyam pa nyid khong du chud pa rnams yin/ dma' ba dma' ba'i yid kyis gdol bu ltar 'jig rten na spyod pa rnams yin/ rtag tu rgyun mi chad par bsod snyoms blang bar 'du shes nye bar gzhag pas nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang / dregs pa dang bral ba rnams yin/ 'di ltar de mngon sum du shes pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la nem nur med pa rnams yin/ chos rang gis rig pa'i phyir the tsom —1med pa rnams yin/ rang gis lam mthong bas gzhan gyis mi bkri zhing pha rol gyi dring mi 'jog pa rnams yin/ rab tu zhugs pas 'jig rten na sbyin pa'i gnas su gyur pa rnams yin te / rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na cibyang chub sems dpa' cang shes pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' pad ma tshadang 'dra ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ ma gos 2pa rnams yin/ sdig pa chung ngu dang ne yang lhan cig mi gnas pa rnams yin/ tshul khrims kyi dri zhim pa rnams yin/ gtsang ba rnams yin/ bzhin 'dzum pa rnams yin/ mi rtsub pa rnams yin/ mthong na bkra shis pa rnams yin/ blo rnam par bye ba rnams yin/blo yongs su smin pa rnams yin/ shin tu yongs su bzung ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ma gos pa yin pa nas ji ltar na shin tu yongs su bzung ba'i bar du yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/dper na pad ma ni chu'i nang nas 'byung 57yang mi chags par skye'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de'i chos nyid thob pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du byang chub 64—141

sems dpa' 'khor ba'i chu las 'byung yang mi chags par skye'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de'i thabs dang / shes rab kyi chos nyid thob pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas pa ni 'khor ba na spyod kyang 'khor ba'i nyes pa dag gis mi gos 17te/ de'i thabs de ni shes rab chosakyis yang dag par zin pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad ma la ni chu'i thigs pa chung ngu yang mi chags so/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' la sdig pa chung ngu yang mi chags so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na sa'i phyogs gang du pad ma skyes par gyur pa'i sa'i kyiphyogs de dris khyab par 'dug go/ /de bzhin du yul dang yul gyi phyogs gang na byang chub sems dpa' gnas pa de thams cad tshul khrims kyi dris khyab par 'dug go/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad ma ni sa'i phyogs gar skyes pa'i sa phyogs de gtsang zhing bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / grong pa dang / yul gyi mi thams cad kyang 'du ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' gar skyes kyang rung 'di lta ste/ tshul khrims dang ske/ gtsang sbra kun spyod pas gtsang ba 4yin te/ lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams 'du bsre yin / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis dgongs pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rab tu bsngags pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/dper na pad ma ni kha bye 5na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can rnams kyi yid du 'ong bas 'dzum pa lta bur snang ngo / /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang khro gnyer med cing dbang po shin tu dang bas bzhin rtag tu 'dzum pa yin no/ /61—142

rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad ma ni rang bzhin gyis 'jam zhing mi rtsub pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang rang bzhin gyis 'jam zhing dal gyis smra ba yin/ mi brlang zhing mu cor mi smra ba'i rang bzhin can yin no / /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad ma ni rmi lam dang / ltas dang /yud tsam dag la mthong na yang 'di lta ste/ don 'grub pa'i phyir bkra shis shing rab tu bsngags pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba yang 'di lta ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid thob par bya ba la dus thams cad du'ang bkra shis shing rab tu bsngags pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad ma ni nam rgyas pa de na rnam par bye ba zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang nam shes rab dang / byang chub kyi yan lag me tog rgyas pa de na blo rnam par bye ba zhes bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad ma ni nam yongs su smin par gyur pa de na 3)bltas na mig gi dbang po tshim par byed/mnyan na rna ba'i dbang po tshim par byed/ mnamasaken sna'i dbang po tshim par byed / 2reg na lus kyi dbang po tshim par byed/ sems rab tu dga' bas yid kyi dbang po tshim par byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang nam shes rab kyi snang ba yongs su smin par gyur pa de'i tshe ④bltas na mig gi dbang po rnam par dag par byed/ mnyan na rna ba'i dbang po rnam par dag par byed/ tshul khrims dang yon tan gyi dri mnams snin sna'i dbang po rnam par dag par byed/ ne༄reg pa dang bsnyen bkur byas na lus kyi dbang po rnam par dag par byed/ yon tan brjod pa rnam par bsams 477pas yid kyi dbang po rnam par dag par byed do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na pad ma ni skye 61—143

ba'i tshe 'di lta ste/ mi dang mi ma yin pa dag gis shin tu yongs su bzung ba yin te/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang skye ba'i tshe sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / de ma yin pa gzhan brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dag gis shin tu yongs su bzung ba yin no//rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' ma gos pa nas shin tu yongs su bzung ba'i bar du yin te/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' pad ma 1dang 'dra ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems rgya che ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na / 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad yang dag par sgrub bo zhes sems rgya cher skyed nado/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya'o zhes sems rgya cher skyed sa do/ /sems can thams cad gdul lo gezhes sems rgya cher skyed 5do/ /byang chub kyi snying por 'dug ste/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o zhes sems rgya cher skyedas 'do/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas 'jig rten du dge sbyong ngam/ bram ze'am/ lha'am/ bdud dam/ tshangs pa'am/ sus kyang chos dang ldan par sngon ma bskor ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor 3)ro zhes sems rgya cher skyed rigedo/ /'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med par song ste/sems can 7gyi don bya ba'i dngos po de dang de dag gis sems can rnams kyi don bya'o zhes sems rgya cher skyed 1 )do/ /shes rab kyi gru sbyar te sems can rnams 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las pha rol tu (glebasgral lo zhes sems rgya cher skyed /3do//mgon med pa dang / skyabs med pa dang / gnas med pa dang / rten med 64wa 144

pa dang / dpung gnyen med pa dang / gnyan med 3)pa'i sems can rnams kyi gnyen bya'o zhes sems rgya cher skyed ②do/ /lha dang bcas/ bdud dang bcas / tshangs pa dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang / dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i skye dgu'i〈 rinang du sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog nyid bstan to/ /sangs rgyas kyi seng ge'i sgra bsgrag mgo/ /sangs rgyas kyi rnam par rol bas rnam par rtse'obla/ /glang po chen po'i blta bas blta bar bya'o zhes sems rgya cher skyed 6)do/ /sangs rgyas kyi che bas sems can rnams gdul bar bya'i ④spyod pa ngan pas ma yin/ dka' 3bar spyod pas ma yin / zhan pa'i spyod pas ma yin/ zhum pa'i spyod pas ma yin no zhes sems rgya cher skyed 1༄do/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems rgya che ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems rnam par dag pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ bsam pa mi g.yo bas bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/'di lta ste/ bsam pa la sgyu med pas bsam pa shin tu gnas pa rnams yin/'di lta ste/ nyan thos kyi byang chub yid la byed pa mi skyed nya 7pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub yid la byed pa mi skyed tsho/1pa dang / brtson pa chung ba'i yid la byed pa mi skyed hurtepas tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid la byed pa dang bral ba rnams yin/ 'di lta ste/ nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dang bral bas dri ma thams cad dang bral ba rnams yin/ 'di lta ste/ sgyu'i 'aspyod lam dang bral bas lus kyi tshul 'chos pa dang bral ba rnams yin/ 'di lta ste/ yang dag pa'i don kun ston pas ngag gi tshul 'chos pa dang bral ba rnams yin3 ci/ 'di lta ste/64—145

lus kyis 'du 'dzi med pa dang / ngag gis7'dod pa chung ba dang / sems kyis 70smon pa med pa'i phyir sems kyi tshul 'chos pa dang bral ba rnams yin/cung zad byas pa yang chud mi gzon na mang po lta ci smos te/ byas pa gzo ba rnams yin/ byas pa tshor ba rnams yin te/ dgos pa byas pa la mi smod mi skyud / yon tan ma yin par mi lta ste/ gzhan du na cung zad byas pa yang tshor zhing de la stodamakhudapar byed/ / gzengs stodangaji)par byed/ yang dag par dga' bar byed/ rab tu bsngags par byed/ /de la yon tan du lta ba yin no/ /ji ltar smra 5ba de ltar byed pa rnams yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ngag gis snyan par ston cing sems kyis mi 'thunamathapar sems pa ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ngag gis ston gecing sems kyis ngan du bya ba'i sbyor ba mi byed / byang chub sems dpa' rnams ngag ni༄gis 'jam par smra zhing sems kyis zhe la non te shar gnyer ba 9)ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams lus kyis des pa ston cing sems kyis 'khon 3 5gyi mdud par 'dzin pa (1ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams lus kyis ri mor bya ba ston cing sems kyis brnyas par byed pa ma yin/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams tshul mi 'chos/ kha gsag mi byed / 'jungs pa dang phrag dog gis kun tu glags pa ma yin/ sgyu dang g.yos mi spyod/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'thab spyanatshwa)mi byed/ phan tshun du dpar ba nyuge'ajug pa ma yin gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni lus kyis kyang ri mo byed 8pa yin/ ngag gis kyang yang dag pa'i don smra ba las su rung ba yang sgrub bo/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la skur 8pa'i phyir zhugs pa ma yin pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la skur pa dang 64wa 146

bral ba rnams yin no/ /ji ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la skur pa ma btab pa yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ skra dang kha spu bregs/ gos ngur smrig dag gyon nas yang dag par dad pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu 'byung ngo / /de rab tu 'byung ba na rgyal pos mnar ba med par rab tu 'byung /rkun7pos gtse ba med pa dang / bu lon gyis gtse ba med pa dang / 'jigs pas gtse ba med pa dang / 'tsho ba med pa'i 'jigs pas skrag pa med par〈 —rab tu 'byung ngo / /de dang de rab tu byung nas dge ba ci yin zhes 'tsholaphub yin te/ de dge ba ci yin zhes tshol bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la bsnyen par byed/ sten par byed/ bsnyen bkur byed do/ /de dag las chos kyang nyan to/ /thos nas kyang nan tan du 37byed/ nga rgyal gyi zil gyis mnon561pa yin te/ de nga rgyal dang bral bas ma log par 'dzin pa yin/ ma log par 'dzin pas lam shin tu rtogs pa thob bo/ /de lam shin tu rtogs pas chos nyid thob bo/ /chos nyid thob pas name/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur te/ de ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan⑧pa la skur pa ma btab pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems rnam par dag pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems nem nur med pa rnams boyin no / /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i gsang ba la〈nye mngon par dad/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi gsang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yid kyitshwa gsang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par 61—147

sgrub pa nyu7dang / byang chub dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang / theg pa gcig gi tshul bstan pa dang / tshul sna tshogs bstan pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi sgra ri dbyangs zab mo dang / sems can gyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul ba la mngon par dad do/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i gsang ba la mngon par dad pa nas ji ltar na sems can gyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul ba la mngon par dad pa'i bar du yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems so/ /gang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku dang / zhi ba'i sku dang / mi mnyam pa'i sku dang /da mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i sku dang / tshad med pa'i sku dang /phal la med pa'i sku dang / rdo rje'i sku zhes bya ba thos pa 'di ni yang dag pa'o/ /'di ni de kho na'o/ /'di ni mi slu ba'o snyam ste/ gnas 'di la nem nur med cing the tsom 4med de de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i gsang ba la mngon par dad do/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi gsang ba la mngon par dad ce na/ de 'di ltar sems so/ /gang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa ni mngon sum du lung ston pa dang / gsang ste lung ston pa dang /ldem po ngag gis kyang sems can rnams la lung ston mod kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa la 'khrul pa'am ca co med de/ de'i phyir de la brdzun du smra ba'i nyes pa mi 'byung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni skyon thams cad52spangs pa/ dri ma thams cad sgo spangs pa/ rdul thams cad spangs pa/ yongs su gdung ba thams cad dang bral ba/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ dbang du gyur 64—148

pa / zhi ba/ dang ba/ yongs su dag pa/ rnyog pa med pa/ rnam par gsal ba ste/ gang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la 'khrul pa'am/ ca co 'byung ba de ni gnas ma yin zhing skabs0)med do zhes thos pa 'di ni yang dag pa'o/ /'di ni de kho na'o/ /'di ni mi slu ba'o snyam ste/ gnas57'di la rnam nur med/the tsom ( med de de ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung gi gsang ba la mngon par dad do/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i yid kyi gsang ba la mngon par dad ce na/ de 'di ltar sems so/ /gang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i yid kyi gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pas ci dgongs pa'i don gang sems dang 'grogs pa/ sems la gnas pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs gekyis gyur pa ma gtogs par nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / sems can thams cad kyis shes par mi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni zab cing gting dpag dka' ba/ brtag par bya ba ma yin pa / rtog ge'i spyod yul las shin tu 'das pa/ dpag tu med pa/ rgya che ba/yangs pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings dang mtshungs pa/ rtog ge thams cad kyi yul las 'das par thos pa 'di ni yang dag pa'o/ 'di ni de kho na'o/ /'di ni mi slu ba'o snyam ste/ gnas 'di la nem nur med the tsomasamed pa yin te/ de ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa'i yid kyi gsang ba la mngon par dad do/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i yang dag par bsgrub yopa la mngon par dad cesathon/ de 'di ltar sems so/ /gang 'di lta ste/ byang chub kyi rgyu/ byang chub kyi gzhi/ byang chub kyi phyir byang chub sems dpa' de dgashon)61—149
