sems can gyi don la mngon du phyogs pa dang / sems can gyi bya ba dang /sems can gyi byed pa dang / yongs su mi skyo ba dang / mi skrag pa dang / khur chen po khyer ba dang / mthu brtan pa dang / rtul ba brtan pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par sgrub pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams mthar gyis yang dag par sgrub pa dang / thogs pa med pa'i blo dang / mtha' yas pa'i blo dang ske/ mi0)mnyam pa'i blo dang / phal la med pa'i blo dang / brtson 'grus brtan pa dang / go cha brtan lapa dang / dam bcas padzad brtan pa dang /dam bcas pa las mi g.yo ba dang / dam bcas pa phal la med pa de dag thams cad rim gyis 'phel5bzhing rgyas pa dang / yangs par yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro zhes thos pa 'di ni yang dag pa'o/ /'di ni de kho na'o/ /'di ni mi slu ciraba'o snyam ste/ gnas 'di la de nem nur med/ the tsom med de de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par sgrub pa la mngon par dad do/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' byang chub dang de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba la mngon par dad ce na/ de 'di ltar sems so/ /gang byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying por 'dug nas lha'i mig chags pa med cing thogs pa med pa sgrib pa med pa 'thob rtsibo/ /lha'i rna ba dang / gzhan gyi sems shes pa dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i shes pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam pasheshes pa dang /zag pa zad pa shes pa dang / dus gsum pa7skad cig gcig dang ldan pas shes pa chags pa med pa/ thogs pa med pa/ sgrib pa med pa 'thob po/ /de'i phyir sems can gyi khams la yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du lta ste/ sems can 'di rnams ni lus kyisarmāḥ/ngan du spyod pa dang ldan pa/ ngag gis 32ngan du 64—150

spyod pa dang ldan pa/ yid kyis hu)ngan du spyod pa dang ldan pa/ 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa/ log par lta ba rnams te/ log par lta ba'i las dang /chos yang dag par blangs pa'i phyir〈de'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis lus zhig nas shi ba'i 'og tu ngan 'gro log par ltung ba sems can dmyal ba dag tu skye'o/ /sems can 'di rnams ni lus kyisakelegs par spyod pa dang ldan pa/ bangag gis 5 legs par spyod pa dang ldan pa/ yid kyis nyalegs par spyod na pa dang ldan pa/'phags pa la skur pa mi 'debs pa/ yang dag par lta ba rnams te/ yang dag par lta ba'i las dang / chos yang dag par blangs pa'i phyir de'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis lus zhig nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du lha'i nang du skye'o snyam nas de ltar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can gyi khams la lta ste/sems can gyi khams de nyid kyi se dge ba dang / mi dge ba'i las rnams la rnam par lta'o/ /de yang 'di snyam du sems te/ sngon bdag byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pas gang 'di ltar bdag nyid rnam par sangs rgyas nas gzhan yang rnam par sangs rgyas par bya'o zhes dam bcas pa'i bdag gi smon lam de yongs su rdzogs so/ /bdag gi brnag pa de yongs su rdzogs so snyam mo zhes thos pa 'di ni yang dag pa'o/ /'di ni de kho na'o/ /'di ni mi slu ba'o snyam ste/ gnas 'di la nem nur med/ the tsom tshamed do/ /gang la byang chub sems dpa' de rnam par sangs rgyas pa de ni byang chub ces bya'o/ /bdag nyid rnam par sangs rgyas pas tu stan rdzogs par sangs rgyas zhes bya ste31/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' byang chub dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba la mngon par dad do/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' theg pa gcig gi tshul bstan pa la mngon par 64—151

dad ce na/ de 'di ltar sems so/ /gang 'di theg pa ni gcig kho na te①/'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg pa'o zhes thos pa 'di ni yang dag pa'o//'di ni de kho na'o/ /'di ni mi slu ba'o/ /'di ni de bzhin pa'o/ /ma nor pa'o / /gzhan ma yin pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ theg pa gzhan rnams kyang 'di las byung ngo / /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na 'dzam bu'ilo gling na gang gling yod pa ③rnams ming gis tha dad par shes mod kyi/ 'on kyang de dag ni 'dzam bu'i gling du 'du'o/ / 'dzam bu'i ri5)gling la rten stso)to/ / 'dzam bu'i /gling gi grangs su 'gro'o/ /de'i phyir na 487gling gcig kho na ste/ de ni 'dzam bu'i 1)gling ngo / /de bzhin du theg pa thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg par 'du'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg pa la gnas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg pa las byung ba'o3 )/ /de'i phyir theg pa gcig kho na stenyurte/'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg pa'o snyam ste/ gnas 'di la de nem nur med / the tsom nyi med de de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' theg pa gcig gi tshul bstan pa la mngon par dad do/ /ji ltar na tshul sna tshogs bstan pa la mngon par dad ce na/ de 'di ltar sems so/ /gang 'di mdo sde de dang de dag las de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul sna tshogs bshad pa thos pa 'di ni yang dag pa'o/ /'di ni de kho na'o/ /'di ni mi slu ba'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'dul ba'i dbang gi phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dad pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can rnams la chos ston to snyam ste/ gnas 'di la de nyurtenem nur med/ the tsomasamed de de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' tshul sna tshogs bstan pa la mngon parashedad do/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i ⑩gsung sgra'i dbyangs 61—152

zab mo la mngon par dad ce na/ de 'di ltar sems so/ /gang 'di ①de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung sgra'i dbyangs zab mo thos pa 'di ni yang dag pa'o/ /'di ni de kho na'o/ /'di ni mi slu ba'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ngu'i⑧lha'i bu rnams kyi dbyangs kyang zab cing snyan pa yin na/ bskal pa brgya stong du mar dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrubs ②pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi lta ci smos snyam ste/ gnas 'di la deshenem nur med/ the tsoms༅med de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung sgra'i dbyangs zab mo la mngon par dad do/ /rigs kyi bu ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can gyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul ba la mngon par dad ce na/ de 'di ltar sems so/ /gang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa yibasam pa dang / bag la nyal mkhyen tege/ sems can mos pa tha dad pa dang / 'dul ba tha dad pa rnams la gsung sgra'i dbyangs gcig brjod pas the tsomadegacod cing yongs su smin pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can rnams 'dul lo/ /sems can rnams kyang so so nas de bzhin gshegs pa bdag la chos ston te④/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bdag la chos ston to snyam byed kyang de bzhin gshegs pa ni mi rtog rnam hu )par mi rtog go zhes tuṅgāthos pa 'di ni yang dag pa'ohurte/ /'di ni de kho na'o/ /'di ni mi slu ba'o snyam ste/ gnas 'di la de nem nur med/ the tsom dzo/rtemed de/ rigs kyi bu 8de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems can gyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul ba la mngon par dad do/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag 8dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems nem nur med pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' blo rgya mtsho dang mtshungs pa rnams yin no//61—153

bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rin po che'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa rnams yin/ zab cing gting dpag dka' ba rnams yin/ rgya che zhing tshad med pa rnams yin/bags kyis gzhol ba rnams yin/ nyon mongs pa'i ro dang lhan cig mi 'dug pa rnams yin/ ro gcig pa rnams yin/ chu bo kun zed pa rnams yin/ dus las mi yol0)ba rnams yin/ 'byung po mang po'i gnas su gyur pa rnams yin/mi zad pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa yin pa nas ji ltar na mi zad pa'i bar du yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni rin po chesathams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ 'dzam bu'i7gling gi mi thams cad kyis rin po che blang bas mi zad do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang yon tan rin po che thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin te/ sems can thams cad kyis yon tan rin po che blang bas mi zad do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni zab cing gting dpag dka' ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ye shes yang dag par grub pa yang zab cing sems can thams cad kyis gting dpag dka' zhing zab pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni 'di lta ste/ chu tshad med pas na yangs shing rgya che ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang 'di lta ste/ blo tshad med pas na yangs shing rgya che ba yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni bags kyis gzhol/ bags kyis 'bab④/ bags kyis bab bo/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la gzhol/thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la 'babad / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la bab bo/ /64—154

rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni shi ba'i ro dang lhan cig mi 'dug go/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni rgya mtsho chen po'i chos nyid do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang nyon mongs pa'i ro dang mi dge ba'i grogs po rnams dang lhan cig mi gnas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni byang chub sems dpa'i chos nyid do/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rgya mtsho chen por chu bo ji snyed bab pa de dag7thams cad kyang ro gcig pa yin te/ 'di lta ste / lan tshwa'ikhuro'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yangasachos dkar po rnams ji snyed sdud pa de dag thams cad ro gcig pa yin te/ 'di lta ste/thams cad mkhyen pa'i ro'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni chu bo tshad med pa kun zedamagekyang de la bri ba'am/ gang bar yang mi mngon no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang chos kyi chu bo tshad med pa kun zedabakyang de la bri ba'am/ gang bar mi mngon no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni dus las mi yol lo/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang gdul bar bya ba'i sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i dus las mi yol lo/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni 'byung po mang po'i gnas so/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang sems can thams cad dang ske/ chos dkar po thams cad kyi gnas so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/dper na rgya mtsho chen po ni sems can thams cad kyis chu bcus kyang mi zad pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang sems can thams cad la chos ston pa mi zad pa yin te/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa nas mi zad pa'i bar du yin no/ /rigs kyi 61—155

bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' blo rgya mtsho dang mtshungs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' blo zhib pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'byung ba0)tshol ba la mkhas pa rnams yin/ chos thams cad brtag pa la mkhas pa rnams yin/chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid khong du chud pa rnams yin/ chos thams cad sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid du khong du chud pa rnams yin/ chos thams cad yongs su shes pa la mkhas pa rnams yin/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba zab cing gting dpag dka' ba la mkhas pa rnams yin/ las bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mkhas pa rnams yin/ smras 2pa'i don shes pa rnams yin/ don yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa rnams yin/ de kho na la mkhas pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'byung ba tshol ba la mkhas pa yin pa nas ji ltar na de kho na la mkhas pa'i bar du yin zhe na/ 'di la byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar dpyod de/ kye ma'o 'jig rten gnas pa 'di ni 'di lta ste / 'dod chags kyi mes kun tu 'bar ro/ /rab tu 'bar ro/ /kun tu rab tu mched da cing 'bar ro/ /kye ma'o 'jig rten gnas pa 'di ni 'di lta ste/zhe sdang gi du ba 'khrigs pa'i du ba 'tshubs ④pas rnam par rmongs na)so kye ma'o 'jig rten gnas pa 'di ni 'di lta ste/ gti mug gi mun pas mun nag tu gyur to snyam mo/ /de 'di ltar sems can 'di dag ji ltar 'byung bar 'gyur snyam sems te/ de de dag gi 'byung ba yongs su tshol zhing chos thams cad la rtog go/ /chos thams cad la rtog 6pas chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid khong du chud par 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid khong du chud pas chos 64—156

thams cad sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid du yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /chos rnams sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid du yang dag pa ji0)lta ba bzhin du shes pas chos thams cad yang dag pasko ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /chos thams cad yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su shes pas rten cing 'brelarang )par 'byung ba zab mo la rnam par sems so/ /de rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zab mo la rnam par sems pas las bsam gyis mi khyab pa la rnam par rtog ste/ de 'di snyam du dngos po med pa'i chos rnams la las sna tshogs byasnang ba ni ngo mtshar to snyam du sems so/ /de ltar demachi blo zhib mo dang ldan pas sangs rgyas rnams sam/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gsungs pa tsam gyis don shes so/ /des don shes pas don yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu rtogs so/ /don yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu rtogs pas de kho na mthong ngo / /de kho na mthong bas sems can rnams 'khor ba'i btson 6sgyur nas thar bar byed de kyi/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' 'byung ba tshol ba la mkhas pa nas/ de kho na la mkhas pa'i bar du yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' blo zhib pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rigs rinapa'i spobs pa can rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na / 'di lta ste/ chos thams cad bdag med par 'jog go/ /chos thams cad sems can med pa dang / srog med pa dang / gso ba med pa dang /gang zag med pa dang / byed pa po dang tshor ba po med pa dang / shes pa po dang mthong ba po med pa dang / gsog gsob ste dbang phyug med pa dang /stong pa yang dag pa ma yin pa las yongs su brtags 9pa dang / rkyen las byung 64—157

bar 'jog ste/ rigs kyi bu de la chos thams cad bdag med pa zhes bya btu'adi ni rigs pa'o/ /'di ni chos nyid dang 'thun②pa'o/ /chos thams cad sems can med pa srog med pa zhes bya ba 'di ni rigs pa'o/ /'di ni chos nyid dang 'thunamathu)pa'o/ /de bzhin du chos thams cad gso ba med pa dang / gang zag med pa dang / byed pa po dang / tshor ba po med pa dang / shes pa po dang mthong ba po med pa dang / gsog gsob ste dbang phyug med pa dang /stong pa yang dag pa ma yin pa las yongs su brtags pa dang / rkyen las byung ba'o zhes bya ba 'di ni rigs pa'o/ /'di ni chos nyid dang 'thun⑧pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gang chos nyid dang 'thun nyepa de ni rigs pa'o/ /gang chos nyid dang mi 'gal ba de ni rigs pa'o/ /gang chos nyid las mi 'khrul ba de ni rigs pa'o/ /gang chos nyid la 'babatso)pa de ni rigs pa'o/ /gang chos nyid ston pa de ni rigos pa'o/ /de yang de dag la〈spobs pas na de'i phyir rigs7par spobs pa rnams zhes hu3 bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag07dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rigs 3)pa'i spobs pa canam/3rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' grol ba'i spobs pa can rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ spobs pa thogs pa med pa rnams yin / spobs pa rgyun chags pa rnams yin/ spobs pa mi zad pa rnams yin/spobs pa mi brtabs 3 ripa rnams yin/ spobs pa ma zhum pa rnams yin/spobs pa mi skrag pa rnams yin/ spobs pa phal la med pa rnams yin/ spobs pa zil gyis ma non pa 8rnams yin/ spobs pa mtha' yas pa rnams yin/ so so yang dag par rig pa thob pa'i spobs pa can rnams yin te⑩/ rigs kyi bu 64—158

chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' grol ba'i spobs pa can rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dag pa'i spobs pa can rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/'dar 'dar po med pa'i spobs pa can rnams yin/ mi 'khrul pa'i spobs pa can rnams yin/ mi zhan7pa'i spobs pa can rnams yin/ yeng yeng po med pa'i spobs pa can rnams yinal/ de dag gi spobs pa don dang bral ba ma yin/tshig 'bru dang bral ba ma yin/ sbyor ba dang bral ba ma yin/ dus dang bral ba ma yin/ rtsub pa ma yin/ mi gsal ba'i spobs pa can ma yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spobs pa ni 'dar 'dar po ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'khor gyisa'ajigs pa'i bag tshasab dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyisaspobs pa ni 'khrul pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ blo brtan zhing mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spobs pa ni zhan pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jigs pa med pa'i phyir te/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' ni 'khor gyi nang du phyin na mi 'jigs mi skrag ste/ seng ge ltar 'jigs pa med cing mi skrag mi dngangs pasheyin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spobs pa ni yeng yeng po med pa yin no / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nyon mongs pasnyedang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa'i spobs pa ni yeng yeng por 'gyur ba yin te/nyon mongs pa med pa'i nishem yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spobs pa ni don dang bral ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos nyid thob pa'i phyir te/ rigs kyi bu chos nyid ma thob pa rnams kyi ni don dang bral bar 64—159

'gyur gyi/ chos nyid thob pa rnams kyi ni ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spobs pa ni tshig 'bru dang bral ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/gtsug lag thams cad la 'jigs pa med pa'i phyir te/ rigs kyi bu gtsug lag gi phyogs 'ga' shes pa rnams kyi ni tshig 'bru dang bral bar 'gyur0)gyi/ gtsug lag thams cad la 'jigs pa med pa rnams kyi ni lam yinasko —)no/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spobs pa ni sbyor ba dang bral ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sbyor ba thams cad yang dag par bsgrubs ④pa'i phyir te/ rigs kyi bu sbyor ba la mi mkhas pa rnams kyi ni sbyor ba dang bral bar 'gyur gyi/ sbyor ba mtha' yas pa dang ldan pa rnams kyi ni snim yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spobs pa ni gang phyis smra bar bya ba de sngar smra ba'am/ gang sngar smra bar bya ba de 6phyis smra ba lta bur dus dang bral ba ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni dus shes pa yin/ tshod shes pa yin/ skabs shes pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spobs pa ni rtsub pa/ yid du mi 7'ong ba/ mi snyan 8pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ngag gi gnas ngan len dang bral ba'i phyir te/ rigs kyi bu gnas ngan len dang bcas pa rnams kyi spobs pa ni rtsub pa yin gyi/ gnas ngan len dang bral ba rnams kyi ni ma yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spobs pa ni mi gsal ba ma yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dbang po rno ba'i phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu dbang po rtul po rnams kyi spobs pa ni 'o/mi gsal ba yin gyi/ dbang po rnon nya )po rnams kyi ni ma yin te/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnam par dag pa'i spobs pa can rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang 64—160

ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad mgu bar byed pa'i spobs pa can rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 3)'jam par smra ba rnams yin/ bzhin 'dzum zhing khro gnyer med pa rnams yin/ don du smra ba rnams yin/ chos su smra ba rnams yin/ mtshungs par smra ba rnams yin/ mi ngoms ②pa rnams yin/ brnyas pa dang bral ba rnams yin/ nyon mongs par 'gyur ba med pa rnams yin/ 'khrug pa med pa rnams yin/ spobs pa sna tshogs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' 'jam par smra ba ni / 'jam par smra bas sems can rnams mgu bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni bzhin 'dzum zhing khro gnyer med pa yin te/ mdangs bzang pos sems can rnams mgu bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' don du smra ba ni tshig ran pas sems can rnams mgu bar byed do / /byang chub sems dpa' chos su smra ba ni phan par smra bas sems can rnams mgu bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' mtshungs par smra ba ni sems can thams cad la mtshungs par bachos ston pas sems can rnams mgu bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' mi ngoms 5pa ni nga rgyal dang dregs pa dang rgyags pa dang bral zhing spyod pa mtshungs pas sems can rnams mgu bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' brnyas pa dang bral ba ni ri mor byas shing chos bstan pas sems can rnams mgu bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyon mongs par 'gyur ba med pa ni ngang tshul des pas sems can rnams mgu bar byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'khrug pa med pa ni bzod pa mang bas ⑥sems can rnams mgu bar byed do/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' spobs pa sna tshogs can ni dga' ba'i tshig gis sems can 64—161

rnams mgu bar byed do/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems can thams cad mgu bar byed pa'i spobs pa can rnams yin no / /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' tshig gzung7bar 'gyur bsnyernams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams snod du ma gyur pa'i sems can rnams la chos mi ston te③/zhe ④'gras pa rnams la ma yin/ klan ka tshol ba rnams la ma yin/ mu stegs can rnams la ma yin/ ri momasamed pa rnams la7ma yin/ ma dad pa mang bshernams la ma yin/ g.yo dang sgyus7glags pa rnams la ma yin/ 'tsho7ba'i bsam pa can rnams la ma yin/ rnyed pa dang / bkur ste dang / phrag dog dang ske/ ser snas glags pa rnams la ma yin/ sems can glen pa rmongs pa lug ltar lkugs51pa'i rang bzhin can rnams la chos mi ston te(rte/ rigs kyi bu derwa ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la chos kyi ser sna yang med/chos la slob dpon 'chab pa yang med sems can rnams la ri mor mi byed pa yang med / sems can gyi don la rgyab kyis 8phyogs pa yang med mod kyi/ sems can 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos 'dul ba'i snod du ma gyur pa'o zhes btang snyoms su gnas pa rnams yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas 7gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das 'o na sems can ci 'dra ba rnams la sangs rgyas rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos ston / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu sems can dad pa rnams la sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos ston to/ /sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba sminal pa rnams dang / snod du gyur pa rnams dang /64—162

sngon gyi rgyal ba la bya ba byas pa rnams dang / g.yo med pa rnams dang / sgyu med pa rnams dang / spyod lam mi 'chos pa rnams dang / rnyed pa dang /bkur sti la chags pa dang bral ba rnams dang / bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su zin pa rnams dang / tshul bzang po dang ldan pa rnams dang / legs par ston ①nus pa rnams dang /dbang po rno ba gang bshad pa'i don rig par 'gyur ba de thob par bya ba'i phyir/brtson 'grus brtsamasalgepar 'gyur ba de bzhin gshegs pas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin byed par 'gyur ba'i sems can de lta bu dag la rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos ston to/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' tshig gzung ①bar 'gyur ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' chos brjodar+sā)pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos yang dag par bsgrub pa'i phyir chos ston kyang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang /yang dag par bsgrub pa yang mi dmigs so/ /pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par bsgrub pa'i phyir chos ston kyang pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par bsgrub⑦pa yang mi dmigs so/ /byang chubasheyang dag par bsgrubalgepa'i phyir chos ston kyang byang chub yang dag par bsgrubalgepa yang mi dmigs so/ /ston mongs pa spang〈nyeba'i phyir chos ston kyang nyon mongs pa spang ba yang mi dmigs so/ /skyo ba dang 'dod chags dang bral ba dang 'gog pa'i phyir chos ston kyang skyo ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba dang / 'gog parwarteyang mi dmigs so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par bya 61—163

ba'i phyir chos ston kyang rgyun tu zhugs pa hu)yang mi dmigs sos/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba yang mi dmigs/ phyir 5kye'ong ba'i 'bras bu yang mi dmigs so/ /dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob par bya ba'i phyir chos ston kyang dgra bcom pa dang / dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu yang mi dmigs so/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu thob par bya ba'i phyir chos ston kyang rang sangs rgyas dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu yang mi dmigs so/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa la mngon par zhen pa 4srang ba'i phyir chos ston ri5kyang bdag tu 'dzin pa yang mi dmigs sol/ /las kyi yirnam par smin pa yang 'jog mod kyi las dang las kyi57rnam par smin pa yang mi dmigs so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag 'di snyam du sems te/chos gang ming gang gis brjod pa de ming des ri3yod pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos ni yi ge'i rang bzhin ma yin/ yi ge rnams ni chos kyi rang bzhin ma yin mod kyi/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa la brtenatshe/ tha snyad la brten /brtags 11pa la brten te/ ming med pa'i 32chos rnams la ming du 'jog ste/ming de yang gsog go/ /gsob bo/ /gang gsog dang gsob de〈snyel don dam pa med do/ /gang la don dam pa med pa de brdzun 3hete slu ba'i chos so/ /gang brdzun 1lhazhing slu ba'i chos de ni byis pa skye bo slu ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' chos brjod hu9pa rnams yin no// //'phags pa dkon mchog sprin zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo1 / bam po lnga pa/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos kyi rjes su yang 'brang la gzugs las kyang mi 64wa 164

'byung ske/ chos kyi rjes su'ang 'brang la tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed rnams dang / rnam par shes pa las kyang mi 'byung / chos kyi rjes su'ang 'brang la 'dod pa'i khams las kyang mi 'byung / chos kyi rjes su'ang 'brang la gzugs kyi khams las kyang mi 'byung / chos kyi rjes su'ang 'brang la gzugs med pa'i khams las kyang mi 'byung / chos kyi rjes su'ang 'brang la chos las kyang mi 'byung / chos kyi rjes su'ang 'brang la chos las0) 'da' b.ralayang mi 'byung ske/ chos kyi rjes su'ang 'brang la/ sems can gyi phyir yang mi 'brang /chos kyi rjes su'ang 'brang la chad par lta ba'i phyir yang mi 'brang / chos kyi rjes su'ang 'brang la lam las kyang mi 'byung ste/ de ni thabs mkhas pa dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyi phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings la mkhas pa rnams yin no / /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ shes rab can rnams yin/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung ba rnams yin/ brtson 'grus rgyabartsams pa rnams yin/ sgribasngo )pa thams cad dang bral ba rnams yin/ shin tu yongs su dag pa rnams yin/ gdams ngag la ri mo dang bcas pa rnams yin/ stong pa nyid la sgom pa mang ba rnams yin/ dmigs par lta ba dang bral ba rnams yin / lam du zhugs pa rnams yin/ de kho na mthong ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' shes rab dang ldan pa ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshol te/ des dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong nas dga' zhing rangs te/de la ston par 'du shes skyed cing de la brten te gnas so/ /de gedage ba'i 64—165

bshes gnyen la brten pas na mi dge ba'i chos thams cad spang ①ba dang /dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin no/ /brtson 'grus brtsams pas narnyusgrib pa thams cad nub par 'gyur rol/ /sgrib pa med cing lam gyi rgyun ma bcad pas shin tu yongs su dag cing lus dang ngag dang yid kyi gnas ngan len dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de shin tu yongs su dag pas gdams ngag la ri mo dang bcas pa7yin no/ /de gdams ngag la ri mo dang bcas pas stongamachenapa nyid la sgom pa mang ba yin no/ /stong pa nyid la sgom pa mang bas dmigs pa'i lta bar7mi 'gyur ro/ /de dmigs pa'i lta ba dang bral bas lam du 'jug go/ /de lam du zhugs pas de kho na mthong ngo //byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de kho na zhes bgyi ba de ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ de kho na zhes bya ba 'di ni yang dag pa'i don gyi tshig bla dgas so/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das yang dag pa zhes bgyi ba 'di ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu gang mi slu ba de ni yang dag pa'o/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mi slu ba zhes bgyi ba 'di ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ zode ni rjode bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pashede bzhin nyid do / /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin nyid7ces bgyi ba 'di ci lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/7) rigs kyi bu chos 'di ni so sorwa17rang gis rig pa yin te/ 'di ni yi ge dag gis gdams par mi nus sol/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos 'di ni yi ge thams cad las yang dag par 64wa 166

'das pa/ smra ba thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa/ tshig gi spyod yul thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa/ ngag gi lam thams cad las yang dag paratu'adas pa/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba blang ba dang dor ba thams cad dang bral ba/ phye ba dang / btsums pa thams cad dang bral ba/rtog ge thams cad dang bral ba/ brtag⑧par bya ba ma yin pag/ rtog ge'i spyod yul ma yin pa/ rtog ge'i spyod yul las yang dag par 'das pa/ mtshan ma med pa mtshan ma dang bral ba/ mtshan ma'i spyod yul lasasnyiyang dag par 'das pa/ byis pa'i spyod yul las yang dag par 'das pa/ bdudakyithams cad kyi〈yul las yang dag par 'das pa/ nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi spyod yul las yang dag par 'das pa/ rnam par shes pa'i spyod yul las yang dag par 'das pa/ gnas ma yin pa/ mi gnas pa/ zhi ba/ 'phags pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul te/ de dag nyid kyi so so rang gis rig pa/ dri ma med pa/ma gos pa dang / rnam par dag pa/ gya rnam pa/ mchog /dam pa/ phul/ rtag paX brtan pa/ ther zug /mi 'jig pa'i chos can te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung / ma byung yang rung ste/ chos kyi dbyings 'di ni 'dug pa kho na'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' dag chos nyid 'di thobasnyenas sems can5) dag kyang chos nyid 'di kho na la rab tu dgod do snyam ste/ don gang gi phyir 'bad cing rtsol ba dang // brtson 'grus rtsomasngortepa dang / dka' hunyeb brgya dag byed pa/ rigs kyi bu de ni de bzhin nyid ces bya'o / /yang dag pa'i mtha' zhes bya'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ces bya'o/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'ichadabyings 64wa 167

zhes bya'o/ /gnyis su med pa'i dbyings zhes bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas 47gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos 'di ji ltar mngon du bgyi/ ji ltar khong du chud par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab kyis mngon du bya'o / /rang gis rig par khong du chud par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas 3)gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang shes rab kyis mngon du bgyis pa de rang gis rig pa khong du chud pa nyid ma lags sam / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyis ni chos rnams yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du mthong ngo / /lus kyis ni mngon du byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu gang dag gis thos pa las byung ba'am/ bsam 3)pa las byung ba'i shes pas chos khong du chud par gyur pa de rang gis rig pa ma lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu ma yin te/ thos pa tsam 'amage bsams 8)pa tsam gyis ni rang gis rig pa'i chos khong du chud par mi nus so/ /rigs kyi bu de lta bas na dpe nyon cig /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na 'brog chen por rtsonadapyid kyi zla ba tha ma la/ mi la la zhig shar phyogs nas nub phyogs su 'gro lan)ske/ de nas mi gzhan zhig nub phyogs nas shar phyogs su 'ong stetshi/ de yang dpyid kyi tsha bas yongs su gdungs par 3 )gyur nas skom gyis nyen pa de shar phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i (1)mi de la 'di skad ces smras te12/ kye skyes bu kho bo dpyid kyi tsha bas yongs su gdungs te/ skom gyis nyen na/ gang na mtsho /rte64wa 168

'am / lteng ku'am/ rdzing gang chu bsil ba dang rnyog pa med pa/ gsal bas gang btuyod de/ gang du bdag tsha ba dang / skom pa rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ba'i lam bdag la ston cig ces zer 'kho/ shar phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i mi de yang lam shes pa/ lam mkhas pa/ lam mthong ba/ lam gyi mtshan ma mthong ba zhig yin te/ des de na chu'i nyes pa dang bral buba'i chu sngon chad mthong la/sngon myangs shing sngon yang zhugs pa yin te/ des mi de la 'di skad du kye༄)grogs po lam 'di nas lam kha brag mthong gi bar du song la/ kye skyes bu khyod kyis g.yon gyi lam 'or ༅te/ g.yas kyi lam nas nags tshal sngon po dang /nags tshal de'i dbus na mtsho ④'am/ lteng ku'am/ rdzing bu〈kyebasil zhing dang la rtog pa med pa gsal bas〈sheXgang ba mthong gi bar du song la/ der skyes bu khyod skom pa dang / tsha ba med par byos shig ces zer na/ rigs kyi bu de ji snyam du sems/ dpyid kyi tsha bas yongs su gdungs te/ sgom gyis nyen pa'i mi des chu thos ma thag dang / bsams mi )pa tsam gyis tsha ba med par 'gyur ram/skom pa dang yang bral bar 'gyur ram/ chu de'i bsil ba yang rang gis rig par 'gyur ram/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das mi de nam der phyin nas/ des chu der zhugs te 'tshal bar rtegyur pa de'i tshe/ mi de'i tsha ba de ma mchis par 'gyur ro/ /skom pa dang yang bral bar 8'gyur ro/ /des bsil ba yang rang gis rig par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin du rigs kyi bu thos pa tsam dang /bsams〈 pa tsam gyis rang gis rig pa'i chos khong du chud par mi nus so/ /de la rigs kyi bu 'brog ces bya ba de ni 'khor ba'i 'brog mug tshig bla dgas so/ /61—169

mi dpyid kyi tsha bas yongs su gdungs shing skomanyegyis nyen pa zhes bya ba gang yin pa de ni nyon mongs pa'i gdung bas yongs su gdungs shing yul gyi sred pas nyen pa'i sems can rnams kyi tshig bla dgas so/ /lam shes pa'i mi zhes bya ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam la mkhas pa/ chos myong ba chos rang gis rig pa rnams kyi tshig bla dgas so/ /chu bsil zhing dang la rnyog pa med pa gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don dam pa'i chos nyid kyi tshig bla dgas sol/ /yang rigs kyi bu dpe nyon cig /rigs kyi bu de ji snyam du sems/gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i⑧che'i tshad bskal par bzhugs te/ 'dzam bu'i⑧gling gi mi rnams kyi mdun du 'di lta ste/ lha'i bdud rtsi dri zhim pa dang /gtsang ba dang / gya rnam pa dang / shin tu zhim pa dang / reg na bde ba las brtsams te/ bsngags pa brjod na/ rigs kyi bu de ji snyam du sems/ ci sems can de dag gis lha'i bdud rtsi de'i bsngags pa rang gis rig par 'gyur ram / gsol pa bcom ldan 'das de byam lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de lta bas na khyod kyis rnam5gegangs 'dis ji ltar thos pa tsam 'am6)/ bsams pa tsam gyis rang gis rig ④pa'i chos khong du chud par mi nus par rig par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu yang dpe nyon cig /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na mi zhig gis shing thog gi rnam pa sngon sems can sus kyang ma myangs pa zhig myangasalgepar gyur la/ des mi gzhan zhig gi mdun du shing thogarwa1gi rnamatshwa pa de'i bsngags pa 'di lta ste/ kha dog phun sum tshogs pa dang / ro phun sum tshogs pa dang / dri zhim pa las brtsams te brjodamurten rigs kyi bu de ji snyam du sems/ ci mi des shing thog gi ro des rang 64—170

gis0)rig par 'gyur ram/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de lta bas na khyod kyis rnam grangs 'dis ji ltar thos pa tsam 'amakha/ bsams lapa tsam gyis so so rang gis rig pa'i chos khong du chud par mi nus par rig par bya'o/ /de nas53)byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das legs par gsungs so/ /bde bar gshegs pa shin tu legs par gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi tshul 'di su dag gi rnar thos par 'gyur ba'i rigs kyi bu de dag gis chos 'di khong du chud pa 55nyid du rig par bgyi'o / /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu de dag gis chos 'di thob par bgyi ba nel 'di nyid ma log pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te )rka/ rigs kyi bu de dag gis chos 'di thob par bya ba la 'di nyid ma 3)log pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings la mkhas pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' stong pa nyid kyi ri9)spyod yul pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ stobs kyi stong pa nyid kyang rab tu shes / mi 'jigs pa'i stong pa nyid kyang rab tu shes/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i stong pa nyid kyang rab tu shes/ tshul khrims kyi phung po'i stong pa nyid kyang rab tu shes/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po'i stong pa nyid kyang rab tu shes/shes rab kyi phung po'i stong pa nyid kyang rab tu shes/ rnam par grol ba'i phung po'i stong pa nyid kyang rab tu shes/ rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung 61—171

po'i stong pa nyid kyang rab tu shes/ stong pa'ishestong pa nyid kyang rab tu shes/don dam pa'i stong pa nyid kyang rab tu shes te/ de'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis stong pa nyid du dmigs pa dang / stong pa nyid du 'dzin pa dang / stong pa nyid du ②lta ba dang / stong pa nyid la gnas pa'ang mi dmigs/ de'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis med par yang mi ltung ngo / /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' stong pa nyid spyod yul pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' mtshan ma med pa la gnas pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ phyi rol gyi mtshan ma dang bral ba rnams yin/ nang gi mtshan ma dang bral ba rnams yin/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rnams yin/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba rnams yin/dmigs pa thams cad dang bral ba rnams yin/ g.yo ba thams cad dang bral ba rnams yin/ rgyu ba thams cad dang bral ba rnams yin/ dmigs par bya ba thams cad dang bral ba rnams yin/ rnam par shes pa mi dmigs pa rnams yin/rnam par shes par bya ba'i dngos po mi dmigs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' mtshan ma med pa la gnas pa rnams yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mtshan ma ma mchis pa la gnas pa'ang de 'dra na/de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ci 'dra du ribar blta bar ④bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu gnas 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab po/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ bsam pa'i yul dang bral ba'i phyir te/ rigs kyi 7bu de 64—172

bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid rjes su bsams0)na/ sems can thams cad myos〈(par 'gyur gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid kyi0)pha rol tam/ tshulgerol mthong bar mi 'gyur/ mi dmigs kyi/ tha mar na dub pa'i skalamachab can du7'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni zab cing gting dpag dka' la bsam gyis mi khyab pa ⑦dpag tu med pa/ (9rgya che ba nam mkha' dang 'dra ba/ rtog ge pa thams cad kyi yul las 'das pa/dmigs pa can thams cad kyi yul las 'das pa ste/ de ni brtag ⑨pa'am/bsam pa'am/ gzhal ba'am/ tshad gzung bar mi nus so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sol bas gsol pa/ ༵/ gal te zhus nas zhu ba lung bstanas(1pa'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na/bdag bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i hunyesangs rgyas la phyogs 'ga' the zhig zhu'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod la de bzhin gshegs 8pas rtag tu skabs phyes khyod dris shig /byang chub sems dpa' tsho/)sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/ bdag bstod pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyis skyes bu dam pa ma 7lags pa'i chos su gsung na/ de ji ltar chos kyi rje bcom ldan 'das nyid bdag la bstod pa mdzadahu tsho/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal panyu)/ rigs kyi bu legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis the/dri ba tshul bzhin du dris so/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir legs par shin tu nyon du )la yid la zung shig du medang / ngas khyod la bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bdage/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sa ltar nyan pa dang /64wa 173

bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal tonyu/ /rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can 'di dag la ci nas kyang phan 3)pa dang / bde ba dang /chos nyid thob par bya ba'i phyir bdag bstod ྅pa ma gtogs par nga rgyal gyi zil gyis canon pa dang / rnyed pa'i zil gyis non pa dang / bkur sti'i zil gyis non pa dang / grags pa 'dod pa dang / shes kyi khe ciga'adod pa'i phyir tshul 'chos pa'am/ kha gsag byed cing yang dag pa ma yin par bdag bstod pa ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa la dga' ba dang / dad pa dang / rangs pa nye bar gzhag pas chos bstan pa'i skal ba yod par 'gyur/ dge ba'i chos rnams kyi snod du 'gyur te/ de yang de dag la yun ring por don dang / phan pa dang / bde bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags/ sems can de dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu masatho'atshal tam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu mi shes so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di'i sems can rnams ni rgya chung ngu nyal mos pa/ dman tshegs la mos pa/ shes rab chung ba/ dad pa chung ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ngus brtan 8pa dag ste/ de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi che ba mi shes pas de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa bdag nyid bdag gi yon tan gyi bsngags pa brjod pa mdzad de9/ de'ang nan tan gyis sgrub bo/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na sman pa mkhas pa zhig yod la/sems can rnams kyang nad kyis nyen par gyur/ sa'i phyogs de na nya 'ang sman pa gcig pur zad de gnyis su med la11/ de'i yon tan gyi che ba sus kyang mi shes 64wa 174

pa dang / de nas sman pa de 'di snyam du sems te/ kye ma'o sems can 'di dag ni sdug bsngal ba/ nad kyis nyen pa/ sman la mi mkhas pa/ gnod pa la sten pa yin gyis1)/ bdag gis de dag gso bar bya'o snyam nas/ sman pa des sems can de dag gi mdun du kye sems can dag bdag0)ni sman pa ste/ nad la mkhas pa'o nad kyi gzhi la mkhas pa'o/ /sman la mkhas pa'o zhes bdag gi yon tan gyi bsngags52)pa bdag nyid kyis brjod pa dang / sems can de dag 'di ni sman pa'o zhes bya bar geshes shing yid ches par gyur nas sman pa de la rten tol/ /de nas sman pa des5gesems can de dag gso zhing nad de77zhi bar byed na/rigs kyi bu de ji snyam du sems/ sman pa de bdag la bstodam475par 'gyur ram/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa yang sman pa'i rgyal po chen po bla na med pa ste/ nyon mongs pa'i nad la mkhas pa/ nyon mongs pa'i nad kyi gzhi la mkhas pa/ nyon mongs pa'i nad gso ba la mkhas pa/ chos kyi sman chen po stobs 2)pa yin yang / nyon mongs pa'i nad kyis nad par gyur pa'i sems can rnams kyis mi nyushes te/ nyon mongs pa'i nad kyis nad par gyur pa'i sems can rnams gzigs nas/ de dag gi mdun du bdag gi yon tan dang /bsngags pa bdag 1 )nyid brjod de/ de nas nyon mongs pa'i nad kyis nad par gyur pa'i sems can de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi bsngags pa'i che ba thos /snronas/ yid ches par gyur pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la rten nyu to/ /de nas de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa nyunyesman gyi rgyal po chen po chos kyi sman de dag gis nyon mongs pa'i nad rab tu gezhi bar mdzad dem/ chos kyi 64—175

sman chen po de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi sdug pa dang / byams pa dang ske/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba la sogs pa ste/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa ni don gyi dbang 'di gzigs nas/ bdag la bdag nyid bstod pa mdzad do/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rnams smon lam thams cad la gnas pa dang bral ba yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa la smon kyang sbyin pa la mi gnas pa rnams yin/ de bzhin du tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang /shes rab dang / khams gsum pa dang / byang chub dang / lam dang / mya ngan las 'das pa la smon kyang mya ngan las 'das pa la mi gnas pa rnams yin tenya)ske/ rigs kyi bu de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni gnas pa thams cad dang bral ba ste/ mi gnas par 'jig rten thams cad du rnam par spyod do/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan natsobyang chub sems dpa' smon lam thams cad la gnas pa dang bral ba rnams ④yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa'asabyams pa'i bdag nyid can rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ nyi tse seb med pa'i byams pa dang ldan pa rnams yin/ tha dad pa med pa'i byams pa dang ldan pa rnams yin/chos kyi byams pa dang ldan pa rnams yin/ nges par rtogs pa'i byams pa dang ldan pa rnams yin/ gnod pa med pa'i byams pa dang ldan pa rnams yin/phan pa'i byams pa dang ldan pa rnams yin/ sems can thams cad la snyoms pa'i byams pa dang ldan pa rnams yin/ gnod sems med pa'i byams pa dang ldan pa rnams yin/ phyogs bcu kun tu khyab pa'i byams pa dang ldan pa rnams 61—176

yin / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i byams pa dang ldan pa rnams yin te0)/rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' byams pa'i bdag nyid can rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' snying rje'i bdag nyid can rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can sdug bsngal ba dang / skyabs med pa dang / mgon med pa dang ske/ rten med pa dang / dpung gnyen med pa dag mthong na/ byang chub tu sems bskyed mido/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ chos nyid thob par bya ba'i phyir 'bad cing rtsol/ brtson 'grus rtsom ste/ dka' bar spyod pa brgya dag kyang byed do/ /de dag chos thobarkunas sems can rnams la phan par byed derngo / 'di lta ste/ sems can ser sna can rnams sbyin pa la gzhog par byed/tshul khrims ngan pa can rnams zhu)tshul khrims la/ gnod sems can rnams bzod pa la/ le lo can rnams brtson 'grus la/ sems 'khrugs pa rnams bsam gtan la/ sems can shes rab 'chal pa rnams mthong nas shes rab la gzhog par byed kyang zhi / sems can gyi sdug bsngal mi bzad pa/ rtsub pa/tsha ba dag gis nyen kyang byang chub la dusaphyir ldog par mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' snying rje'i bdag nyid can rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu medang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba la gnas pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bdag ni 'khor ba'i btson 1 byer rab tu 'bar ba nas byung ba'o〈skyezhes rab tu dga' ba skyed7do/ /bdag gis 'khor ba'i dpyang thag yun ring po nas thogs pa chad do zhes dga' ba skyed do/ /bdag ni rnam par rtog pa sna tshogs mang po'i chu srin 61—177

gyis dkrugs pa'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las rgal to ①zhes rab tu dga' ba skyedakyido / /bdag gis yun ring po nas bsgreng ba'isang rgyal gyi rgyal mtshan bsnyal lo zhes rab tu dga' ba skyed gedo/ /bdag gis nyon mongs pa'i ri rnams ye shes kyi rdo rjes bcom ste/ ji ltar rdul kyang mi snang ba de ltar bcom mo zhes rab tu dga' ba skyed gdo/ /bdag nyid ni dbugs phyin pa yin gyis(5)/ da ni gzhan yang dbugs dbyung rimabar bya'o zhes rab tu dga' ba skyed 48)do/ /bdag nyid ni 'jig rten gnas pa/ yun ring po nas gnyid la sred 9pa'i snyoms pas nyu sduyongs su zin pa/ 11gti mug gis bsgribs pa'i nang nas sad pa yin gyis(rte/da ni gzhan yang rnam par 1lhasad par bya'o zhes rab tu dga' ba skyedapha do/ /bdag nyid ni ngan 'gro dang / ngan song dang / log par 7ltung ba thams cad las rnam par grol ba yin gyisas/ da ni gzhan yang ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang ske/ log par ltung ba thams cad las rnam par grol bar bya'o zhes rab tu dga' ba skyed 1 rmedo/ /bdag 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon par yun ring po nas 'khyams te/ grogs med cing gnyis su med par gar (1sheyang 'khyam zhing 37lam la mi mkhas la/ lam mi shes shing yul mi shes pas lam stor ba rnyed pa tshodo zhes rab tu dga' ba skyed 21do/ /bdag ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi grong khyer dang nye bar gyur to zhes rab tu dga' ba skyed na do/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' dga' ba la gnas pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' btang snyoms la gnas pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mig gis nu rnam par shes par bya ba'i gzugs rnams la btang snyoms su gnas pa rnams yin te/ mig 64wa 178

gis rnam par shes par bya ba'i gzugs rnams kyis smas ①par mi 'gyur/gnod par mi 'gyur/ rma byungapo/bar mi 'gyur ba rnamasasnyedang / de bzhin du rna bas rnam par shes par bya ba'i sgra rnams dang / snas rnam par shes par bya ba'i dri rnams dang / lces rnam par shes par bya ba'i ro rnams dang / lus kyis rnam par shes par bya ba'i reg bya rnams dang / yid kyis rnam par shes par bya ba'i chos rnams la btang snyoms su gnas pa rnams yin te/ yid kyis rnam par shes par bya ba'i chos rnams kyis smas gepar mi 'gyur/ gnod par mi 'gyur / rma byung sribar mi 'gyur ro/ /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal la btang snyoms su gnas pa rnams 6)yin te/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal mudang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang ske/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyis smas rin par mi 'gyur/ gnod par mi 'gyur / rma byung thobar mi 'gyur ro/ /bya ba byas pa'i sems can rnams la btang snyoms su gnas pa rnams yin te/ de dag la dga' ba dang / dad pa dang ske/ rangs pa skyed 12cing de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ gang bdag gis bsgral bar bya ba de dag nyid rgal bar gyur to zhes btang snyoms su gnas pa (1 rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' btang snyoms la gnas pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' mngon par shes pas rnam par rol pa rnams yin rnam/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ shi 'pho ba'ang ston/ skye sna ba'ang ston/btsas pa dang / byis pa'i spyod pa dang / slas kyi nang na rtse 1 ba'ang ston/mngon par 'byung ba'ang ston/ dka' ba spyod pa'ang ston/ byang chub kyi snying 64—179

por 'gro ba'ang ston/ bdud 'dul ba'ang ston/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'ang ston/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'ang ston/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'ang ston to①/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa'alasgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bsala'adi skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci'i rgyu ci'i rkyen gyis byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi pho brang dam pa nas shi 'pho ston pa nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i bar du ston pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dga' ldan gyi pho brang dam pa na50sems can gang dag rtag par 'du shes pa yod pa gede dag gis/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten thams cad las7khyad zhugs pa/ 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa/ 'jig rten kun gyi phul du byung ba/ mi mnyam ⑦pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams kyis ma gos ma chags pa shi 'pho bar mthong na/ rtag pa'i⑧'du shes ldog cing mi rtag pa'i 'du shes phyi)'byung ste/ mi rtag pa'i 'du shes la gnas pas bag yod pa la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dga' ldan gyi pho brang dam pa na sems can gang dag bag med par spyod pa yod pa0 )de dag byang chub sems dpa' la dga' ba yod/ dad pa yod rangs pa yod kyang yul la mngon par zhen pas byang chub sems dpa'i drung du mi 'dong / mi rten bsnyen bkur mi byed cing / de dag la 'di snyam du sems te/ byang chub sems dpa' yang bzhugs la/ bdag cag nyushākyang 'khod de/ dus kyang ring du yod kyis labs kyis〈ge 'dong b.rachabya'o snyam du sems pa de dag gi bag med pa bzlog pa'i tsophyir byang chub sems dpa' shi 'pho ston te/ de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' shi 'pho mthong nas 61—180

skyo ba la gnas par 'gyur zhing / de dag skyo bar gyur nas bag med pa mi byed de / bag yod pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu sems can gang dag skye bas 'dul ba yod pa de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' ma'i mngal na 'dug pa de dag gi mthu mthong na ngo mtshar rmad du byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag ci nas kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ba de lta de ltar byang chub sems dpa' ma'i mngal na 'dug bzhin du chos ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sems can gang dag byang chub sems dpa' btsas pa ①dang / byis pa'i spyod pa dang /slas kyi nang na 'dug pas yongs su smin par bya ba yod pa de dag yongs su smin par bya ba dang / dman pa la mos pa'i sems can rnams bsrung ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' btsas padzagedang / byis pa'i spyod pa dang / slas kyi nang na 'dug pa ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sems can gang dag byang chub sems dpa' mngon par 'byung ba dang / rab tu 'byung bas yongs su smin par bya ba yod pa de dag yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' mngon par 'byung ba ston cing rab tu 'byung ngo / /rigs kyi bu sems can gang dag lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin la sogs pa spyod pa dman pa la mos pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dka' ba'i spyod pas yongs su smin par bya ba yod pa/ de dag yongs su smin par bya ba dang / mu stegs can gzhan tshar gcad5)pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' dka' ba spyod pa ston to/ /rigs kyi bu sems can gang dag gis yun ring po nas bdag cag gis byang chub sems dpa' babyang chub kyi snying por ge'agro ba'i tshe mchod pa'i las la brtson par 61—181

bya'o zhes smon lam btab pa yod pa de dag la byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba ston la/ de dag kyang shibyang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba la so so'i tshul bzhin du mchod pa byed de/ de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa byas pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu sems can gang dag nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang /dregs pas rlom lde)pa yod de/ de dag de milas bzlog pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug cing bdud 'dul ba ston to/ /sems can gang zhi ba la gnas pa de dag de las gong du khyad par thob par bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba ston te/ gang gis0tshe byang chub sems dpa' mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba de'i tshe/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sgra sna tshogs dang / ca co sna tshogs gang zhu yod pa de dag thams cad med cing stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyang zhi bar 'gyur te/ de dag gis mthu de mthong na/ bdag cag kyang de ltar byang chub kyi snying po la 'khod de/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya b.ra'65bya'o zhes smon lam 'debs so/ /rigs kyi bu sems can gang ston par bkur ba dang / ston par dam bca' lasho ride dag gis 'byung ba dang / phyi ma'ipo/chos mngon par rdzogs par sangs mdza9byergyas pa yod pa de dag tshar gcad nya tshopa dang / sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin cing snod du gyur pa rnams la lam bstan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa ka shi'i grong rdal du song 37nas chos kyi 'khor lo lan gsum rnam pa bcu gnyis su bskor ro/ /rigs kyi bu 64—182

sems can gang dag yongs su mya ngan las 'das pas 'dul ba yod pa de dag 'dul ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa tsho1ston te/rigs kyi bu 'di ni rgyu 'di ni rkyen te/ des byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi pho brang dam pa nas shi 'phongo ston cing yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i bar du ston to/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' mngon par shes pas rnam par rol pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' mi khom pa brgyad rnam par spangs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ mi dge ba'i chos las phyir ldog ge pa rnams yin/ de bzhin gshegs pas bslab pa bcas pa las mi 'da' ba snyernams yin/ ser sna dang bral ba rnams yin/ sngon gyi rgyal ba la bya ba byas pa rnams yin/ bsod nams bya ba la brtson nepa rnams yin/ shes rab phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ rimathabs la mkhas pa rnams yin/ smon lam phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ skyo ba mang ba rnams yin/ brtson 'grus brtsamasamadu)pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' ni mi dge ba'i las mngon par 'du bya ba gang gis sems can dmyal ba dag tu skye zhing de dag tu skyes nas kyang tshor ba mi bzad 9 pa/ rtsub pa/ tsha ba yid du mi 'ong ba myong bar 'gyur ba'am/ yun ring por gnas par 'gyur ba'am/ sems can dmyal ba 1 pa'i sems can de dag la gnod pa'i sems skyed 11par 'gyur ba de lta bur mi 'gyur gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' ni rang bzhin gyis dge ba bcu'i las kyi 12lam dang ldan pa yin te/ de ltar na de ni sems can dmyal bar skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' ni de bzhin gshegs 64—183

pas bslab pa bcas pa las 'da' ba gang gis byol song gi nang du skye bar 'gyur ba'am / de dag tu skyes nas kyang byol song gi sdug bsngal mi bzadashepa myong bar 'gyur ba med do/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' ni gangs②ser snar 'gyur ba'i rgyu de dang / rkyen de dang / gzhi des yi dgas kyi nang du skye zhing de dag tu skyes nas kyang yi dgas kyi sdug bsngal mi bzad pa rtsub pasamyong bar 'gyur ba med blo/ /byang chub sems dpa'acha)ni gang du skyes pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'grogs pa 'thob 0pa'i rkyen dang bral bar 'gyur ba'i log par lta ba'i rigs su mi skye'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams nimo sngon spyad pa ste/ sngon gyi rgyal ba la bya ba byas pa yin pas de dag yang dag par lta ba'i rigs su skye ba yin te/ de dag tu skyes nas kyang rkyen phun sum tshogs par 'gyur zhing rkyen de dag de bas kyang 'phel ba dang / rgyas pa dang ske/ yangs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' ni dbang po ma tshang ba'i rnam pa gang gis sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi snod du mi rung bar 'gyur bar dbang po dang mi ldan par 'gyur ba ma yin gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' ni bsod nams bya ba la brtson zhing bsod nams kyis brtan pa yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten nam/ chos sam/ dge 'dun la bya ba gang byas shing /bsnyen pa dang / bsten pa dang / bsgoms pa dang / mang du byas pas dbang po phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba'i bya ba de 87dang de dag byed cing / dbang po phun sum tshogs pas sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi snod du 'gyur ba yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni mtha' 'khob kyi yul gang na sems can blun pa/rmongs pa/ lug ltar lkugs pa'i ngang tshul can/ skal bas9)med pa/ legs 64—184

par bshad pa dang nyes par bshad pa'i don shes par bya ba'i mthu med pa/sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyishesnod du ma gyur pa/ mar mi shes pa/ phar mi shes pa/ dge sbyong du mi 'dzin pa②/ bram zer mi 'dzin⑧pa dag gi nang du mi skye'i / byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni dbus kyi yul gang na sems can dbang po rno ba/ dbang po gsal ba/ mkhas pa/ mkhas par bkur ba/skal ba yod pa/ legs par bshad pa dang / nyes par bshad pa'i don yongs su shes par bya ba'isnyimathu yod cing / sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi snod du gyur pa / phar shes pa/ mar shes pa/ dge sbyong du 'dzin pa/ bram zer 'dzin pa dag gi nang du skye'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sngon gyi shes rab dang /ye shes kyi stobs kyi mthu dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni gang na gnas pas sangs rgyas skyes pa du ma 'bras bu med par 'gyur ba dang /sems can gyi don 'grib par 'gyur ba/ lha tshe ring po'i nang du mi skye'i/byang chub sems dpa' rnams ④ni 'dod pa'i khams nyid du gang na sems can gdul bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas skyes pa mnyes par byar yod par skye'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni thabs mkhas pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'atsha'urnams ni gang na sangs rgyas mi bzhugs ④pa dang / chos mi thos pa dang /dge 'dun la ⑧bsnyen bkur byar med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong pa dag tu mi skye'il / byang chub sems dpa' rnams nyuste ni dkon mchog gsum (tshephun sum tshogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag tu skye'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sngon gyi smon lam phun sum tshogs pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni gnas de lta bu dag thos kyang skyo ba mi mnga' ba dang / dmu rgod kyi ngang tshul can ma 61—185

yin gyi/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni gnas de lta bu dag thos ma thag tu skyo bar 'gyur te/ skyo bar gyur 1tshonas mi dge ba'i chos 'di dag spang ba'i phyir dge ba'i chos rnams la brtson 'grus brtsams pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' mi khom pa brgyad rnam par spangs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi sems ma stor ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste / g.yo dang sgyu med de drang zhing gya gyu 2med la sems dang ba rnams yin/sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams dang de 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams la yid gnyis dang /rnam nur dang / the tsom 3med pa rnams yin/ chos la slob dpon 'chab pa dang bral ba rnams yin/ chos kyi ser sna dang bral ba rnams yin/ chos kyis phongs 4par 'gyur ba'i las kyi mtha' dang bral ba rnams yin/ ji skad du smras pa de ltar byed de mi slu ba rnams yin/ theg pa chen po yongs su 'dzin pa rnams yin / de yongs su 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams la chos mtshungs pa'i 'du shes kyis zhe sa dang bcas ri mo dang bcas pa rnams yin/ theg pa chen po la gzhol/theg pa chen po la 'babar/ theg pa chen po la bab pa rnams yin/ chos smra ba'i gang zag rnams la ston par 'du shes pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'du shes skyed pa rnams yin te6/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' byang chub kyi sems ma stor ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' tshe rabs dran pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa rnams yin / dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa rnams yin/ tshul khrims yongs su 64wa 186

dag pa rnams yin/ 'gyod pa med pa rnams yin/ sgrib pa med pa rnams yin/dga' ba mang ba rnams yin/ sgom pa mang ba rnams yin/ sems mnyam par gzhag pa rnams yin/ rdzus te skye ba rnams yin/ rnam par shes pa ma rmongs pa rnams yin te/ rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni dam pa'i chos la rim gromanyayod cing bkur dubaste yod pa yin / dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams la rim gro yod cing bkur ste yod pa yin te/ des de'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis lus dang / srog la mi lta bar dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin cing 'chang ngo / /klog go/ /kun chub par byed do/ /gzhan la yang rgya cher ston to/ /de dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa la brtson pas 'di lta ste/ lus dang / ngag dang / sems kyi tshul khrims rnam pa gsum gyis tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yin/ tshul khrims yongs su dag pas ④'gyod pa med pa yin te/ de yang rim gro med pa ma geyin gyi/tshul khrims yongs su dag pa'i zhephyir 'gyod pa med pas sgrib pa med pa yin④/sgrib pa med pas dga' ba mang ba geyin/ dga' ba mang bas 7sgom pa mang ba yin / sgom pa mang bas sems mnyam par gzhag par 'gyur ro/ /sems mnyam par gzhag pas 'gro ba yongs su dag par 'gyur/ 'gro ba yongs su dag pas rdzus te skye bar 'gyur/ rdzus te skyes pas rnam par shes pa ma rmongs pa yin no / /rnam par shes pa ma rmongs pa'i phyir tshe rabs dran pa yin te tshe rabs gcig kyang rjes su dran no/ /gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang ske/ bcu dang / nyi shu dang / sum cu lha byedang / bzhi bcu dang / lnga bcu nas tshe rabs brgya stong du ma'i bar du rjes su dran no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu 61—187

po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' tshe rabs rjes su dran pa rnams yin nol/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang ma bral ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas mthong ba dang / thos pa dang / dran pa dang ma bral ba rnams yin/chos mnyan0)pa dang ma bral ba rnams yin/ dge 'dun mchod cing bsnyenashebakur ba bdang ma bral ba rnams yin/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gus par smra ba gyedang / phyag 'tshal ba dang / ldang ba dang / thal mo sbyar ba dang / gdud pa'isnyilas dang ma bral ba rnams yin/ mang du thos pa'i gang zag chos smra ba rnams dang ma bral ba rnams yin/ pha rol tu phyin pa mnyan pa dang ma bral ba rnams yin/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos mnyan pa dang ma bral ba rnams yin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum mnyan pa dang ma bral ba rnams yin/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi mnyan pa dang ma bral ba rnams yin/thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mnyan pa dang ma bral ba rnams yin tekhya/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang ma bral ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sdig pa'i grogs po yongs su spangs pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ tshul khrims nyams pa'i gang zag rnam par spangs pas sdig pa'i grogs po yongs su spangs par rig par bya'o/ /lta ba nyams pa'i gang zag rnam par spangs pa dang / cho ga nyams pa'i gang zag rnam par spangs pa dang /'tsho ba nyams pa'i gang zag rnam par spangs pa dang / 'du 'dzi la dga' ba'i gang zag rnam par spangs pa dang / le lo can gyi gang zag rnam par spangs pa 64—188

dang ske/ 'khor ba la dga' ba'i gang zag rnam par spangs pa dang / byang chub la rgyab kyis7phyogs pa'i gang zag rnam par spangs pa dang / khyim pa dang sten pa rnam par spangs pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad rnam par spangs pas na sdig pa'i grogs po rnam par spangs par rig par bya ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' des gnas 'di dag rnam par spong ba'i tshe/ gang zag de dag la zhe sdang ba'i sems bskyed par mi bya'o/ /khong khro ba'i sems dang / brnyas pa'i sems bskyed par mi bya'i/ des 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang sems can rnams ni khams so sor bsten te/ bsten⑧par gyur nas chud za bar 'gyur ro zhes bka' stsal gyis / de bas na bdag gis bsten pa yongs su spang bar sems nye bar gzhag par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sdig pa'i grogs po yongs su spangs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i chos nyid thob pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste / lus mnyam pa rnams yin/ lus yongs su dag pa rnams yin/ lus rma med pa rnams yin/ lus legs par grub pa rnams yin/ chos kyi lus rnams yin / lus brtag par bya ba ma yin zhing gting dpag dka' ba rnams yin/lus bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams yin/ lus zhi ba rnams yin/ lus nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa rnams yin/ ye shes kyi lus dang ldan pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i chos nyid 'thob par 'gyur r+ha/ /byang chub sems dpa'asnyesgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gang dang 64—189

gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i chos nyid 'thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu sa dang po la byang chub sems dpa' lus mnyam pa nyid thob bo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / lus mi mnyam 15pa thams cad dang bral ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /sa gnyis pa la byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims yongs su dag pa'i phyir lus yongs su dag pa 'thob bo/ /sa gsum pa la byang chub sems dpa' khong khro ba dang / gnod sems thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir lus rma ri med pa 'thob bo/ /sa bzhi pa la byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su grub pa'i phyir lus legs par grub pa 'thob chod bo/ /sa lnga pa la byang chub sems dpa' chos thams cad rab tu rtogs pa'i phyir chos kyi lus 'thob bo/ /sa drug pa la brtag ④par bya ba ma yin zhing gting dpag dka' ba'i chos yongs su grub pa'i phyir lus brtag par bya ba ma yin zhing gting dpag dka' ba 'thob bo/ /sa bdun pa la sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su grub pa dang / thabs mkhas pa yang dag par grub pa'i phyir lus bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'thob bo/ /sa brgyad pa la spros pa thams cad bral ba dang ske/ nyon mongs pa med pa'i phyir lus zhi ba 'thob bo/ /sa dgu pa la lus tshad med pas khyab pa'i phyir lus nam mkha'apo)dang mtshungs pa 'thob bo sa bcu pa la byang chub sems dpa' ye shes kyi lus 'thob bo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/shes par bya ba thams cad yang dag par grubartso6)pa'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ci lags / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i chos nyid dang / byang chub sems dpa'i〈pe64—190

lus kyi chos nyid la7tha dad du bgyi ba mchis sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu lus tha dad pas7tha dad du bya ba med de/ yon tan gyi mthus ni tha dad du bya ba yod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar lus tha dad pasaphutha dad du bgyi ba ma mchis la/ yon tan gyi mthus tha dad du bgyi ba mchis pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu lus lus zhes bya ba 'di ni tha dad pa med pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ lus su brjod pa'i mtshan nyid gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /yon tan dang mthu'i mtshan nyid ni tha dad par blta'o④/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam lapar sel bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar gang lta bur yon tan gyi mthu'i mtshan nyid tha dad du blta 6bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/rigs kyi bu de bas na don gyi dbang 'di nyid khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir khyod la dper bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na byi dor ma byas pa'i nor bu rin po che dang / byi dor byas pa'i nor bu rin po che ni 'di lta ste/ nor bu rin po che nor bu rin po che zhes bya bar nor bu rin po che zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro mod kyi/ ji ltar byi rirje)dor byas pa'i nor bu rin po che'i mthu dang / yid du 'ong bas khyab 3)par byed pa de ltar ni byi dor ma byas pas ma yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i lus nor bu rin po che yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i nor bu rin po che dang bcas su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i chos nyid kyi grangs su 'gro mod kyi/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus57nor bu rin po che ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i nor bu rin po che'i drung du yongs su dag pa zhes mi 64—191

brjod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i7nor bu rin po che ni sems can gyi khams tshad med pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings tshad med pa'i rina'od kyis khyab par byas te gnas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni shin tu yongs su dag pa dang / dri ma thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir te/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus nor bu rin po che ni de tsam du khyab par byed pa sem yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ④ltar dri ma'i lhag ma lasamasnipa'i phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na tshesalgeganyis kyi zla ba ni zla ba zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro ba nas/ zla ba nya ba'i bar gyis7)zla ba yang zla ba zhes7bya ba'i grangs su 'gro mod kyi/ tshes gnyis kyi zla ba ci 'dra ba de lta bur zla ba nya bshem yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chos nyid thob pa'i phyir te/rigs kyi bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i skur bcas te lus kyi grangs su 'gro mod kyi/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i drung na lam mer mi 'gyur/ lhan der mi 'gyur/lhang nger mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na/ zla ba nya ba'i drung na tshes gnyis kyi zla ba ji lta ba de 17bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang /byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyang lus su brjod pa'i mtshan nyid kyis mtshan nyid gcig mod kyi/ yon tan gyi mthu'i mtshan nyid kyis ni ma yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' lus rdo rje ltar sra ba rnams yin no / /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug dag gis mi tshugs 32pa rnams yin/ khro ba dang / gnod sems kyi tha ba dang ske/ dri ma dang / nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang / dregs pa dang / lta 64—192

ba phyin ci log dag gis mi tshugs pa rnams yin/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad po de dag gis mi tshugs pa rnams yin/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal7thams cad kyis du mi tshugs pa rnams yin/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal dag gis mi tshugs pa rnams yin / skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang /ge 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dag gis mi tshugs pa rnams yin/ mu stegs can dang pha rol rgol bas thams cad kyis ⑤mi tshugs pa rnams yin/ bdud thams cad dang bdud kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa rnams yin/ nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa rnams yin/ 'dod pa la spyod pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa rnams yin te④/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de medag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' lus rdo rje ltar sra ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' ded dpon chen po rnams yin te / bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bkur ba rnams yin/ mchod par 'os pa rnams yin/ phyin par byed pa5nyernams yin/ brtanam7par bya ba rnams yin/nye bar 'tsho bar bya bas rnams yin/ rgyags 31shin tu phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin / tshogs shin tu bsags pa rnams yin/ mi ngoms pa rnams yin/ thog mar 'gro ba7)rnams yin/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi grong khyer chen por phyin par bya ba la mkhas pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bkur ba yin pa nas ji ltar na thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong khyer chen por phyin par bya ba la mkhas pa'i bar du yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na ded dpon chen po ni rgyal po dang / rgyal po chen po'i blon po dag gis bkur ba yin no/ — /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ded dpon 64—193

chen po yang sangs rgyas rnams dang / sangs rgyas kyi nyan thos rnams kyis bkur ba yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste dper na/ ded dpon chen po ni bram ze dang glu/ rgyal rigs dang / grong ba dang / yul gyi mi rnams kyis mchod par 'os pa rnams yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ded dpon chen po yang slob pa dang / mi slob pa dang / gzhan yang lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dag gis mchod par 'os pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na ded dpon chen po ni 'brog dgon par lam grogs kyi tshogs 'chan pas gtses 17pa dag legs par bde zhing yongs su mi skyo bar phyin par byed pa yin te/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ded dpon chen po yang 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa chen po'i nang nasari sems can lam grogs kyi tshogs nyon mongs pa'i 'chan pas te zhigatses pa dag nyelegs par bde zhing yongs su mi skyo bar phyin par byed pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na ded dpon chen po la brten na/ sdug bsngal ba dang / phongs pa dag 'brog dgon pa nas 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ded dpon chen po la brten na mu stegs can gzhan spyod pa can dang / kun tu rgyu dang ske/ gcer bu ba rnams 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa chen po nas 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na ded dpon chen po ni rgyal po dang ske/ las byed pa'i mi dang / zho shas 'tsho ba dang /da de ma yin pa'i sems can gzhan rnams nye bar 'tsho ba yin te/ de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i 6)ded dpon chen po yang 'khor ba la mngon par dga' ba'i se mas can 64wa 194

rnams nye bar 'tsho ba yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na ded dpon chen po ni nam phyogs su 'gro bar hu)chas te lam grogs mang po dang lhan cig tu grong khyer chen por phyin ( par bya ba'i phyir 'brog dgon par zhugs pa de'i tshe/grong khyer chen por phyin gyi bar du rgyagasalaphun sum tshogs pas 'brog dgon pa de nas legs par bde zhing yongs su skyo ba med par 'byung bar byed do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ded dpon chen po yang nam sangs rgyas kyis bsten snyipa'i phyogs su 'gro bar 'dod cing sems can lam grogs mang po dang 6)de 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa chen por 'jug par 'dod la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi grong khyer chen por phyin par bya bar 'dod pa de'i tshe bsod nams kyi rgyags thodakyi tshogs shin tu phun sum tshogs pas 'gro'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/dper na ded dpon chen po ni 'tsho ba'i yo byad 'di lta ste/ gser dang /nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai drur+ya ri dang / dung dang / man shel dang /byi(ru la sogs pa mang po bsags 0shing phyogs su hu1'gro'o/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ded dpon chen po yang nam thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi grong khyer chen por mngon par zhugs pa de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi tshogs shin tu bsags hu shing 'gro'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na ded dpon chen po ni nor bsags pas chog mi shes pa yin no/ / de bzhin dul byang chub sems dpa' ded dpon chen po yang chos kyi nor bsags pas chog mi shes pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na ded dpon chen po ni 'di lta ste/ nor phun sum tshogs pa dang / gtso bo dang / dbang tshiyod pa dang / ngag mnyan pas lam grogs kyi tshogs thams cad kyi thog mar 'gro ba yin no/ /de bzhin du byang 61—195

chub sems dpa' ded dpon chen po yang 'di lta ste/ yon tan phun sum tshogs ci pa dang / yongs kyi gtso bo dang / chos la dbang ba dang / ma log par smra bas sems can lam grogs kyi tshogs thams cad kyi thog mar 'gro ba yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na ded dpon chen po ni grong khyer chen por phyin par bya ba la mkhas pa yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' ded dpon chen po yang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi grong khyer chen por phyin par bya ba la mkhas pa yin te/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' bkur ba yin pas na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi grong khyer chen por phyin par bya ba la mkhas pa'i bar du yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldanatun byang chub sems dpa' ded dpon chen po rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' lam la mkhas pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ lam mnyam pa yang rab tu shes/ lam nyam ngasaba'ang rab tu shes/lam bde ba'ang rab tu shes/ 'tsham pa'i lam yang rab tu shes/ lam chu che ba dang / chu med pa yang rab tu shes/ lam gyi dgongasalgemal dag kyang rab tu shes/ lam gyis༄tshugs dag kyang rab tu shes/ lam 'khyog pa dag kyang rab tu shes/ lam drang po dag kyang rab tu shes/ lam 'byung ba yang rab tu shes sos/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' lam la mkhas pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' thalam ma log par ston pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/〈 theg pa chen pos52'dul ba'i sems can rnams la/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam ston gyi nyan thos kyi lam mi ston to/ /nyan thos kyis 'dul 61—196

ba'i sems can rnams la nyan thos kyi lam ston gyi byang chub sems dpa'i lam mi ston to/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyishelam ston gyi/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam mi ston to/ /zhurang sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la rang sangs rgyas kyi lam ston gyi thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam mi ston to/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa la mngon par zhen pa'i sems can rnams dang / chos su 'dzin pa la mngon par zhen pa rnams la bdag med pa'i lam dang / stongs pa nyid kyi lam ston gyi/bdag dang sems can dang / srog dang / gso ba dang / skyes bu dang /gang zag gi lam mi ston to/ /mtha' gnyis la gnas pa'i sems can rnams la mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i lam ston gyi/ mtha' gnyis la gnas pa mi ston to/ /sems g.yengs pa'ikhusems can rnams la zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong gi lam ston rgyagyi g.yeng ba'i lam mi ston to/ /spros pa la mngon par dga' ba'i sems can rnams la de bzhin nyid kyi lam ston gyi byis pa spros pa la mngon par dga' ba'i lam mi ston to/ /'khor bsrel mngon par dga' ba'i sems can rnams la mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam ston gyi 'khor ba'i lam mi ston to/ /lam gol bar zhugs pa'i sems can rnams la lam srol ma dod pa ma yin pa dang / tsher ma med pa'i lam ston gyishenyon mongs pa'i tsher mas gang ba'i lam mi ston to/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' lam ma log par ston pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu rgyun mi chadakyipar sems mnyam par gzhag pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ lus la dran pa shin tu nye bar gzhag cing gnas 64—197

sol/ /tshor ba rnams dang / sems7dang chos rnams dang / yul rnams dang /dgon pa rnams dang / grong dang / grong khyerashedang / grong rdal dang /gzhongs dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor rnams dang /rnyed pa dang / bkur sti dang / grags pa dang / sgra dang / tshigs su bcad pa rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pas bslab pa bcas pa rnams dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / yongs su nyon mongs pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa thams cad la dran pa shin tu nye bar gzhag cing gnas so/ /rigs kyi bu de la ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' lus la dran pa shin tu nye bar gzhag cing gnas zhe ri na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' gang lus dang ldan pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos de dag yang dag pa'i shes rab kyis rab tu brtags shing yongs su spong ngo / /de 'og gi rkang pa'i mthil nas brtsams te/yar la klad capa'i bar du lus kyi nyes pa la rtog go/ /lus la bdag med par yang rtog go/ /lus mi brtan pa dang / 'jig pa dang / chu rgyus kyis glags pa dang / dri mi zhim pa dang / dri nga ba dang / kha dog mi sdug par rtog ste/de de ltar rtog pa'i tshe/ gang lus la lus su 'dod pa dang / lus la 'dod chags pa dang / lus la dga' ba dang / lus la bdag gir 'dzin pa dang /lus la zhen pa de dag mi 'byung ste/ de'i rgyu de'i rkyen de'i gzhis lus dang ldan pa'i chos rnams kyi dbang du 'gro bar mi 'gyur te/ gzhan du na lus dang ldan pa'i chos rnams de nyid kyi dbang du 'gyur te/ de ltar na lus la dran pa shin tu nye bar gzhag cing gnas pa'o/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' tshor ba rnams la dran pa shin tu nye bar gzhag cing gnas zher+sān/ 'di la byang chub 61—198

sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/ tshor ba gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad ni sdug bsngal na/ byis pa phyin ci log gis phyin ci log tu gyur pa rnams ni bde bar 'dzin te/ byis pa rmongs pa rnams sdug bsngal la7bde ba zhes bya bar 'dzin gyis 'phags pa rnams kyis ni thams cad sdug bsngal bar thugs su chud do snyam nas de spang ba'i7phyir nan tan du byed do/ /sems can gzhan dag kyang bslab pa de nyid la 'god kyis ②bdag gis kyang de dag gi rjes su bslab par bya'o snyam ste/ de de ltar rtog pas tshor ba rnams la dran pa shin tu nye bar gzhag cing gnas so/ /de tshor ba dag la chags pa'ang med/ khong khro ba'ang med cing de dag spang ba'i phyir rab tu zhugs pa yin no/ /gzhan dag kyang bslab pa de nyid la 'god de/ de ltar na tshor ba rnams la dran pa shin tu nye bar gzhag cing gnas so/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' sems la dran pa shin tu nye bar gzhag cing gnas zhesan/ de 'di snyam du sems te/ sems 'di ni mi rtag pa la rtag par mngon par dga' ba'o/ /sdug bsngal la bde bar mngon par dga' ba'o/ /bdag med pa la bdag tu mngon par dga' ba'o/ /mi gtsang ba la gtsang bar mngon par dga' ba'o/ /g.yo zhing mi brtan pa la myur du 'gyur geba'o/ /nyon mongs pa rnams kyi rtsa ba'o/ /ngan song rnams kyi sgo'o/ /nye ba'i nyon mongs pa rnams kyi gzhi'o/ /bde 'gro rnams chud son ra pa'o / /'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug rnams kyi rkyen du gyur pa'o / /chos thams cad kyi bdag por gyur pa'o/ /chos thams cad kyi thog mar sems 'gro ste④/ sems yongs su shes namakha chos thams cad kyang yongs su shes par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten sems kyis bris 3 tshopa ste/ sems 61—199
