lam mi 'chos so/ /ji ltar na spyod lam mi 'chos zhe7na/ gnya' shing gang tsam du lta ba dang / skyo bar lta ba dang / sgrib pa med par lta bas gom pa bags kyis dal dal nas 'dor zhing 'deg⑧pa ma yin/ de ltar na lus kyisatshul 'chos pa mi byed do/ /ji ltar na ngag gi getshul 'chos pa mi byed ce na/byang chub sems dpa' ni rnyed pa'i rgyu rnyed pa'i phyir gcom5gebaskyungs shing kyesmra ba mas shenayin/ 'jam por smra ba ma yin/ dga' bar smra ba ma yin/ rjes su 'brang ba'i tshig brjod pa ma yin te/ de ltar na ngag gi0)tshul 'chos pa mi byed do / /ji ltar na sems kyishetshul 'chos pa mi byed ce na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni sbyin pa byed pa 'am/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos rnyed pa bstabs tu )na/tshig gis 'dod pa chung bar ston cing sems kyis 'dod pa skyed7pa ma yin no/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ tshig gis 'dod pa chung la/ sems kyis rnyed pa 'dod pa 'di ni nang gi gdung ba yin te/ de ltar na sems kyis tshul 'chos pa mi byed de12/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' tshul 'chos pa dang / kha gsag gi rnyed pa dang bral ba yin no/ /ji ltar na brda'i rnyed pa dang bral ba yin zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' ni sbyin pa byed pa 'am/ sbyin bdag mthong na bdag gos kyis phongs so/ /bdag lhung bzed kyis phongs so/ /bdag nad kyi rkyen rtsis phongs so zhes brda 1 mi byed cing / sbyin pa byed pa'am/ sbyin bdag la mi slong bozhing tshig tu mi brjod debe/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' brda'i rnyed pa dang bral ba yin no/ /ji ltar na gzhogs slongs kyis rnyed pa dang bral ba yin zhe na / byang chub sems dpa' ni sbyin pa byed pa dang / sbyin bdag mthong na bdag 1 sbyin pa'i bdag po che ge mo zhig gis dngos po che ge mo zhig byin te(nye/64—250

de la bdag gis kyang phan pa che ge mo zhig byas so/ /des kyang bdag la0)tshul khrims dang ldan par rig ste/ mang du thos pa'o/ /'dod pa chung ba'o zhes 'di dang 'di byin no/ /bdag gis kyang de la snying rje ba'i sems nye bar gzhag ste blangs so zhes de skad kyi tshig mi brjod de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' gzhogs slongs kyisarnyed pa dang bral ba yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi rigs par btsal ba'i rnyed pa dang bral ba yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' ni lus la rma byung ba dang / sems la rma byung bar rnyed pa tshol ba ma yin te/ de la lus kyi rma ni 'di lta ste/ rnyed pa'i rgyu rnyed7pa'i phyir rgyug pa dang / kun tu rgyug pa dang / tshul khrims 'chal bar spyod pa'o/ /sems kyi rma ni 'di lta ste/ rnyed pa la smon pa dang / tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa gzhan gyis rnyed pa dag la gnod sems mang ba ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' mi rigs pa btsal ba'i rnyed pa dang bral ba yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos ma yin pa'i rnyed pa dang bral ba yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' srang la sgyu gemed pa dang / gzhal ba la sgyu ④med pa dang / yid brtan pa la gnod par byed pa med pa dang / g.yos rnyed pa mi sgrub pa ste/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' chos ma yin pa'i rnyed pa dang bral ba yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yongs su ma dag pa'i rnyed pa dang bral ba yin zhe na 'di la byang chub sems dpa' gang mchod rten gyi dang 'dres pa'am/ chos kyi dang 'dres pa'am/ dge 'dun gyi dang 'dres pa'am/ma byin pa'am/ ma gnang ba de dag mi len cing bdag gir mi byed/ chags pa'i sems mi skyed de/ de ltar na byang chub sems dpa' yongs su ma dag pa'i 64—251

rnyed pa dang bral ba yin no/ /ji ltar na byang chub sems dpa' rnyed pa la zhen pa med pa yin zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di la byang chub sems dpa' rnyed pa rnyed kyang bdag gir 3)mi byed nor du mi rtsi tshogs su7mi byed cing / dus dus su dge sbyong dang / bram ze dang / pha ma dang / mdza' bosredang / blon po dang ske/ gnyen bshes dang / snag gi⑧gnyen mtshams dag la gtong zhing /dus dus su bdag kyang yongs su spyod la/ yongs su spyod pa'i tshe chags pa med pa dang / zhen pa med par yongs su spyod do/ /rnyed pa ma rnyed na yang skyo ba'i sems mi skyed cing yongs su yi mi 'chadakyide/ sbyin pa byed pa dang / sbyin bdag rnams la ma dad par mi 'dzin pa yin pa gho/ de chos dang 'thun pa'ishernyed pa/ dge 'dun phyir gtogs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas bsngags pa/byang chub sems dpas ma smad pa/ lhasashebastod pa/ tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pas mi dpyashi bas chog shes pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' 'tsho ba yongs su dag pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' yid yongs su mi skyo ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can gyi rgyu sems can gyi phyir 'khor ba na gnas pas yongs su mi skyo'o/ /sems can gyi rgyu7sems can gyi phyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis7yongs su mi skyo'o/ /sems can gyi don rnams la yongs su mi skyo'o/ /sems can gyi dgos pa rnams la yongs su mi skyo'ol/ /sems can gyi bya ba rnams la yongs su mi skyo'o/ /gang zag nyan thos kyi theg pa pa rnams la lam ston pas yongs su mi skyo'o/ /de dag la ma dad par yang mi byed do/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos yongs su bsdu0bas kyang yongs su 64—252

mi skyo'o/ /byang chub kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par bya bas kyang yongs su mi skyo'o①/ /bsam pa mya ngan las 'das par gyur kyang mya ngan las 'dasalgepa la mngon par mi lta'i/ byang chub la gzholas/ byang chub la 'babargya/ byang chub la bab pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' yid yongs su mi skyo ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bka' bzhin byed pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ bag med pa thams cad dang bral zhing bag yod par spyod pa rnams yin/ lus kyis shin tu bsdams shing lus kyi ngan du spyadakyipa mi spyod pa rnams yin/ ngag gis shin tu bsdams shing ngag gi ngan du spyad pa mi spyod pa rnams yin/ yid kyis shin tu bsdams shing yid kyi ngan du spyad ④pa mi spyod pa rnams yin/ 'jig rten pha rol gyis 'jigs shing mi dge ba'i chos thams cad rnam par spangs pa rnams yin / rigs par smra zhing mi rigs pa thams cad dang bral ba rnams yin/chos smra zhing chos ma yin pa la smod pa rnams yin/ smad pa'i las rnam par spangs shing dge ba'i las kyi rjes su 'brang ba rnams yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la sun mi7'byin cing nyon mongs pa'i dri nga ba'i yul thams cad dang bral ba rnams yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid yongs su skyong zhing sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams la srung ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi tunyebaka' bzhin byed pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bzhin 'dzum zhing khro gnyer med pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang 64—253

zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dbang po shin tu dang ba rnams yin/ dbang po yongs su dag pa rnams yin/ dbang po gsal ba rnams yin/ dbang po dri ma med pa rnams yin/ dbang po yongs su byang ba rnams yin/ gnod sems dang bral ba rnams yin/ bag la nyal ba dang bral ba rnams yin/ kun nas ldang ba dang bral ba rnams yin/43) tha ba dang mdud par 'dzin pa dang bral ba rnams yin / khro ba dang bral ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bzhin 'dzum zhings3)khro gnyer med pa rnams yin no / /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don ji lta bu lags pa bdag gis 'tshal te/byang chub sems dpa' rnams dbang po yongs su dag pas na bzhin 'dzum pa lags / nyon mongs pa rnams dang bral bas na khro gnyer ma mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dbang po yongs su dag pas na bzhin 'dzum pa yin/ nyon mongs patshagernams dang bral bas rigen khro gnyer med pa yin rnal/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' mang du thos pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ 'khor ba ni 'dod chags kyi mes rab tu 'bar ba'o zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /zhe sdang gi mes gerab tu 'bar ba'o zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so / /gti mug gi mes garab tu dkrugs pa'o zhes yang dag pa ⑦ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /'dus 8byas ni mi rtag pa'o zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /'du byed rnams ni sdug bsngal ba'o zhes yang dag pa 64—254

ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /'jig rten ni stong pa'o zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /chos thams cad ni bdag med pa'o zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /'jig rten ni7spros pa la mngon par dga' ba'o zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /chos thams cad ni rkyen las byung ba'o zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /mya ngan las 'das pa ni〈mizhi ba'o zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes sol/ /de yang thos pa dang / bsam pa dang / bsgoms pas shes kyi sgrar brjod pa tsam gyis ma yin te/ de ltar shes nas kyang snying rje'i sems brtan pa nye bar bzhag ste/ sems can rnams kyi don du rtsol zhing 'bad la brtson 'grus (gertsom mo/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' mang du thos pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa rnams yin noyi/ /bcu gang zhe na / 'di lta ste/ phyi ma'i dus phyi ma'i tshe lnga brgya tha ma la dam pa'i chos rnam par 'jig cing bstan pa 'khrugs par gyur pa dang / sems can rnams lam ngan par zhugs pa dang / ye shes kyi sgron ma mya ngan las 'das te/ ston pa med pa'i tshe/ mdo sde bya rgya chen po/ rgya chen po0)don che zhing mthu che ba/dam pa'i chos thams cad kyi ma mo dang 'dra ba dag 'dzin cing klogs9)la kha ton byed cing kun chub par byed pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rjod nya )cing ston la yang dag par ston cing gsal bar byed pa dang / de la zhugs pa'i gang zag rnams la dga' ba dang / dad pa dang / rangs par byed cing de dag la phan 'dogs pa dang / zang zing med pa'i kyi sems kyis dam pa'i chos nyan pa dang /64—255

chos smra ba'i gang zag rnams la ston par 'du shes skyed pa dang / dam pa'i chos la bdud 7rtsir 'du shes skyed pa dang / bcud kyis len du 'du shes skyed pa dang ske/ rtsi'i 'du shes skyed pa dang / lus dang srog la mi lta bar dam pa'i chos yongs su tshol ba dang / btsal nas kyang nan ②gyis sgrub pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' dam pa'i chos yongs su 'dzin pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rgyal po'i sras rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/lus mtshan gyi rgyan gyis brgyanas pa rnams yin/ lus dpe byad bzang po'i me tog rgyas pa rnams yin/ dbang po rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan zhing shin tu yongs su rdzogs pa rnams yin/ de bzhin gshegs pas bstan pa'i gnas la rjes su sten⑧pa rnams yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bzhud pa'i lam rjes su thob par7byed pa rnams yin/ de bzhin gshegs pasakyithugs su chud pa'i gnas khong du chud par byed pa rnams yin/ 'jig rten sdug bsngal ba yongs su skyong ba ⑦rnams yin/ 'phags pa'i tshul la shin tu bslabs ⑧pa rnams yin/ tshangs pa'i gnas rnams la shin tu mthar phyin pa rnams yin/de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi pho brang na gnas pa rnams yin te⑨/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi rgyal po'i sras rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong bas brga⑩ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa rnams yin/ bdud thams cad kyis mi sgul ba rnams yin/64—256

sangs rgyas kyi7chos thams cad las mi g.yo ba rnams yin/ chos thams cad kyi tshul la zhugs pa rnams yin/ chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid khong du chud pa rnams yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa rnams yin/shin tu rtogasalgepa'i ye shes dang ldan pa rnams yin/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang thun mong ma yin pa rnams yin/ 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa rnams yin/ mi skye ba'i chos kyi bzod pa thob pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang7ldan na byang chub sems dpa' brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong bas bsu ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcusadang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa dang bag la nyal shes pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/sems can 'dod chags kyi bsam pa can yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /zhe snang gi bsam pa can dang / /gti mug gi bsam pa can dang /dma' ba'i bsam pa can dang / bar ma'i bsam pa can dang / zhen pa'i bsam pa can dang / dge ba'i bsam pa can dang / brtan pa'i bsam pa can dang / yun ring po'i bsam pa can dang / sems tshan gtum pa'i bsam pa can dag kyang yang dag pa ji lta bshebazhin du rab tu shes shing / de yang sems can gcig la ji ltar shes pa bzhin du sems can gyi khams kun la yang yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes so/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa dang / bag la nyal shes pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i cho ga shes pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di 64—257

lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi gzugs nye bar ston to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs/ rang sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la rang sangs rgyas kyi gzugs/nyan thos kyi gzugs kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la nyan thos kyi gzugs/brgya byin gyi tshogazugs kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la brgya byin gyi gzugs/bdud kyi gzugs kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la bdud kyi gzugs/tshangs pa'i gzugs kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la tshangs pa'i gzugs/bram ze'i gzugs kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la bram ze'i gzugs/rgyal rigs kyi gzugs kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la rgyal rigs kyi gzugs / khyim bdag gi gzugs kyis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la khyim bdag gi gzugs nye bar ston geto/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar rnam pa gang dang gang gis sems can rnams 'dul bar 'gyur ba'i rnam pa de dang de byang chub sems dpa' rnams nye bar ston to/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i cho ga khushes pa rnams yin no ri/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' des pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ drang ba rnams yin/ 'jam pa rnams yin/ gya gyu med pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams yin/ gnod sems med pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams yin/ dri ma med pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams yin/ rnam par dag pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams yin/ mi brlang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams yin/ rtsub pa spangs pa rnams yin/ bzod pa 61—258

mang ba rnams yin/ des pa phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin te①/ rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' des pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' 'grogs na bde ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ lta ba yongs su dag pas lta ba phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin②/ tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/cho ga yongs su dag pa rnams yin/ tshul dang 'thuna'i pa'i spyod yul du spyod pa rnams yin/ kun nas nyon mongs pa med par spyod pa rnams yin/ khong yangs pa rnams yin/ tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa la mchod pa rnams yin/skal ba mnyam pa rnams yin/ lam gcig tu zhugs pa rnams yin/ ston pa gzhan med pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' 'grogs na bde ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bsdu ba'i dngos po la mkhas pa rnams yin no//bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ phan pa'i sbyin pas sems can rnams sdud do/ /bde ba'i sbyin pa dang / mi zad pa'i sbyin pa dang / phan pa smra ba dang / don du smra ba dang / chos su smra ba dang / rigs par smra ba dang / don bya ba dang /zang zing gis don 'thunam④pa dang / 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyis don 'thunasapas sems can rnams sdud do/ /rigs kyi bu phan pa'i sbyin pa nilagang chos sbyin pa'o / /bde ba'i sbyin pa ni rinagang zang zing sbyin pa'o/ /mi zad pa'i sbyin pa ni gang lam gyi lung sbyin pa'o/ /phan par smra ba ni gang dge ba'i rtsa ba bstan pa'o/ /don du smra ba ni gang yang dag pa'i bstan pa'o/ /chos su smra ba ni gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa dang 'thun par chos bstan ⑧pa'o/ /rigs par smra ba 61—259

ni gang don yang dag par chud mi gson7pa'o/ /don bya ba ni gang mi dge ba'i gnas nas bslangs tekhudage ba'i gnas su gzhog pa'o/ /zang zing gis don 'thun sde)pa ni gang bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / bldags0pa dang /btung ba dang / gzhib7pa dang / gos la sogs pa thun mong du yongs su spyod pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyis don 'thun pa ni gang gser dang ske/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / bai drur+ya〈pedang / dung dang / man shel dang / byidzan)ru dang / sa le sbram dang / dngul dang / rta dang / glang po che dang / shing rta dang / bzhon pa thun mong du spyod pa yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa'7bsdu ba'i dngos po la mkhas pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' tshul du shis 8pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ spyod lam rab tu zhi ba rnams yin/ spyod lam sgyu med pa rnams yin/ spyod lam yongs su dag pa rnams yin/ blta na dga' ba rnams yin/ blta na 'jam pa rnams yin/ blta hunabs chog mi shes pa rnams yin/ blta na yid du 'ong ba rnams yin/ blta na sems can thams cad khong khro ba med par 'gyur ba rnams yin / blta na sems can thams cad sems tshim par 'gyur ba rnams yin/blta hurten sems can thams cad kyi sems dang bar 'gyur ba rnams yin te(nye/rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' tshul du shis pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' gnas bca' ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa'i 'jigs pa dag las yongs su srung ba rnams yin/64—260

'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa nas 'don pa rnams yin/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ba rnams yin/ mgon med pa rnams la gnyen du gyur pa rnams yin/nyon mongs pa'i nad kyis nad par gyur pa rnams la sman par gyur pa rnams yin/rten med pa dag la rten pa rnams yin/ gnas med pa dag la ①gnas pa rnams yin/ skyabs7med pa dag la skyabs rnams yin/ gling med pa dag la gling rnams yin/ dpung gnyen med pa dag la dpung gnyen rnams yin te②/rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' gnas bca' ba rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rtsi'i rgyal po'i shing chen po lta bu rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 0rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na rtsi'i rgyal po'isnyishing chen po blta na bzang ba zhes bya ba de ni rtsa bas kyang sems can nad pa rnams nye bar 'tsho'o/ /sdong po dang /yal ga rnams dang / lo ma rnams dang / me tog rnams dang / 'bras bu rnams dang / mthong ba dang / mnams pa dang / myangs pa dang / reg pas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin te/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang7sems dang po bskyed pa nas bzung ste/ nyon mongs pa sna tshogs kyi nad kyis nad par gyur pa'i sems can rnams sbyin pas 0kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang / mthong ba dang / thos pa dang / yon tan gyi ro myangs pa dang / bsnyen bkur byas pas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' rtsi'i rgyal po'i shing chen po lta bu rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub 64—261

sems dpa' bsod nams bya ba la brtson pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ dkon mchog gsum la ci nus su bya ba byed pa dang / sems can nad pa rnams la rtsi sbyor ba nya)dang / sems can bkres pa dang skom pas nyen pa rnams la zas dang skom gyi sbyin pa dang / rlung dang lhags pa dang nyi mas nyen pa'i sems can rnams la dgab pa misbyin pa dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon rnams la gus par rim gro byed pa dang / tshangs sa pa mtshungs par spyod pa rnams la gus par smra/ phyag 'tshal/ ldang thal mo sbyar zhing 'dud par byed pa dang / kun dga' ra ba dang / gtsug lag ④khang dang / skyedasamos tshal bya ba dang / dus dus su nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod dang / bang ba gtong ba dang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang / las mi dang / zho shas 'tsho ba la bgo bshas yongs su skyong ba dang / dus dus su tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i dge sbyong dang bram ze dag la bsnyen bkur byed pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams bya ba la brtson pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sprul50pa la mkhas pa rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig nas kyang mi g.yo la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la yongs su 'dri'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig nas kyang mi g.yo la/sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la chos nyan to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig nas kyang mi g.yo la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod cing bsnyen bkur byed do/ / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig nas kyang mi g.yo la/7) sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar yang byang chub 64—262

kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig nas kyang mi g.yo la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar yang byang chub sems dpa' mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba rnams la rim gro7byed/ bkur sti byed/ bsti〈stang byed / mchod pa byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig nas shekyang mi g.yo la/sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar yang byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba ston to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig nas kyang mi g.yo la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar yang bdag mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar yang snang ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig nas kyang mi g.yo la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar yang chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu skorasher/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig nas7kyang mi g.yo la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du marasheyang yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar snang ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig nas kyang mi g.yo la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mar yang sems can 'dul ba ji snyed pa la de snyed kyi sprul pa 'gyed kyang〈de dag sprul pa 'gyed pa'i tshe / rtog pa med cing rnam par rtog pa med pa yin nol/ /byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar gang lta bur byang chub sems dpa' sprul pa 'gyed na mi rtog rnam par mi rtog pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de'i phyir dpe nyon cig /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na nyi ma dang zla ba ni gling bzhir snang bar byed cing sems can rnams la phan 'dogs pa yin kyang / nyi ma dang zla ba ni bdag cag gis snang bar bya'o/ /bdag cag ni sems can la phan 'dogs pa'o zhes mi rtog rnam par mi rtog 3 )mod kyi/ 'on kyang sngon gyi las rnam par smin pa'i mngon par 'du byed pas zla ba dang nyi ma gnyis kyi 31bya ba de 64—263

lta bu 'byung ngo / /rigs kyi bu de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang sprul pa 'gyed natumi rtog rnam par mi rtog ste/ bsgrim pa'am/ mngon par 'du bya ba mi byed rdza/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sngon gyi lasashernam par smin pas mngon par 'du bya ba rnams0mngon par grub pa'i phyir te/ sngon gyi byang chub sems dpasasnyebyang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ de ci nas kyang rnam par rtog pa med par yang sprul pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ba de lta de ltar smon lam btab/ de lta de ltar mngon par 'dus byas pa'i phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' sprul pa lashemakhas pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa shin tu grub pas sbyin pa shin tu'uphun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ tshul khrims shin tu grub cing tshul khrims kyi phung po skyon med pa dang / ma 'dres pa dang / ma 'bags pa dang ske/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad las 'das pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba dang ldan pas tshul khrims shin tu phun sum tshogs pa rnams yin/ bzod pa shin tu phun sum tshogs pa rnams dang / brtson 'grus shin tu phun sum tshogs pa rnams dang / bsam gtan shin tu phun sum tshogs pa rnams dang / shes rab shin tu phun sum tshogs pa rnams dang /thabs shin tu phun sum tshogs pa rnams dang / smon lam shin tu phun sum tshogs pa rnams dang / stobs shin tu phun sum tshogs pa7rnams dang / ye shes shin tu grub cing thun mong ma yin pa'i ye shes nyan thos dang / rang sangs 61—264

rgyas thams cad las 'das pa/ sa dang po la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yan chad/ sa dgu pa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bar gyi ye shes las 'das patudang ldan pas ye shes shin tu rdzogs pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu po de dag dang ldan na byang chub sems dpa' myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa'i tshe/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rnam pa drug tu rab tu 'gul te/ rab tu g.yos par gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na ri rab ri'i rgyal po chen posnyedag gam/ ri btang bzungashengam/ ri btang bzung7chen po dag gam/ khor7yug gi ri'am/ khor yug gi ri chen po dag gam/ de ma yin pa'i rin po che'i ri dang / ri nag po de dag thams cad kyang yul ga ya gang na ba dang / ga ya mgo'i ri gang na ba de logs su bcom ldan 'das la chos kyi dgabalgepa bya ba'i phyir 'dud par gyurarnyuto/ /gang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'ishe'ajig rten gyi khams 'di na me tog gi shing ngam/ 'bras bu'i shing ngam / spos kyi shing ci yod pa de dag thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das la chos kyi dgab pa bya ba'i phyir ga ya mgo'i ri gang na ba de logs su 'dud par gyur to//byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das la chos kyi dgab pa ⑩'bul ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag du mas kyang na bza' dang / rgyan gyi bye brag rnam pa sna tshogs kyi phung po ri rab tsam byas par gyur to/ /brgyanyebyin dang / tshangs pa dang ske/ 'jig rten skyong ba brgya stong du ma yang mgo bos phyag 'tshal zhing thal mo sbyar ba byas te 'dud cing / bcom ldan 'das la me tog man rā〈nyer ba dang /64—265

man dā ra ba chen po dag 'thor bar gyur to/ /lha'i bu brgya stong du ma yang nam mkha'i dbyings la gnas te/ gos g.yob cing ca co dang / ga zhashebargya stong du ma byed par gyur te/ lha rdzas kyi me tog gis bcom ldan 'das la mngon par 'thor bar gyur cing / kye ma'o deng ni 'jig rten du sangs rgyas gnyis pa skyes par gyur te/ kye ma'o chos kyi 'khor lo gnyis pa bskor to/ /sems can gang gi rna lam du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di grag par gyur pa de dag kyang bsod nams dang ldan zhing dge ba'i las byed pa ste/ sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la dge ba'i rtsa ba rab tu bsags pa yin na/ gang 'di la dad pa rnyed pa de dag lta smos kyang ci dgos zhes de skad ces ched du rjodarka pa ched du brjodakyido/ /lto 'phye chen po brgya stong du ma yang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyid la chos kyi dgab pa bya ba'i phyir 'brug ltar sgra 'u0ru ru 'byin/ sgrogs ⑤par byed shin tu sgrogasasrepar byed cing / spos kyi sprin sna tshogs mngon par sprul te/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang / ga ya mgo'i ri la spos chu'i char mngon par 'bebs kyang sems can rnams la gnod par mi snang ngo / /klu'i bu mo brgya stong du ma yang bcom ldan 'das kyikhuspyan sngar klu'i nga ro'i sgra 'byin par gyur tod)/ /dri za dang mi 'am ci brgya stong du ma yang snyan cing zab pa'i dbyangs kyis glu len cing ga ya mgo'i ri dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams la skor phyo ba byed par gyur to/ /gnod sbyin bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma yang pad ma'i char mngon par 'bebs par gyur to/ /bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang / grong pa rme/nge dang / yul gyi mi brgya stong du ma yang me tog dngarwate/bdug spos dang / spos dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang /64wa 266

na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byed par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing du ma dag nas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis chos kyi dgab pa bya ba'i phyir so so'i smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu dag spyinas 'od zer mang po bkye bar gyur ②te/'od zer de dag kyang kha dog sna tshogs/ gzugs sna tshogs/ snang ba sna tshogs can sha stag ste/ 'di lta ste/ sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang /dkar po dang / le brgan dang / shel dang / dngul gyi kha dog ste/ de dag stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di la skorarkub byed cing mun pa thams cad rnam par sel bar gyur te/ 'khor nas ga ya mgo'i ri la bskor ba byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la yang bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tu nub par gyur to/ /rlung yang bde bar langs par gyur to/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa dang / mchod pa mngon par 'du bya ba 'disabyung ba'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyis mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob bo/ /srog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma yang chos rnams la rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba chos kyi mig rnam par dag go//srog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas kyang sngon michad ma bskyed pa las byang chub tu sems bskyed par gyur to/ /de nas ga ya mgo'i ri la gnas pa'i lha mo mi 'chi ba zhes bya ba dpung dang bcas 'khor dang bcas te 'khor 'dus pa de nyid du 'dus shing 'dug 'dug pa las de stan las langs nas bdag gimathoganas su song ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod pa blangs nas/ phyir bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyin te/ bcom ldan 'das la bkur sti rtso)byas/ btsun pa ni 64—267

byas / ri mo7byas/ mchod pa byas/ bstibastang byas/ rim gro7byas so/ /bkur ste dang / btsun pa dang / ri mo dang / mchod pa dang / bsti0stang dang ske/ rim gro byas nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das tshe rabs gzhan de dang de dag la ga ya mgo'i ri 'di nyid du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di sangs rgyas stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyis don 'di nyid dag dang / tshul 'di nyid dag dang / tshig dang yi ge 'di nyid dag gis bstan pa bdag gis mngon par dran no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/mi 'chi ba de ltar khyod kyis dkon mchog 'byung ba de lta bu thos par gyur pa ni khyod kyis thob par bya ba legs par thob bo/ /de nas 'khor der tshogs pa'i nang na lha'i bu kha cig 'di snyam du sems par gyur tedu/ lha mo 'dis de srid cig nas chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas de snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa mang po la bsnyen bkur byas kyang / 'dis7bud med kyi lus las ma bsgyur snyam pa dang ske/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas/ lha'i bu de dag gi sems kyi rtog pa sems kyis yongs su shes nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar lha mo mi 'chi ba 'dis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul che ba thob la/de bzhin gshegs pa de snyed du mang ba zhig bsnyen bkur bgyis na/ ci'i rgyu ci'i rkyen gyis 'dis bud med kyi lus las ma bsgyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu 'di la sems can gyi don ni rgyu'o/ /sems can gyi don ni rkyen to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu lha mo mi 'chi ba ni rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gnas pa/ rdzu 'phrul che ba/ mthu che 64—268

ba ste/ rigs kyi bu lha mo mi 'chi bas gang7yang dag par len du btsud pa dang / gzengs7bstod pa dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa las yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas ni bgrang ba las 'das pa zhig ngas mngon par shes te③/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na lha mo mi 'chi ba ni rdzu 'phrul che ba/ mthu che ba ste/ rigs kyi bu lha mo mi 'chi ba 'di ni bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas rnams la bsnyen bkur byas nas/ sangs rgyas kyisnyizhing 'di nyid du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur te/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas kyang mi 'chi ba zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha mo mi 'chi ba la bka' stsal pa/ mi 'chi ba khyod kyis rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing ston cig /de nas lha mo mi 'chi ba gzugs thams cad yongs su ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs par gyur te/ lha mo mi 'chi ba gzugs thams cad yongs su ston⑧pa'i ting nge 'dzin de la snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu de'i tshe/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di lag mthil lta bur mnyam zhing be+e drur+ya'i gzhir snang bar gyur te/ ri nag po med cing shing tha mal pa med la/ gnasalgeganas dag na yang dpag bsam gyi shing sha stag snang bar gyur to/ /gnasalgeganas dag na chu mig dang / mtshe'u dang / lteng7ka dang / rdzing yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus yongs su gang ba dag snang bar gyur to/ /mi phal pa med par snang bar gyur to/ /de na bud med kyi sgra yang mi grag par gyur to/ /gnas dang gnas dag na pad ma shing rta'i 'khor lo tsam dag snang bar gyur te/ pad ma de dag la yang byang chub sems dpa'i 64—269

gzugs skyil mo krung tso/du 'khod pa sha stag snang bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'chi ba de yang byang chub sems dpa' de dag la chos ston par snang ste/ brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas yongs su bskor cing byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du mas mdun du bdar te/ 'di ltar chos nyid 'di kho na brtsams nas chos ston par snang bar gyur to/ /de nas lha mo mi 'chi ba yang ting nge 'dzin de las langs te/bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum du g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas 'di skad ces gsol tol/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo gang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan tam/'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ kun chub par bgyid dam/ kha ton bgyid dam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par ston par bgyid na/ de bsod nams ji tsam zhig skyed snopar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i sems can rnams la sbyin pa lhug par byin te/ de ltar sbyin pas ④bskal pa brgya stong mang por byin pa bas/rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di legs par bris legs par zhus te/ sems dad pas sems phyedad pa la byin na/ de bas kyang 'di bsod nams ches mang du skyed 6 do/ /rigs kyi bu de ci'i phyir zhe na/zang zing gi sbyin pa ni phran tshegs te/ chos kyi sbyin pa ni rdzu 'phrul che ba'o/ /64—270

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'khor ba natu'akhor ba'i sems can rnams kyis zang zing ni rnam pa du mar myong gi/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi ro ni nam yang ma myong ste/ 'jig rten pa ni ma yin no/ /rigs kyi bu gang la las stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i sems can rnams dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams la bkod pa bas/ gang gis chos kyi7rnam grangs 'di nyan tam/ 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam/ klogasho )gam/kun chub par byed dam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher ston na/ de bas 'di bsod nams ches mang du skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu dge ba bcu'i⑧las kyi lam rnams ni 'di las byung ngo / /rigs kyi bu gang la la zhig gisabastong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i sems can rnams rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa nyid kyi 'bras bu la bkod pa bas kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyan tam/ 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ kun chub par byed dam/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher76 ston na/ de bas 'di bsod nams ches 7rimang du skyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu chos 'di nyid la brten nani/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams snang bar 'gyur ro/ /chos 'di nyid la brten na byang chub sems dpa' rnams snang bar 'gyur ro/ /chos 'di nyid la brten na de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di gzung77ba dang / bklag hu7pa dang ske/ spel ba dang / kha ton byas pas mdo sde thams cad gzung hu ba dang /bklag〈nyepa dang / spel ba dang / kha ton byas par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir 64—271

zhe na/ rigs kyi bu 'di ni chos thams cad kyi ma mo ste/ rigs kyi bu chos nyid 'di ma thob par chos nyid rgya chen po 'thob par mi 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'dul ba'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus nyan thos chen po de dag thams cad stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar7te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba dephulogs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de①/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang chos nyid 'di thosakyipas skye ba'i 'khor ba chen po bas par bgyis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ ji skad smras pasnyide bzhin no/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor mang po dekyidag la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag sa phyogs gang du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'chad pa dang / ston pa'i sa'i7phyogs de byang chubashekyi snying por gzung bar bya'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar gzung bar bya'o/ /mchod rten chen por gzung bar bya'o/ /bdag cag gi ston pa gnas 'di na bzhugs so bar〈skyegazung bar bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu dag de ci'i phyir zhe na/ chos nyid 'di ni byang chub bo/ /chos nyid 'di ni chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu dag de bzhin gshegs pa ni chos kyi sku ste/ rigs kyi bu dag chos mchod pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mchod par 'gyur ro/ /sa phyogs gang na chos smra ba de gnas pa de la yang mchod rten du 'du shes bskyed par bya ste(nye/chos smra ba de la yang bla mar 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen du 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /lam ston par 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /64—272

chos smra ba de mthong na dga'atub dang / dad pasnyedang / rangs pa bskyed par bya'o/ /rim gror byas te stan la bdar bar bya'o/ /chos smra ba de'i bsngags pa brjod par bya'o/ /legs so zhes brjod pa mang bar bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu dag ngas bskal pa 'am/ bskal pa las lhag par chos smra ba de'i bsngags pa brjod kyang chos7smra ba de la cung zad kyang phan par byas pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu dag 'di lta ste/ bkur ster bya ba dang /btsun par bya ba dang / bsngags pa brjod pa ni gyi na cung zad du zad do/ /rigs kyi bu dag gal te chos 'di 'dod pa'i rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dag gis chos smra ba de 'ong ba'i lam bdag gi khrag gis chag chag byas kyang7chos smra ba de la phan pa cung zad kyang byas pa med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu dag 'di ltasnyiste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi tshul gzung ba0'di ni dka' ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu dag chos smra ba des kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa dang / bstan pa dang / yang dag par ston pa'i tshe/ 'jigs pa med par bya'o/ /ma zhum pa dang / spa ma gong ba dang / zhe ma 'gras pa'i sems dang / gos gtsang ma bgos te dad pa bskyed par bya'o/ /bdag gi bsngags pa brjod kyang mi snyems pa dang / nga rgyal du mi gzung bar bya ste/bdag mi stod⑨/ gzhan mi smod cing / des zang zing med pa'i sems kyis ri mor byas te chos bstan par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dog sa'i phyogs gang du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa'am/ bstan par 'gyur ba'i sa phyogs der chos kyi rnam grangs 'di mnyan pa dang / chos smra ba de la sman par bgyi ba'i 64—273

slad du bdag cag dpung dang bcas 'khor dang bcas te mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis7de ltar gyis shig /kau shi ka khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid yongs su bsrungashebar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'iphuming ci zhes bgyi/ 'di ji ltar gzungamathubar bgyi/ (debacom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de'i phyir khyod kyis chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dkon mchog sprin ces bya bar zung shig5 /yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas kyi le'u zhes bya bar yang zung shigaci /ye shes sgron ma zhes bya bar yang zung shigani /sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel bas kun dris pa zhes bya bar yang zung shigatso /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba yid dga' zhing byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / nyan thos chen po de dag dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang /'jig rten skyong ba dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu la sogs pa1 )/ lha'i bu brgya stong du ma dag dang / de ma yin pa gzhan 31lha dang ske/ klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto the 'phye chen po brgya stong dag kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga'o/ /'phags pa dkon mchog sprin ces bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs sonyunye// // lots+tsha ba ban de 1 rin chen 'tsho 15dang / chos nyid tshul khrims kyis bsgyur 8cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //64—274

༄ga /'phags pa sprin chen po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/༷1)༄༄ga /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ma hā me gha ( nā ma ma hā yā lke zhin sru tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa sprin chen chopo zhes bya ba slotheg pa chen po'i mdo/bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa'akhedang / 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na/ bya rgod kyi 7phung po'i ri la gnas brtan 'od srung 8chen po la sogs pa dge slong sa ya phrag dgu dang brgyad 'bum gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po thams cad kyang /dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ dbang dang ldan par gyur pa/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ cang shes pa/ glang po chen po/ sems shin tu rnam par grol ba/shes rab shin tu rnam par grol ba/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ yang dag pa'i she shes pas sems shin 64wa 314

tu rnam par grol ba/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ tshul khrims shin tu rnam par dag pa/ sems kyi dbang thams cad kyi dam pa'i pha rol tu son pa/ nya)mngon par shes pa/ mkhas par namangon par shes pa/ rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsam gtan pa sha stag dang thabs cig 5tu bzhugs so/ /de nas gnas brtan 'od srung chen po la sogs pa dge slong sa ya phrag dgu dang brgyad 'bum po de dag phye ma red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos 4 phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe skye dgu'i 5)bdag mo chen mo gi ta sī nel sogs pa dge slong ma sa ya phrag drug dang lnga 'bum yang phye ma red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 7te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba 2de logs su thal mo sbyar 9ba btud de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe sprin chen snying po la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i gtso bo chen po sa ya phrag drug dang brgyad 'bum la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sprin chen snying po zhes bya ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sprin chen kho'od 11srung zhes bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sprin chen glog gi 'od ces bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sprin chen 'brug bsgrags dbyangs zhes 12bya ba dang / sprin chen brtson 'grus srung zhes bya ba 64—315

dang ske/ sprin chen dga' byed can zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen rab dga' zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen brtsegs 1zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen rdo rje dpal zhes bya ba nadang / sprin chen nges par sgra sgrogs /zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen gragasam zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen glog gi 'od kyi dra ba can zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen glog sbyin zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen dpyod pa la mkhas pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen rtsal gyis 'gro zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen seng ge sgra sgrogs t+t+waṃrgyal po zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen chu rgyas blo gros zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen brtson 'grus lto zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen lta ba'i dus tshod rgyal po zhes bya ba dang —/ sprin chen rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen mngon par 'phags pa'i grags 6pa mtha' yas zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen yang dag par lta ba 7zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen mu stegs su gyur pa'i dbang phyugaglen ces bya ba dang / sprin chen bsod nams zhing zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen bsil bar gyur 9ces bya ba dang / sprin chen nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba dang /sprin chen zla ba'i gzi brjid ces bya ba dang / sprin chen rin thang med pa'i be+e drur+ya 1 zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen rtag tu lta ba 11zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen rtag pa'i rang bzhin la dga' ba zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen blo gros rgya mtsho zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen 'od rgyas zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen rnam par rgyal ba'i klus byin zhes bya ba dang /sprin chen dga' bas 'tsho ba'i dpal zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen ded dpon mig ces bya ba dang / sprin chen cod 12pan gyis spungs skyes pa zhes bya ba dang /sprin chen ston par gyur pa zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen sa bon srung 1 zhes bya ba 61—316

dang ske/ sprin chen rnam par rgyal ba'i ri1)pad ma dkar po zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen me lta bu'i ye shes kyi pad ma zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen bsgo ribs bsgos pa'i ud pa la'i dri ldan zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen stag ces bya ba dang /sprin chen 'dren spyod ces bya ba dang / sprin chen mi 'jigs sgra zhes bya ba dang /sprin chen ta ma la'i lo ma bsil ba zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen rin chen tsan dan bsil ba'i lus zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen dam pa zhes bya ba dang sprin chen ya mtshan la mkhas pas zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen dga' ba sred med kyi bu zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen snyan dngags mkhan gyi khyu mchog ces bya ba dang /sprin chen snying po phra ba la 'jug pa zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen dam pa'i chos mchog pad ma dkar po rgyas pa'i gdong zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen dam pa'i gdong zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen dam pa'i chos kyi rgyun rtogs zhes bya ba dang /sprin chen grags pa'i bde ba zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen gser gyi ri bo'i rgyal po'i dpal zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen sman kun sbyin zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen sman pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen lus chen zhes bya ba dang /sprin chen mkha' la mngon par 'phags zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen sgra ldan zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen dri ma sel zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen sgron ma pad ma'i dpal zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen rnam par sgrogs lapa len pa med pa'i rtog pa ma 'dres pa zhes bya ba dang / sprin chen mun sel zhes bya ba dang /sprin chen rim pa'i thog tog 5sel ba zhes bya ba dang / de la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sa ya phrag drug dang / brgyad 'bum yang phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags 61—317

nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de0)logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe seng ge sgron ma la sogs pa lid tsha bī (migazhon nu sa ya phrag lnga dang brgyad 'bum la 'di lta ste/lid tsha bī gzhon nu chos byin /zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu klu mgo zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu chos sde zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu dbang pos byin zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu dbang po'i tog ces bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu dbang po'i rgyal mtshan 'od ces bya ba dang ske/ lid tsha bī gzhon nu seng ge'i sgra sgrogs54)blo gros zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu rin chen mgrin dbyangs zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu rangs byed dpal zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu klu dpal zhes bya ba dang ske/ lid tsha bī gzhon nu rdo rje phreng ldan zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu sangs rgyas 'bangs zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu rgyal ba'i 'bangs zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu rgyal ba'i zla ba zhes bya ba dang /lid tsha bī gzhon nu lag chen zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu dpal chen zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu gang gās byin zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu 'jam dpal snying po zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī 3)gzhon nu klu dga' stobs zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu klus phyi skyong zhes bya ba dang /yid tsha bī gzhon nu chos skyong zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu 'od grags zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu nam mkha'adza mdzod ces bya ba48)dang /lid tsha bī gzhon nu gang gās skyong zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu srin 64—318

phyis kyis rna cha gdub 'khor can zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu glog phreng can zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu khyad 17par dga' zhes bya ba dang /lid tsha bī gzhon nu khyad par can gyi rigs zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu dri med 'od grags zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu gling bu can gyis byin zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu sa'i dbang phyug ces bya ba dang /lid tsha bī gzhon nu sa steng phreng ba can zhes bya ba dang / lid tsha bī gzhon nu mtshungs pa med pa'i rdo rje'i branasngonazhes bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa lid tsha bī gzhon nu sa ya phrag lnga dang brgyad 'bum ste/ lid tsha bī gzhon nu de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la yang dag par zhugs pa/ theg pa chen po la sems rab tu dga' ba sha stag ste/ phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis zhabs la mgo bos naphyag 'tshal te/bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe lha'i bu mthong na dga' ba'i 65dri za'i rgyal po la sogs pa lha'i bu sa ya phrag bzhi dang bzhi 'bum la 'di lta ste/ lha'i bu mthong na dga' ba'i dri za'i rgyal po zhes bya ba dang ske/ lha'i bu dga' zhing dang ba'i 7grags pa zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu zla ba'i gtsug phud can zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu nyi ma'i mdog ces bya ba dang /lha'i bu rna 'phyang rna cha gdub kor can zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu rangs byed kyi rol mo'i na sa 'dzin ces bya ba dang / lha'i bu dpal chen zhes bya ba dang /lha'i bu zab mo tshul chen po la 'jug pa zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu nag po chen po 64wa 319

zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu dpa' ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu nam mkha' ltar mig dri ma med pa zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu dga' ba la rnam par mos pa'i dpal zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu dga' phreng0)rgyal po zhes bya ba dang /lha'i bu dga' bar grags pa'i 'od ces bya ba dang / lha'i bu bzhin dga' zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu yid 'phrog ces bya ba dang / lha'i bu be+e drur+ya'i〈khu'od ces bya ba dang / lha'i bu be+e drur+ya chos ltar 'od snang ba zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu skar ma la dga' ba zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu 'phral54)ba zla gam ltar 'dug pa zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu nges par sgra sgrogasam5)zab mo zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu nyon mongs pa rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu brgya byin dga' ba zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu gzhon nu yid du 'ong ba zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu man dra56)ra ba brtsegs pa zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu mgo la 'khri shing thogs pa zhes bya ba dang ske/ lha'i bu bur ma sel ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba dang / lha'i bu dam pa'i chos 'dzin ces bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa lha'i bu sa ya phrag bzhi dang bzhi 'bum ste/ lha'i bu de dag thams cad kyang theg pa chen po la sems dad cing rab tu dga' ba/ dam pa'i chos bsrung merabar dga' ba/ dam pa'i chos rgyas par dga' ba ting nge 'dzin thams cad gzung bar dga' ba sha stag ste/sems can rnams la phan pa dang / bde ba'i phyir phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan stong bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 48logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po sa ya phrag 64wa 320

gnyis dang brgyad 'bum la 'di lta ste/ klu'i rgyal po pad ma zhes bya ba dang /klu'i rgyal po 'jog po zhes bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho zhes bya ba dang /klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa zhes bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po stobs kyi rgyu zhes bya ba dang /klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas nor rgyas kyi bu zhes bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal 'byor gnas zhes bya ba0)dang / klu'i rgyal po byis pa rtses zhes bya ba nodang /klu'i rgyal po mche ba mchog tu rno zhes bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po mang khyer zhes bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal pos byeyan lag 'char ri dgasam3)mig ces bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po phur bu sgra rig zhes bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po gser mdog gdong zhes bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po stang zil gtsug phudam6ces bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po chu'i shugs 'dzin ces bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po ti se'i gangs thub ces bya ba dang —/ klu'i rgyal po byi ru bzangs zhes bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po phreng sgra snyan ces bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po lug gdong zhes bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po gnas sgrogs (2rimakhas zhes bya ba dang / klu'i rgyal po gzi can ces bya ba dang /klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bu zhes bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po sa ya phrag gnyis dang brgyad 'bum ste/ klu'i rgyal po de dag thams cad kyang theg pa chen po thos par 'dod pa/ thos nas kyang gzhan dag la rgyas par ston par 'dod pa/ dam pa'i chos 'chad par 'dod pa/ dam pa'i chos kun tu bsrung 9bar yongs su 'dzin pa'i ngang tshul can/ dam pa'i chos bsrung nya sgyuba'i khur khyer ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i ngang tshul can sha stag ste/ phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 11zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 64wa 321

lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de nyu1logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnams nathos kyi bumagul sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po sa ya phrag gsum dang drug 'bum la 'di lta ste/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos kyi bu zhes bya ba dang /gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po ma la 'bod ces bya ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po ma 'dzin ces bya ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po ma la dpal du 'dzin pa zhes bya ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po lag sgeg ces bya ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po 'jigs chen 'jigs byed ces bya ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po khro gnyer mig zur can zhes bya ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po sa skul gezhes bya ba dang /gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po nyi ma rengs byed55zhes bya ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po shes ldan ngang tshul can zhes bya ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po nor bu bzang zhes bya ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po 'od chags pad ma mdzod ces bya ba dang ske/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po shing rta gtong76)ba'i pad ma'i snying po dpal zhes bya ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po thaba'i mo las rnam par rgyal ba'i g.yul gyi dpal zhes bya ba dang / gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po lngas rtsen 8zhes bya ba dang /gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po nor bu spyod ces bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po sa ya phrag gsum dang drug 'bum ste/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la rjes su slob par 'dod pa/ dam pa'i chos bsrung tsho)ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i ngang tshul can sha stag ste/ phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe nyu )rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom 61—322

ldan 'das kyi7tu)zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po sa ya phrag bzhi dngu dgu 'bum la 'di lta ste/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po spos kyi glang po che rlung gi50stobs dang mnyam pa'i shugs can zhes bya ba dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po 'ur 'ur zhes bya ba dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po rnga bo che dang ③cang te'u yisasgra ltar dir dir zhes bya ba dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po klu'i stobs dang dregs pa 'jomasam5)pa zhes bya ba dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po nyasang sang zhes bya ba dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po 'od chen zhes bya ba dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gshog zegs bkram zhes bya ba dang /nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po bud rgyal gdong zhes bya ba dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po rig sngags kyi nor bu rinasil sil 'chang zhes bya ba dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bu'i rigs gzhig par dga' 8ba zhes bya ba dang /nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bu'i rigs rab tu 'joms par dga' ba zhes bya ba dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po yang dag par mthong ba zhes bya ba dang ske/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po byams pa chen po'i tshig snyan par sgrogs pa 9zhes bya ba dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po chos dga' zhes bya ba dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser gyi gshog pa sbyin zhes bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po sa ya phrag bzhi dang dgu 'bum ste/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po de dag thams cad kyang dregs pa dang / nga rgyal dang // rgyags pa dang bral ba dang 7/ theg pa chen po la dad pa'i sems thob pa/ dam pa'i 61—323

chos kun tu srung bar gyur pa ༅sha stag ste/ phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe dri za'i rgyal po sa ya phrag drug dang brgyad 'bum la 'di lta ste/ dri za'i rgyal po dga' ba'i snying po zhes bya ba dang / dri za'i rgyal po gdangs snyan ces bya ba dang / dri za'i rgyal po sta gon la dga' ba zhes bya bshedang / dri za'i rgyal po khyu mchog lha zhes bya ba dang / dri za'i rgyal po shugs kyis 'khyig0ripar len pa la dga' ba zhes bya ba dang / dri za'i rgyal po shang shang te'u yis/skad 'byin pa ces bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa dri za'i rgyal po sa ya phrag drug dang brgyad 'bum ste/ dri za'i rgyal po de dag thams cad kyang dregs pa dang ske/ nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang bral ba/ theg pa chen po la dad pa'i sems thob pa/ dam pa'i chos kun tu srung 'ubar gyur pa sha stag ste/ phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong 3)ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe mi'am ci'i rgyal po chen po sa ya phrag dgu dang brgyad 'bum la 'di lta ste/ mi 'am ci'i rgyal po legs mthong yid 'phrog ces bya ba dang ske/ mi 'am ci'i rgyal po klu khyer zhes bya ba dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po bud med sems 'phrog ces bya ba dang / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po bud med kyi snying du sdug pa zhes bya ba dang / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po lha'i bu mo la 'bodams pa zhes bya ba dang /mi'am ci'i rgyal po nyon mongs pa rku ba zhes bya ba dang / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po 61—324

dgra rig dregs 'joms gsod0)ces bya ba dang / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po bdud kyi bu mo dga' ba zhes bya ba dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po bdud kyi sde 'joms zhes bya ba dang / mi 'am ci'i rgyal po ye shes snying po zhes bya ba dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po zab mo'i tshul bsgosalo zhes bya ba dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po dri ma med par〈snang ba'i dpal zhes bya ba dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po dbang po bsrungs zhes bya ba dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po rgyang ring mthong zhes bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa rtso)mi 'am ci'i rgyal po sa ya phrag dgu dang brgyad 'bum ste/ mi 'am ci'i rgyal po de dag thams cad kyang dregs pa dang / nga rgyal dang / rgyags pa dang bral smi ba/ theg pa chen po la dad pa'i sems thob pa/ dam pa'i chos kun tu srungs ribar gyur pa sha stag ste/ phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe srin po'i rgyal po sa ya 7dang brgyad 'bum la na'adi lta ste/ srin po'i rgyal po 'jigs su rung ba zhes bya ba dang / srin po'i rgyal po rtsib ma sreg ces bya ba dang / srin po'i rgyal po drang srong zas len skra 9ser zhes bya ba dang /srin po'i rgyal po so rad rod can zhes bya ba dang / srin po'i rgyal po rna bcas thod pa 1 can zhes bya ba dang / srin po'i rgyal po ser po sbrang rtsi'i mdog ces bya ba dang / srin po'i rgyal po mgul ngar zhes bya ba dang / srin po'i rgyal po sgra bo che zhes bya ba dang / srin po'i rgyal po mgo zed ces bya ba dang / srin po'i rgyal po gyad la skul zhes bya ba dang / srin po'i rgyal po skrag71byed gzugs can zhes bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa srin po'i rgyal po sa ya dang brgyad 'bum 61—325

ste / srin po'i rgyal po de dag thams cad kyang srin po'i rang bzhin dang bral ba/theg pa chen pos sems dul bar gyur pa/ dam pa'i chos kun tu srung7)bar gyur pa sha stag ste/ phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod ( do/ /yang de'i tshe grul bum gyi rgyal po sa ya phrag bdun dang brgyad 'bum la 'di lta ste/ grul bum gyi rgyal po glang po che'i rna ba can zhes bya ba dang / grul bum gyi rgyal po stag ltar dregs pa zhes bya ba dang / grul bum gyi rgyal po shin tu che ba zhes bya ba dang /de dag la sogs pa grul bum gyi rgyal po sa ya phrag bdun dang brgyad 'bum ste/grul bum gyi rgyal po de dag thams cad kyang 3grul bum gyi rang bzhin dang bral ba/dam pa'i chos kun tu srung la bar gyur pa sha stag ste/ phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nasad / bcom ldan rine'adas ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas / bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do / /yang de'i tshe 'byung po'i rgyal po sa ya phrag gsum dang brgyad 'bum la 'di lta ste/ 'byung po'i rgyal po glang po che'i gdong can zhes bya ba dang /'byung po'i rgyal po myu gu zhes bya ba dang / 'byung po'i rgyal po khyim 'bigs rkun po zhes bya ba dang / 'byung po'i rgyal po bod skad can zhes bya ba dang / 'byung po'i rgyal po me tog gi rna cha can zhes bya ba dang / 'byung po'i rgyal po sbal phreng sor rdub can zhes bya ba dang / 'byung po'i rgyal po byi so mdzes zhes bya ba dang /'byung po'i rgyal po byi la na'agros mdzes zhes bya ba dang / 'byung po'i rgyal po sre mo 'gram zhes bya ba dang / 'byung po'i rgyal po spras༄9rubazhin zla ba 1 cigadong zhes bya 64wa 326

ba dang / de dag la sogs pa 'byung po'i rgyal po sa ya phrag gsum dang brgyad 'bum ste/ 'byung po'i rgyal po de dag thams cad kyang theg pa chen po la sems dad cing rab tu dga' ba sha stag ste/ gar byed cing rol mo'i sgra sgrogasam1la sil snyan rnams rdob cing phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe gcod byed kyi bu'i rgyal po sa ya phrag brgyad la 'di lta ste/ gcod byed kyi bu'i rgyal po glog zhi byed btsun zhes bya brtenanodang / gcod byed kyi bu'i rgyal po sna tshogs sngo btsun zhes bya ba dang / gcod byed kyi bu'i rgyal po bya mchu can zhes bya ba dang /gcod byed kyi bu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho 'khrug byed ces bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa gcod byed kyi bu'i rgyal po sa ya phrag brgyad de/ gcod byed kyi bu'i rgyal po de dag thams cad kyang theg pa chen po la mngon par rtse ba/ theg pa chen po la sems mngon par rab tu dga' ba/ theg pa chen po rimangon par 'dod pa/theg pa chen pos mngon par skom 5pa/ theg pa chen po la mngon par sred pa/theg pa chen po la dad pa/ theg pa chen pos bkres pa/ dam pa'i chos kun tu srung bar dam bcas pa/7 dam pa'i chos kun tu bsrung 8bar yongs su 'dzin pa'i ngang tshul can sha stag ste/ phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 9)zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te 9phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe lha ma yin gyi rgyal po bye ba phrag brgyad dang brgyad 'bum la 'di lta ste/lha ma yin gyi rgyal po thag zangs 11ris kyi mdun na sgra sgrogs 12zhes bya ba dang /64—327

lha ma yin gyi rgyal po yul gyis g.yonas3)spyo ba zhes bya ba dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po gang gā dri ma med par 'jug pa zhes bya ba dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po sa steng zhi byed ces bya ba dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po bya mgrin ces bya ba dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po mdung rtse gsum pa 'chang zhes bya ba dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po thal ba'i gtsug phud can zhes bya ba dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po gtum po drag tu khro ba nazhes bya ba dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po me'i rigazi brjid kyi shugs can zhes bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa lha ma yin gyi rgyal po sa ya phrag brgyad dang brgyad 'bum ste/ lha ma yin gyi rgyal po de dag thams cad kyang galha ma yin gyi rang bzhin dang bral ba/ sems dul ba/ yid rab tu brtan pa sha stag ste/phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe rigamasasngags 'chang gi rgyal po sa ya phrag drug dang lnga 'bum la 'di lta ste/ rig56)sngags 'chang gi rgyal po rin chen 'changs zhes bya ba dang / rig na sngags 'chang gi rgyal po longs spyod mi zad 'chang zhes bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa rig ri9sngags 'chang gi rgyal po sa ya phrag 1 cudrug dang lnga 'bum ste/ rig 11/sngags 'chang gi rgyal po de dag thams cad kyang theg pa chen po 'chang ba/ ting nge 'dzin 'dod pa/ ting nge 'dzin tshol bar 'dod pa/ theg pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod pa spyad par 'dod pa/ bdag gi yid gnyis bsal nyi bar 'dod pa/ dam pa'i chos kun tu bsrung /lhabar yongs su 'dzin pa'i tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs gecan sha stag ste / phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 64—328

'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga thob pa/ sa ya phrag dgu dang dgu 'bum la 'di lta ste/ drang srong mis byin gyi bu zhes bya ba dang / drang srong te ma bu ka zhes bya ba dang /drang srong shing shun73)can zhes bya ba dang / drang srong dka'atsha thub can zhes bya ba dang / drang srong yang dag sbyor zhes bya ba dang / drang srong kun tu rgyal zhes bya ba dang / drang srong ngan spong shes ldan zhes bya ba dang / drang srong ri byi rangs byed gzhu can zhes bya ba dang / drang srong ma ma ri dgasam zhes bya ba dang ske/ drang srong sha med zas sbyin zhes bya ba dang / drang srong gnas 'jog sel brtson zhes bya ba dang / drang srong sgra mi snyan lnga len ril pa can zhes bya bam ridang ske/ drang srong 'dod pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pa zhes bya ba 5dang / drang srong dus dang po la dga' ba zhes bya ba dang / drang srong brgya byin lhar 'dzin yun ring gnasadza zhes bya ba dang / drang srong mdzod 7ldan sgra mi snyan ces bya na/ba dang ske/ drang srong bha ra dwa 9dza shing shun can zhes bya ba dang / drang srong klu'i ril pa can zhes bya ba dang / drang srong 'dam bus byin 1 zhes bya ba dang / de dag la sogs pa drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga thob pa sa ya phrag dgu dang dgu 'bum ste/ phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya 11byin sum cu 12rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i bu'i tshogs 'bum 64—329

phrag du ma dang lhan cig0)tu phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe 'jig rten skyong ③ba bzhi lha'i bu 'bum phrag du mas mdun gyis bltas te yongs su bskor nas phyems red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe yul mnyan yod nas sku)ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal rang gi blon po chen po theg pa chen po la mngon par rtse 55ba de dang de dag rang rang gi 'khor dang dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa dag dang lhan cig tu phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe rab sbyin la sogs pa khyim bdag 'bum phrag du ma bslab pa'i gzhi lnga blangs pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la yang dag par zhugs pa/ de dag thams cad chos 'dod pa dang / chos don du gnyer ba dang / 'di ltar byang chub kyi phyogs su gtogs pa'i chos rnams yang dag par bsdu ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyir 'brang ba de dag /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de phyogs snyogacig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe yul pan tsa nas rgyal phran zla ba skyong zhes bya ba rang gi blon po chen po dang / grong khyer gyi dpon po stong bslab pa'i gzhi lnga blangs pa/ bla na med pa 3)yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 64—330

byang chub la yang dag par zhugs pa/ de dag thams cad chos 'dod pa dang /chos don du gnyer ba dang / 'di ltar byang chub kyi phyogs su gtogs pa'i chos rnams yang dag par bsdu ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyir 'brang ba de dag /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe yul chen po bcu drug gi grong khyer dang /tshong rdal dang / lung pa'i mdo dang / grong dang / yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor thams cad kyi mi rnams bcom ldan 'das la blta ba dang /phyag bya ba'i 1phyir lhags te/ de dag thams cad kyang dam pa'i chos kun tu srung ba/ bslab pa'i gzhi lnga blangs pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la yang dag par zhugs pa sha stag ste/ chos 'dod pa dang /chos don du gnyer ba dang / 'di ltar byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yang dag par bsdu ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi phyir 'brang ba/ byams pa'i sems sgom pa de dag phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe btsun mo phreng ldan ma la sogs pa chung nama'i 'khor dang / btsun mo khri drug stong dang /gzhan yang rang gi blon po chen po'i btsun mo 'bum dang lhan cig tu phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe dge bsnyen 4ma sa ga dge bsnyen 5ma 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu phyem red 6kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas 764—331

byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag rmetshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po lha'i bu rdzu 'phrul dang snang ba chen po dang ldan pa 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/me tog gi phur ma ri rab tsam dang / spos dang / me tog phreng ba dang / byug pa dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par gtor nas bdug pa dag gis yongs su bdugs te/ tsan dan gyi phye ma dag gis yongs su gtor nas sil snyan dag brdungs te/ gzhan yang shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyis3)pad ma'i sil ma dag gis khebs par byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de 5phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe tshangs pa rin chen phreng ba 'chang zhes bya ba dang / tshangs pa thor tshugs 'chang zhes bya ba dang /tshangs pa gzhon nu 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu rdzu 'phrul chen pos rgyal po'i khab dang bcas/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri dang bcas/ 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa dang bcas pa thams cad mdzes par byas te/ phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/khor yug khebs pa tsam gyi me tog sil ma dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par gtor te sil snyan rnams brdungs nas/ tsan dan gyi phye ma dang / byug 64—332

pa dag gis gtor te/ rgyal po'i khab dang bcas/ bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri dang bcas/ 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa dang bcas pa/ bsod nams chen po'i zhing du gyur pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po mu stegs kyi tshoganas su gyur pa/ / kho ra khor 5)yug tu la ba dang / ras dang / zab dar dang /zar ma'i ras 'jam po dang / lha'i gos lha'i phye mas bsgos shing tsan dan gyis zhen par byas nas lha'i bdug pas bdugs pa dag bting ste/ mngon par sprul pa bzhin du byas nas me tog gi char mngon par phab nas lha'i tshon rin po che du mas yongs su mdzes par byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi seng ge'i 4)khri 'bum bshams te lan sa ya phrag gsum bskor ba byas nas lhurang rang gi bla gos bcom ldan 'das kyi sku la gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe bdud kyi ris ri kyi lha mo mngon par sdud pa zhes bya ba bdud kyi ris kyi lha mo 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas rnga yab dang / rma bya'i mdongs lag na thogs shing / lha'i pheg 7dang / gling bu dang / bdug pa thogs te/ lha'i me tog sil mas de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par gtor nas sil snyan rnams brdungs 8te gar byed cing glu len no/ /lha mo de dag thams cad kyang theg pa chen po la sems dad cing rab tu dga' ba/ theg pa chen po la dad cing yid dge bar gyur pa sha stag ste/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe lha'i bu mo chu shing lta bu zhes bya ba la 64—333

sogs pa lha'i bu mo 'bum phrag du ma phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ lha'i gser gyi tsong 1tsong dang / lha'i rin po che'i phreng ba dang / lha'i me tog gi phreng ba dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par gtor te sil snyan rnams brdungs nanas tsan dan gyi phye ma dang byug pa dag gis kyang gtor to/ /lha'i bu mo de dag thams cad kyang bud med kyi sems kyi g.yo sgyu'i rang bzhin dang bral ba/theg pa chen po la sems dad cing rab tu dga' ba/ theg pa chen po la dad cing yid dge bar gyur pa sha stag ste/ glu len cing gar byed las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/la bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de nyid kyi 5tshe ljongs kyi phyogs dag na dge slong ji snyed gnas shing 'khod pa de dag thams cad rgyal po'i khab dang / bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri ga la ba der 'dong bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul mngon par 'du mdzad pa mngon par mdzad do/ /der phyin nas kyang bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der 'dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe nam mkha' las sil snyan stong gi glu dbyangs lta bu 'thun 7pa dang mi 'thun pa'i sgra mngon par grag ste/stang nazil gyi ri lta bur 'dug pa'i sprin chen po'i tshogs lha'i rin po che'i chus yongs su rgyas pa dag kyang / bcom ldan 'das seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs shing 964wa 334

chos ston pa mnod 1pa'i phyir sdod 5)do/ /yang de'i tshe rlung gi rgyal po chen po bzhi la 'di lta ste/ rlung gi rgyal po chen po rnam par 'thor rlung zhes bya ba dang ske/ rlung gi rgyal po chen po 4rnam par 'thor rlung chen po zhes bya ba dang /rlung gi rgyal po chen po shugs ma nyams pa zhes bya ba dang / rlung gi rgyal po chen po 'jigs byed chen po zhes bya ba rnams lha'i bde ba'i longs spyod dang /yongs su spyod 45pa'i dus tshigs drug gi bde zhing bsil ba'i me tog dang rnam par 'dres pa'i dri bsung zhim po'i ngad gtong zhing / rlung gi rgyal po chen po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la sri zhu bya ba'i phyir sprin chen po nerab tu 'gyed de ske/ bcom ldan 'das seng ge'i sgra chen po sgrogs shing nachos ston pa mnod pa'i phyir stodas9do// //'phags pa sprin chen po'i mdo/ bam po gnyis pa/ yang de'i tshe ngang pa'i rgyal po seng ge ltar dpa' ba zhes bya ba ngang pa 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas rang rang gi 'dab 1 ma thal mo'i thabs su sbyar te/bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ slob dpon dang slob mas legs par 11bsgrubs pa'i sil snyan stong gi glu dbyangs lta bur skad 'thun par 'byin cing / ngang pa'i tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das la sri zhu bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa'i phyogs gcig tu go bzung ngo / /yang de'i tshe rma bya'i rgyal po blta na 'od chags zhes bya ba rma bya'i rigs 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der 64—335

dong ste lhags nas rang rang gi 'dabs1ma thal mo'i thabs su sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas lha dang / dri za'i slob dpon dang slob mas legs par bsgrubs pa'i sil snyan stong gi glu dbyangs lta bur mgrin pa bltams te naskad snyan cing 'thun pa 'byin te/ rma bya'i tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das la sri zhu bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa'i phyogs gcig tu go bzung ngo ske/ /yang de'i tshe khu byug gi rgyal po sde bdag ces bya ba khu byug gi rgyal po 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas rang rang gi 'dab ri kyim thal mo'i thabs su sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas sil snyan stong dang 'dra ba'i sgra phyung ste tshoca co'i sgra bton nas/bung ba'i mdog 'dra ba'i khu byug gi tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das la sri zhu bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa'i phyogs gcig tu go bzung pa ngo / /yang de'i tshe gangs kyi ri la gnas pa'i bya ka la ping ma'i rgyal po pad ma'i 'dab snyom 'dra ba'i mig ces bya ba bya 7ka la ping ku'i rgyal po 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas rang rang gi 'dab nam thal mo'i thabs su sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas yid du 'ong ba'i sgra phyung ste/ ka 9la ping ma'i tshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das la sri zhu bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa'i phyogs gcig 61—336

tu go bzung ngo / /yang de'i tshe bya'i rgyal po shang shang te'u zhes bya ba bya'i rgyal po shang shang te'u 'bum phrag du ma dang lhan cig tu phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas rang rang gi 'dab 4)ma thal mo'i thabs su sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas yid du 'ong ba'i sgra phyung ste/ shang shang te'u yi natshogs kyis bcom ldan 'das la sri zhu bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa'i phyogs gcig tu go bzung ngo / /yang de'i tshe bya'i tshogs thams cad phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas rang rang gi 'dab ri ma thal mo'i thabs su sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas yid du 'ong ba'i sgra 'bum phrag du ma phyung ste/ nam mkha'i dkyil yongs su gang bar byas nas bcom ldan 'das la sri zhu bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa'i phyogs gcig tu go bzung ngo / /yang de'i tshe ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi lha ri btang bzung cadang btang bzung 5chen po'i lha 'bum phrag du ma dang / lha'i bu 'od chen dang lhan cig tu phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong 6ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas 'od ma'i tshal 7 bya ka lan da ka gnas pa'i phyogs gcig tu go 8bzung ngo / /yang de'i tshe gangs kyi ri la gnas pa'i sman gyi tshogs kyi lha mo rnams phyem red kyi dus kyi tshe rang rang gi gnas nas 64—337
