cad ni gnas ma mchis pa ste/ gnas rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ gnas kyi rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/gnas kyi rang bzhin las gnas ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi/ gnas kyi rang bzhin nyid gnas ma mchis pa lags te/ gnas kyi rang bzhin gyis gnas ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad gnas ma mchis pa lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni dngos po ma mchis pa lags te/ dngos po rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ dngos po'i rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ dngos po'i rang bzhin las dngos po ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi/ dngos po'i 1rang bzhin nyid dngos po ma mchis pa lags te/ dngos po'i rinarang bzhin gyis dngos po ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad dngos po ma mchis pa lags rin bcom ldan 'das kyis dngos po rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni gnyis su ma mchis pa 4lags te/ gnyis rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ gnyis kyi rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/gnyis kyi rang bzhin las gnyis su ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi/ gnyis kyi rang bzhin nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa lags te/ gnyis kyi rang bzhin gyis 64wa 637

gnyis su ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad gnyis su ma mchis pa lags na / 1bcom ldan 'das kyis gnyis rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rirlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir sa bsdu bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni mtshan nyid ma mchis pa lags te/ mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/mtshan nyid kyi rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ mtshan nyid kyi rang bzhin las mtshan nyid ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi/ mtshan nyid kyi rang bzhin nyid mtshan nyid ma mchis pa lags te/ mtshan nyid kyi rang bzhin gyis mtshan nyid ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad mtshan nyid ma mchis pa lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis mtshan nyid rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni dmigs pa ma mchis pa lalags te/ dmigs pa rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/dmigs pa'i rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ dmigs pa'i rang bzhin las dmigs pa ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi5/ dmigs pa'i rang bzhin nyid dmigs pa ma mchis pa lags 6te/ dmigs pa'i rang bzhin gyis / dmigs pa ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad dmigs pa ma mchis pa lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis dmigs pa rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang 64—638

dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni dbu ma'i lam lags te/ mtha' rnam par dag pa 1lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/mtha'i rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ mtha'i rang bzhin las dbu ma'i lam gzhan ma lags kyi/ mtha'i rang bzhin nyid dbu ma'i lam lags te / mtha'i rang bzhin gyis dbu ma'i lam shes pa des chos thams cad dbu ma'i lam lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis mtha' rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi narlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni lus ma mchis pa lags te / lus rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ lus kyi rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ lus kyi rang bzhin las lus ma mchis pa nyid gzhan ma lags kyi/ lus kyi rang bzhin nyid lus ma mchis pa nyid lags te/ lus kyi rang bzhin gyis lus ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad lus ma mchis pa lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis lus rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni 'khor ba ma mchis pa lags te/ 'khor ba rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/'khor ba'i rang bzhin las 'khor ba ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi/ 'khor 64—639

ba'i rang bzhin nyid 'khor ba ma mchis pa lags te/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin gyis 'khor ba ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad 'khor ba ma mchis pa lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor ba rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das 1chos thams cad ni brjod du med pa ma mchis pa lags te/ brjod du med pa rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin las gzhani ma lags pa'i slad du ste / brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin las brjod du med pa ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi/ brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin nyid brjod du med pa ma mchis pa lags te/ brjod du med pa'i rang bzhin gyis brjod du med pa ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad brjod du med pa ma mchis pa lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis brjod du med pa rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi tsho stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu ri bar gsol / bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa lags te/ kun nas nyon mongs pa rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin las kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin nyid kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa lags te/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin 61—640

gyis kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis kun nas nyon mongs pa rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi 41)rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas nabyang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni chags pa ma mchis pa lags te/ chags pa rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ chags pa'i rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ chags pa'i rang bzhin las chags pa ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi/ chags pa'i rang bzhin nyid chags pa ma mchis pa lags te/chags pa'i rang bzhin gyis 5chags pa ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad chags pa ma mchis pa lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis chags pa rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi 4 stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu gebar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni rlom sems ma mchis pa lags te/ rlom sems rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ rlom sems kyi rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du56)ste/ rlom sems kyi rang bzhin las rlom sems ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi / rlom sems kyi rang bzhin nyid rlom sems ma mchis pa lags te/ rlom sems kyi rang bzhin gyis rlom sems ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad rlom sems ma mchis pa lags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rlom sems rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag 64wa 641

bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod ga1)pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni yod pa ma mchis pa lags te/ yod pa rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ yod pa'i rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/yod pa'i rang bzhin las yod pa ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi/ yod pa'i rang bzhin nyid yod pa ma mchis pa lags te/ yod pa'i rang bzhin gyis yod pa ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad yod pa ma mchis pa lags na/bcom ldan 'das kyis yod pa rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsolam/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni ming ma mchis pa lags te/ming rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ ming gi rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ ming gi rang bzhin las ming ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi ming gi rang bzhin nyid ming ma mchis pa lags te/ ming gi rang bzhin gyis ming ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad ming ma mchis pa lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis ming rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi (0rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni bdag ma mchis pa lags te/ bdag rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bdag gi rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ bdag gi rang bzhin las 64—642

bdag ma mchis pa'i rang bzhin gzhan ma lags kyi/ bdag gi rang bzhin nyid bdag ma mchis pa lags te/ bdag gi rang bzhin gyis bdag ma mchis pa shes pa des/ chos thams cad bdag ma mchis pa lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni rgyu dang rkyen gyi bya ba ma mchis pa lags te/ rgyu dang rkyen gyi bya ba rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe 1)na/ rgyu dang rkyen gyi bya ba'i rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ rgyu dang rkyen gyi bya ba'i rang bzhin las rgyu dang rkyen gyi bya ba nam mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi/ rgyu dang rkyen gyi bya ba'i rang bzhin nyid rgyu dang rkyen gyi bya ba ma mchis pa lags te/ rgyu dang rkyen gyi bya ba'i rang bzhin gyis zhe rgyu dang rkyen gyi bya ba ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad rgyu dang rkyen gyisari bya ba ma mchis pa lags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyu dang rkyen gyi bya ba rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol / bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni 'dres pa ma mchis pa lags te/'dres pa rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'dres pa'i rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ 'dres pa'i rang bzhin las 'dres pa ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyir kyi/ 'dres pa'i rang bzhin nyid 'dres pa ma mchis pa lags te/ 'dres pa'i rang bzhin gyis 'dres pa ma mchis pa shes pa 64wa 643

des chos thams cad 'dres pa ma mchis pa lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dres pa rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni yi ge ma mchis pa lags te/ yi ge rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ yi ge'i rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ yi ge'i rang bzhin las yi ge ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi/yi ge'i rang bzhin nyid yi ge ma mchis pa lags te/ yi ge'i rang bzhin gyis yi ge ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad yi ge ma mchis pa lags na bcom ldan 'das kyis 17yi ge rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni nga rgyal med pa ma mchis pa lags te/ nga rgyal med pa rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ nga rgyal med pa'i rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ nga rgyal med pa'i rang bzhin las nga rgyal med pa ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi/ nga72)rgyal med pa'i rang bzhin nyid nga 5rgyal ma mchis pa lags te/ nga rgyal med pa'i rang bzhin gyis nga rgyal med pa ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad nga rgyal med pa ma mchis pa lags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nga rgyal med pa rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 64—644

'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad ni yul 1bsam gyis mi khyab pa lags te/ yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam par dag pa lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin las gzhan ma lags pa'i slad du ste/ yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin las yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa ma mchis pa gzhan ma lags kyi/ yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin nyid yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa ma mchis pa lags te/yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin gyis yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa ma mchis pa shes pa des chos thams cad yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa ma mchis pa lags na/bcom ldan 'das kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun nas nyon mongs pa can dag tu yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas byang chub sems dpa' gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ de bzhin du stong pa nyid kyi sgor 'jug pa grangs med 3)pa dag la phan tshun gnyen por gyur pa 'dres da pa'i tshul dag gis 'jug par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun nas nyon mongs pa can dag tu thabs rnam pa sna tshogs la mkhas pa'i tshul gyis mtshams sbyor ba'i 'jig rten gyi spyod pa rnams dang / ye shes dang / gzigs pa dang / khams dang ske/ rgyu dang / dmigs pa dang / nges pa'i tshig dang / gdags pa dang /rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor bas sems can rgya mtsho ji snyed bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ④yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang lags pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis 61—645

'khor 'dir bsdu bar gsol/ de skad ces gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor de dag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa thugs su chud de/ phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mthong bar 'dod pa mkhyen nas bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag bsdu bar bya ba'i phyir zhabs gnyis kyi mthil nas 'od zer ga1rgya mcho1re sprin 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed phyung ngo / /de bzhin du zhabs gnyis kyi sor mo'i tshigs re re dang / de bzhin du rje ngar gnyis dang / de bzhin du pus mo'i lha nga gnyis dang / de bzhin du brla gnyis dang / de bzhin du sta zur gnyis dang ske/ de bzhin du rtsib logs gnyis dang / de bzhin du lte ba khung dang /de bzhin du phrag pa gnyis dang / de bzhin du dpung mgo gnyis dang / de bzhin du dpung pa gnyis dang / de bzhin du lag mthil gnyis dang / de bzhin du phyag sor gyi 2 tshigs re re dang / de bzhin du gtsug tor rinadang /de bzhin du mdzod spu dang / de bzhin du dbu'i skra nyag ma re re dang / de bzhin du mtshan re re dang / de bzhin du dpe byad 4 bzang po re re dang / de bzhin du spu'i khung bu re re chosanas kyang 'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i 56klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed phyung 7ste/ shar phyogs su 'phros so/ /de las 'od zer gcig gis kyang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i na klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa 9snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur te/ 'jig 64wa 646

rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang 'od zer gcig gis khyab pa de gnyis kyis khyab par mi byed do/ /shar phyogs ji lta ba de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang dang /de bzhin du byang shar gyi mtshams dang / de bzhin du shar lho'i mtshams dang /de bzhin du lho nub kyi mtshams dang / de bzhin du nub byang gi mtshams dang /de bzhin du steng dang 'og gi phyogs su yang 'od zer rgya mtsho de (1 dag thams cad mi'aphros so/ /de las 'od zer gcig gis kyang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho snang ba chen pos khyab par gyur te/ gang gcig gis khyab pa de gnyis kyis khyab par mi byed do/ /yang de'i tshe shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'od zer de dag gis snang bar byas pa gang yin pa de dag las 'jig rten gyi khams re re nas byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya samatsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed lhags so / /byang chub sems dpa' re re'i 'khor kyang byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed lhags na/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing cabacu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig brjod du 64—647

med pa snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams 'bum gyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams stong gi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams lnga bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed lta ci smos/'khor 'jig rten gyi khams lnga'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams gcig gi rdul nyu)phra rab kyi rdul snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor gang gā'i klung brgya'i bye ma snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor gang gā'i klung nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bye ma snyed lta ci smos/'khor gang gā'i klung bcu'i bye ma snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor gang gā'i klung lnga'i bye ma snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor gang gā'i klung (gegacig gi bye ma snyed lta ci smos/'khor gang gā'i klung gi )bye ma'i gi)bzhi cha snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor gang gā'i klung gi bye ma'i brgyad cha snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor gang gā'i klung gi bye ma'i bcu drug cha snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor gang gā'i klung gi bye ma'i cha nyi shu snyed lta ci smos/'khor bye ba phrag brgya lta ci smos/ 'khor bye ba phrag lnga bcu lta ci smos/ 'khor bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga 5lta ci smos/ 'khor bye ba phrag bcu lta ci smos/ 'khor bye ba phrag lnga lta ci smos/ 'khor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba gcig lta ci smos te / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po re res kyang nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po'i (7)sprin bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya mtsho grangs med pa brjod pa/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po 64—648

bcu'i tshad tsam gyi tu)char gyis chags pa med cing sgrib pa medamatshon/la ma 'dres pa'i nam mkha' khyab par phab nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po re res kyang nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po'i sprin ye shes kyi tshogs rgya mtsho grangs med pa brjod pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po bcu'i tshad tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa la gtor cing mngon par gtor to/ /gtor cing mngon par gtor nas bcom ldan 'das la lan grangs med par bskor ba byas te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /shar phyogs ji gulta ba de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang gi phyogs su yang de dang 'dra'o/ /shar lho'i mtshams su yang de dang 'dra'o/ /lho nub kyi mtshams su yang de dang 'dra'o//nub byang gi mtshams su yang de dang 'dra'o/ /byang shar gyis4)mtshams su yang de dang 'dra'o/ /steng du yang de dang 'dra'o/ /'og gi phyogs su yang de dang 'dra ste / 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang dag 'od zer de dag gis snang bar byas pa de dag las 'jig rten gyi khams gcig nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed lhags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' re re yang 'khor byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i 5klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed kyis bskor nas/ 'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig brjod du med pa snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams brgya'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed lta ci smos / 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams lnga bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed lta ci smos/64wa 649

'khor 'jig rten gyi khams nyi shu rtsa 1)lnga'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed lta ci smos/'khor 'jig rten gyi khams bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams lnga'i 5rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams gcig gi ri rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed lta ci smos/ 'khor gang gā'i klung gcig gi bye ma snyed kyi bar 5du lta ci smos/ 'khor bye ba phrag brgya lta ci smosal/ 'khor bye ba phrag lnga bcu lta ci smos/ 'khor bye ba phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga lta ci smos / 'khor bye ba phrag bcu lta ci smos/ 'khor bye ba phrag lnga lta ci smos/'khor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba gcig lta ci smos te/byang chub sems dpa' re res kyang / nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po'i sprin pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa brjod pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po bcu'i tshad tsam gyi char gyis chags pa med cing sgrib pa med 5la ma 'dres pa'i nam mkha' khyab 7par phab nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas byang chub sems dpa' re res kyang nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po'i sprin sa rgya 3)mtsho grangs med pa brjod pa/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po bcu'i tshad tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa la gtor cing mngon par gtor to/ /gtor cing mngon par gtor nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ lan grangs med par bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe phyogs bcu kun gyi phyogs cha 9re rer 'jig rten gyi 3 tshokhams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi 11khams rgya mtsho las/ 'jig rten gyi khams re re'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul re re la byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi 64wa 650

khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs 1med pa snyed gnas par gyur te/ 'on kyang sems can su la yang gnod pa'am sgrib pa med do/ /2 'jig rten gyi khams rnams 5dang ske/ gling rnams dang / lhun po dang / lhun po chen po dang / btang bzung dang /④ btang bzung 5chen po dang / gangs dang / gangs chen po dang ske/ khor yug dang / ne/khor yug chen po rnams dang / rgya mtsho dang / rgya mtsho chen po rnams dang / lha'i gnas rnams dang / klu dang / mtsho bran dang ske/ mtshe'u 7rnams dang / grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal niridang ske/ ljongs dang / yulas9ci'akhor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang rnams la yang gnod pa'am sgrib pa med des/ sngon ji lta ba de bzhin du phyis kyang bya ba la 'jug par gyur to17/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang bsam pa ji lta ba dang / 'dul ba ji lta ba de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa mngon sum du bzhugs par mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i 'khor dang /byang chub sems dpa' kha cig 12'di snyam du sems te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kun nas nyon mongs pa can dag tu thabs rnam pa sna tshogs la mkhas pa'i tshul gyi 1lhamatshams sbyor ba'i 'jig rten gyi spyod pa 1 rnams dang / ye shes dang / gzigs pa dang / khams dadang / rgyu dang /dmigs pa dang / nges pa'i tshig dang / gdags pa dang / rnam par gzhag pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi stobs la sbyor ba dag gis sems can gang dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par mdzad pa dag ci 1764wa 651

thams cad 'khor 'dir 'dus sam/ 'on te gzhan yang gang dag ma 'dus pa dag kyang yod dam zhig gu snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi 1sems kyi yongs su rtog pa thugs kyis mkhyen nas/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la bka' stsal pa /kye rgyal ba'i sras dper na nyan thos chen po rgya mtsho rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa/mngon par shes pa la rnam par rtse ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed yod par gyur la/ nyan thos chen po de dag re res kyang se gol gtogs pa re re la sems bskyed pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed bskyed de/ nyan thos chen po re res kyang sems bskyed pa re res gom pa 'dor ba rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed song la / gom pa re re bor bas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi 4khams rgya mtsho 'da' bar byed de/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang du nyan thos chen po gcig 'gro ba der gnyis mi 'gro ba de lta bu'i tshul gyis bskal pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klungs5)lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed du 'gro bar byed detshi/ shar phyogs ji lta ba de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang /byang dang / de bzhin du shar lho'i mtshams dang / de bzhin du lho nub kyi 61—652

mtshams dang / de bzhin du nub byang gi mtshams dang / de bzhin du byang shar gyi mtshams phyogs 1su song zhing / nyan thos chen po gcig gang du song ba der gnyis mi 'gro la tshon de nas mi la la zhig gis 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de dag thams cad grongs /khyer gcig tu byas la/ srid pa'i rtse mor thugs par ra bas kun nas bskor te/ lag mthil bzhin du mnyam par gyur cing rdo dang /gsog ma dang / gyo mo med par byas nas/ bye mas bkang ste/ byur bur byas la / de nas mi des bye ma'i grong khyer de nas byes45)ma 'bru re re nas blangs la/grong khyer de'i nang gi bye ma'i 'bru ji snyed yod pa de snyed 46kyi char gses 7te/ rtsi ba'i ri'u/thabs 'dis bye ma'i 'bru de dag thams cad char gses lta la/ de nas mi de bye ma'i 'bru char gses 1 tshopa de dag thams cad shar phyogs su khyer te/ bye ma'i 'bru char gses 31pa de dag ji snyed pa de snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'das shing / bye ma'i 'bru char gses 12pa gcig bor te/ rtsis 1 pa'i thabs 'dis bye ma'i 'bru char gses pa de dag thams cad 7bor te/ shar phyogs su ji lta ba de bzhin du lho dang / de bzhin du nub dang / de bzhin du byang dang /de bzhin du shar lho'i mtshams dang / de bzhin du lho nub kyi mtshams dang /de bzhin du nub byang gi bematshams dang / de bzhin du byang shar gyi mtshams su bor la/ de nas mi des 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang dag tu bye ma'i 'bru char gses pa de dag bor ba dang / gang dag tu ma bor ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de dag thams cad grong khyer gcig tu byas la/ srid pa'i rtse mor thug par ra bas kun nas bskor te/ lag 30mthil bzhin du mnyam par gyur cing ske/ rdo dang / gseg ma dang / gyo mo med par byas nas bye 1 mas bkang 64wa 653

ste byur bur byas la/ nga'i 1)byang chub sems dpa' 'khor 'dir 'dus pa 'di dag ni bye ma'i grong khyer de las bye ma'i 'bru gcig 5tsam du zad do/ /nga'i risabyang chub sems dpa' 'dir ma 'dus pa ni grong khyer de'i nang gi bye ma lhag ma ji snyed pa tsam mo/ /de'i lhag ma'i bye ma snyed kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyang ming 'thun 4la rus gcig pa sha stag yin nas /ming tha dad pa dang rus tha dad pa lta ci smos/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku'i kha dog yongs su grub pa mtha' yas pa la sgrub pa'i gzungs thob pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su dag pa du mar sangs rgyas 'byung ba ston pa dang /'jig rten gyi khams kun nas nyon mongs pa can yongs su sbyong ba dang /sems can gyi khams bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su smin par byed pa'i khyu mchog tu gyur pa dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag cag gis byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi nang nas kha cig gi sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'i khyu mchog tu gyur pa mthong na ci ma rung snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag 'khor de'i nang du bsdu ba dang / de dag gis 6)sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'i khyu mchog tu gyur pa bstan pa'i phyir 7se gol gyi sgra mdzad do/ /de'i tshe shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang dag nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag 'khor der na'adus pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de dag gi 'dab 9kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang yin pa de dag gi ches 1 pha rol 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra 61—654

rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho rnams 'gul/ rab tu 'gul/ kun tu rab tu 'gul/ g.yo1/rab tu g.yon/ kun tu rab tu g.yod/ ldeg /rab tu ldeg /kun tu rab tu ldeg /chem chem/ rab tu chem chem/ kun tu rab tu chem chem/ 'khrug /rab tu 'khrug /kun tu rab tu 'khrug /'ur 'ur/ rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun tu rab tu 'ur 'ur te/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i 'jig rten gyi khams re re na shar phyogs dma' na nub phyogs mtho/ nub phyogs dma' na shar phyogs mtho / lho phyogs dma' na byang phyogs mtho/ byang phyogs dma' na lho phyogs mtho / byang shar mtshams kyi phyogs dma' na lho nub rimatshams kyi phyogs mtho/lho nub mtshams kyi phyogs dma' na byang shar mtshams kyi phyogs mtho/ shar lho mtshams kyi phyogs dma' na nub byang mtshams kyi phyogs mtho/ nub byang mtshams kyi phyogs dma' na shar lho mtshams kyi phyogs mtho/ mtha' dma' na dbus mtho/ dbus dma' na mtha' mtho ste/ shar phyogs ji lta ba de bzhin du lho phyogs kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /nub phyogs kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /byang phyogs kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /shar lho'i mtshams dang / lho nub kyi mtshams dang /nub byang gi mtshams dang / byang shar gyi mtshams kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /steng dang 'og gi phyogs kyang de dang 'dra'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang dag nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag 'khor der 'dus pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de dag gi 'dab 5kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang yin pa de dag gi pha rol gyi yang ches pha rol/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba 61—655

khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'gul/ rab tu 'gul / kun blurab tu 'gul/ g.yo(17/ rab tu g.yo/5) kun tu rab tu g.yo ske/ ldeg /rab tu ldeg /kun tu rab tu ldeg /chem chem/ rab tu chem chem/ kun tu rab tu chem chem/ 'khrug /rab tu 'khrug /kun tu rab tu 'khrug /'ur 'ur/ rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun tu rab tu 'ur 'ur te/'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i 'jig rten gyi khams re re yang shar phyogs dma' na nub phyogs mtho/ nub phyogs dma' na shar phyogs mtho/ lho phyogs dma' na byang phyogs mtho/ byang phyogs dma' na lho phyogs mtho/ byang shar mtshams kyi phyogs dma' na lho nub mtshams kyi phyogs mtho/ lho nub mtshams kyi phyogs dma' na byang shar mtshams kyi phyogs mtho/ shar lho mtshams kyi phyogs dma' na nub byang mtshams kyi phyogs mtho/ nub byang mtshams kyi phyogs dma' na shar lho mtshams kyi phyogs mtho/ mtha' dma' na dbus mtho/ dbus dma' na mtha' mtho bar gyur to/ /yang de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi kun nas phyogs bcur 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag gi 'jig rten gyi khams re re na rdul phra rab kyi rdul re re na/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gnas par gyur te/ 'dzam bu'i chu cabo'i gser gyi stegs bu rin po ches spras pas ni bskor rin po che'i tsong tsong gis ni mdzes par byas/ gdugs dang ske/ rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan ni bsgreng sku / dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba'i bla 61—656

re ha)ni bres/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying pos ni byugs/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i dra bas ni bkab/ rin po che mthon kham chen po ni mig mangs daris su bris )te nor bu rin po che'i dra ba'i phyogs re re nas kyang mu tig gi rgyanas5phreng kha dog sna tshogs pa kha dog du ma dang ldan pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med grangs med pa dag 'phyang ngo / /rin po che'i rgyan phreng kha dog sna tshogs pa kha dog du ma dang ldan pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med grangs med pa dag 'phyang ngo / /dar gyi lda ldi kha dog sna tshogs pa kha dog du ma dang ldan pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med grangs med pa dag 'phyang ngo ske/ / ras kyi lda ldi kha dog sna tshogs pa kha dog du ma dang ldan pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med grangs med pa dag 'phyang ngo / /dzinadar gyi chun kor kha dog du ma dang ldan pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med dpag tu med pa dag 'phyang ngo / /dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba kha dog sna tshogs pa kha dog du ma dang ldan pa 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med grangs med pa dag 'phyangs ngo / /rin po che'i rgyan phreng dang / mu tig gi rgyan phreng de dag la rlung gis phog na yang ske/ lha'i sgra yid du 'ong ba dag 'byung ste/ rin po che'i rgyan phreng 8)dang /mu tig gi rgyan phreng rlung gis phog ri9)pa de dag las lha'i sgra yid du 'ong ba 'byung ba de lta bu ni sil snyan gyi yan lag dpe med pa 'bum phrag 1 bye ba brdungs pa'i 1 slob dpon gyis brdungs pa las kyang de lta bu'i sgra snyan pa mi 'byung ngo / /dril bu g.yer ku'i phreng ba rlung gis phog pa de dag las kyang lha yul pa'i sgra yid du 'ong zhing zab pa/ 'byung ba de lta bu ni gser gyi snod 'dzam bu'i gling gi tshad tsam brdungs pa las kyang de lta bu'i sgra 12zab cing yid du 'ong ba mi 'byung ngo / /64wa 657

mig mangs 1ris re re las kyang rin po che'i shing ljon pa re re yod de/ rin po che'i stegs bus ni bskor/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / rin po che'i phreng bas ni mdzes par byas/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan ni bsgreng na/ rin po che'i rgyan phreng gi rgyan dpag tu med grangs med pas ni brgyan / mu tig gi rgyan phreng gi rgyan dpag tu med grangs med pas kyang brgyan to / /ras kyi lda ldi'i rgyan /dpag tu med grangs med pa dang / me tog gi lda ldi'i rgyan dpag tu med grangs med pa dang / dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba'i rgyan dpag tu med grangs med 5pas kyang brgyan to/ /rin po che'i shing ljon pa re re'i drung na yang rin po che'i seng ge'i khri 'phang du dpag tshad lnga brgya pa yod de/rin po che'i stegs bus ni bskor/ nor bu dang / mu tig dang / rin po che'i phreng bas ni mdzes par byas/ gdugs dang / rgyal 56)mtshan dang / ba dan ni bsgreng 7/ dril bu g.yer ku'i dra ba'i bla re〈87ni bres/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying pos ni byugs/ me tog man dā ra ba dang / man dā ra ba chen po dang / man dzu sha ka dang / man dzu sha kum9chen po dang / mdog mdzes dang /mdog 1 mdzes chen po dang / 'khor lo dang / 'khor lo chen po dang / sna ma dang ske/ bar shi ka 11dang / ta ru ni dang / bal li dang / go ta ra ni dang /rab tu dri zhim dang / da nu 12ska ri dang / lha'i sna ma dang / ud 1 pa la dang ske/ pad ma dang / ku mu da dang 7/ pad ma dkar po dang / me tog chen po rnams ni bkram/ nor bu rin po che glog gi sgron 15ma'i rgyan phreng gi rgyan dpag tu med grangs med pa dang / nor bu rin po che nyi zla'i sgron ma'i rgyan phreng gi rgyan dpag tu med grangs med pa dang / nor bu rin po che snang ba thams cad 64wa 658

'dus pa'i rgyan phreng gi rgyan dpag tu med grangs med pa dang / nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po'i rgyan phreng gi 1 rgyan dpag tu med grangs med pa dang /nor bu rin po che ze ba can gyi rgyan phreng gi rgyan dang / nor bu rin po che seng ge'i ze ba can gyi rgyan phreng gi rgyanas nadang / nor bu rin po che seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi rgyan phreng gi rgyan /dang / nor bu rin po che brgya byin thogs pa'i rgyan phreng gi rgyanams dang / nor bu rin po che lha thams cad kyi 'od kyi rgyan phreng gi rgyan55tshodang / nor bu rin po che rdo rje'i 'od kyi rgyan phreng gi rgyan 6)dang / nor bu rin po che pad ma ral gri 7rgyan phreng gi rgyan nadang / nor bu rin po che chu 'dang gi rgyan phreng gi rgyan 9dang / nor bu rin po che be+e drur+ya'i hu rirgyan phreng gi rgyan 11dang / nor bu rin po che an da rnyil gyi rgyan phreng gi rgyan gyis kyang brgyan to / /nor bu rin po che rdo'i snying po'i rgyan phreng gi rgyan gyis kyang brgyan to/ /nor bu rin po che dpal gyi snying po'i rgyan phreng gi rgyan gyis kyang brgyan to/ /nor bu rin po che mdzes bkod kyi rgyan phreng gi rgyan gyis kyang brgyan to/ /mu tig dkar po'i rgyan phreng gi rgyan gyis kyang brgyan to12/ /mu tig mthon 3)ka'i rgyan phreng gi rgyan gyis kyang brgyan to/ /mu tig ser po'i rgyan phreng gi rgyan gyis kyang brgyan to/ /mu tig dmar po'i rgyan phreng gi rgyan gyis kyang brgyan to/ /mu tig kyi gser mdog gi rgyan phreng gi rgyan gyis kyang brgyan to/ /mu tig nam mkha' lomadog gi rgyan phreng gi rgyan gyis kyang brgyan to/ /mu tig gi 'bru'i ngos re re dang ske/ rin po che'i 17'bru'i ngos re re nas kyang sems kyi skad cig re re la 'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin dpag tu med pa dang / grangs med pa dang / mtshungs pa med pa dang / gzhal du med pa dang / tshad med pa dag byung ngo / /de la 64wa 659

'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kham1)cig las ni bsod nams kyi tshogs tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjodalo3)pa dag byung ngo / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig las ni ye shes kyi tshogs tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjod yipa dag byung ngo / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig latswani pha rol tu phyin pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjod gepa dag byung ngo / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig las ni sa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjod pa dag byung ngo / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig las ni gzungs tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjod pa dag byung ngo / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig las ni rnam par thar pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad56)par bstan pa rjodaho7)pa dag byung ngo / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig las ni so so yang dag par rig pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjod pa dag byung ngo / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig las ni mngon par shes pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjod pa dag byung ngo / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig las ni smon lam tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjod pa dag byung ngo ske/ /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig las ni brtson 'grus rtsom pa tha dad pa'i 33rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjod pa dag byung ngo / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig las ni dbugs 'byin pa 'thobs9pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjod pa dag byung ngo / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig las ni byang chub sems dpa' la 'jug pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjod 1 pa dag byung ngo / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig las 64wa 660

ni de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jug pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjod pa dag byung ngo / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig las ni sems can gyi bsam pa dang / spyod pa la 'jug pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjod pa dag byung ngo / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig las ni 'jig rten gyi khams la 'jug pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjod pa dag byung ngo / /'od zer rgya mtsho'i sprin kha cig las ni bskal pa la 'jug pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa rjod7pa dag byung ngo / /yang de'i tshe shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang yin pa de dag ni 'gul/ rab tu 'gul/ kun tu rab tu 'gul/ g.yo(5/ rab tu g.yosnol/ kun tu rab tu g.yoci/ ldeg /rab tu ldeg /kun tu rab tu ldeg /chem chem/ rab tu chem chem/ kun tu rab tu chem chem/ 'khrug /rab tu 'khrug /kun tu rab tu 'khrug /'ur 'ur/5) rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun tu rab tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /de nas 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de dag las/'jig rten gyi khams re re nas kyang 467/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed lhags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po re re'i 'khor yang byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams (7 rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed lhags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' re res kyang nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po'i 3)sprin gzungs rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjod 59pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po bcu'i tshad tsam gyi char gyis chags 1 64wa 661

pa med cing / sgrib pa med 17la ma 'dres pa'i nam mkha' khyab par byas nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ byang chub sems dpa' re res kyang lha'i nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po'i sprin ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjod ldepa stong gsum gyi stong chen po dbacu'i tshad tsam gyis chags pa med cing sgrib pa med la ma 'dres pa'i nam mkha' khyab par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa la gtor cing mngon par gtor la mngon par rab tu gtor to/ /gtor cing mngon par gtor la mngon par rab tu gtor nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ lan grangs med par bskor ba byas nasang)/rang rang gi smon lam las byung ba'i seng ge'i khri la 'khod do/ /shar phyogs ji lta ba de bzhin du lho dang / nub dang / byang dang / shar lho'i mtshams dang /lho nub kyi mtshams dang / nub byang gis45)mtshams dang / byang shar gyi mtshams dang / steng dang 'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang yin pa de dag kyang 'gul/ rab tu 'gul/ kun tu rab tu 'gul/ g.yos rab tu g.yo ni/ kun tu rab tu g.yon/ ldeg rab tu ldeg /kun tu rab tu ldeg /chem chem/ rab tu chem chem/ kun tu rab tu chem chem/ 'khrug /rab tu 'khrug /kun tu rab tu 'khrug /'ur 'ur/ rab tu 'ur 'ur/kun tu rab tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag re re nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 9'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul 1 phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed lhags sol/ /byang chub sems dpa' re re'i 'khor yang byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi 64—662

rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed lhags so/ /byang chub sems dpa' re res kyang nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po'i sprin rnam pa tha dad pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjod 1)pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po ②bcu'i tshad tsam gyi char gyis chags ripa med cing sgrib pa med la ma 'dres pa'i nam mkha' khyab par byas nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ byang chub sems dpa' re res kyang nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po'i sprin so so yang dag par rig pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa rjod cadapa stong gsum gyi stong chen po bcu'i tshad tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa la gtor cing mngon par gtor la mngon par rab tu gtor to/ /gtor cing mngon par gtor la mngon par rab tu gtor nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal 5te/ lan grangs med par bskor ba byas nas rang rang gi smon lam las byung ba'i seng ge'i khri la 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi 46gtsug tor dang / mdzod spu dang / mtshan dang / dpe byad chubazang po re re dang / ba spu'i khung bu re re nas kyang 8'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mchoXrno rdul phra rab kyi rdul lta shin tu nyung gi/ de bas ches mang ba'i 9byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho dag byung ste/ de dag thams cad kyang lus 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi mdog can gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa bas lhag pa/dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la rnam par rtse ba/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mdog yongs su grub pa mtha' yas pa sgrub pa'i gzungs thob pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas mi bzhugs pa dag tu sangs rgyas 'byung ba ston pa 'jig rten gyi 64wa 663

khams kun nas nyon mongs pa can yongs su sbyong ba pad ma'i stan la 'khod pa sha stag go/ /pad ma re re yang rin po che thams cad kyis spras pa sdong bu rnam pa sna tshogs pa nor bu rin po che'i ze ba can gser gyi 'dabatum bkod pa shin tu rgyas pa'i gzugs can 'dzam bu tsho chu bo'i gser gyi snying po dang ldan pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs kyis phyogs thams cad kyi sprin snang bar byed pa/ kun nas 'od zer bkod pa sangs rgyas kyi yul mtha' yas pa'i gsung brjod pa'i 'od zer nor bu dang / mu tig dang / rin po che'i phreng ba rab tu 'gyed pas mdzes par byas shing gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan bsgreng ba sha stag go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis 'od zer rgya mtsho 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa btang nas pad ma de dag las babs te/lha'i gdugs kyi sprin dang / rgyal mtshan gyi sprin dang / ba dan gyi sprin dang /me tog gi sprin dang / spos kyi sprin dang / rin po che'i sprin dang / rol mo'i sgra'i sprin dang / rgyan gyi sprin dang seng ge'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i sprin dang /lha'i sil snyan dang / pheg rin rdob pa dang / glu'i dbyangs kyi sgra'i sprin chags pa med cing sgrib pa med la ma 'dres pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po bcu'i tshad tsam gyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag la gtor cing mngon par gtor la mngon par rab tu gtor to/ /gtor cing mngon par gtor la mngon par rab tu gtor nas lan grangs med par bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas lan grangs med par bskor ba byas te/ rang rang gi pad ma'i stan la 'khod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i nang du chud pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i 'jig rten gyi 64—664

khams dag nas byung ba de dag thams cad kyang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par byas pa sha stag go/ /de nas 'khor de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i nang du chud pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams sangs rgyas kyi mthus bdag cag gis mthong na ci ma rung snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sems kyi yongs su rtog pa thugs kyis mkhyen nas gtsug tor nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i nang du chud pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams ston pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer 'khor 'od zer grangs med pa dag byung ste/ des phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byamatsham)thams cad snang ba chen pos khyab par byas nas/ bdud kyi gnas thams cad mog mog por byas so / /sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul ba thams cad kyang bstan te/ sems can gyi khams mtha' yas pa yongs su smin par byas nas/ yang phyir log ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la lan grangs med par bskor ba byas nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de midag gi lus la phog par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi lus la 'od zer des phog ma thag tu yang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi mdzod spu dang / gtsug tor dang / mtshan dang / dpe byad bzang po re re dang / spu'i khung bu re re la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mcho'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul lta shin tu nyung gi /de bas ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho dag na mes 'jig na pa dang /64—665

chus 'jig pa 1dang / rlung gis 'jig rin pa dag mthong ste/ dper na 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 'bum phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho srid pa'i rtse mor thug par ra bas bskor te/ rdo dang / gsog ma dang / gyo mo med cing ske/ lag mthil ltar mnyam par gyur nas rdul phra rab kyi rdul gyis gang ba la 'jig rten gyi khams gang dag ritu me'i 'jig la pa dang / chu'i 'jig 5pa dang ske/ rlung gi 'jig 6par mthong ba 7de dag ni ra ba de'i nang gi rdul phra rab kyi rdul gcig lta bur blta bar bya'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de dag las 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gnas pa ni rdul phra rab kyi rdul lhag ma ji snyed yod pa tsam du blta bar bya'o/ /de la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che skar 'od las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che glog gi sgron ma las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che nyi zla'i sgron ma las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che snang ba thams cad 'dus pa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che ze ba can las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che seng ge'i ze ba las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che seng ge'i nardo rje'i rtse mo las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che 9 brgya byin thogs pa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che lha thams cad 64wa 666

kyi 'od las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che rdo rje'i 'od las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che pad ma rā 1 ga las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che chu 'dang las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po chemachon/las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che be+e drur+ya 4rilas grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che an da rnyil las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che mthon ka chen po las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che rdo'i snying po las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che dpal gyi snying po las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi phyinakhams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che mdzes bkod las grub pa yin no / /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni 6)mu tig dkar po las grub pa yin nol/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni mu tig gser mdog las grub pa yin nom/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni mu tig nam mkha' 7rimadog las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po 8)che bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod 9pa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che ye shes kyi tshogs rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod pa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod 1 ripa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig 64—667

rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po ches 1rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod pa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che gzungs rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod pa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che rnam par thar pa rgya mtsho pagrangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod pa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che so so yang dag par rig pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod pa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che mngon par shes pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod50pa las grub pa yin no//'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che smon lam rgya mtsho gegangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod pa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che brtson 'grus rtsom pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod pa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che dbugs 'byin thob pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod pa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che byang chub sems dpa' la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod pa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod pa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che sems can gyi bsam pa dang / spyod pa la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod pa las grub pa yin 61—668

no / /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che 'jig rten gyi khams la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod pa las grub pa yin no/ /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni nor bu rin po che bskal pa la 'jug pa rgya mtsho grangs med pa'i khyad par bstan pa brjod pa las grub pa yin no / /'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho la la ni 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul phra 1mo re re la zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhing thams cad kyi rdul snyed du sna tshogs su gnas pa dag snang ngo / /zhing re re tshonan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bsam gyis mi khyab pa cibadag snang bar gyur te/ zhing thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi kha dog tu gnas pa dag snang ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang dag gis byang chub tu sems bskyed du bcug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa slob tu bcug pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang snang bar gyur tog/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na byang chub tu sems bskyed du bcug pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang yin pa de dag kyang snang ngo / /de bzhin du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das53)gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa phyi ma'i mthar thug pa'i bar du bstan kyang sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa de dag gi mtha' bstan par mi nus so//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das re re la yang 'khor cagyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dpag tu med grangs med pa dag 6snang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'am de dag gi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho rnam pa sna tshogs bstan pa gang yin pa de dag kyang thos so/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi mngon par rdzogs par byang 64wa 669

chub pa yang snang ngo / /de dag gi byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dag kyang snang ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi byang chub kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho rnam pa sna tshogs bstan pa gang yin pa de dag kyang thos so/ /byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi 1mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa dag kyang snang ngo ske/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das re re'i byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa grangs named pa dag kyang snang ngo / /de dag gi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnam pa sna tshogs gang yin pa de dag kyang snang zhing thos so/ /de bzhin du ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi 4sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa yang bskal pa rgya mtsho 'jig rten gyi khams thams 5cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi bar du bstan kyang mthar phyin par mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sku dang ye shes chags pa med pa brnyes pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de dag 'di snyam du sems te/ byang chub sems dpa' gang dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas mos par byed cing 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / 'don pa dang / 'don du 'jug pa dang / mar me dang / bdug pa dang / spos dang / me tog phreng dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / chos gos dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas mchod pa de dag gi bsod nams ji 46tshosnyed cig 'phel bar 'gyur zhig gu snyam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sems kyi yongs su rtog pa thugs kyis mkhyen nas / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul 61—670

'bum7)phrag bye ba khrag khrig grangs med pa snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul lta shin tu nyung gi /de bas ches mang ba'i 5byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtshokhudag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba pha rol tu phyin pa lnga las byung ba bskal pa dpag tu med grangs ④med pa'i bar du bskyed pa yang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' tha na dud 'gro'i skye 5gnas su gyur pa la zan 6chang gcig tsam yongs su btang 7bas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba pha rol tu phyin pa lnga las byung ba de zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal dper na zla ba yar gyi ngo tshes bcwa nalnga'i nam phyed kyi dus na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis 'di ltar mtho ba dang / mtshungs pa med pa dang / che bas skar ma'i 'khor thams cad zil gyis gnon te/ lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nger 'dug go/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'di ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba mtho ba dang / mtshungs pa med pa dang / che bas byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi 9rdul snyed kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba pha rol tu phyin pa lnga las byung ba rnams zil gyis gnon te/ lham me/ lhan ne/ lhang nger 'dug go/ /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' gang la las/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad dbyug pas bsnun tam/ mtshon gyis btab ste3 rim/ bdog pa thams cad phrogs 11pa bas/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' gzhan zhig gis byang chub sems dpa' la gnod sems dang / tha ba dang ske/ khro ba'i sems bskyed de brnyas 12pa'i sems kyang bskyed na 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa mang po 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub 61—671

sems dpa'as 1)byang chub sems dpa' la gnod sems dang / tha ba dang /khro ba'i sems bskyed pa dang / brnyas 5pa'i sems bskyed pas ni chos kyis phongs par 'gyur ba'i las byas par 'gyur te/ chos ma yin pa yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ro/ /chos ma yin pa du 3yongs su 'dzin pa ni sangs rgyas kyi gdung gcod par byed pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas rnams ma byung na rgyal chen bzhi'i lha'i ris rnams 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ / sum cu ( kyirtsa gsum pa rnams dang /'thab bral ba rnams dang / dga' ldan pa rnams dang / 'phrul dga' ba rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rnams dang / bdud kyi ris rnams kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zla ba dang nyi ma thams cad kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'khor los sgyur bab dang / stobs kyis snena'akhor los sgyur 7ba rnams kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /mi'i 'jig rten yang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag thams cad ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang phrad pa las 'byung la/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni byang chub sems dpa' las 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de bas na sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod par 'dod pas ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod pa byas na sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bkur sti byas na sangs rgyas thams cad la bkur ste byas par 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' gang la las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed la lha'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa dang / lha'i 64—672

na bza' phul te/ sbyin pa de lta bu bskal pa rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rdul snyed kyi bar du phul la/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan zhig gis ni byang chub sems dpa' la dmigs pa gang yang rung ba zhig gis byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ bdug pa las dmigs pa'am/ mar me las dmigs pa'am/ me tog las dmigs pa'am/ spos las dmigs pa'am/gzhan gang yang rung ba zhig las dmigs te/ byang chub tu sems bskyed na 'di ni de bas ches grangs med pa'i 1bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur na gzhan skyed du 'jug pa gang yin pa dag lta ci smos te/ 'di ni de bas bsod nams ches grangs med pa skyed par 'gyur ro/ /snga ma des pani bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa riX'adi'i brgya'i char yang mi phod stong gi char yang mi phod/ 'bum gyi char yang mi phod bye ba'i char yang mi phod/ bye ba brgya'i char yang mi phod/bye ba stong gi char yang mi phod/ bye ba 'bum gyi char yang mi phod de/ dpe dang rgyur yang la/mi bzod do/ /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' gang la las sems can thams cad byang chub 5kyi sems la bkod la/ byang chub sems dpa' gzhan zhig ni stong pa nyid la mos par gyur na 'di ni de bas 6)ches grangs med par bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur na gzhan mos pa skyed 7du 'jug pa gang yin pa dag lta ci smos te/ 'di ni de bas bsod nams ches grangs med par skyed par 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa snga ma de ni bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa 'di'i brgya'i char yang mi phod/ stong gi char yang mi phod/ 'bum gyi char yang mi phod/ bye ba'i char yang mi phod/ bye ba brgya'i char yang mi phod/ bye ba stong gi char yang mi phod/ bye ba 'bum gyi char yang mi 61—673

phod de/ dpe dang rgyur yang mi bzod do/ /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' gang la las byang chub sems dpa'i zan bcad dam/ khros te tha na byang chub sems dpa' glang po cher skyes pa de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas la bskyed pa gcig bcad la/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' gzhan zhig gis ni chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / don gyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / brgyad pa dang /rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir tsho1 mi 'ong ba dang /dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas 'jig rten 2)gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi zan bcad de/ khros nas lhung bzed dang / chos gos med par byas la / sems can thams cad long bar byas na mi dge ba'i las 'di ni snga ma'ilo nomi dge ba 4de'i brgya'i char yang mi phod pa nas/ dpe'i bar du yang mi bzod dol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong dang /dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma de dag dang / lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' ⑤lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / brgyas yibyin dang /tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten skyong ba dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa rnams ri nidang ske/ phyogs tha dad pa nas lhags pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho grangs med / tshad med pa rnams yi rangs ten / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /mdo'i rgyal po chen po sprin chen po'i le'u re re 'dzi)/chos snang ba'i sgo stong phrag gang gā'i klung grangs med pa'i bye ma snyed yang dag par 'du bya ba snang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 1 dpal gyi glog gis gsal bar byas pa'i le'u chen po'i 11tshogs mtha' yas pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las dga' ldan 64wa 674

na gnas pa la sogs pa 'jig rten grangs med pa dang 'thun ①par 'jug pa'i stobs la sbyor ②ba'i mthu las byung bas dbang byed cing / phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rgya ma31 'dus pa'i dga' ston chen po la rtse ba zhes ①bya ba'i le'u ste sum cu byartsa bdun pa rdzogs sos// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po su rin dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo ts+tsha ba ban de 6)ye shes sdes zhu/sa te gtan 'a/ phab pa/ ༄ga /'phags pa sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ha)༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ma hā me gha bā yumatshosamaṇ+ḍa la ga ) pa ri brta sarba nā ga skṛ med yam0nā ma ma hā yā na suskonatra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa sprin chen 3)po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa 7dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgya mtsho chen po na nor bu rin po che'i rtse mo can gyi khang pa brtsegs pa na/ klu stong du tshang ba'i klu'i tshogs chen po klu thams cad kyang rdzu 'phrul che zhing klu'i 'khor chen po dang ldan pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang /klu'i rgyal po nye dga' dang / klu'i rgyal po yang dag sgul nyi )dang / klu'i rgyal po glog phreng can medang / klu'i rgyal po gzi can dang / klu'i rgyal po gzi can hurtechen po dang / klu'i rgyal po btang bzung nyi dang / klu'i rgyal po dung dang /64wa 683

klu'i rgyal po e la'i 'dabamanya)ma dang / klu'i rgyal po mtshams bzangs75)dang /klu'i rgyal po stobs kyis rgyu dang / klu'i rgyal po glog 'byung dang / klu'i rgyal po snang ldan gtsug phud 4can dang / klu'i rgyal po sprin chen rnam par 'phrul dang /klu'i rgyal po sprin chen rgyas byed 5dang / klu'i rgyal po 'brug sgrogs 6)dang /klu'i rgyal po charam sku'abyung dang / klu'i rgyal po skar mda' stong dang / klu'i rgyal po dus min sgrogasam nodang / klu'i rgyal po 'brug skad dang / klu'i rgyal po glog rab tu gtong dang / klu'i rgyal po sa 'dzin dang / klu'i rgyal po sogs9)ma med dang ske/ klu'i rgyal po legs mthong dang / klu'i rgyal po rnam par snang dang /klu'i rgyal po 'brug chen sgrogs 7dang / klu'i rgyal po 'od chen lam lam dang /klu'i rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid dang / klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang / klu'i rgyal po mdongs bu dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal 'dzin dang / klu'i rgyal po hu1/rnga sgra dang / klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra rnam par sgrogs 12pa'i skad dang / klu'i rgyal po la ba dang / klu'i rgyal po 'dren byed dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal mgrin dang /klu'i rgyal po dpal bzangs kyi dang / klu'i rgyal po sha sho sgra chen dang / klu'i rgyal po ding ding sgra dang / klu'i rgyal po rab 'joms bodang / klu'i rgyal po char 'byung dang / klu'i rgyal po rlung chen rnam par 'phrul dang / klu'i rgyal po rlung rab tu gtong dang / klu'i rgyal 15po 'jog po dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal ldan dang / klu'i rgyal po smad dkris bzang dang / klu'i rgyal po bkra shis dang /klu'i rgyal po sprin rgyas dang / klu'i rgyal po sprin gyis dga' byed dang / klu'i rgyal po sprin gyis 'gebs pa'i rigs dang / 16klu'i rgyal po legs par 'gebs dang ske/ klu'i rgyal po rnam par rtse dang / klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bu dang /64wa 684

klu'i rgyal po0tshom dros pa dang / klu'i rgyal po 'od bzangs dun dang / klu'i rgyal 5po mthong dga' dang / klu'i rgyal po don yod dga' dang / klu'i rgyal po sprin gyi dkyil 'khor gyis legs par 'gebs dang / klu'i rgyal po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / klu'i rgyal po sprin las chu 'byin dang / klu'i rgyal po bde mthong dang /klu'i rgyal po rlung 'byung dang / klu'i rgyal po rlung 'khrug par byed gdang / klu'i rgyal po gtsug na nor bu dang / klu'i rgyal po chen po de dag dang / gzhan yang klu'i rgyal po chen po stong dang thabs cig 5tu bzhugs46)te/ de dag thams cad kyang klu'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / klu'i rnam par 'phrul pa chen pos nam mkha' la di ri rir sgrogs shing tsho7)/ rdzi char chen po rab tu 'bebs te/ bcom ldan 'das la mi58)zhu bya ba dang / chos mnyan 9)pa'i phyir lhags so/ /kye klu chen po dang klu dag tshur sheganyi ) /mu lu mu lu tsa ta tsa ta/ pa ṭa pa ṭa/ ma ṭamanyam ṭa/hā / hā/ glog 'bar ba rab tu phyung 1 zhing rdzi char chen po'i rgyun thong la char phobakheshigabo /kye kye klu chen po dag sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa dran par gyis shig /kye klu chen po dag tshur tshur/ tshur sheg tshur shegaskya / 'dzam bu'i 1 tshogling du char nyi rab tu phob shig /gu zu gu khu37/ mu ḍū mu zuri sna/ hi hi hi nyi/ tsu ḍa tsu ḍa sto/ ma hā nā gā hre da da ya/ sarba nā gā nisnyen/ ā narje 0/ san tso da ya/ shi gā na da ra swā hā/ sprin chen po rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyan bkod pa dag gser snam gyi mtha' rin po che thams cad tshon gyi lda ldis 25mdzes pa/ mu tig gi rgyan phreng rab tu 'phyang ba/ rgya mtsho chen po'i sprin dag 2'dang / lha'i rin po ches mdzes par byas pa'i gzhal med khang me tog rab tu 'phyang ba/ rgya mtsho chen 64wa 685

po'i sprin dag gis nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor kun tu khebs par byin gyis rlobs la rin po che'i sprin rab tu 'phyang zhing lha'i ras bcos bu mang po dang mu tig gi rgyan phreng rgya mtsho chen po'i sprin dag dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa zab mo sna tshogs kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis sgra sgrogs 1pa rgya mtsho'i sprin dag dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi rgyan bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam pa sna tshogs yang dag par ston pa'i rin po che bkod pa chen po rgya mtsho'i sprin dag gis nam mkha'i dkyil kun tu khebs par byin gyis brlabs te/ sprin chen po rnam par 'phrul pa'i sgra sgrogs 2pa rgya mtsho'i sprin dag dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi lha'i bla re dril bu'i sgra snyan pa sgrogs 4pa rgya mtsho'i sprin dag dang / bya'i tshogs thams cad skad 'byin cing me tog gi char chen po rab tu 'bebs pa rgya mtsho chen po'i sprin dag dang / rgya mtsho sprin chen pos sgra cher sgrogs shing ri lha'i rin po che rab tu 'phyang la/ mu tig gi lda ldi rnam pa sna tshogasamatharab tu 'phyang ba / rgya mtsho'i sprin dag dang / gser skud kyis brgyan pa'i snang ba chen po can gyi rtse mos nam mkha' kun tu khebs par byed pa rgya mtsho chen po'i sprin dag dang ske/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi phreng ba'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis nam mkha' kun tu khebs par byed pa la mkhas pa rgya mtsho'i sprin dag dang / snang ba dang ldan pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i sgras kun tu khebs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i sprin dag gis nam mkha' mngon par khebs par gyis shig /klu dang klu'i rgyal po thams cad tshur shog /sa'i steng 'dir 'brug sgra sgrogs shig /char phob shig /char rab tu phob shig /char kun tu rab tu phob shig di ri rir sgrog 8shig /glog chen po snang ba rab tu phyung shig /'du zhing kun tu 'du la tog yar dir dir 64wa 686

zhing 'dug ste klu'i skad chen po—yid——bye —rte /zhe (rte — rmye rterno —rte ——rterno ge(rngo — ———— dbyangs chen po rab tu sgrogs 1pa dag 'dzam bu'i gling du char rab tu phob shig /gha ḍa gha ḍa ghi ḍi snyi ḍi/ hu ḍū hu ḍū/ gu ḍū gu ḍū/ ga ḍa ga ḍa/ gi ḍi gi ḍi2/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ tsa ṭa tsa ṭa/ pa ṭa pa ṭa/ kye kye klu dang klu chen po dag tshur tshur/ tshur sheg tshur sheg /dhu dhu dhu dhu/ hā hā hā hā/ tī tī/ hū hū ni/ hūṃ hūṃ/ 'brug sgra chen po sgrogs shing 5rlung chen po rab tu gtong bdag sangs rgyas kyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob shig swā hā tsho/ kye kye klu dang / klu'i rgyal po dag klu thams cad la yang dag par bskul gyis na'adzam bu'i gling du char phob shig9 / ghu ḍū ghu ḍū / pha ḍa pha ḍa/hā hā/ te nye11/ klu chen po dag 'dus shig /sa'i steng du char rab tu phob shig /gu ru ghu ru/ ki ri ki ri/ tsi ri tsi ri/ mi ri mi ri rna/ di ri di ri/ki li ki li/ zhing thams cad yongs su gang bar gyis shig /'bru dang / shing ljon pa dang / rtswa 1 dang shing gel pa dang / sman thams cad rab tu skye bar gyis shig /byams pa'i sems kyis tshur sheg /sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang /chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang / lag na rdo rje'i bden pa dang / klu thams cad kyi bden pas klu chen po dag tshur sheg /tshur sheg1 /klu'i rgyal po mdongs bu la yang dag par bskul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob shig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid la yang dag par bskul lo/ /chos kyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob shig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas la yang dag par bskul lo//dge 'dun gyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob shig swā hā/64wa 687

klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bu la yang dag par bskul lo/ /lag na rdo rje'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char 1)rab tu phob shig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po 'jog po la yang dag par bskul lo/ /tshangs pa'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob shig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po dpal mgrin la yang dag par bskul lo / /dbang po'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob shig swā hā/klu'i rgyal po sa srung gi bu la yang dag par bskul lo/ /khyab 'jug gi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob shig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po phreng ba can la yang dag par bskul lo/ /drag po'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob shig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can la yang dag par mibaskul lo/ /drang srong gi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob shig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po skrag 'bros byedam la yang dag par bskul lo/ /lha'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob shig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal (gepo gzi can chen po la yang dag par bskul lo/ /klu thams cad kyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob shig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po rab 'jomasashor la yang dag par bskul lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob shig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po thams cadamo )la yang dag par bskul lo/ /srin po'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob shig swā hā/ klu gong ma gong ma thams cad kyi bden pas char rab tu 7phob shig /char phob shig /ma 'phyi bar tshur shegan / tshur sheg9 /kye kye klu chen po dag klu thams cad kyi snying po la yang dag par bskul lo/ /kun nas drang ngo / /sa ra sa ra/ hā hā dhu ma dhu ma/ hā hā hā hā/ hi hi nyi hi/ e h+ye ti/④ tha tha tha/ tsa tsa tsa 64wa 688

rata / zhing thams cad kun tu gang bar gyis shig /'bru0)thams cad kyi char phob shig /rlung chen po rab tu thong shigazhu / dru ma byu ma/ byung byung /bum bumanya/ ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ni bā ra ṇi/ stam bha ni/ mo ha ni/ rdzu'achogyu li/ bu ga gshesi/ bra hā 46)/ ma tang gi/ dza ye bi dza ye/ hā hā swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen snying po dpal gyi gzi brjid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen rab 'joms57dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin 'byung dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen ④snying po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen kun tu 'gebs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug chen7sgrogasnyedang /de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen rgyas mdzad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug chen rnam par sgrogs77pa'i sgra'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'jig mdzad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen srung dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen rnga sgra dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug chen sgra dang /de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen dpal gyi gzi brjid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen dbyangs snyan dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen skar ma'i rgyal po dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen tshub 32ma'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen shin tu brtan pa'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen brtan pa'itshwa dga' bar mdzad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'ur 'ur sgra dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'jigs pa'i sko'ajigs mdzad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen thog tog rab 'bebs (snyedang /de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen rnam par 'phrul pa'i78rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen bkra shis kyi ched hu 7dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin 64wa 689

gyis brlabs 1)dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis〈mibarlabs sakyikyi phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen po sprin chen snying po thams cad la yang dag par bskul lo/ /klu thams cad kyi bden pas klu thams cad kyi snying po la yang dag par bskul lo/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' lung gis myur du sheg shig /kye kyi555klu dang klu chen po dag tshur sheg tshur sheg(6) /hu lu hu lu/ su ru su ru/ dha pa dha pa/ gha ra gha ra/ bhu ru lhune ru/ ma 'phyi bar sangs rgyas kyi bden pas tshur shegan /chos kyi bden pas tshur sheg /dge 9'dun gyi bden pas tshur sheg1 sdu /klu thams cad dang / klu chen po gong ma gong ma dag gi bden pas 'dzam bu'i 11gling du char phob shig /a la la zhes 3gegar byed cing ske/ a la la zhes glu 12len pa dang / a la la zhes klu'i mirnam par 'phrul pa chen po byed gecing 'du la/ char gyi rgyun chen po 'bebs par byedatsha klu chen po rnams kyi chos kyi sgra yid du 'ong ba ston pa gang 1 / gu lu gu lu/ nā ge nā ge/ ste tsan ta 1snyenā ga ni/ ha ha ṭi shi/ nā ga nā gi ni nā ge(/t+ta/ sarba nā ga bisdom sgyum bha de 1/ ma ra ṇa ṭa ra ṇa ṭā re/ ṭā ra ṭa ra/ ṭā re ka bi la/ ke ṣi/bi ka te daji/ bha ya nā ye/ a skad nye/ a yid nye/ mā bi lam ba tha/ bi ṭu da re na/ go ra re 3 bi ni sku/ ka li zhugs ka le/ gardzi te t+t+waṃ/ sarba me gha bim kurba ṇi/ saṃ tso 2shed na 9/ sarba k+ṣe tra ra chos pū 21ra ṇi/ tsakri/ tsakra brte(rte/ he ru he ru tshon/ bi gi ba bi / sma ra sma ra/ kā li kā li/ ma hā kā li/ skṛ da ya gi/ pra ba tha po/ ad te/ mad te/ sarba nā ga/ a kun+ta ṇi/ pu ra ya pū ra ya/ hū ma hū ma/ rat+na tra ya bi ku te/ badzi ṇi/ badz+re ṇi/ badz+ra badz+rake pā ṇir / kā la sho dā 9re/ nā ga rū pi ṇi tsho/ su ru51pe/ bho gi sgo52gi/64wa 690

ma hā bho gi /bho ga rus 1)pa ta yari / ba le/ bste ṇitshe// sarba nā ga sastso cad ni swā hā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma byuṇ+ḍar+sā)badz+ra pā 956)ye/ ban dha banane ridha / su rū 58)pe/ ka li rū ri9)pa ni/ swā hā/ chos smra bas thog ma kho nar srung ba'i cho ga byas la/ chos gos gyi grwar /tsho )lan bdun bzlas brjod byas te/mdud pa bor nas rlung 31gi dkyil 'khor gyi32/ le'u klul thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba 'di/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du rgyun ma chad ༅par bklag tshapar bya'o / /shar phyogs su ni ba lang gi lci bas klu'i rgyal po mgo gsum pa/ zhes bya ba 'khor dang bcas te bri b.ram bya'o/ /lho phyogs su ni klu'i rgyal po rab tu rgyas byed ces bya ba mgo lnga pa 'khor dang bcas te bri bar bya'o/ /nub phyogs su ni klu'i rgyal po snang ldan gtsug phud nya tshocan zhes bya ba mgo bdun pa 'khor dang bcas te bri bar bya'o/ /byang phyogs su ni klu'i rgyal po sprin bskulasngo zhes bya ba mgo dgu pa 'khor dang bcas te bri bar bya'o/ /bla re /6dang / gos sngon po dang ske/ rgyal mtshan sngon po dang / lha bshos thams cad kyang sngon por bya'o/ /klu rnams la dbab pa ni mngar ni gsum gyis bya'o/ /mngar 31gsum gyi dgang blugs du nyebadun yang klu'i snying pos sbyin bsregadza snyebya'o/ /sprin gyi rgyal po rnams kyang bris te char gyi rgyun 'bebs la phan tshun thug cing mthar glog 'gyu zhugebar bya'o / /'dir dbab pas ni khur ba bkra shis ldan dang / pen tse dang / sha dang ske/ nya sha dang / sbrang rtsi las byas pa'i zas mchog rgyas par bya'o/ /de nas chos smra ba gtsang zhing gos gtsang ma bgosam rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po bklag na tshopar bya'o/ /de nas klu rnams dang po'i nyin mo nas brtsams te/ di ri rir sgra sgrogasam par byed cing sgra yid du 'ong ba dag 64wa 691
